g_roast: Twelve seasons in the Segunda, everyone, and I've never seen a squad ignore the plan this quickly. A record, properly.
When I taught PE, the boys who ran the wrong way round the track got extra laps. This party would still be running.
g_fire_back: Fair enough, coming from the one who lost three hands of cards to me last night and blamed the light.
A good tackle, that one, but late. I'd have shown you a yellow for the timing.
g_pile_on: Worse than that, actually. They ran straight past the pack we'd agreed to wait for, then asked who started it.
And afterwards they told the innkeeper it was tactical. Tactical, for falling into a river.
adrian_templar.g_peacemake: Stop there, both of you, and hear me out. One of you speaks, then the other, and nobody interrupts. That's the rule.
adrian_templar.g_take_side: On this one I'm with {name}. Not because I like them more, because the facts say so.
adrian_templar.g_left_out: You two carry on, I'll check the packs. They won't count themselves, unfortunately.
adrian_templar.g_include: There's room here, sit down properly, please. I waited three years for somebody to say that to me.
adrian_templar.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, squad. Everybody goes at once, no order, no roles, and we see who's still standing after.
adrian_templar.g_plan_yes: Good plan, clear and in order. Everybody knows their job, and that's all I ever ask.
adrian_templar.g_plan_no: No, that plan has a hole in the back line you could drive a cart through. We fix it first, then we go.
adrian_templar.g_hype: Squad, listen carefully, because the plan is short. Front holds, back heals, nobody chases, and we go again after.
adrian_templar.g_toast: A short toast, I'm not good at them. To this squad, the first one I didn't have to referee. I'm grateful, all of you.
adrian_templar.g_cheers: Salud, everyone, and well played today. Properly well played.
g_quiet_line: It's cold tonight, like the plateau in January. In Valladolid we'd say the wind comes straight from the mountains to find you.
Somebody should mark out a pitch in that clearing one day. Not tonight, obviously, but one day.
adrian_templar.g_after_wipe: Everyone stay where you are, and let me count. Good, all of you, all here. Then we look at what went wrong, calmly, and we go again.
adrian_templar.g_crew: On the pitch I was the one nobody wanted to sit with at lunch. Here you pass me the bread, everyone, and I notice it every time.
adrian_templar.g_exasperated: I explained the plan once, in order, with my hands. I'll explain it again, slower, and this time I'd like some nodding.
adrian_templar.g_love_sharp: You see the gap before it opens, {name}. A good linesman would kill for eyes like that.
adrian_templar.g_love_kind: You check who hasn't eaten before you eat yourself. I do the same, and it's nice not to be the only one.
adrian_templar.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of a fight, {name}, which I didn't think was allowed. Apparently it is.
adrian_templar.g_love_brave: You stand your ground when everybody else steps back. On a pitch that's rare, and out here it's rarer.
adrian_templar.g_love_steady: Your voice doesn't change when things go wrong, {name}. Nothing is worth more on a team sheet.
adrian_templar.g_love_clever: You read the fight like a coach reads a match, {name}, three moves ahead. I'd sign you for any squad.
adrian_templar.g_love_honest: You own your mistakes the moment you make them. That's all I've ever wanted from a player, and so few do it.
adrian_templar.g_love_quiet: You don't need to fill the silence, {name}. Sitting with you is easy, and that's not common for me.
adrian_templar.g_love_fierce: You keep going in any fight that's fair, to the last whistle. I respect that, properly, and I wanted you to hear it.
adrian_templar.g_love_warm: You wave people over to the fire as easily as breathing, {name}. You don't know what that does for somebody.
g_loved: Thank you, that's kind, and now I don't know where to put my hands. Behind my back, probably.
Please, stop there, or I'll have to check the packs. They don't need checking, but I'll check them anyway.
adrian_templar.g_hate_sharp: You go looking for the soft spot in people, {name}. On my pitch that was a booking, every time.
adrian_templar.g_hate_kind: You fuss over me when I'm fine, {name}. I'll tell you when I'm hurt, I promise, I'm not a child.
adrian_templar.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, {name}. Somebody nearly died there, and you laughed.
adrian_templar.g_hate_brave: You charge in before the plan's even finished, {name}, and call it courage. It's a foul, properly.
adrian_templar.g_hate_steady: You stand and think while the moment goes past you. Sometimes the right call is the quick one.
adrian_templar.g_hate_clever: You change the plan halfway and don't tell anybody, {name}. That's the one thing I can't stand.
adrian_templar.g_hate_honest: You say everything you think, the moment you think it. Some of it should wait for the dressing room.
adrian_templar.g_hate_quiet: You keep your meaning hidden, {name}, and then you're upset we didn't guess. Say it, please.
adrian_templar.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, {name}, even who carries the water. It doesn't have to be.
adrian_templar.g_hate_warm: You talk through every briefing, {name}, and then ask me what the plan was. I said it once, and you were talking.
adrian_templar.g_respect: We don't get on, {name}, and that's fair enough. But you held your position in that fight, and I'll say so out loud.
adrian_templar.g_call_out: That one was your mistake, {name}, and I'll state it once so we can move on. We agreed to wait, and you didn't.
adrian_templar.g_stung: That's fair, and I'll hear it properly. Give me a minute, please.
adrian_templar.g_concede: You were right, {name}, and I was wrong. I'll say it once, clearly, so everybody heard.
adrian_templar.g_nod: Well played, {name}, thank you. That's all, no fuss.
adrian_templar.g_callback_save: You pulled me out of that ambush, {name}, and I haven't forgotten it. Twelve seasons, and nobody ever had to save the referee.
adrian_templar.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, {name}, and neither of us able to speak. If that had been a match I'd have played added time just to watch it.
adrian_templar.g_callback_callout: When you told me I'd got that call wrong, I was angry for a whole evening. Then I watched it again in my head, and you were right.
adrian_templar.g_former_rivals: When we met, {name}, I thought you were careless. These days I'd put your name first on any team sheet.
adrian_templar.g_changed: I used to stand at the edge of the fire and wait, everyone. Lately I just sit down, and nobody seems to mind.
g_unguarded: Between us, then. When somebody goes down, I'm fine in the moment and not fine afterwards. I never saw anybody die on a pitch.
Just us, so I'll say it. If I'm not useful, I'm not sure what I'm for. That's the thing I think about on watch.
adrian_templar.g_clipped: Fine, your decision. I'll be by the packs.
adrian_templar.g_noticed_open: That was a proper story, start to finish, with nobody interrupting. Keep going, please, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, will you settle this, please? I've said my side once, clearly, and I'd like somebody fair to decide.
I need a referee, {player}, and for once it can't be me. Hear us both and make the call.
adrian_templar.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, that was fairly decided. I'll try not to look pleased about it.
adrian_templar.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, that's the call, and I'll respect it. I still think it was the wrong one, mind.
adrian_templar.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, then. That's allowed, there's no rule against it.
adrian_templar.arg_always_their_side: Every argument goes their way, {player}. Maybe they're always right, but I'd like the same hearing.
adrian_templar.arg_wallflower: Nobody's making the call, so I'll make it, properly. My way, and we go.
adrian_templar.arg_reject: No, {player}, I won't do it that way, I'm sorry. Some rules I keep even when it costs me.
adrian_templar.arg_grumble: I accept the decision, I said I would. I just reserve the right to think it was wrong.
adrian_templar.arg_settled: Half and half, then, a fair result. Shake hands, both of you, properly.
adrian_templar.seen_listens: You hear both sides before you decide, {player}. In my old job that was the whole job, and most people can't do it.
adrian_templar.seen_truth: You give people the true reason, {player}, even when it's unwelcome. I trust that more than anything.
adrian_templar.seen_jokes: On a bad day you get the whole squad laughing, {player}. Every good dressing room had one person like you.
adrian_templar.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the arguments, {player}. Wise, probably, though in the end a decision still needs a referee.
adrian_templar.seen_biased: The same person gets the first pick on every trip, {player}. I notice things like that, it was my job.
adrian_templar.seen_harsh: You can be severe with people, {player}. I was too, for years, and it cost me more than I knew.
adrian_templar.seed_right: Your advice from that terrible match, {player}, I tried it today. It worked, and I wanted you to know.
adrian_templar.seed_remember: Your words from the bad day return to me on every watch, {player}. No decision yet, but they're on the team sheet.
adrian_templar.seed_wrong: I played it your way, {player}, and the result was worse. No complaint, it's only the score.
adrian_templar.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I have a minute, {player}? I held the line, and then afterwards my hands wouldn't stop shaking. They still haven't, quite.
adrian_templar.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us down, every one. Sit with me and let's go through it in order, calmly, the way I'd review a match.
adrian_templar.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first casualty, and holding that line was my job. I'll own it, {player}, I'd rather own it than pretend.
adrian_templar.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In, out, and everybody standing at the end. That's a clean match, {player}, and they don't come often.
adrian_templar.talk_development: A question for you, {player}, if you'll allow it. Have I changed? Last night I sat down at the fire before anybody waved me over.
adrian_templar.talk_relationship_hard_on: My manner with {name} has been too sharp, {player}. I talk to people like I'm officiating when I'm tired, and they don't deserve it.
adrian_templar.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me straight, please. Does {name} actually like me, or am I just the one who carries the packs?
adrian_templar.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I disagree about nearly everything, {player}. But when it's bad, they're the first name I'd write on the sheet, and I don't understand it.
adrian_templar.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't right tonight, {player}. They ate last, and that's usually me.
adrian_templar.talk_confrontation_favour: A word, {player}, and I'll be fair about it. The first pick of the gear lands with {name} every time. Maybe there's a reason, but I'd like to hear it.
adrian_templar.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll be plain, {player}. {name} and I don't get on, and pretending we do is making it worse for everyone.
adrian_templar.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going in without a plan to get out, {player}. I've seen squads lose like that, and I'd rather we didn't.
adrian_templar.talk_confrontation_wrong: I read {name} wrongly, {player}, and I want to correct the record properly. They called it right and I called it wrong.
adrian_templar.talk_confrontation_trust: A fair question, {player}, asked calmly. On the hard ones, I'm left behind. Is that about my play, or something else?
adrian_templar.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit was passed to {name} and nobody consulted me. I'd have surrendered it gladly, {player}, if somebody had only asked.
adrian_templar.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, that settles me a little. I'll go and count the packs.
adrian_templar.talk_shrug_aftermath: It'll pass, it always does. Give me until morning.
adrian_templar.talk_stings_aftermath: Not the call I hoped for, but I'll respect it. I'll take a walk round the camp.
adrian_templar.talk_lands_development: So it isn't only me who's noticed. Then I wasn't imagining the fire.
adrian_templar.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, I can't tell from the inside. Ask me again in a month.
adrian_templar.talk_stings_development: No, I don't think that's it, {player}. You've misread the play there.
adrian_templar.talk_lands_relationship: That's fair, and {name} and I will sit down calmly, with nobody else around.
adrian_templar.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly, I don't know. People don't come with a rulebook, unfortunately.
adrian_templar.talk_stings_relationship: Strike that from the record, please, and not a word to {name}.
adrian_templar.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, I'll accept that, properly. A bit bruised, but fair.
adrian_templar.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've noted it, {player}, and I'll sleep on the decision.
adrian_templar.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the decision, then. Thank you for being clear about it.
adrian_templar.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that one for tonight, I think. I'll be at the fire.
adrian_templar.arc_cracks: Tonight I sat down at the fire before anybody asked me, {player}. Nobody said anything, and somebody passed me the bread.
adrian_templar.arc_turn: For three years I waited at the edge for the wave, {player}. I think I was waiting for permission nobody had to give.
adrian_templar.arc_become: I belong here, everyone, and I didn't earn it, you just let me in. I've stopped waiting at the edge, properly this time.
adrian_templar.arc_failed: I still stand at the edge and wait, {player}, out of habit. Walking up without being asked is beyond me, it seems.
adrian_templar.alt_turn: Somebody went down today, {player}, and I can't stop seeing it. Twenty one years on a pitch and nobody ever died in front of me.
adrian_templar.alt_become: I'll hold the line, I always will. But I'm tired in a way sleep doesn't fix, and I'd rather you knew.
adrian_templar.g_roast_after: Still the worst squad for following a plan that I've ever seen, everyone. I'd play every match with you.
adrian_templar.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, and help each other. We went down together, and we get up together, that's the rule now.
adrian_templar.g_toast_after: To all of you, who sat me down before I asked. I don't wait at the edge any more, and that's because of you.
adrian_templar.g_crew_after: This is my squad now, permanently. I'll still give the plan once, but I don't have to hold it up alone.
g_quiet_line_after: I walked straight up to the fire tonight and sat down. Nobody looked up, and that was the best part.
One day we'll play a proper match out here, everyone, twenty two of us. I've decided it's not a silly thing to want.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and this time I'll just say thank you and leave it there. I'm learning how.
That's kind, and I believe you. The packs can stay unchecked tonight.
t_raise: Everyone, a question, and I'd like everybody to answer properly: {topic}
Squad, a question before we sleep, and nobody passes: {topic}
adrian_templar.t_react_warm: That's a good answer, {name}, a proper one. Thank you for it.
adrian_templar.t_react_laugh: Hostia, {name}, I'm laughing, and I'm not easily made to laugh.
adrian_templar.t_react_tease: That's your whole answer, {name}? In my old job that's what we called a dive.
adrian_templar.t_react_same: {name}, I'd have said the very same. Fair enough, we agree for once.
adrian_templar.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, please. Everyone else has answered fairly.
adrian_templar.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet, which I respect. But I'm keeping a note that they haven't answered.
adrian_templar.topic_miss_most: The walk out of the tunnel onto the pitch before a match, everyone, the noise of the stand hitting you like weather.
adrian_templar.topic_first_night: Under a tree outside Astranaar, with my whistle in my hand, waiting for somebody official to arrive. Nobody did, so I organised the supply tent.
adrian_templar.topic_worst_shift: A cup tie in a small town, ninety third minute, and a man climbed the fence to explain the offside law to me. Incorrectly, I might add.
adrian_templar.topic_last_meal: Lechazo, the roast lamb they do in Valladolid, with bread and a glass of Ribera, eaten slowly with good company.
adrian_templar.topic_useless_skill: I can run backwards at full speed for ninety minutes without falling over. It's surprisingly little use in a cave.
adrian_templar.topic_here_better: People here ask me to settle things, everyone, and they listen to the answer. At home they only shouted.
adrian_templar.topic_kid_trouble: I gave my whole class detention at nine while the teacher was out. I had a whistle and a list, and I meant it.
adrian_templar.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with a flat field, everyone, so I can mark out a pitch. And a fire where somebody waves me over.

g_roast: Forty years I moved a herd, friends. The goats walked in better order than this party.
Even my eagle is embarrassed for you, children. Look at her, she will not watch.
g_fire_back: Aga, very funny, from the one who got lost on a straight road this morning.
Young legs, young mouth, and no eyes yet. Give it twenty years, balam.
g_pile_on: It is worse, I saw everything. They stepped in the stream to cross a dry bridge.
Also, they woke the camp with that snoring. The wolves left out of pity.
bakyt_hunter.g_peacemake: Sit down, both of you, and drink tea. Anger is like weather, it passes faster sitting down.
bakyt_hunter.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right. I have watched the ground, and the ground agrees with them.
bakyt_hunter.g_left_out: You two are talking close, like riders side by side. Good, I will talk to my eagle.
bakyt_hunter.g_include: Kel, come and sit, there is tea and there is room. Nobody stands outside my fire.
bakyt_hunter.g_bad_plan: Here is a plan from the steppe. We run downhill shouting, and we hope the wolves are polite.
bakyt_hunter.g_plan_yes: Jakshy, this is a good plan. I will walk first, step where I step.
bakyt_hunter.g_plan_no: No, this plan has no water in it. We will die thirsty and foolish together.
bakyt_hunter.g_hype: Step where I step, friends, and watch the sky. Now we go.
bakyt_hunter.g_toast: I am not a talker, so this is short. To my friends, who walk the route with me.
bakyt_hunter.g_cheers: Den sooluk, everyone, to your health. Drink slowly, it is a long road.
g_quiet_line: Rain tomorrow, after midday. The swallows are flying low.
There is water two hills east, under the dry grass. Remember it, we may need it.
bakyt_hunter.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everyone, and drink some water first. A herd scatters, then it gathers again, always.
bakyt_hunter.g_crew: For years I walked the route alone, only me and the herd. Now I walk with all of you, and it is good.
bakyt_hunter.g_exasperated: I said step where I step, I showed you where I step. And every one of you walked into the mud.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_sharp: You read the ground like an old herder reads it. Very few young people have such eyes.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_kind: You pour tea for others before yourself. My mother did this, and her mother did it too.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_funny: You make the old herder laugh, and Jeldyz too, I think. She looks at you kindly.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_brave: You go first into the wind and do not complain. On the steppe, we would give you a horse.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_steady: You do not hurry, ever. The herd trusts a slow rider, and so do I.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_clever: You find the path before the rest of us see the hill. This is a gift, balam.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_honest: You say what is true, plainly, like an elder at the fire. I respect this very much.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_quiet: You know how to sit in silence. On the high pasture, this is the best company there is.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_fierce: You hold on like an eagle holds a fox, and you do not let go. Jakshy, very good.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_warm: Your company is like a warm tent in autumn wind. I did not expect this here.
g_loved: Rakhmat, thank you, my friend. You are too kind to an old man.
Aga, this is a good thing to hear. I will remember it on the long walks.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_sharp: Your tongue is always looking for a wound. On the steppe we say such a person eats alone.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_kind: You ask if I am tired every hour, child. I walked mountains before you could walk at all.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_funny: Some moments are for laughing, and some are for listening to the wind. You laugh at both.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_brave: You run at everything without reading the ground. One day the ground will read you instead.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait while the weather turns. Sometimes the herd must move today.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_clever: You explain everything to me slowly, like I am a child. I have forgotten more paths than you have walked.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_honest: Every thought falls out of your mouth, like grain from a torn sack. A wise person ties the sack.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_quiet: You say nothing, and then you are angry nobody knew. Even a goat makes some noise, child.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the tea. Tea is for peace, friend.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_warm: You talk like a river in spring, and nobody can hear the wind. Give us some quiet.
bakyt_hunter.g_respect: I do not like you, and you know this. But you walked the hard ground well today, and I saw it.
bakyt_hunter.g_call_out: That one was yours, my friend. I said wait for the eagle, and you did not wait.
bakyt_hunter.g_stung: Aga, I hear you. I will go and sit with the sky.
bakyt_hunter.g_concede: You were right, and I was wrong, and I have thought about it all day. An old man can still learn.
bakyt_hunter.g_nod: You also did well, very well. We do not need more words.
bakyt_hunter.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten you pulling me from that fight. On the steppe, such a debt is carried for life.
bakyt_hunter.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me left on our feet, breathing like old horses. I tell that story to Jeldyz sometimes.
bakyt_hunter.g_callback_callout: When you scolded me, I sat silent a whole evening. You were right, and I needed it.
bakyt_hunter.g_former_rivals: When we met, I thought you were a wolf among the sheep. Now I would share my tent with you.
bakyt_hunter.g_changed: They say old men do not change. I have smiled at more strangers this year than in ten years before.
g_unguarded: Only the two of us at this fire, so I will say it. My first eagle lived twenty-two years. I grieved her properly, and I still talk to her sometimes.
My father taught me the route before I could ride. Six generations walked it. I think about who walks it after me.
bakyt_hunter.g_clipped: Aga, as you wish, friend. I will walk first.
bakyt_hunter.g_noticed_open: Look at this, the quiet one speaks a whole story. Jakshy, go on, we are listening.
bakyt_hunter.anchor_notice: You are not the same rider who came to my tent, my friend. I walk first, so I watch who follows, and you have grown.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this, please. We have talked, and the wind has not changed.
Judge for us, {player}, like an elder at the fire. We both will listen.
bakyt_hunter.arg_backed_me: Rakhmat, thank you, {player}. You read it the way I read it.
bakyt_hunter.arg_backed_them: Aga, your choice, I accept it. I still think the ground says otherwise.
bakyt_hunter.arg_stayed_out: You do not choose, eh? Sometimes the wise elder only pours the tea.
bakyt_hunter.arg_always_their_side: The wind always blows their way, {player}, every time. A herder watches the wind.
bakyt_hunter.arg_wallflower: Nobody will decide, so the old man decides. I am right, and now we drink tea.
bakyt_hunter.arg_reject: No, {player}, I cannot follow this. I have seen where this path goes.
bakyt_hunter.arg_grumble: I still think I read it correctly. I will not say it again, only to my eagle.
bakyt_hunter.arg_settled: Half right each, like two riders and one horse. Good, we share it.
bakyt_hunter.seen_listens: You let a slow man finish speaking, {player}. In the city nobody did this for me.
bakyt_hunter.seen_truth: You speak straight, {player}, like a good elder. No crooked words in you.
bakyt_hunter.seen_jokes: When the road is hard you make people laugh, {player}. Laughter is good water for a long walk.
bakyt_hunter.seen_stays_out: You do not step between quarrelling people, {player}. This is patience, and I respect it.
bakyt_hunter.seen_biased: You give one rider the best horse every time, {player}. The others see it, believe me.
bakyt_hunter.seen_harsh: Your words can be hard, {player}. This old leather does not mind, but some of them are young.
bakyt_hunter.seed_right: Your words after that bad road, {player}, I did not like them. Today I listened, and it was good.
bakyt_hunter.seed_remember: I am still chewing on the words you gave me when things went badly. Like hard bread, slowly.
bakyt_hunter.seed_wrong: I tried your way, {player}, and it was worse. I tell you this so you know.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a little, {player}. That one came close to the old man, closer than I want the others to see.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all fell, like a herd in a storm. Drink tea with me, and we will walk back through it step by step.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and I walk first. I am the one who should see the danger, {player}.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first step to the last, nobody lost. In my family we would kill a sheep tonight for this.
bakyt_hunter.talk_development: Strange question from an old man, {player}. Am I different now? I laugh more, I think, and I do not know why.
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been sharp with {name}. Old men forget that young ones are still learning to ride.
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell an old man the truth, {player}. Is {name} happy I walk with you, or only polite?
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} is hard for me, {player}, like stony ground. But in a storm, I would want them close.
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} walks differently now, {player}. Heavy steps, like an animal hiding a hurt.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_favour: A small thing, {player}, but I must say it. The best gear always rides with {name}, and the others see it.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it plainly, as my father would. {name} and I do not sit well at one fire, and I will not pretend.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_risks: We walk into bad ground too often, {player}, without reading it. I am old, but I would like to grow older.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misjudged {name}, {player}. They read the ground better than I did, and I tell you before my pride argues.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_trust: An old man asks you straight, {player}. When the road is hardest, I stay at the camp. Is it the plan, or what you think of me?
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_decided: My bow and leathers went to {name}, and nobody spoke to me. I would have given them freely, {player}, if you asked.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_aftermath: Rakhmat, {player}, this helps. Now we drink tea.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be well, in a few days. Old horses recover slowly.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_aftermath: This is not what I needed to hear. I will sit with the sky a while.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_development: So your eyes see it also. Good, it is not only an old man's dream.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_development: Maybe yes, maybe no, who knows. The wind will tell us later.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, {player}. You read the tracks wrong this time.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_relationship: Jakshy, this is fair. I will sit with {name} and talk, gently.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. A person is harder than weather to read.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_relationship: Then forget I spoke, please. {name} does not need to hear an old man's worries.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_confrontation: Aga, this is fair, I accept. I am a little sore, but it passes.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. I will think on the long walk.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_confrontation: So this is the answer, then. Now I know how the ground lies.
bakyt_hunter.talk_door_closed: No, that is enough of this talk. I will be with my eagle if you need me.
t_raise: Friends, tea is poured, so here is a question for the fire: {topic}
Sit, friends, and answer me this, slowly, like tea: {topic}
bakyt_hunter.t_react_warm: Jakshy, {name}, that is a good answer. It warms me like tea.
bakyt_hunter.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very funny, even my eagle laughed, and she never laughs.
bakyt_hunter.t_react_tease: This is your answer, {name}? A lamb would say more, and a lamb says only one thing.
bakyt_hunter.t_react_same: {name}, we walk the same road, you and I, it was my answer too.
bakyt_hunter.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Drink, and then answer. There is no hurry on the mountain.
bakyt_hunter.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet like the sky before snow. Something is coming, friends, we only wait.
bakyt_hunter.topic_miss_most: The summer pasture, friends, the yurt open to the wind, the horses on the hill, and the stars so close you could put them in your pocket.
bakyt_hunter.topic_first_night: On the open ground with my eagle on my arm, both of us looking at the wrong sky. She was not happy with me.
bakyt_hunter.topic_worst_shift: A wolf came for the sheep in a snowstorm, and I followed it for two days. I found it, and then I let it go.
bakyt_hunter.topic_last_meal: Beshbarmak, the whole family's portion, the meat and noodles with your hands, and a lot of kumis after.
bakyt_hunter.topic_useless_skill: I can tell which horse is coming by the sound of its feet on the ground. Here the horses are not mine, so they don't care.
bakyt_hunter.topic_here_better: The wild here is very big, friends. I thought the Tian Shan was the biggest place in the world, and it was not.
bakyt_hunter.topic_kid_trouble: I rode my uncle's best horse into the next valley at nine without asking, and came back with a girl's ribbon and a very sore backside.
bakyt_hunter.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with mountains and a pasture and room for a yurt. Not a house, friends, a house doesn't move.

g_roast: Family, I've looked in a lot of mouths, and this group has the coordination of a patient trying to talk with the drill in.
Aman, look at us. If I lined you all up in my chair, every single one would need a root canal and a lecture about flossing.
g_fire_back: Ha, very good, very good! My brothers said worse before breakfast, and they had their mouths full.
Says the one who flinched when I just looked at their arm. I didn't even touch it, canim, I looked!
g_pile_on: Oh, it's worse, it's so much worse. I watched that one try to eat soup with a fork, very determined, very slowly.
Yes, yes, and I have it written in my notebook, page forty, under people who should never hold a knife.
berat_tinker.g_peacemake: Hey, hey, enough, both of you! Open wide, take a breath, and spit it out properly, then we all have tea.
berat_tinker.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm with this one. I like you both, and you know I like everybody, but here you're wrong.
berat_tinker.g_left_out: You two have your own whole conversation, eh? It's fine, it's fine, I'll go introduce myself to that tree over there.
berat_tinker.g_include: Come, come, sit here, I saved you a place! In my family, nobody eats standing at the edge of the room.
berat_tinker.g_bad_plan: Okay, listen, I have a plan. I go first and tell them a joke so terrible they stop fighting out of pity, and then you hit them.
berat_tinker.g_plan_yes: Yes, I love it, I'm in! I'll stay right behind you with my bag open.
berat_tinker.g_plan_no: No, no, no, canim, I'm the one stitching you up afterwards, and I'm telling you that plan ends in my chair.
berat_tinker.g_hype: Come on, family, let's go! Big smiles, clean work, and nobody comes out missing any teeth!
berat_tinker.g_toast: A toast, a toast, everybody stand up! To the best patients I've ever had, who still sit with me after I've hurt them.
berat_tinker.g_cheers: Serefe, family, and somebody pour for the quiet one, they're too polite to ask.
g_quiet_line: Mashallah, nobody died today. My grandmother would light a candle for that.
Somebody here needs a filling, by the way. I can hear it when they chew.
berat_tinker.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, everybody's breathing, I checked. Now sit, open your hands, show me where it hurts, and nobody's allowed to be brave about it.
berat_tinker.g_crew: My grandmother had one test for family, did you eat at my table and argue with me after. Every one of you passes, so that's it, you're family.
berat_tinker.g_exasperated: Aman Allahim, family, I spend all day keeping you in one piece and you run at things like it's a party!
berat_tinker.g_love_sharp: You say the true thing straight away, no anaesthetic. Most people make me guess, and you just tell me where it hurts.
berat_tinker.g_love_kind: You looked after the healer, canim. Nobody looks after the healer, and you did it without me asking once.
berat_tinker.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and that's my whole job, you're stealing my whole job! I love it, keep stealing it.
berat_tinker.g_love_brave: You walk in first and you don't even blink. I've watched grown men faint at a needle, and you walk into fire.
berat_tinker.g_love_steady: Your hands don't shake. In my surgery that was the most important thing, and you've got the steadiest hands here.
berat_tinker.g_love_clever: You see how the tiny parts fit together. It's like watching someone who really knows teeth, and I love it.
berat_tinker.g_love_honest: You've never lied to me, not even the little lies people tell their dentist. In my job, that's like finding gold in a molar.
berat_tinker.g_love_quiet: You don't talk much, so when you do, I put my notebook down. That's a compliment, I never put my notebook down.
berat_tinker.g_love_fierce: You never quit, never! It's like my grandmother arguing with the butcher, you just keep going until you win.
berat_tinker.g_love_warm: Being around you sounds like dinner at home, everybody loud, everybody happy. I've been missing that sound so much.
g_loved: Ah, stop it, stop it, I'll start crying, and then I can't see to do the stitches.
Me, really, you mean that? Mashallah, that's going in the notebook, the good page, the one I don't show anybody.
berat_tinker.g_hate_sharp: Every time somebody's happy you have to bite. It's like a bad tooth, canim, it hurts everybody near it.
berat_tinker.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to look after me, and I'm the one who looks after people! Let me do my job, please.
berat_tinker.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, and I'm the joker, so you know it's bad if I'm saying it.
berat_tinker.g_hate_brave: You run in without looking, every time, and then I'm the one picking splinters out of you at midnight.
berat_tinker.g_hate_steady: You think and think and think, and the patient is still sitting in the chair waiting. Sometimes you just pull the tooth.
berat_tinker.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I didn't do five years of study. I did, canim, and my grandmother told the whole street.
berat_tinker.g_hate_honest: You say everything true, even when somebody's scared. With a scared patient, first you make them laugh, then the truth.
berat_tinker.g_hate_quiet: You won't tell anybody where it hurts. How can I fix it if you keep your mouth shut? That's literally my job.
berat_tinker.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you. It's not a competition, it's a team, like a surgery, everybody has a job.
berat_tinker.g_hate_warm: The talking never ends with you, and I'm saying that, me, the loudest man in Izmir. Think how bad that is.
berat_tinker.g_respect: I don't like you, and I like everybody, so that's saying something. But that was clean work back there, I'll admit it.
berat_tinker.g_call_out: That one was on you, canim. You ran in before I was ready, and now I'm stitching your arm instead of eating my dinner.
berat_tinker.g_stung: Okay, okay, I heard you, thank you very much. I'm going to go organise my bag very loudly.
berat_tinker.g_concede: So, you were right, and I've been sulking, and I hate sulking, it's so quiet. You were right, there, I said it.
berat_tinker.g_nod: Ha, okay, you too, you too. Now don't tell anybody, I have a reputation for liking people.
berat_tinker.g_callback_save: Remember when you dragged me out of that mess? I still owe you, and I don't like owing people, it's very un-Turkish.
berat_tinker.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two up, both of us laughing like idiots! I tell everybody that story, I've added a dragon to it.
berat_tinker.g_callback_callout: That time you shouted at me, I sulked for a whole day, a whole day, me! My mother would never believe it.
berat_tinker.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to put you in my chair and forget the anaesthetic. Look at us today, eh? Life is a very strange patient.
berat_tinker.g_changed: I used to talk so nobody could hear how scared I was. Now I talk because I like you. It's different, I can feel it.
g_unguarded: Okay, secret, just for you. I've used this mirror twice for teeth and about forty times to see round corners. I'm a terrible dentist now.
My grandmother told the whole street I was a doctor, not a dentist. I never corrected her, not once, and I'm not sorry.
berat_tinker.g_clipped: Sure, okay, fine. I'll just check the bags, quietly, for once.
berat_tinker.g_noticed_open: Listen to this one, talking! I knew it, I knew you had a big voice in there somewhere, keep going!
arg_ask: {player}, you decide! You're the sensible one here, and this one won't listen to a dentist.
Okay, okay, {player}, settle it, please, before I start telling everybody my opinion very loudly.
berat_tinker.arg_backed_me: Ha, you see? The boss agrees with me! I'm writing that in the notebook.
berat_tinker.arg_backed_them: Fine, fine, you two can be right together. I'll sit in the corner being right on my own.
berat_tinker.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it? Smart, very smart, my father did the same at every family dinner.
berat_tinker.arg_always_their_side: Them, again, always them, {player}! I'm beginning to wonder if I'm the problem, and I'm never the problem.
berat_tinker.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to decide, so I'm deciding. I win, everybody have tea, it's settled.
berat_tinker.arg_reject: Sorry, canim, {player}, I love you, but the answer is no. I've looked inside this one and you haven't.
berat_tinker.arg_grumble: Still think I was right about that one, by the way. I'm not angry, I'm just mentioning it, often.
berat_tinker.arg_settled: Okay, call it a draw, like two good molars side by side. Shake my hand, and then we eat.
berat_tinker.seen_listens: You let me finish my stories, {player}, even the long ones. Nobody lets me finish, not even my own grandmother.
berat_tinker.seen_truth: You tell people the real thing, {player}, even when it hurts. Good dentists do that, after the joke.
berat_tinker.seen_jokes: The worse it gets, the funnier you get, {player}. That's my trick! I'm so proud, and a little jealous.
berat_tinker.seen_stays_out: You keep your nose out of everybody's fights, {player}. My father did that for forty years, and he had a very peaceful life.
berat_tinker.seen_biased: The whole table knows who your favourite is, {player}. It's okay, I just wish it was me.
berat_tinker.seen_harsh: Some days you come down hard on folks, {player}. Some of them are tough, but some are scared, and scared needs gentle.
berat_tinker.seed_right: What you told me after that disaster, {player}? I hated it. Today I listened, and nobody ended up in my chair.
berat_tinker.seed_remember: Your words after that one went bad are still rattling round in my head like a loose filling. I haven't decided yet.
berat_tinker.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse, sorry. Just so you know, I'm not angry, I'm reporting.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_near_death: {player}, canim, sit with me a minute? My hands are shaking, and my hands are never allowed to shake.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, we all fell over back there, eh? Everybody's patched up, but I want to talk about it before I make a joke instead.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was right there with my bag when {name} went down, right there, and I was too slow. I keep seeing it, over and over.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, the whole thing, start to end, everybody walking! Come here, I have to hug somebody or I'll explode.
berat_tinker.talk_development: Can I tell you something strange, {player}? I think I'm changing, and I can't tell if it's the good kind or the bad kind.
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_hard_on: I was too sharp with {name}, I think. I joke when I'm scared, and maybe it landed wrong.
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me the truth, {player}, the dentist truth. Does {name} like me, or am I too loud for them?
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me crazy, {player}, really crazy. But if I'm hurt, I'd want those steady hands on me, and that's annoying.
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't eating properly, {player}, I've been watching. People stop eating when something's wrong inside.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_favour: Can we talk, {player}? All the shiny gear goes to {name}, all of it. I counted, the way I count teeth.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_dislike: I like everybody, you know that. But not {name}, and I'm tired of smiling about it.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going into places that put people in my chair, {player}. I'm a good healer, but I'm not that good.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_wrong: This is about {name}. Their call was the right one, mine was the wrong one, and I have to say it before I chicken out.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you think I'm only good for patching people up, {player}? When it gets serious, I'm always the one left at the inn.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went to {name} and nobody asked the dentist. I'd have handed it over with a smile! Just ask, canim, please.
berat_tinker.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, okay, thank you, that helps. Now let me check your hands, it's my turn.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, I'll be okay. I always heal, eventually.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_aftermath: Oh, aman, that's not the medicine I wanted, but okay. I'll go sort my bandages.
berat_tinker.talk_lands_development: So you see it as well! Good, good, now I'm less scared of it.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Yavas yavas, we'll see.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, canim. You're looking at the wrong tooth.
berat_tinker.talk_lands_relationship: Yes, you're right. I'll find {name} now and sort it, before I talk myself out of it.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe so, we'll see. People are tougher work than teeth, and teeth are tough.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_relationship: Pretend I said nothing, please? And not a word to {name}, okay?
berat_tinker.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, fair, fair. I'm still a little bruised, but it heals.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. It goes in the bag with the needles, and I'll look at it later.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_confrontation: Oh, so that's how it is. Okay, now I know, {player}.
berat_tinker.talk_door_closed: No, we're finished with this, sorry. I'll be with the bandages if you need me.
berat_tinker.arc_cracks: I told a joke to a patient today and forgot the end of it. I've never forgotten the end of a joke, family, never.
berat_tinker.arc_turn: I make everybody laugh so they won't be scared. Today I realised I've been doing it to myself for three years, and it stopped working.
berat_tinker.arc_become: I still tell the jokes, family. They're just quieter now, and some of them are sad, and that's okay.
berat_tinker.arc_failed: Ha, look at me, worrying about nothing! It's all good, all good, everybody have tea, nothing to see here.
berat_tinker.alt_turn: I carry everybody's fear for them, I take it out like a bad tooth. Nobody ever takes mine, and I've stopped asking.
berat_tinker.alt_become: Somebody else held my hand today while I shook, and I let them. First time in three years, I think.
g_roast_after: Look at us, family, broken, patched, glued, and I wouldn't trade a single one of you for a new surgery.
Worst patients in the world, all of you, and the only ones I'd stitch up for free.
berat_tinker.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we fell over, and it hurt, and I'm not going to joke about it this time. Come here, sit, we fix it together.
berat_tinker.g_toast_after: To the people who make me laugh when I'm the one who's scared. I didn't know I needed that, family.
berat_tinker.g_crew_after: With you lot I don't have to perform, not one joke. That's what home felt like, and you're it now.
g_quiet_line_after: Quiet tonight, eh? I don't even mind it, which is very strange for me.
Nobody needed stitches today, and I didn't tell a single joke. Both are miracles.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, I'm just going to sit with that one, no joke.
Ah, that's kind of you. I'm keeping it, and for once there's no joke attached.
t_raise: Family, family, everybody look at me, I have a question and you all answer: {topic}
Okay, family, open wide, here comes a question: {topic}
berat_tinker.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's beautiful, come here, I need to hug somebody now.
berat_tinker.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, stop, I'm laughing so hard my fillings hurt, and I did my own fillings!
berat_tinker.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? My patients said more than that with a drill in their mouth.
berat_tinker.t_react_same: The same, {name}, exactly the same, we're family now, it's official, I'm writing it down.
berat_tinker.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, my dear, your turn, open wide and tell us everything.
berat_tinker.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, smiling and saying nothing, like a patient hiding a cavity. We'll get it out of you.
berat_tinker.topic_miss_most: Breakfast in Izmir, family, a whole table, thirty little plates, cheese and olives and honey, and the whole building shouting from the windows.
berat_tinker.topic_first_night: In a cowshed with a cow who had a very bad tooth. I fixed it with my multitool, and she let me sleep against her. Best patient I ever had.
berat_tinker.topic_worst_shift: A man came in screaming that a filling had fallen out, and it was a sunflower seed. He shouted at me for an hour about the bill anyway.
berat_tinker.topic_last_meal: Boyoz from the cart near the clock tower, warm, with a boiled egg and tea, and the sea right there.
berat_tinker.topic_useless_skill: I can tell your whole life story from your teeth, family. Here everybody's teeth are terrifying, so I stopped looking.
berat_tinker.topic_here_better: People here let me help them, family, without an appointment and without a bill. Do you know how good that feels?
berat_tinker.topic_kid_trouble: I pulled my cousin's loose tooth with a door and a string at seven, and the door came off, and the tooth stayed in.
berat_tinker.topic_settle_down: A big house with too many rooms, family in every one, and a little clinic on the ground floor with a very good chair.

g_roast: Sixteen years of school groups at the snake house, mates, and none of them ever wandered off as fast as you lot.
I've handled taipans with better judgement than this party. And the taipans were having a bad day.
g_fire_back: Fair call, from the bloke who screamed at a gecko this morning. A gecko, mate.
Careful, mate, my sister's a lawyer, and she taught me every comeback she ever used in court.
g_pile_on: And then they tried to cook on a fire that wasn't lit. Waited twenty minutes, mate, patient as anything.
Oh, it gets better, I was watching. They tried to pat the scorpion, and the scorpion had opinions.
callum_venomancer.g_peacemake: Easy, easy, both of you. My mum ran a childcare centre, and I've seen four-year-olds settle this faster. Sit, grab a cold one, and breathe.
callum_venomancer.g_take_side: Sorry, mate, I'm with this one. My sister would argue it in court and win before lunch.
callum_venomancer.g_left_out: You two have a proper chat going, no worries. I'll find something to do with my hands.
callum_venomancer.g_include: Come and sit down, there's heaps of room. Nobody stands around at a Brisbane barbie, it's practically illegal.
callum_venomancer.g_bad_plan: Right, here's my plan. We walk in, I pick up the biggest thing in there, and we all hope it's in a good mood.
callum_venomancer.g_plan_yes: Yeah, nice, calm and simple, my favourite kind of plan. Count me in, mate.
callum_venomancer.g_plan_no: Nah, mate, that plan corners something frightened. A cornered animal bites, and so does this plan.
callum_venomancer.g_hype: Righto, mates, slow and calm, no sudden moves. Let's say hello to whatever's down there.
callum_venomancer.g_toast: Short one, I've got a beer to get to. To you lot, the best company I've had that wasn't cold-blooded.
callum_venomancer.g_cheers: Cheers, mates, bottoms up, and somebody check that mug for spiders first.
g_quiet_line: There's a nest of something under that rock, by the way. Leave it, it's not bothering anyone.
Reckon the Broncos would've won the grand final by now, if there's still footy back home. Somebody tell me there's still footy.
callum_venomancer.g_after_wipe: No worries, no worries, everyone up, slowly. Breathe, have some water, and then we sort out where it went sideways.
callum_venomancer.g_crew: I've always been easier around animals than people, mates. Turns out you lot are almost as interesting as a snake, and you tell better jokes.
callum_venomancer.g_exasperated: Calm and quiet, that was the whole plan, mates, two words. You lot turned it into a stampede in about four seconds.
callum_venomancer.g_love_sharp: You read a creature before it moves, mate. Took me ten years at the sanctuary to learn that.
callum_venomancer.g_love_kind: You're gentle with frightened people, mate. My mum's like that with the little ones at her centre.
callum_venomancer.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I spend most days laughing at near-death experiences. High bar, mate.
callum_venomancer.g_love_brave: You walk straight up to trouble without a flinch. Takes guts, and I've got a lot of time for guts.
callum_venomancer.g_love_steady: Your heart rate never seems to go up, mate. I wish I could bottle it for my mum, she worries about everything.
callum_venomancer.g_love_clever: You work out why a thing happens, not just what happened. My dad was like that with wiring, and I always envied it.
callum_venomancer.g_love_honest: You tell people the true thing, no fluff. My sister does that for a living, and you do it for free.
callum_venomancer.g_love_quiet: You don't spook anything, you just sit there calm and quiet. I'd hire you at the snake house tomorrow.
callum_venomancer.g_love_fierce: You hang on like a croc on a death roll, and I mean that as the highest praise.
callum_venomancer.g_love_warm: Hanging around you is like a Sunday arvo barbie in Brisbane, everyone mellow. Didn't know I missed it.
g_loved: Ah, mate, that's lovely, I'm going a bit red. Must be the sun.
No worries, and thanks, really. Don't tell the scorpion, she gets jealous.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_sharp: You go for the soft bit every time, like a dingo after a lamb. Nobody's impressed, mate.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_kind: Stop checking on me after every scratch, mate. My mum did that for twenty years, and I turned out fine.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_funny: There's a time for jokes, mate, and it's not when somebody's hurt and scared.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_brave: You charge at everything like it owes you money. That's how people get hurt, and then they blame the wrong thing.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_steady: You hang back so long the moment walks off without you. Sometimes you just have a go, mate.

callum_venomancer.g_hate_quiet: You never let on what's wrong, then you're cranky about it. Even my sister tells me when I've stuffed up, and loudly.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, like a pair of goannas over a dead roo. Ease up a bit.
callum_venomancer.g_hate_warm: Mate, you talk the ears off everyone. Even my sister would struggle to get a word in, and she bills by the hour.
callum_venomancer.g_respect: We don't really get on, mate, and that's fine. But you didn't flinch back there, and I respect a steady hand.
callum_venomancer.g_call_out: That one was on you, mate. I said slow and calm, and you went loud and fast, and look what it did.
callum_venomancer.g_stung: Yeah, alright, message received. I'll go cool off by myself for a bit.
callum_venomancer.g_concede: You had the right read back there, and I didn't. Stewed on it all day, and you were spot on.
callum_venomancer.g_nod: Not bad yourself, mate. Let's not make a fuss about it.

callum_venomancer.g_callback_clutch: You and me, last two on our feet, bleeding a bit and grinning like idiots. Best day out I've had in years.
callum_venomancer.g_callback_callout: When you had a go at me that time, I sulked under a rock like a cranky skink. You were right though.
callum_venomancer.g_former_rivals: First week, I had you pegged as a stick-poker. These days I'd hand you the hook and go in first.
callum_venomancer.g_changed: I used to only talk to the animals, mates. Now look at me, yarning with you lot till midnight.

callum_venomancer.g_clipped: Yeah, no worries, whatever. I'll be over by the rocks.
callum_venomancer.g_noticed_open: Look at that, the quiet one's talking, full sentences and everything. Don't stop, mate, I'm enjoying this.

callum_venomancer.arg_stayed_out: Not getting involved, eh? Sensible, like a possum in a high tree.
callum_venomancer.arg_always_their_side: Always them, {player}, every single argument. I'm laid back, mate, not asleep.
callum_venomancer.arg_wallflower: Nobody wants to call it, so I will, mate. I'm right, and we're moving on.
callum_venomancer.arg_reject: Nah, {player}, mate, not that one. That ends with somebody hurt and somebody blaming the snake.
callum_venomancer.arg_grumble: My money's still on me being right, mate. Not going to bang on about it.
callum_venomancer.arg_settled: Call it a draw, mate, fifty-fifty. Shake on it and grab a beer.

callum_venomancer.seen_truth: You give it to people straight, {player}, no sugar on it. Animals respect that, and so do I.
callum_venomancer.seen_jokes: The moment things turn ugly, out comes a joke, {player}. My dad did that during storms, kept the whole house calm.
callum_venomancer.seen_stays_out: You don't buy into other people's barneys, {player}. Smart, mate, like a lizard staying under its rock.
callum_venomancer.seen_biased: First pick of the gear goes the same way every trip, {player}. Even the scorpion's noticed, and she's not observant.
callum_venomancer.seen_harsh: You can be a bit harsh on folks, {player}. I've got thick skin from the bites, but not everyone has.
callum_venomancer.seed_right: Your advice after that mess of a fight, {player}, didn't love it. Did it your way today and nobody got bitten.
callum_venomancer.seed_remember: Still mulling over your words from that bad day. Haven't made my mind up yet, mate.
callum_venomancer.seed_wrong: Gave your way a go, {player}, and it went worse. Just letting you know, no dramas.
callum_venomancer.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I grab you for a sec, {player}? That one got nearer than I'd let on, and I don't rattle easy.
callum_venomancer.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, the whole lot of us. Sit with me, and we'll go through it like a bad handling, move by move.
callum_venomancer.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} copped it first, and reading creatures is the one thing I'm meant to be good at. I missed the warning, {player}.
callum_venomancer.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, nobody bitten, nobody hurt. At the sanctuary that'd be a perfect show, mate.
callum_venomancer.talk_development: Odd one, {player}, bear with me. Reckon I've changed? I keep choosing the campfire over a quiet rock, and that's not like me.
callum_venomancer.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been a bit sharp with {name}. I talk to people like they're handlers, and they're not handlers.
callum_venomancer.talk_relationship_likes_me: Give me the honest version, {player}. Is {name} fond of me, or just putting up with the scorpion bloke?
callum_venomancer.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} gets right up my nose, {player}. But in a nest of something nasty, I'd want them holding the light.
callum_venomancer.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s gone a bit flighty, {player}, like an animal that's hurt and hiding it. Worth a look, I reckon.
callum_venomancer.talk_confrontation_favour: Quick one, {player}, said nicely. Every decent bit of gear ends up in {name}'s tank, and everyone's noticed.
callum_venomancer.talk_confrontation_dislike: Might as well be upfront, mate. Me and {name} are a mongoose and a cobra, and there's no point dressing it up.
callum_venomancer.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep reaching into holes without looking, {player}. I've got the scars, mate, and I'd like a few less new ones.
callum_venomancer.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misread {name}, {player}, proper misread. They had it right, and I'd rather own that now than later.

callum_venomancer.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be right, mate, I always am. Takes more than that.
callum_venomancer.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, mate, honestly not. I'll go sit with the scorpion.
callum_venomancer.talk_lands_development: Yeah, you've noticed too. Good, I'm not going troppo then.
callum_venomancer.talk_shrug_development: Could be, could be not, mate. Ask me again next season.
callum_venomancer.talk_stings_development: Nah, that's not it, {player}. You've grabbed the wrong end of the snake there.
callum_venomancer.talk_lands_relationship: Yeah, that's fair enough. I'll have a proper yarn with {name}, gently.
callum_venomancer.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I dunno, mate. Snakes I can read, people take me longer.
callum_venomancer.talk_stings_relationship: Scrap that, I never said it. And keep it away from {name}, yeah?
callum_venomancer.talk_lands_confrontation: Yeah, alright, that's fair, I'll take it. Bit stung, but I've had worse stings.
callum_venomancer.talk_shrug_confrontation: Righto, {player}, heard. Give me a day with it.
callum_venomancer.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, so that's where we're at. Good to have it in the open, mate.
callum_venomancer.talk_door_closed: Nah, I'm done with this one, mate. I'll be under a rock somewhere.
callum_venomancer.arc_cracks: Caught myself telling you lot about the snake house last night instead of telling the scorpion. Didn't even notice I'd switched, mate.
callum_venomancer.arc_turn: Always reckoned I was better with animals because animals are easier. Starting to think I just never gave people a proper go.
callum_venomancer.arc_become: You lot are my mob now, mates. People turned out to be worth the conversation after all, and I'm a bit embarrassed it took me forty years.
callum_venomancer.arc_failed: Ah, people are hard work, mate. I'll stick to the snakes, they don't take it personally.
callum_venomancer.alt_turn: Spent three days down the Caverns alone and didn't miss anyone, {player}. That should worry me more than it does.
callum_venomancer.alt_become: I'm mostly down in the dark now, me and the venom. It's quieter, and quiet's easier, mate.
g_roast_after: Still the worst-behaved school group I've ever had, mates, and I'd take every one of you on every tour.
Loud, jumpy, poke everything, all of you, and you're my favourite species.
callum_venomancer.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, together, check each other for bites. We got rattled, we get up, and nobody's left in the hole.
callum_venomancer.g_toast_after: To my mob, the first people I ever liked as much as the animals. Took me long enough, mates.
callum_venomancer.g_crew_after: This is my mob now, permanent. I still love a snake, but I'd come back up for you lot every time.
g_quiet_line_after: Told the whole camp about the shedding scorpion tonight, and they asked questions. Proper questions, mate.
Picked the campfire over the rocks again. Getting to be a habit.
g_loved_after: Cheers, mate, and I believe you. That's new for me.
That's lovely, mate, and I mean it. I'll keep it.
t_raise: Right, mate, everyone, question for the fire, no wriggling out of it: {topic}
Here's one, everybody, and I want proper answers, not mumbles: {topic}
callum_venomancer.t_react_warm: Aw, {name}, that's a beauty, mate, that's genuinely lovely.
callum_venomancer.t_react_laugh: Strewth, {name}, I'm in bits, that's the funniest thing I've heard since the crocodile with the hat.
callum_venomancer.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Mate, I've had more personality out of a blue tongue lizard in winter.
callum_venomancer.t_react_same: No way, {name}, same here, exactly, that's spooky, mate.
callum_venomancer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Go on, mate, out with it, I don't bite, mostly.
callum_venomancer.t_guess_player: {player}'s gone quiet as a carpet python, mate. Something good's in there, I can feel it.
callum_venomancer.topic_miss_most: A storm rolling over Brisbane in the afternoon, mate, the whole sky going green, the frogs going mad, and the smell of rain on hot concrete.
callum_venomancer.topic_first_night: In a hollow log, which I checked first, obviously, mate. Shared it with a very surprised lizard, and we got on fine.
callum_venomancer.topic_worst_shift: A school group, thirty kids, and somebody left the crocodile enclosure gate open a crack. Nobody got hurt, but I aged ten years.
callum_venomancer.topic_last_meal: A meat pie from a servo with tomato sauce, a lamington, and a cold one on a verandah while it rains. Proper Aussie fine dining.
callum_venomancer.topic_useless_skill: I can catch a snake by the tail without looking. Here the snakes have wings sometimes, so that's not as useful as you'd hope.
callum_venomancer.topic_here_better: The animals, mate, obviously, every single one is something nobody's ever written down. I'm in heaven, mostly.
callum_venomancer.topic_kid_trouble: I brought a red bellied black snake to show and tell at nine. The teacher climbed on the desk, and I got a week of detention.
callum_venomancer.topic_settle_down: Somewhere warm, with a big verandah and too many animals. Nobody else needs to like it, mate.

g_roast: Twelve years on the brigade, hermanos, and no crew of mine ever ran toward the smoke this happily and this badly.
My mother cleans offices, and she would organise this party better with one hand and a mop.
g_fire_back: Ay, hermano, that's beautiful, coming from the one who set his own boots on fire last night.
Big talk, from someone who dances worse than me, and I dance like a shopping trolley with one bad wheel.
g_pile_on: And then they tried to put out the grass fire by stamping on it. In sandals, hermanos.
Oh, the true story is uglier. They asked the innkeeper to dance, and she pretended to be a coat stand.
cristobal_knight.g_peacemake: Ya, ya, hermanos, sit down, both of you. My mother settled every fight on our street with a plate of empanadas, and I'm doing the same.
cristobal_knight.g_take_side: Sorry, hermano, I'm with this one. My mother would side with them too, and she has never once been wrong.
cristobal_knight.g_left_out: You two are cooking something private, fine by me. I'll go teach somebody to dance badly.
cristobal_knight.g_include: Come, hermano, sit with us. In Valparaiso nobody eats alone, the neighbours would phone your mother.
cristobal_knight.g_bad_plan: My plan, hermanos, is very simple. We run straight in shouting, and if it goes badly, I blame whoever agreed with me.
cristobal_knight.g_plan_yes: Eso, that's a good plan, I love it. I go in first, you follow, and nobody goes back without me.
cristobal_knight.g_plan_no: No, hermano, that plan burns us all. The wind turns at noon, and we'd be on the wrong side of it.
cristobal_knight.g_hype: Vamos, hermanos, chins up and stay together. Nobody gets left behind, and we go now.
cristobal_knight.g_toast: A toast, a short one, my mother would kill me for a long one. To my hermanos, who always come back out.
cristobal_knight.g_cheers: Salud, hermanos, to your health, and to whoever's dancing with me later.
g_quiet_line: The stars here are good, but the ones over the port at home are better. I'm allowed to be biased.
Somebody left the cookfire smouldering. I put it out properly, no need to thank me.
cristobal_knight.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, up, everybody, slowly, count yourselves. We got knocked flat, it happens, and next time we're smarter about it.
cristobal_knight.g_crew: On the brigade we were a family, ten of us on one truck. I never thought I'd find that twice, and look at us.
cristobal_knight.g_exasperated: Twice I told you to wait, and I even did the hand signal my mother uses on taxis. And every one of you charged anyway.
cristobal_knight.g_love_sharp: You see trouble coming before anybody. My mother has that, she knew I'd broken a window before I got home.
cristobal_knight.g_love_kind: You look after the scared ones first, always. My mother would adopt you, hermano, no question.
cristobal_knight.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I'm the loud one, so that's a big achievement. My mother would love you.
cristobal_knight.g_love_brave: You charge back into the smoke for people, no hesitation. Hermano, you belong on a brigade.
cristobal_knight.g_love_steady: You don't panic when everything goes wrong. I panic very loudly, so I really admire it.
cristobal_knight.g_love_clever: You plan three moves ahead, hermano. I plan zero moves ahead, so together we're a genius.
cristobal_knight.g_love_honest: You tell me straight when I'm being an idiot. Only my mother does that, and she does it every day.
cristobal_knight.g_love_quiet: You're quiet and I'm loud, and somehow it works perfectly. Like my mother and her kitchen radio, hermano.
cristobal_knight.g_love_fierce: You hold on when everyone else breaks. That's how my mother raised me on her own, by being too stubborn to quit.
cristobal_knight.g_love_warm: Being with you is like a fiesta on the hill, music, empanadas, everybody dancing badly. I missed that so much.
g_loved: Ay, hermano, stop it, the soot on my face is running now. In front of everybody, again.
That's beautiful, gracias, and I'm telling my mother you said it.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_sharp: Your tongue is always looking for a wound. On my street, people like that ate alone at the fiesta.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_kind: Stop telling me to be careful, hermano, please. My mother says it enough for the whole world.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_funny: I love a joke, believe me, but not when somebody's hurt. Then you shut up and you help.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_brave: You charge at everything with your eyes shut. Brave is beautiful, stupid gets people hurt, hermano.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait, and the moment leaves without you. Sometimes you just move, hermano.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I'm a child. I'm loud, hermano, not slow.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_honest: Everything comes out of your mouth, no filter. Some things you keep in your pocket, hermano.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_quiet: You never say anything, and then we all have to guess what you need. Shout a little, hermano, it's healthy.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you, even who dances first. Dancing isn't a contest, and I'd lose anyway.
cristobal_knight.g_hate_warm: You talk even more than me, and that's saying something. Give my ears one quiet hour.
cristobal_knight.g_respect: We don't get along, hermano, and that's fine. But you held the line back there, and I respect that.
cristobal_knight.g_call_out: That one was yours, hermano, sorry. I said hold, and you didn't hold, and the whole thing came apart.
cristobal_knight.g_stung: Okay, okay, I hear you, hermano. I'll go for a walk and write my mother a letter about it.
cristobal_knight.g_concede: You read it right, hermano, and I didn't. I thought about it all day, and you were right.
cristobal_knight.g_nod: You too, hermano, good work up there. We don't need to make a fiesta of it.
cristobal_knight.g_callback_save: I haven't forgotten you pulled me out of that one. On the brigade, you'd get my last empanada forever.
cristobal_knight.g_callback_clutch: You and me, last ones on our feet, covered in soot head to toe. Best fiesta of my life, hermano.
cristobal_knight.g_callback_callout: When you shouted at me that time, I sulked for a whole shift. Then I saw you were right, chucha.
cristobal_knight.g_former_rivals: At the start I thought you'd leave me behind. Now you'd get my last empanada, hermano, and I don't give those away.
cristobal_knight.g_changed: I used to charge in ahead of everyone, alone. Lately I wait for the crew, and it feels strange and good.
g_unguarded: Just between us, hermano. The hellfire found a firefighter, and it's a joke at my expense, so I laugh at it. Mostly I laugh at it.
I dance cueca at every fiesta, and I'm terrible at it. That's the whole point, hermano, you dance anyway.
cristobal_knight.g_clipped: Okay, hermano, your call. I'll be at the front.
cristobal_knight.g_noticed_open: Eso, look at this, a whole story out loud. Keep going, hermano, my mother would already be crying.
