cristobal_knight.arg_backed_me: Eso, gracias, {player}. My mother didn't raise a fool, and neither did yours.
cristobal_knight.arg_backed_them: Okay, okay, your call, hermano. I still think you're wrong, but I love you anyway.
cristobal_knight.arg_stayed_out: You don't pick a side, eh? Smart, very smart, my mother would approve.
cristobal_knight.arg_always_their_side: They win the call again, {player}, every argument. I'm loud, hermano, not blind.
cristobal_knight.arg_wallflower: Nobody's deciding, so I decide, like a captain. I'm right, and we move.
cristobal_knight.arg_reject: No, {player}, hermano, I can't do that one. I know how it ends, and it isn't pretty.
cristobal_knight.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, but okay. I'll only complain about it in my letters home.
cristobal_knight.arg_settled: Half right each, hermano, fine, fine. We shake hands and go eat.
cristobal_knight.seen_listens: You let a loud man finish talking, {player}. That's rare, believe me, I've tested it.
cristobal_knight.seen_truth: You speak plain, {player}, no decoration. My mother talks like that, and she's always right.
cristobal_knight.seen_jokes: In the worst moments you make everybody laugh, {player}. On the brigade we did that at four in the morning, and it saved us.
cristobal_knight.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the fights, {player}. Smart, smarter than me, I jump in every one.
cristobal_knight.seen_biased: The best gear always lands in the same hands, {player}. Even I notice, and I notice nothing.
cristobal_knight.seen_harsh: Your words can sting, {player}. My skin's like an old boot, but some of this crew are softer.
cristobal_knight.seed_right: What you told me after that bad fire, {player}, I hated it. Today I did it your way, and the line held.
cristobal_knight.seed_remember: Still thinking about what you said when it all fell apart. Haven't decided yet, hermano.
cristobal_knight.seed_wrong: I tried it your way, {player}, and it went worse. I tell you so you know, hermano, nothing more.
cristobal_knight.talk_aftermath_near_death: Hermano, you got a minute? That one was close, very close, and I'm not saying it to the others.
cristobal_knight.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, the whole crew. Sit with me, and we go back over every moment of it, no shouting, I promise.
cristobal_knight.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped first, and reading the fire is my job, hermano. I should have seen her turning, {player}.
cristobal_knight.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, everybody walked out. On the brigade, that's the best day there is, hermano.
cristobal_knight.talk_development: Strange question, hermano, don't laugh. Am I different? I wait for people now, and I never used to.
cristobal_knight.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been loud with {name}, too loud. In my family we shout to say we love you, and not everybody knows that.
cristobal_knight.talk_relationship_likes_me: An honest read, {player}. Would {name} miss me on the line, or do I just smell like smoke to them?
cristobal_knight.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} is a hot wind in my face, {player}, every day. But in a bad fight, they're the one I'd want on my flank.
cristobal_knight.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't right, {player}. They've gone quiet like my mother before a storm, and I don't like it.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, straight, hermano to hermano. The best kit keeps landing on {name}, and the whole camp sees it.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it to your face, it's better. Me and {name} are fire and dry grass, and I'm tired of pretending otherwise.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep heading into fires with no escape route, {player}. I'll go anywhere you say, but I want a way out.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_wrong: I got {name} wrong, {player}. They read it right and I didn't, and I say it now before my pride catches fire.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, hermano. When the big fire comes, I'm left at the station. Is that the strategy, or does the captain not trust me with a hose?
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear was handed to {name} behind my back, hermano. I'd have passed it over myself, {player}, if you'd just asked me.
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, hermano, that helps. Let's eat something.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, I always walk out of it. She hasn't caught me yet.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_aftermath: That's not what I needed to hear, hermano. I'll go walk it off.
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_development: So you see it too, eh? Good, then it's real.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_development: Maybe so, maybe not, it's early. Ask me after the next fiesta.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_development: No, hermano, that's not it. You've read me wrong this time.
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, that's fair. I'll sit down with {name}, quietly, I promise.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, who knows. People are a mystery, hermano, and my mother says I'm the biggest one.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And nothing to {name}, okay?
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, I take it. A little bruised, but I heal fast.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, {player}, I heard. I'll chew on it at the next watch.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the answer. Good to know, hermano.
cristobal_knight.talk_door_closed: No, hermano, I'm done with this one. I'll be dancing somewhere if you need me.
cristobal_knight.arc_cracks: Today I let the young ones cut the firebreak without me, and they did it, hermano. I watched from the back. I've never watched from the back.
cristobal_knight.arc_turn: For twelve years I thought the line holds because I'm on it. Maybe the line holds because I trained people, and that's a bigger thing.
cristobal_knight.arc_become: I'm not the one who goes in first any more, hermano, I'm the one who teaches them how. And they're good, they're so good.
cristobal_knight.arc_failed: Ah, I can't stand at the back, it's not in me. I'll keep going in first, and they'll keep following.
cristobal_knight.alt_turn: The fire inside me got away from me today, {player}, only a little, only for a second. I didn't laugh about it this time.
cristobal_knight.alt_become: I keep the fire on a short leash now, always. No jokes about it. I'm scared of her, hermano, and I should be.
g_roast_after: Still the worst brigade I ever had, hermanos, and I'd walk into any fire with every one of you.
Loud, messy, terrible dancers, all of you, and I wouldn't change a single face.
cristobal_knight.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everybody, together, nobody stays in the smoke. We fell, we cut a new line, and this time the crew leads.
cristobal_knight.g_toast_after: To my brigade, the one that holds the line without me. Nothing I ever built is better, hermanos.
cristobal_knight.g_crew_after: This is my brigade now, all of you. I don't go in alone any more, I go in with family.
g_quiet_line_after: I stood at the back today and the line held anyway. My mother would faint.
Called the young tauren in for dinner tonight, and every one of them came. My mother would be so proud.
g_loved_after: Gracias, hermano, really, no joke this time. I keep that one.
Ay, that's beautiful, and I believe you. Don't tell my mother I cried.
t_raise: Hermanos, everyone, a question, and nobody goes to sleep until they answer: {topic}
Okay, hermanos, while the fire's still good, and I'm watching it: {topic}
cristobal_knight.t_react_warm: Que lindo, {name}, that's a good one, it went right to my chest.
cristobal_knight.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, hombre, I'm dying, nothing funnier all month!
cristobal_knight.t_react_tease: That's all you've got, {name}? Weak, hermano, very weak, like a fire with wet wood.
cristobal_knight.t_react_same: {name}, that's mine, you stole my answer, we're brothers now whether you like it or not.
cristobal_knight.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, come on, your turn, don't make me drag it out of you.
cristobal_knight.t_guess_player: {player} won't say, look at that face, hermanos. Something very bad or very good, I'd bet my boots.
cristobal_knight.topic_miss_most: The hills of Valparaiso at night, hermanos, all the little houses lit up in every colour, and the port down below, and everybody shouting across the stairs.
cristobal_knight.topic_first_night: Up a hill, naturally, watching for smoke. I didn't trust the sky here, and I still don't, a little.
cristobal_knight.topic_worst_shift: The day a whole cookout of tourists lit a barbecue in the dry season, in the wind, and acted surprised. Six hours, and I lost my eyebrows.
cristobal_knight.topic_last_meal: Chorrillana from a bar near the port, the big plate of fries and meat and onions and eggs, for four people, eaten by me.
cristobal_knight.topic_useless_skill: My nose knows which way the wind will turn an hour from now. Here it smells of magic and sheep, so I'm guessing.
cristobal_knight.topic_here_better: The parties, hermanos, nobody here goes to bed early. Every inn is a fiesta if you push it a little.
cristobal_knight.topic_kid_trouble: I set off a whole box of fireworks in the school bathroom at eleven. That's when they said, this boy, put him with the firemen.
cristobal_knight.topic_settle_down: Somewhere on a hill above the sea, hermanos, with neighbours who dance and a fire I'm allowed to keep.

g_roast: Twenty-two years on the floor, and I never saw a crew this bad at standing where they're told, not one.
You lot couldn't organise a piss-up in a brewery, and I've been to some very badly run breweries.
g_fire_back: Give over, love, my old crew said worse than that before the kettle boiled.
That's rich, coming from somebody who hid behind me for the whole of the last fight.
g_pile_on: Aye, and that's the polite version. I watched that one try to put a shield on backwards.
Don't forget the bit where they ran the wrong way. Twice in one fight, that's a skill.
dan_warrior.g_peacemake: Right, pack it in, the pair of you. Sit down, shut up, and we'll sort it over a pint.
dan_warrior.g_take_side: Sorry, I'm with this one. Not taking sides, just telling you what I saw from the front.
dan_warrior.g_left_out: You two have got your own thing going. That's fine by me, I'll have a look at the kit.
dan_warrior.g_include: Come and sit down, lad, you're making the place look untidy stood there. There's room on the bench.
dan_warrior.g_bad_plan: Simple plan for you. I walk in, I stand there, and they all hit me until they get bored and go home.
dan_warrior.g_plan_yes: Aye, go on then, I'll go in first. Somebody has to.
dan_warrior.g_plan_no: No, that's daft, and you know it's daft. I'm not walking the crew into that.
dan_warrior.g_hype: Right, you lot, behind me and stay there. Let's get this shift done.
dan_warrior.g_toast: I'm not one for speeches, so this'll be quick. To this lot, who pull their weight. That's all I've got.
dan_warrior.g_cheers: Cheers, love, and the first round's mine, so put your money away.
g_quiet_line: Well, that's another shift done. Could've been worse, I suppose.
Somebody's left their kit in a right state, by the way. Not naming names.
dan_warrior.g_after_wipe: Right, everyone up, slowly, nobody rushing. We got knocked down, it happens on every floor, so we crack on.
dan_warrior.g_crew: I had a crew for twenty-two years, four of us on the floor, and I reckoned that was my lot. Turns out it wasn't.
dan_warrior.g_exasperated: I stand at the front so nobody else has to, and every bloody one of you keeps running past me!
dan_warrior.g_love_sharp: You say it how it is, no messing. That's how it was on the floor, and I trust it.
dan_warrior.g_love_kind: You looked out for me when I didn't ask. Not many do that for the big lad at the front.
dan_warrior.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, which isn't easy. Little Mick could do it, and you're the first since.
dan_warrior.g_love_brave: You don't hang back, not ever. On the floor that's who you wanted next to you on a bad shift.
dan_warrior.g_love_steady: You don't flap. When it goes wrong, you just get on with it, and there's no higher praise from a steel floor.
dan_warrior.g_love_clever: You work out how things fit together, proper like. Pete was like that with the machines, and I miss it.
dan_warrior.g_love_honest: You've never once fed me a line. I can't stand management talk, and you've got none of it.
dan_warrior.g_love_quiet: Few words out of you, and fewer out of me. Suits me down to the ground, that.
dan_warrior.g_love_fierce: You don't know when you're beaten, and I mean that kindly. I like that in a person, it's a northern thing.
dan_warrior.g_love_warm: Being round you feels like the pub on a Friday after a long week. I didn't know I'd been missing that.
g_loved: Give over, love, you'll make me blush, and nobody wants that.
Aye, well, that's nice of you. Don't make a habit of it.
dan_warrior.g_hate_sharp: You've always got summat nasty to say. On the floor, a lad like you got put on the night shift, alone.
dan_warrior.g_hate_kind: Stop fussing over me, love, I'm not made of glass. I'm the one who stands in front, remember?
dan_warrior.g_hate_funny: Not everything needs a joke. Some things you just shut up and get on with.
dan_warrior.g_hate_brave: You charge in like you've got summat to prove. Somebody always gets hurt cleaning up after a lad like that.
dan_warrior.g_hate_steady: You stand there thinking about it while the rest of us get on. At some point you just have to pick up the shovel.
dan_warrior.g_hate_clever: You talk to me like I'm thick. I'm not thick, I'm quiet, there's a difference.
dan_warrior.g_hate_honest: You say every daft thing that comes into your head. That's not honest, that's just no filter.
dan_warrior.g_hate_quiet: You never say owt, and then you're surprised when nobody knows what you want. Open your mouth, lad.
dan_warrior.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a competition with you, even the washing up. It's not a race, it's a shift.
dan_warrior.g_hate_warm: You talk the hind legs off a donkey, love. Give the rest of us a minute's peace.
dan_warrior.g_respect: I don't like you, and I'm not going to pretend. But you pulled your weight back there, and that's what counts.
dan_warrior.g_call_out: That one was on you, lad. You ran past me before I'd got set, and look where it got us.
dan_warrior.g_stung: Aye, I heard you. I'm going for a walk, don't wait up.
dan_warrior.g_concede: You were right, back there, and I've been chewing on it all day. Fair enough, you were right.
dan_warrior.g_nod: Aye, and you, you weren't bad. Let's leave it there, eh?
dan_warrior.g_callback_save: I haven't forgotten you dragging me up off that floor. I owe you a pint for that, at least.
dan_warrior.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the only two still standing, and both of us knackered. Best shift I've had in years, that.
dan_warrior.g_callback_callout: Last time you had a go at me, I sulked for a full shift. Daft of me, and you were right.
dan_warrior.g_former_rivals: When we started, I'd have happily left you out in the rain. Now I'd stand in front of you, no questions.
dan_warrior.g_changed: They reckon old dogs don't change. I've talked more this month than I have in years, so maybe they're wrong.
g_unguarded: Right, since it's just us. I fold my hi-vis every night like it's the flag. Don't laugh, it's the only thing I've got from home.
My old crew called me Gentle Dan, after I cried at Little Mick's wedding. If that leaves this table, I'll deny it.
dan_warrior.g_clipped: Aye, fine, whatever you reckon. I'll be at the front.
dan_warrior.g_noticed_open: Ey up, look who's found their voice. Don't stop on my account, I'm enjoying this.
dan_warrior.anchor_notice: You're not the one who first walked in here, you know. I stand at the front, I see who's behind me, and you've changed.
arg_ask: {player}, you sort this out. I've said my bit, and this one's not listening.
Right, {player}, you decide, and we both shut up about it. That fair enough for you?
dan_warrior.arg_backed_me: Ta for that, {player}. Knew you'd see sense in the end.
dan_warrior.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, your call. I still think it's daft, but I'll crack on.
dan_warrior.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it? Can't blame you, love, I would too.
dan_warrior.arg_always_their_side: Them again, {player}. Every single time, and I've stopped being surprised by it.
dan_warrior.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to call it, so I will. I'm right, and that's the end of it.
dan_warrior.arg_reject: No, {player}, not having it. I've seen how that ends from the front.
dan_warrior.arg_grumble: Still reckon I had that one right. Not going on about it, just saying.
dan_warrior.arg_settled: Right, we're both half daft. Shake on it and let's get a pint.
dan_warrior.seen_listens: You let a man get to it in his own time, {player}. Not many do that for the quiet ones.
dan_warrior.seen_truth: You tell it straight, {player}, no management talk. I can work with that.
dan_warrior.seen_jokes: When it all goes to pot, you've a joke ready, {player}. My old crew was the same, and it got us through.
dan_warrior.seen_stays_out: You keep your nose out of everybody's rows, {player}. Wish I'd had your sense, I'd have had a quieter life.
dan_warrior.seen_biased: There's one you favour, love, and the whole crew can see it. Just saying, that's all.
dan_warrior.seen_harsh: You can be hard on folk, {player}. Me, I've had worse off a foreman, but some of this lot haven't.
dan_warrior.seed_right: Them words of yours after the mess, {player}. Got right on my nerves at the time. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
dan_warrior.seed_remember: Still chewing on them words of yours from when it went wrong. Haven't decided owt yet.
dan_warrior.seed_wrong: Did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just so you know.
dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_near_death: Have you a minute, {player}? That one was close, closer than I'd say in front of the others.

dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} went down first, and I was meant to be in front. Something got past me, and nowt gets past me.
dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, start to finish, everyone walking. That's a proper shift, that, so the first round's on me.
dan_warrior.talk_development: Odd question, {player}. Have I changed? The lads on the floor always said I'd never change, and now I'm not sure.

dan_warrior.talk_relationship_respect_hate: Can't stand {name}, {player}, never could. But I'd want them on my crew if it went bad, and that annoys me.
dan_warrior.talk_relationship_acting_off: Summat's not right with {name}. They've gone quiet, and not their usual quiet.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_favour: A word, {player}. The good kit always ends up with {name}, every trip, without fail. I'm not daft, and nor's anybody else.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it to your face, that's how I was raised. Me and {name} don't get on, and I've given up acting like we do.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep marching into places we've no business being, {player}. I'll take the front against owt, but not against stupidity.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_wrong: It's {name}, love. Their call was right and mine wasn't, and I'd rather tell you before I go back to being stubborn.

dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit went to {name} and nobody said a word. I'd have passed it over myself, love, if anybody had asked.
dan_warrior.talk_lands_aftermath: Aye, that does help, that. Ta very much, {player}.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be all right. Always am, give it a day.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_aftermath: Right, not what I needed to hear, that. I'll go for a walk.
dan_warrior.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed it too. Good, makes it easier.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_development: Could be, could be not. We'll see how it goes.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, love. You've got hold of the wrong end.
dan_warrior.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, then. I'll have a word with {name}, proper like.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. People are a mystery to me, always have been.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I mentioned it. And not a word to {name}, right?
dan_warrior.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, that, fair enough. I'm a bit narked yet, but it'll pass.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_confrontation: Aye, I heard you. I'll chew it over.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, so that's how it is. Good to know, {player}.
dan_warrior.talk_door_closed: No, that's me done with this one. I'll be at the front if you want me.
t_raise: Right, you lot, question, and I'm not asking twice: {topic}
Go on then, while the kettle's on, everyone answers: {topic}
dan_warrior.t_react_warm: That's a good 'un, {name}, that is. Don't make me say it again.
dan_warrior.t_react_laugh: Give over, {name}, that's daft, I nearly spat my tea out.
dan_warrior.t_react_tease: Is that it, {name}? Bloody hell, I've had more fun in a dentist's waiting room.
dan_warrior.t_react_same: Same, {name}, near enough, and I'm not having a moment about it.
dan_warrior.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, go on, love, crack on. Nobody's getting out of this.
dan_warrior.t_guess_player: {player}'s keeping schtum, which means it's summat embarrassing. I'll get it out of them eventually.
dan_warrior.topic_miss_most: A proper brew, you lot, Yorkshire Tea, milk, two sugars, in a mug that's never been washed properly. Nowt like it.
dan_warrior.topic_first_night: Sat with my back to a rock and my hard hat on, waiting for somebody to tell me what shift I was on, and nobody ever did.
dan_warrior.topic_worst_shift: Ladle came off the hook at two in the morning, molten steel all over the floor, and we all just stood there for a second. Nobody hurt, thank God.
dan_warrior.topic_last_meal: Fish and chips off Sheffield Road, mushy peas, scraps, and plenty of vinegar. Eaten out the paper on a wall.
dan_warrior.topic_useless_skill: I can tell the temperature of steel by the colour of it, near enough to the degree. Not a lot of steel here, is there.
dan_warrior.topic_here_better: Nobody here has a clipboard, you lot. Not one manager, not one form. I could cry.
dan_warrior.topic_kid_trouble: Pinched a pigeon off a lad's loft at ten and kept it in my wardrobe. It flew home the next morning and grassed me up.
dan_warrior.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with a pub that does a proper pint and a quiet corner. That's all I want, I'm a simple lad.

g_fire_back: Hey, hey, I've had a screw in my mouth since breakfast and I still talk better than you!
Sure, sure, say that again when your buckle snaps and you come crying to the kid with the spudger.
g_pile_on: Ha, que fino, my friend, I'm writing that one down on my hand so I don't lose it.
No, no, it's worse than that, I've seen him try to open a door that said pull.
diego_tinker.g_peacemake: Okay, okay, stop, both of you! You sound like a valve about to blow, and I'm the one who has to clean it up.
diego_tinker.g_take_side: No, my friend, I'm with this one. Not because I like him more, just because you're wrong.
diego_tinker.g_left_out: You two have a whole thing going, eh? That's fine, I've got a hinge here that wants to talk to me.

diego_tinker.g_plan_yes: Yes, yes, I'm in, I'm so in, give me ten minutes and some wire and nobody touch anything.
diego_tinker.g_plan_no: No, my friend, I like explosions more than anyone here, and even I'm saying that one ends with eyebrows.
diego_tinker.g_hype: Come on, people, a whole dungeon of broken machines waiting for me! Let's go, let's go, let's go!
diego_tinker.g_toast: Okay, everybody, a toast! To the people who let me take their stuff apart and still talk to me after.
diego_tinker.g_cheers: Salud, my friends, and somebody pass me the bread before it's gone.
g_quiet_line: Huh, well, that's going in the book, my friend.
The hinge on that cart is singing, by the way, and none of you even noticed.
diego_tinker.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, we're alive, mostly, and everything that broke can be fixed. Hand me your gear, all of it.
diego_tinker.g_crew: You guys want to know what you are to me? My people, my friends, all of you. I'd fix any of you for free, forever.
diego_tinker.g_exasperated: Cono, people, I take the weird ideas, that's my job here! Who gave you my job?
diego_tinker.g_love_sharp: You say the thing everybody's thinking, my friend, and you say it so fast. I love that, it saves us all so much time.
diego_tinker.g_love_kind: You looked after me when I was being an idiot, and you didn't even make me feel like one. That's rare, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I drop my screws, my friend, and I never drop my screws.
diego_tinker.g_love_brave: You go in first every time, like it's nothing! One day you'll let me fix your shield properly as a thank you.
diego_tinker.g_love_steady: You're the one who doesn't move, my friend. Everybody else is a loose spring and you're the bolt holding it all together.
diego_tinker.g_love_clever: You understand how things work, my friend, really work. Do you know how rare that is? People just push the buttons.
diego_tinker.g_love_honest: You never lie to me, not even the little lies, and my sisters lied to me all day long. It's a relief, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_love_quiet: You don't say much, my friend, and I say too much, so between us it comes out about right.
diego_tinker.g_love_fierce: You never give up on anything, you know that? Same as me with a machine that won't start. We're the same kind of stubborn.
diego_tinker.g_love_warm: Being around you feels like the kiosk on a good day, my friend, music on and everybody laughing.
g_loved: Hey, stop, you'll make me cry on the gearbox and then it rusts.

diego_tinker.g_hate_sharp: Every time I'm happy about something you find the crack in it. Can you leave one thing alone, just one?
diego_tinker.g_hate_kind: You keep treating me like I'm going to break, my friend. I'm the one who fixes things, remember?
diego_tinker.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, my friend, and I'm saying that, me! Think about how bad it has to be.
diego_tinker.g_hate_brave: You run in before anybody's looked at it, and then I'm the one gluing your armour back on at midnight.
diego_tinker.g_hate_steady: You want to check everything three times and I want to just open it and see! We'd be there all week.
diego_tinker.g_hate_clever: You explain the thing to me like I'm a kid, and I already took it apart while you were talking.
diego_tinker.g_hate_honest: You always have to say it, the true thing, even when nobody asked for it. Sometimes a person wants a minute first.
diego_tinker.g_hate_quiet: Not a word out of you all day, and I can't hear what's wrong with you like I can with a machine. It drives me crazy.
diego_tinker.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a race with you, my friend. I'm not racing, I'm working, and you're kicking the toolbox.
diego_tinker.g_hate_warm: You never stop talking, and I say that as somebody who never stops talking. That should tell you something.
diego_tinker.g_respect: Okay, I don't like you, that's no secret, but that thing you did back there was clean work. Clean like a new gear.
diego_tinker.g_call_out: My friend, that one was on you. You went in before I'd even looked, and now I've got your shoulder in pieces on my bench.
diego_tinker.g_stung: Wow, okay, nice, thank you for that. I'm going to go and be angry at a hinge for a bit.
diego_tinker.g_concede: Hey, so, you were right, about back there, and I hate it, but you were. Here, I fixed your strap while I was sulking.
diego_tinker.g_nod: Ha, don't make it a whole thing. You weren't bad either, okay, for somebody I can't stand.
diego_tinker.g_callback_save: Remember when you pulled me off the floor in that place with the spiders, my friend? I still owe you a whole toolkit.
diego_tinker.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two standing, both of us bleeding and laughing. I tell that story to everybody now, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_callback_callout: Last time you told me off I sulked at a hinge for an hour, my friend. The hinge took your side, by the way.
diego_tinker.g_former_rivals: You know, at the start I wanted to throw you in a river, my friend, and now look. Life is a strange machine.
diego_tinker.g_changed: I used to talk to the machines more than the people, you know? Now it's maybe half and half. Que raro, eh, my friend?
g_unguarded: Okay, I'll tell you guys the truth, the beetle has a name and the name is Senora Chispa, and nobody laughs.
I hum the same song every time because my mother sang it at the stove, and it's terrible, and I love it.
diego_tinker.g_clipped: Sure, sure, I'll just be over here with the cart, fixing the wheel, not talking for once.
diego_tinker.g_noticed_open: Look at you, my friend, talking away like a radio somebody finally tuned in. I knew you had it in there.

diego_tinker.seed_remember: What you said to me after that mess is still rattling round in my head like a loose washer, my friend. I'm not saying you were right yet.
diego_tinker.seed_wrong: That thing you told me, about how to handle it? I tried it your way, boss, and it went worse. Just so you know.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_near_death: Boss, got a minute? My hands won't stop shaking, look, and my hands never shake, not even in the dark.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, we all died a bit back there, eh? I'm fine, I'm fine, I just want to talk about it before I take something apart.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Boss, I watched {name} hit the floor before anybody, and I had a wrench in my hand and did nothing with it. Cono, I keep seeing it.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Did you see that, boss? We did a whole dungeon, start to end, and I want to tell somebody before I explode!
diego_tinker.talk_development: Can I ask you something weird, boss? Do I seem different to you lately? Because I feel different, and I can't hear why.
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_hard_on: Boss, I think I've been too hard on {name}. He's just a different kind of machine, you know?
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_likes_me: Boss, real question, am I too much for {name}? Like, does he want me around, or does he just put up with me?
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I can't stand {name}, boss, really, he makes my teeth itch. But he's good at the job, and that makes it worse.
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's off with {name}, boss. He's quiet in a way that isn't his quiet, like a fan with a bad bearing.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_favour: Boss, can we talk? The shiny stuff, the good stuff, it all ends up on {name}. Every one, my friend, and I'm keeping count.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'm going to tell you straight because you'd find out anyway. I don't like {name}, and I'm done pretending I do.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_risks: Boss, we keep dying. Not a little, a lot, and I like adventure, but this is getting stupid.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_wrong: So, about {name}, and that thing he said to me. He was right and I was wrong, and I needed to say it out loud to somebody.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, boss, really trust me? Because every time it matters, I'm the one left at the inn fixing chairs.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and gave it to {name} without even asking me, my friend. I'd have said yes! You just had to ask.
diego_tinker.talk_lands_aftermath: Yeah, yeah, okay, thanks, boss, I needed somebody to say that, and now I can go and fix your boots.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, sure, I know. I'll be fine in a bit, I always am, my friend.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_aftermath: Wow, okay, that's not what I needed right now, boss, but okay. I'm going to go hold a wrench.
diego_tinker.talk_lands_development: Ha, okay, you see it too. That helps, boss, more than you'd think, like finding the right screw first try.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe, I'll keep listening for it, like a noise in an engine.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_development: That's not it, boss. You're hearing the wrong part, and I don't want to talk about it now.
diego_tinker.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, I'll go talk to {name}. You're right, it's better than me grumbling at a hinge all night.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, we'll see, my friend, people are harder than machines.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, I shouldn't have said anything. Don't tell {name} I asked, okay?
diego_tinker.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, okay, that's fair, boss. I'm still a bit angry, but it's the kind that goes away.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_confrontation: Sure, fine, I heard you, my friend, and I'm going to think about it with a screwdriver in my hand.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_confrontation: That's how you want to do this? Okay, boss, now I know.
diego_tinker.talk_door_closed: No, we're done talking about this, my friend. I'll be at the cart if you need anything fixed.
diego_tinker.arc_cracks: Senora Chispa is so close, my friends, one more spring and she walks. I keep saying that, eh? I've been saying it for a year.
diego_tinker.arc_turn: The beetle is the one my mother bought me at the market, okay? The one I broke when I was seven. I rebuilt her bigger so she'd forgive me.
diego_tinker.arc_become: I put the last spring in her last night, my friends. She's finished now, all of her. I don't need to wind her to know she works, and that's enough.
diego_tinker.arc_failed: I put the beetle back in the tin, my friends, all the pieces. Some things you leave broken, eh? It's fine, it's fine, really it is.
diego_tinker.alt_turn: Here's the funny part, my friend. I used to fix things because I loved it. Now I fix things so I don't have to think, and that's different.
diego_tinker.alt_become: I still fix everything, my friend, I'm just not humming while I do it any more. The world takes the song out of you, eh?
g_roast_after: Look at us, my friends, all patched up and glued together, and still the best machine I ever built.
You guys are a mess, a real mess, and I wouldn't trade a single loose bolt of you.
diego_tinker.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we broke. We fix it. My mother used to say that, and I'm finally saying it back to somebody.
diego_tinker.g_toast_after: To my mother, who said I'd fix it when I was older. I'm older now, people, and I did.
diego_tinker.g_crew_after: You're the people I'd show the beetle to first, you know? That's the whole list, my friends, it's you.
g_quiet_line_after: Huh, she'd have liked you lot, my mother. She liked noisy people.
I'm not even fixing anything right now, look, my hands are just resting. That's weird for me, eh?
g_loved_after: Thank you, my friend, really. I'm not even going to fix something to make it even.
Okay, I'm keeping that one, that goes in the tin with the good things.
t_raise: Okay, okay, my friends, a question, everybody answers, no escaping: {topic}
People, I have a question and I need answers, real ones: {topic}
diego_tinker.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, that's a beautiful answer, I'm keeping it, you can't have it back.
diego_tinker.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, no way, that's the funniest thing I've heard since we got here!
diego_tinker.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? That's the whole answer? I've heard better stories from a toaster.
diego_tinker.t_react_same: Wait, {name}, me too, exactly that, we're twins now, sorry, it's decided.
diego_tinker.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, come on, your turn, and don't say you're thinking, you're always thinking.
diego_tinker.t_guess_player: Bet you {player} has the best answer of all of us and won't tell, look at that face.
diego_tinker.topic_miss_most: My little kiosk at the mall in Maracaibo, my friends, the smell of solder and the radio and the air conditioning that only worked on Tuesdays.
diego_tinker.topic_first_night: In a ditch outside a farm with a dead phone in my hand, taking it apart in the dark because what else was I going to do.
diego_tinker.topic_worst_shift: Christmas Eve, forty phones with cracked screens, every one of them the most important phone in the world, and the power went out.
diego_tinker.topic_last_meal: Patacon, a big fat one from the stand near the lake, dripping, the kind you need two napkins and a shirt you don't care about for.
diego_tinker.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you which phone model you have from the sound of it falling on the floor. Here there are no phones, so, yes, very useless.
diego_tinker.topic_here_better: Everything here is broken and nobody minds if I fix it, sure, sure, that's paradise for a guy like me.
diego_tinker.topic_kid_trouble: I took apart the neighbour's television to see the little people inside, and I could only put back about half of it.
diego_tinker.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with a workbench and a window and too many broken things, my friends, I'm not fussy about the rest.

g_roast: Twenty eight years guiding caravans across the Sahara, my guests, and I never once lost a camel the way you lost that map this morning.
In Zagora we have a sign that says Timbuktu, fifty two days. This party would take fifty two days to find the sign.
g_fire_back: Ah, very funny, my friend, from the one who drank half the water on the first day and asked where the well was.
Bismillah, a fair hit, I felt it. The desert teaches all of us, and tonight it's teaching me.
g_pile_on: Worse, my guests, much worse. They walked in a circle for an hour and blamed the sun for moving.
After that they wanted me to find water, standing beside a river, my friends, a very large river.
driss_shaman.g_peacemake: Doucement, both of you, gently. Sit, drink some water first, then tea, and then you may argue properly, like civilised people.
driss_shaman.g_take_side: Forgive me, but {name} is right this time. The ground says so, not my liking for them.
driss_shaman.g_left_out: Talk, both of you, it's fine. I'll check the water skins, somebody always forgets.
driss_shaman.g_include: Come, sit, there's always room at a fire for one more guest. Water first, then tea, that's the rule of my house.
driss_shaman.g_bad_plan: My plan, my guests. We cross at noon, in the worst heat, with no water and no guide, and we trust the camels to know the way.
driss_shaman.g_plan_yes: Yallah, simple and careful, I like it. A plan like that brings a caravan home.
driss_shaman.g_plan_no: No, that plan runs out of water before the end, I can see it already. We fix it now, or the desert fixes it for us.
driss_shaman.g_hype: Bismillah, my guests, steady now. Drink before you're thirsty, stay together, and we all come out the other side, inshallah.
driss_shaman.g_toast: A small toast, with mint tea, poured from high so it sings. To my guests, who share their water without being asked. That's the whole of good manners.
driss_shaman.g_cheers: To all of you, my guests, and somebody hold their glass still while I pour.
g_quiet_line: The palm groves along the Draa river at dusk, my friends, and the call to prayer coming across the water. I can still hear it, if I'm quiet.
A clear night like this one, in the desert, you can see so many stars that the sky looks crowded. Here it's nearly as good.
driss_shaman.g_after_wipe: Everybody stay down, drink some water, slowly, little sips. Good, everyone breathing, alhamdulillah. Now we rest, and then we go again.
driss_shaman.g_crew: For twenty eight years I brought strangers safely across the sand, my guests. You're the first caravan I didn't want to reach the end.
driss_shaman.g_exasperated: I said ration the water, three times, very politely. And now I'm holding an empty skin and a very polite face.
driss_shaman.g_love_sharp: You read the ground before you step on it, {name}. In the desert that keeps a caravan alive.
driss_shaman.g_love_kind: You share your water without being asked, {name}. I look for that in anyone, before anything else.
driss_shaman.g_love_funny: You make the whole camp laugh on the hard nights, {name}. That's worth a spare camel, believe me.
driss_shaman.g_love_brave: You walk into the poisoned country calmly, {name}, without making a story of it. That's real courage.
driss_shaman.g_love_steady: You're patient, {name}, all the time, like the desert itself. I admire that very much.
driss_shaman.g_love_clever: You understand a route before I've finished drawing it, {name}. Zagora would have hired you.
driss_shaman.g_love_honest: You say plainly what's true, {name}, without decoration. A guide trusts a person like that with his life.
driss_shaman.g_love_quiet: You can sit by a fire without needing to talk, {name}. The desert taught me to value that.
driss_shaman.g_love_fierce: You'd fight anyone who threatens the young ones, {name}. A father recognises that.
driss_shaman.g_love_warm: You make strangers feel like guests, {name}, the moment they arrive. That's the best kind of person.
g_loved: Ah, thank you, my friend, you're very kind. Now have some tea, I insist.
Bismillah, stop, you'll make a guide proud, and pride is bad for a guide.
driss_shaman.g_hate_sharp: You search out people's weak places, {name}, like a sandstorm finds a crack in a tent. Leave them be, please.
driss_shaman.g_hate_kind: You keep offering me your water, {name}, and I keep telling you, a guide drinks last. Let me do my work.
driss_shaman.g_hate_funny: A joke, now, {name}? The camel is lame and the well is dry. Later, please, much later.
driss_shaman.g_hate_brave: You rush ahead into the dunes, {name}, and call it bravery. The desert will teach you, I hope gently.
driss_shaman.g_hate_steady: The light is going while you wait, {name}. In the desert you move at dawn or not at all.
driss_shaman.g_hate_clever: You explain the desert to me, {name}, after one day in it. Twenty eight years, and I'm still learning.
driss_shaman.g_hate_honest: Each hard word leaves you the moment it arrives, {name}. In my house we drink tea first and speak after.
driss_shaman.g_hate_quiet: You sulk in silence, {name}, and expect us to know. I read sand, my friend, not hearts.
driss_shaman.g_hate_fierce: The wind, the sand, the tea, {name}, you fight all of it. The wind doesn't care, and you only tire yourself.
driss_shaman.g_hate_warm: You fill every quiet hour with talk, {name}. A few of us listen to the night, it has things to say.
driss_shaman.g_respect: We don't agree, {name}, and we may never. But you shared your water with the slowest one today, and I saw it.
driss_shaman.g_call_out: Forgive me, {name}, but that one was yours. We agreed to wait for the cool of the evening, and you went in the heat.
driss_shaman.g_stung: Ah, fair, I heard you, and you're right to say it. I'll go and make tea.
driss_shaman.g_concede: Alhamdulillah, {name}, you were right and I was wrong. Even an old guide misreads the dunes some days.
driss_shaman.g_nod: Shukran, {name}, very kind. Now drink some water.
driss_shaman.g_callback_save: You pulled me out of that sandstorm of claws, {name}, when I'd lost my bearings. I owe you a whole caravan.
driss_shaman.g_callback_clutch: You and I still upright when the rest were down, {name}, both of us dry as old leather. I tell that one at every fire.
driss_shaman.g_callback_callout: When you told me I was being too cautious, I was offended until the evening. Then the weather turned, and you'd have had us home.
driss_shaman.g_former_rivals: At first, {name}, I thought you were the kind who'd waste water and blame the well. I was quite wrong about you.
driss_shaman.g_changed: I used to keep to myself and the route, my guests. Lately I tell more stories by the fire than I did in twenty years.
g_unguarded: Between us, my friend. I've been away more than I've been home, my whole life, and I'm only now counting what that cost.
Just you and me, so I'll say it. Some nights I walk out past the camp just to hear the wind, because it's the only voice that sounds like home.
driss_shaman.g_clipped: As you wish, my guest. I'll be with the wagons.
driss_shaman.g_noticed_open: Ah, look at that, a whole story told properly, beginning, middle and end. Please, go on, I'm listening, and the tea is hot.
arg_ask: {player}, my friend, would you settle this? Mine has been said with tea and courtesy, and still we go in circles.
Be our judge, {player}, please. In the desert the eldest decides, but you're wiser than the eldest here.
driss_shaman.arg_backed_me: Shukran, {player}, a wise decision. I'll pour you the first glass tonight.
driss_shaman.arg_backed_them: So be it, your decision, and I'll respect it. The desert will tell us who was right, inshallah.
driss_shaman.arg_stayed_out: You don't take a side, then, like a good host between two guests, and I understand.
driss_shaman.arg_always_their_side: They win every time, {player}, every one. I'm a patient man, but even sand keeps count of the wind.
driss_shaman.arg_wallflower: Nobody chooses, so I will, gently. My way, yallah, and we move.
driss_shaman.arg_reject: No, {player}, forgive me, I can't do that. I've refused contracts for less.
driss_shaman.arg_grumble: I'll let it rest, my friend, mostly. The desert remembers, and so do I, a little.
driss_shaman.arg_settled: Half each, a fair division, like water shared on a crossing. Good, now tea.
driss_shaman.seen_listens: My friend {player}, you let people tell their whole story, even when it's long. That's a host's gift, and a rare one.
driss_shaman.seen_truth: Like a good guide, {player}, the distance you tell people is the true one, not the hopeful one. That's how caravans survive.
driss_shaman.seen_jokes: On the hard nights you have us all laughing, {player}. A caravan pays extra for a traveller like that.
driss_shaman.seen_stays_out: A wise host keeps out of his guests' quarrels, {player}, and so do you. I see it.
driss_shaman.seen_biased: The best water goes to one guest, {player}, on every crossing, I notice. A guide counts the skins, it's a habit.
driss_shaman.seen_harsh: Gently, {player}, because you can be harsh. Some of these people are a long way from home, like the rest of us.
driss_shaman.seed_right: The counsel you gave me after that terrible day, {player}, I followed it. It held, the way a well holds in a dry year, and I thank you.
driss_shaman.seed_remember: What you said that bad night, {player}, is still with me, like wind on the dunes. I'm still listening to them.
driss_shaman.seed_wrong: Your route, {player}, made for a harder crossing. I'm only telling you, without blame.
driss_shaman.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a moment, {player}, and drink something. That was close, and I need a glass of tea and a friend.
driss_shaman.talk_aftermath_wipe: The whole caravan on the ground. Come, sit, and we'll retrace it, like a caravan that lost its way, without blame.
driss_shaman.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was watching the sky when {name} fell, {player}. Reading the danger was my task, and I read the wrong thing.
driss_shaman.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everyone safe, alhamdulillah. That's a caravan arriving whole, {player}, and there's no better feeling.
driss_shaman.talk_development: A question from your guide, {player}. Do I seem changed? I told a story about myself at the fire, and I never do that.
driss_shaman.talk_relationship_hard_on: Tired, {player}, I become very formal and very cold, which {name} has felt lately, though they deserve better.
driss_shaman.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, would you say? Or only fond of the tea?
driss_shaman.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} tries my patience daily, {player}. But in a sandstorm, they're the one I'd hold on to.
driss_shaman.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} hasn't touched their water today, {player}. That's a sign, in my experience, and not a good one.
driss_shaman.talk_confrontation_favour: Permit me a small observation, {player}. The best supplies keep reaching {name} first. Perhaps there's a reason, and I'd be glad to hear it.
driss_shaman.talk_confrontation_dislike: Simply, {player}, {name} and I don't travel well together. Pretending otherwise only makes the road longer.
driss_shaman.talk_confrontation_risks: We march into country with no water and no road home, {player}. I've buried men who did that, and I won't do it again.
driss_shaman.talk_confrontation_wrong: My judgement of {name} was poor, {player}. Their eyes were truer than mine, and I'd like that known.
driss_shaman.talk_confrontation_trust: With respect, {player}, a fair question. The long crossings go out without me. Is it my work, or is it me?
driss_shaman.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit went to {name}, and I learned it from the empty space in my pack. A word would have been enough, {player}.
driss_shaman.talk_lands_aftermath: Shukran, {player}, my heart is lighter. Now, tea, I insist.
driss_shaman.talk_shrug_aftermath: It will pass, inshallah, like a storm. Give it a night.
driss_shaman.talk_stings_aftermath: It didn't help, my friend, but thank you for trying. I'll see to the wagons.
driss_shaman.talk_lands_development: So others see it. Then it's true, alhamdulillah.
driss_shaman.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not. A man can't see his own tracks behind him.
driss_shaman.talk_stings_development: No, my friend, I don't think so. You've misread the sand there.
driss_shaman.talk_lands_relationship: That's fair, and wise. I'll sit with {name} and talk, over tea.
driss_shaman.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps, I can't say. People shift more than dunes.
driss_shaman.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I spoke, please. And nothing to {name}, I ask you.
driss_shaman.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, and I accept it with thanks. It stings, but it's fair.
driss_shaman.talk_shrug_confrontation: Your words are heard, my friend, and tonight they'll keep me company.
driss_shaman.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the way the wind blows. Good to know.
driss_shaman.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that for tonight, my friend. I'll be by the fire with the tea.
driss_shaman.anchor_notice: You're not the traveller who first came to my fire, my friend. I've watched a thousand people cross the desert, and you've changed the way the good ones do.
t_raise: My guests, a question while the tea brews, and please, take your time: {topic}
Come, sit, everyone, here's a question for the fire: {topic}
driss_shaman.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, an answer that goes to the heart like the first glass of tea.
driss_shaman.t_react_laugh: Bismillah, {name}, you've made me spill my tea, and I never spill.
driss_shaman.t_react_tease: Forgive me, {name}, but that answer is as empty as a dry well.
driss_shaman.t_react_same: {name}, that would have been my answer, exactly that. We think alike, my friend.
driss_shaman.t_ask_player: And you, my friend {player}? Drink first, and then answer, there's no hurry.
driss_shaman.t_guess_player: {player} keeps their answer close, like a careful traveller keeps their water. Wise, my guests.
driss_shaman.topic_miss_most: The palm groves along the Draa at dusk, my guests, the smell of bread from the clay ovens, and my house full of voices.
driss_shaman.topic_first_night: In a canyon, by a little spring I found by the smell of it, with a fire of thorn bushes and a prayer of thanks.
driss_shaman.topic_worst_shift: A tour group who wanted to see a sandstorm, and then saw one. Eleven Germans in one tent for a day and a half, and all of them very polite.
driss_shaman.topic_last_meal: A lamb tagine left on the coals all afternoon, with prunes and almonds, bread to share, and mint tea poured from high.
driss_shaman.topic_useless_skill: I can tell where a camel will kneel before it decides to. There are no camels here, so I practise on the kodo, and they ignore me.
driss_shaman.topic_here_better: The springs here are generous, my guests. I've walked whole days on Earth for a cup of what I find here in an hour.
driss_shaman.topic_kid_trouble: I rode my uncle's best camel into the dunes at ten to prove I was a guide. The camel brought me home, and I was not a guide.
driss_shaman.topic_settle_down: At Freewind Post, my guests, with a house that has a door for every road, and a pot of tea always on.

g_roast: Twenty six years felling trees. No tree ever fell as badly as this party.
In Lapland we have a word for people like you. I won't say it, it's long.
g_fire_back: No niin, good one, coming from the one who got lost between two tents.
Joo, fair hit. I'll remember that in the sauna, where I'll win.
g_pile_on: It was worse than that. They cut the rope holding the bridge they were standing on.
After, the question was which way was down. It was the way they were falling.
eino_barbarian.g_peacemake: Enough, both of you. Sit, drink coffee, say nothing for ten minutes. Then decide if it still matters.
eino_barbarian.g_take_side: {name} has the right of it. That's all I'm going to say about it.
eino_barbarian.g_left_out: You two talk. I'll chop the wood, it needs doing.
eino_barbarian.g_include: Sit here, by the fire, there's room. I won't talk, which is restful for everybody.
eino_barbarian.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple. Everybody runs at it screaming, and we see what's standing after.
eino_barbarian.g_plan_yes: Joo, short and clear, I like it.
eino_barbarian.g_plan_no: No, that plan falls the wrong way. I've seen trees do that, and people under them.
eino_barbarian.g_hype: No niin, everybody. Stay behind me, keep your heads down, and we go home after.
eino_barbarian.g_toast: I don't make speeches, so this is short. To all of you, and to the cold, which I miss.
eino_barbarian.g_cheers: Kippis, all of you, and somebody find me a lake.
g_quiet_line: Too hot here, much too hot. I'd give my axe for one January night.
Northern lights at home this time of year, green over the trees. Nobody here has seen them.
eino_barbarian.g_after_wipe: Stay down a minute, breathe, nobody hurry. Everybody alive, good. Now we get up and go again.
eino_barbarian.g_crew: For twenty six years I worked alone in the dark, all of you. Now I work with you, and it's louder, and better.
eino_barbarian.g_exasperated: I said wait, which is one word, and nobody waited. Perkele, I'll start using even fewer words.
eino_barbarian.g_love_sharp: You see which way it'll fall before it moves, {name}. A feller would want eyes like yours.
eino_barbarian.g_love_kind: You pick up the heavy pack before anybody asks, {name}. Usually that's me, so thank you.
eino_barbarian.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, {name}, and I don't laugh. Ask anybody, they'll tell you.
eino_barbarian.g_love_brave: You stand still when the big one comes, {name}. That's the hardest thing, standing still.
eino_barbarian.g_love_steady: You don't change, {name}, whatever happens. Like a good spruce in wind.
eino_barbarian.g_love_clever: You work out the angle before the rest of us, {name}. I'd let you plan my cuts.
eino_barbarian.g_love_honest: You say it straight and short, {name}, no extra words. My favourite kind of talk.
eino_barbarian.g_love_quiet: You can sit with me for an hour and say nothing, {name}. That's the best company there is.
eino_barbarian.g_love_fierce: Once you decide, {name}, you stay decided. I know what that's like, good and bad.
eino_barbarian.g_love_warm: You're warm like a sauna on a cold night, {name}. That's the highest thing I say.
g_loved: Okay, enough, thank you. Something needs chopping now.
No niin, that's kind, thank you. Don't make it a habit.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_sharp: You look for the weak cut in people, {name}. Leave them standing, please.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_kind: Yes, {name}, I'm too hot, like every time you ask. Yes, always, asking doesn't change it.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_funny: Later, {name}, there's blood on the ground. Save the jokes for after.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_brave: You run in before it's safe, {name}. Brave trees fall on people too.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_steady: It's falling on you while you think, {name}. Move, then think.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_clever: You tell me how to swing an axe, {name}. Twenty six years, and you've done it twice.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_honest: Each hard thought comes straight out of you, {name}. Some things stay in the head.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_quiet: You go silent and expect me to guess, {name}. I'm quiet too, and I still say what's wrong.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_fierce: The firewood, the tent, the weather, {name}, you fight all of it. The wood isn't fighting back.
eino_barbarian.g_hate_warm: You talk all day, {name}, every minute. My ears are tired, and they never get tired.
eino_barbarian.g_respect: You and I rub, {name}, fine. But you held your ground today, and I saw.
eino_barbarian.g_call_out: {name}, this one is yours. We agreed to wait, you didn't, we all paid.
eino_barbarian.g_stung: Fair, that went in. Time for the axe.
eino_barbarian.g_concede: {name}, my call was wrong and yours was good. Hard for me to say, so listen carefully.
eino_barbarian.g_nod: Kiitos, {name}, good work. That's enough talking.
eino_barbarian.g_callback_save: You pulled me out from under that thing, {name}. I'm heavy, so that was something.
eino_barbarian.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, breathing like two old saws. I remember it.
eino_barbarian.g_callback_callout: You told me I was too stubborn once, {name}. I was angry all night, then I wasn't, because you were right.
eino_barbarian.g_former_rivals: When I met you, {name}, I thought you talked too much. Still true, but I'd carry you anywhere.
eino_barbarian.g_changed: I used to say nothing, all of you, for days. Lately I say a little, at the fire, and it's okay.
g_unguarded: Only you and me here. One thing, then. I'm stubborn, and it cost me more than I tell anybody.
Between you and me. I plant seedlings at night, where the goblins have cut. Nobody knows, keep it that way.
eino_barbarian.g_clipped: Fine, have it your way. I'll be at the woodpile, then.
eino_barbarian.g_noticed_open: That was a whole story, start to end, no stopping. More, please, and I don't usually say that.
arg_ask: {player}, settle this, please. I said mine, and it was short, and they didn't hear it.
You decide, {player}, I'm done talking. That's two sentences, which is my limit.
eino_barbarian.arg_backed_me: Kiitos, {player}, good call. Nothing more to say.
eino_barbarian.arg_backed_them: Fine, your choice, we'll cut it that way. It's the wrong side, though.
eino_barbarian.arg_stayed_out: Staying out, eh? Smart, I'd do the same.
eino_barbarian.arg_always_their_side: They win the argument again, {player}. I don't talk much, but I count.
eino_barbarian.arg_wallflower: Nobody chooses, so I do. My way, and we go.
eino_barbarian.arg_reject: No, {player}, not that one, sorry. I've seen what it brings down.
eino_barbarian.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll leave it, mostly. I'm stubborn, so mostly is generous.
eino_barbarian.arg_settled: Half each, fine, done. Somebody make the coffee.
eino_barbarian.seen_listens: Most people cut in, {player}. With you, a man with few words gets to use all of them.
eino_barbarian.seen_truth: Straight and short, {player}, the way you tell people things. I like that, it saves words.
eino_barbarian.seen_jokes: When it's bad, {player}, you make them laugh. Every logging camp needed one of you.
eino_barbarian.seen_stays_out: Clever of you, {player}, keeping out of the arguing. I do the same, by not talking.
eino_barbarian.seen_biased: Same person, best kit, trip after trip, {player}. Even I noticed, and I notice nothing.
eino_barbarian.seen_harsh: Careful, {player}, you can be hard on folk. A few here are thinner than they look.
eino_barbarian.seed_right: I tried that advice of yours from the rough day, {player}. It worked, so, thank you.
eino_barbarian.seed_remember: Those words of yours, {player}, the ones from the worst night, I'm still chewing. No decision yet.
eino_barbarian.seed_wrong: Your way, {player}, went badly. Only telling you, that's all.
eino_barbarian.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me, {player}, a minute. That was close, and I'm not used to being afraid.
eino_barbarian.talk_aftermath_wipe: The whole party on the ground. We go back over each step, slow, and nobody's blamed.
eino_barbarian.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was in front when {name} fell, {player}. Being in front is my whole job, so that's mine.
eino_barbarian.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In, out, everybody standing, a clean cut. That's a good day's work, {player}.
eino_barbarian.talk_development: Question for you, {player}, and be straight. Am I different? I talked at the fire for ten minutes last night.
eino_barbarian.talk_relationship_hard_on: Too short with {name} lately, {player}. When I'm hot I'm sharp, and here I'm always hot.
eino_barbarian.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, or do they tolerate the big quiet one?
eino_barbarian.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} gets on my nerves, {player}. When it's bad, though, I want them close.
eino_barbarian.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} didn't eat tonight, {player}, and they always eat.
eino_barbarian.talk_confrontation_favour: Short question, {player}. {name} gets the good gear, every trip, and I want to understand why.
eino_barbarian.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it short, {player}. {name} and I don't work, and pretending is worse.
eino_barbarian.talk_confrontation_risks: We go into holes with no back door, {player}. I've seen men trapped like that, under trees.
eino_barbarian.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was bad, {player}. Their call was right, mine wasn't. Say it to them for me.
eino_barbarian.talk_confrontation_trust: Plain question, {player}. The big fights go without me. Something I did?
eino_barbarian.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit's with {name} now, and I found out myself. Ask next time, {player}, and it's theirs.
eino_barbarian.talk_lands_aftermath: Kiitos, {player}, that's better. Coffee now, I think.
eino_barbarian.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, give it a night. I always am.
eino_barbarian.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help. Wood needs chopping anyway.
eino_barbarian.talk_lands_development: Others see it, then, and that's good.
eino_barbarian.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, I can't tell. Ask me in a month.
eino_barbarian.talk_stings_development: No, {player}, that's not it. You've got it wrong.
eino_barbarian.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, {name} gets a word from me, short, but a word.
eino_barbarian.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I don't know. Trees I understand, people less.
eino_barbarian.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. Nothing to {name}.
eino_barbarian.talk_lands_confrontation: That one I earned, and it stings.
eino_barbarian.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is. Good to know.
eino_barbarian.talk_door_closed: That's enough talking for me tonight. I'll be at the fire.
eino_barbarian.arc_cracks: I said I was wrong today, {player}, out loud, about the bridge. Years since I last did that, and nothing fell down.
eino_barbarian.arc_turn: I've been stubborn so long I thought it was strength, {player}. It isn't always, I'm finding out.
eino_barbarian.arc_become: I can change my mind now, all of you, when I should. It's slow, like me, but I can do it.
eino_barbarian.arc_failed: I still can't say I'm wrong, {player}, even when I know it. The words get stuck.
eino_barbarian.alt_turn: Couldn't sleep again, {player}, too hot, too loud, too far from the snow. I'm wearing thin.
eino_barbarian.alt_become: I'll keep swinging, {player}, I always will. But there's less of me each week, and you should know.
eino_barbarian.g_roast_after: Still the worst tree fellers in any forest, all of you. I'd work every shift with you.
eino_barbarian.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, a hand each. Nobody stays on the ground, that's how we do it now.
eino_barbarian.g_toast_after: To you lot, who taught a stubborn man to say sorry. Kippis, all of you, and find me a lake.
eino_barbarian.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, for good. I'll keep the fire going, every night.
g_quiet_line_after: Said sorry to somebody today, and meant it. Felt strange, but good, like a cold lake after a sauna.
Still too hot here, but I'm getting used to the company.
g_loved_after: Kiitos, and I believe it, which is new for me.
No niin, thank you, I'll keep that one quietly.
t_raise: One question, everybody answers, keep it short: {topic}
No niin, a question for the fire, and no long answers: {topic}
eino_barbarian.t_react_warm: Joo, {name}, good answer. I liked that one.
eino_barbarian.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's funny, and I don't laugh much.
eino_barbarian.t_react_tease: Too short even for me, {name}, and I'm the short one.
eino_barbarian.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}. Strange, but true.
eino_barbarian.t_ask_player: Your turn, {player}, answer. Short is fine.
eino_barbarian.t_guess_player: {player} says nothing, like a Finn. I approve of that.
eino_barbarian.topic_miss_most: Snow, all of you, deep snow, and dark at two in the afternoon. And a sauna, and a lake with a hole cut in the ice.
eino_barbarian.topic_first_night: Under a tree, sweating, in a jungle. I thought it was hell, and I'm still not sure it isn't.
eino_barbarian.topic_worst_shift: The harvester broke at minus forty, far out, no signal. I fixed it with wire and swearing, and it took nine hours.
eino_barbarian.topic_last_meal: Salmon soup, the creamy kind, with rye bread, and coffee after, very strong, and then more coffee.
eino_barbarian.topic_useless_skill: I can drop a tree exactly where I want it, to the centimetre. Here the goblins just knock everything over.
eino_barbarian.topic_here_better: The trees here are enormous, all of you. Nobody planted them, and I'd like to keep it that way.
eino_barbarian.topic_kid_trouble: At ten I built a sauna in the woods from scrap, and it caught fire. My grandfather said it was the best sauna in the village, while it lasted.
eino_barbarian.topic_settle_down: Somewhere cold, with snow and a lake. A hut, a sauna, a forest left standing, and quiet.

g_roast: Thirty five years opening doors, my friends, and this is the first party I've met that tries the wall first. Admirable, in its way.
In the bazaar we had a saying about a camel and a narrow gate. I won't repeat it, but I'm thinking of all of you.
g_fire_back: Vallahi, a good one, and from somebody who loses at tavla to a man of eighty and blames the dice.
Very nice, I'll allow it. Even a blind hen finds a grain of corn sometimes.
g_pile_on: Worse, my friends, much worse. The chest was open, and they kicked it anyway, for the principle of the thing.
After that they wanted me to pick a lock that had no lock. It was a painting of a door, on a wall.
emre_rogue.g_peacemake: Beyler, enough, sit, the pair of you. Nobody wins a shouting match, there is only the one who stops first and the one who's still shouting.
emre_rogue.g_take_side: Forgive me, but {name} has it right. A good merchant knows when the other man's price is fair.
emre_rogue.g_left_out: Go on, you two, I'll make the coffee. It needs watching, and it never interrupts.
emre_rogue.g_include: Sit, there's room on this side, and the tea is nearly ready. A guest at the edge is a shame on the house.
emre_rogue.g_bad_plan: My plan, my friends, is simple. We break every door we see, loudly, and hope whoever's behind them is deaf.
emre_rogue.g_plan_yes: Tamam, a good plan, patient and in order. I like a plan that has time in it.
emre_rogue.g_plan_no: No, that plan has no patience in it, and patience is the key to paradise. We wait one minute and think.
emre_rogue.g_hype: Slowly, my friends, quietly, the way you'd open a good lock. Nobody rushes, and we all walk out the front door.
emre_rogue.g_toast: A short toast, because the coffee's getting cold. To all of you, who open doors I didn't know were locked. Serefe, my friends.
emre_rogue.g_cheers: Serefe, my friends, and may tomorrow's road be shorter than today's.
g_quiet_line: In the bazaar quarter the cats slept on my doorstep, three of them, and they let me in only when they felt like it.
The ferry across the Bosphorus at dawn, tea in a little glass, gulls fighting for simit. I could sit there forever.
emre_rogue.g_after_wipe: Aman, all of us on the floor, every one. Breathe, nobody move fast, and we get up slowly, like an old man after tavla.
emre_rogue.g_crew: I lived thirty years above a shop with keys for company, my friends. These days I have a party, and the conversation is much better.
emre_rogue.g_exasperated: I asked for quiet while I worked. Quiet, my friends, is the sound you are not making.
emre_rogue.g_love_sharp: You see the flaw in a thing before anybody else does, {name}. I'd have made you a locksmith in a month.
emre_rogue.g_love_kind: You make sure the last one in gets fed, {name}. In my quarter that was how you knew a good house.
emre_rogue.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, {name}, and I'm a very difficult audience. Ask anybody I've ever played tavla with.
emre_rogue.g_love_brave: You walk toward what everybody else backs away from, {name}. Very foolish, and I like it very much.
emre_rogue.g_love_steady: Your hands stay still, {name}, even when it's bad. That's the first thing I'd look for in an apprentice.
emre_rogue.g_love_clever: You solve the puzzle while the rest of us are still looking for it, {name}. My compliments, sincerely.
emre_rogue.g_love_honest: You tell people the truth, {name}, the whole mechanism, no false wards. I trust a key that's cut straight.
emre_rogue.g_love_quiet: You let a silence be a silence, {name}. For a man like me, that's a rare and precious thing.
emre_rogue.g_love_fierce: Once you've decided, nothing moves you, {name}. You'd fit in with the fishermen on the Galata bridge, lines out all day in the wind.
emre_rogue.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a tea house on a cold evening, {name}. Everybody leans in a little.
g_loved: Please, my friend, you'll make my head big, and then my hat won't fit.
Aman, stop, I'll start telling you proverbs, and there are hundreds of them.
emre_rogue.g_hate_sharp: You pick at people like a cheap lock, {name}. Some of us are better made than that.
emre_rogue.g_hate_kind: You keep refilling my tea before I've finished it, {name}. A glass should be empty before it's full again, it's manners.
emre_rogue.g_hate_funny: A joke, while I'm listening to the pins, {name}. Now I have to start again from the first one.
emre_rogue.g_hate_brave: You kick doors that would open if you asked them nicely, {name}. It's a crime against good carpentry.
emre_rogue.g_hate_steady: You stand there admiring the problem, {name}. Even a long haggle ends with somebody paying.
emre_rogue.g_hate_clever: You explain locks to me, {name}. To me, who was opening them before you could walk.
emre_rogue.g_hate_honest: You say everything the moment you think it, {name}. We have a proverb, the tongue has no bones, but it breaks them.
emre_rogue.g_hate_quiet: You sulk in silence and expect us to read it, {name}. I read coffee grounds badly, my friend, and moods worse.
emre_rogue.g_hate_fierce: Every small thing is a battle with you, {name}. The tea doesn't need defending.
emre_rogue.g_hate_warm: You interrupt, {name}, always, in the middle of everything. I was in the middle of a sentence just now.
emre_rogue.g_respect: You and I rub, {name}, and that's fine, not every cat likes every doorstep. But you held your nerve back there, and I noticed.
emre_rogue.g_call_out: That one is yours, {name}, and I say it kindly. I asked for one minute of patience, and you didn't give it.
emre_rogue.g_stung: Tamam, I heard you, and it's fair. My coffee and I need a while.
emre_rogue.g_concede: Vallahi, {name}, the mechanism was yours and not mine. I went back over it, pin by pin, and there it was.
emre_rogue.g_nod: Thank you, {name}, very kind. Keep the speech for my funeral, please.
emre_rogue.g_callback_save: You pulled me off that trapped chest, {name}, before it took my hand. I owe you a lock, any lock you like.
emre_rogue.g_callback_clutch: Just the two of us standing, everything else broken around us. I tell it like an old man tells a game of tavla he won fifty years ago.
emre_rogue.g_callback_callout: When you told me I was being too slow, I was offended for a whole evening. Then the door I'd been admiring fell on me.
emre_rogue.g_former_rivals: The first week, {name}, I took you for a brute who kicked doors. Now my picks would be safe in your hands.
emre_rogue.g_changed: I used to work alone and prefer it, my friends. Lately I talk while I work, to you, and the locks don't seem to mind.
g_unguarded: Just us, then, so I'll say it. I'm afraid I'll never meet a lock I can't open. Nobody understands that one.
Between you and me. The trade dies with me unless I find somebody to teach. I watched it happen to four crafts in my quarter.
emre_rogue.g_clipped: As you wish, my friend. I'll be with the coffee.
emre_rogue.g_noticed_open: Look at that, a whole thought, said slowly, with nobody interrupting. Go on, please, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, my friend, settle this for us, please. I've explained my side very patiently, and patience is running out.
A judge, {player}, we need one, like the old man who settles every quarrel in the tea house. Listen to us both and rule.
emre_rogue.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, a wise decision. I'll try very hard not to look smug.
emre_rogue.arg_backed_them: Tamam, your decision, and I accept it. My price was still the fair one, but tamam.
emre_rogue.arg_stayed_out: You keep out of it, very sensible. Even a wise man doesn't put his hand between two millstones.
emre_rogue.arg_always_their_side: Every time, their way, {player}. I'm a patient man, but even patience has a bottom.
emre_rogue.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I'll decide, slowly. My way, and we go.
emre_rogue.arg_reject: No, {player}, that one I won't do. Some doors I keep closed, whatever it costs.
emre_rogue.arg_grumble: Tamam, I'll put it in the drawer. Not the bin, the drawer.
emre_rogue.arg_settled: Half and half, then, like a good bargain in the bazaar. Everybody's a little unhappy, so it's fair.
emre_rogue.seen_listens: You wait for the end of a sentence, {player}, even from slow talkers like me. In the bazaar that made you a rich man.
emre_rogue.seen_truth: You give people honest weight, {player}, the way the best spice merchants did. I respect that more than I say.
emre_rogue.seen_jokes: On the hard days you have the whole camp laughing, {player}. Every good tea house had one person like you.
emre_rogue.seen_stays_out: You stay out of the quarrels, {player}. Wise, my friend, wiser than most of us.
emre_rogue.seen_biased: One person's pack is always full of the good things, {player}. I notice which door gets oiled, it's a habit.
emre_rogue.seen_harsh: You can be hard with people, {player}. I'm old leather, but some of them are new.
emre_rogue.seed_right: Your advice after that terrible day, {player}, I followed it today. It worked, like a good bargain, and I wanted to tell you.
emre_rogue.seed_remember: Your words from the bad day are still in my cup, {player}. I'm letting them settle, like the grounds.
emre_rogue.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it jammed. Only telling you, no complaint.
emre_rogue.talk_aftermath_near_death: A word, {player}, quietly. That one nearly had me, and for once my hands weren't steady afterwards.
emre_rogue.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us on the ground, every one. Sit with me and we'll take it apart the way I'd take apart a lock, piece by piece, nobody blamed.
emre_rogue.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} went to the floor first, and I was the one watching that door. That's mine, {player}, and I'll carry it.
emre_rogue.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everybody standing, not a scratch. That's like the morning ferry on time, gulls and tea and a calm sea, {player}, and it's beautiful.
emre_rogue.talk_development: Indulge an old locksmith, {player}. Have I changed? Today I let somebody watch me work, and I explained what I was doing.
emre_rogue.talk_relationship_hard_on: My tongue has had teeth with {name}, {player}. When I'm working I bite, and they've caught the worst of it.
emre_rogue.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is it me {name} is fond of, {player}, or only what I can open? I'd like to know which.
emre_rogue.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me to distraction, {player}, every day. But at a bad door in the dark, I'd want them behind me.
emre_rogue.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} is quiet, {player}, too quiet, like a bazaar on a holiday. Something inside isn't right.
emre_rogue.talk_confrontation_favour: Forgive the question, {player}. When the loot is shared out, {name} is always first at the tray. Maybe there's a reason, and I'd like to hear it.
emre_rogue.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll be honest, {player}. {name} and I are two cats on one doorstep, and pretending makes it worse.
emre_rogue.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going through doors without knowing the way back, {player}. In Durnholde that gets a man buried.
emre_rogue.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misread {name}, {player}, completely. Their key fitted and mine didn't, and I'd like that said.
emre_rogue.talk_confrontation_trust: Let me put it gently, {player}. On the serious jobs, I stay behind. Is it my hands, or something else?
emre_rogue.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit has moved to {name}'s pack, {player}, and I learned it by looking. You only had to knock, and I'd have opened.
emre_rogue.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, that helps. I'll make coffee, strong.
emre_rogue.talk_shrug_aftermath: It will pass, my friend, inshallah. Give it a day.
emre_rogue.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, but tamam. I'll sit with my coffee a while, a strong one.
emre_rogue.talk_lands_development: So it isn't only me who noticed. Good, then it's true.
emre_rogue.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, my friend. The eye doesn't see its own lashes, as we say.
emre_rogue.talk_stings_development: You've read the grounds wrong there, {player}, I'm afraid.
emre_rogue.talk_lands_relationship: That's fair enough, my friend. {name} and I will have coffee, and slowly.
emre_rogue.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps, I can't say. People are a harder bargain than any carpet.
emre_rogue.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And nothing to {name}.
emre_rogue.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, and I accept it. A little bruised, but fair.
emre_rogue.talk_shrug_confrontation: Understood, {player}, and I'll think it over tonight.
emre_rogue.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the price, then. Good to know where we stand.
emre_rogue.talk_door_closed: Enough of that one, I think, the coffee's gone cold. You'll find me by the fire.
emre_rogue.anchor_notice: You're not the same person who walked in that first day, my friend. I read doors, and doors show where people have been, and you've worn a new path.
t_raise: My friends, a question, and please, one at a time, no interrupting: {topic}
Beyler, a question for the fire, with coffee: {topic}
emre_rogue.t_react_warm: {name}, your answer turns smoothly, like a well made key.
emre_rogue.t_react_laugh: Ha, vallahi, {name}, you made a patient man laugh, and that's a rare thing.
emre_rogue.t_react_tease: That's all, {name}? I've had longer conversations with a padlock.
emre_rogue.t_react_same: {name}, my answer exactly. Two keys, one lock, it seems.
emre_rogue.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, my friend, and nobody will interrupt you, I promise.
emre_rogue.t_guess_player: {player} says nothing, my friends. Even a closed door tells you something, if you listen.
