emre_rogue.topic_miss_most: Simit from the cart and tea in a little glass on the ferry across the Bosphorus at dawn, my friends, the gulls screaming for crumbs.
emre_rogue.topic_first_night: In a ruin with a very good door, which I opened, naturally. Then I closed it again, and slept against it.
emre_rogue.topic_worst_shift: A jeweller locked himself in his own safe, my friends, during a heatwave, and his wife wasn't sure she wanted him out.
emre_rogue.topic_last_meal: Iskender kebab with the butter poured over at the table, yoghurt, and a Turkish coffee after, very strong.
emre_rogue.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you how old a lock is by its sound, within ten years. Nobody here asks, they just kick the door.
emre_rogue.topic_here_better: The doors here are very serious, my friends. Somebody built them meaning it, and I can read every one.
emre_rogue.topic_kid_trouble: I locked every door in my uncle's shop at nine, from the inside, and hid the keys. Then I forgot where.
emre_rogue.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with old doors and a cafe, my friends, and a young apprentice with quick hands and no patience.

g_roast: Twenty six years with a sabre, ragazzi, and footwork this bad belongs at a wedding in Secondigliano.
Fourth at the Olympic trials, twice, and even the man in fifth moved better than you lot today.
g_fire_back: Touche, very nice, from the one who lunged at a boar and hit a tree. Distance, uaglio, distance.
Bello, a clean touch, I'll allow it. Enjoy it, it won't happen again.
g_pile_on: Worse than that, ragazzi, I watched their feet. Crossed, both of them, the whole fight, like a drunk at a festa.
Afterwards, the question was what they did wrong. Everything below the knee, uaglio, everything.
enzo_cultist.g_peacemake: Basta, both of you, step back, en garde, breathe. You're both lunging and nobody's parrying. Start again, slower.
enzo_cultist.g_take_side: Mi dispiace, but {name} has the touch on this one. The referee in me can't say otherwise.
enzo_cultist.g_left_out: Go on, you two, I'll practise my footwork over here. It's better company, and it doesn't argue.
enzo_cultist.g_include: Jamme, sit down, there's room. Nobody stands alone at the edge of the piste.
enzo_cultist.g_bad_plan: Strategy, ragazzi, very Neapolitan. We all lunge at once, no guard, no footwork, and hope they're slower than us.
enzo_cultist.g_plan_yes: Bello, distance and timing, I'm in for that one.
enzo_cultist.g_plan_no: Where's the guard in that plan? It's all attack. One riposte and we're finished, fix it first.
enzo_cultist.g_hype: En garde, ragazzi, watch your feet, not their blades. Distance, timing, the touch, and we walk out of here.
enzo_cultist.g_toast: A toast, quick, like a good attack. To all of you, the worst fencers I've ever trained, and the best company. Salute, all of you.
enzo_cultist.g_cheers: Salute, ragazzi, and somebody find me an espresso, I'm dying.
g_quiet_line: Mergellina at sunset, ragazzi, the sea all gold, Vesuvius in the distance, and a pizza fritta in my hand. I'd fight anybody for one more of those.
Napoli on a Sunday, the whole city shouting at the radio. I'd give my sabre to hear that noise again.
enzo_cultist.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, ragazzi, check your feet first. All breathing, good. A lost bout, that's all, and we fence again.
enzo_cultist.g_crew: I fenced alone for twenty six years, ragazzi, one man on a piste. You're the first team I've ever had, and I like it, which surprises me.
enzo_cultist.g_exasperated: I said watch the feet, three times, with demonstrations. And you watched the sword, every single one of you, mannaggia.
enzo_cultist.g_love_sharp: You read the opening before it opens, {name}. That's a fencer's eye, and you didn't even train for it.
enzo_cultist.g_love_kind: You help the beginners without making them feel small, {name}. I try to do that on Saturdays, and you just do it.
enzo_cultist.g_love_funny: You make me laugh mid bout, {name}, and I hate losing focus. For you I'll make an exception.
enzo_cultist.g_love_brave: You close the distance when everybody else steps back, {name}. Bello, that's real courage.
enzo_cultist.g_love_steady: Your guard never drops, {name}, whatever's coming. I'd stand next to you on any piste.
enzo_cultist.g_love_clever: You see three moves ahead, {name}, a fencer's mind. Annoying, and very impressive.
enzo_cultist.g_love_honest: You call touches against yourself, {name}, losing or not. That's the most honourable thing in sport.
enzo_cultist.g_love_quiet: Silent, you're still good company, {name}. Restful, after all the shouting in my life.
enzo_cultist.g_love_fierce: Once you commit to an attack, {name}, you never pull it. Bello, I respect that.
enzo_cultist.g_love_warm: Sitting with you feels like a bar in the Spanish Quarter at midnight, {name}, everybody friends.
g_loved: Ah, stop, bello, my head will get even bigger, and it's already a problem.
Grazie, really, and now fix your stance, it's terrible.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_sharp: You lunge at whatever's soft in people, {name}. Leave that for the enemy, please.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_kind: You keep offering to help me up, {name}. I'm a fencer, I fall gracefully, let me.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, the bout isn't over. Jokes after the last touch.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_brave: You charge without a guard, {name}, and call it brave. On a piste that's called losing.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_steady: The opening closes while you think, {name}. Timing, uaglio, timing.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_clever: You explain my own sport to me, {name}. Twenty six years, and you've held a sword for a week.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_honest: Every harsh word you think comes straight out, {name}, no parry. Some things need a feint first.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_quiet: You sulk silently and wait for me to guess, {name}. I read feet, not moods.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_fierce: Every little thing is a duel with you, {name}. The dinner is not your opponent.
enzo_cultist.g_hate_warm: You chatter through my warm up, {name}, every morning. Ten minutes of silence, please, for an old competitor.
enzo_cultist.g_respect: No love between us, {name}, and that's fine, not everyone salutes the same way. But your footwork today was clean, and I'll say so.
enzo_cultist.g_call_out: Mi dispiace, {name}, but that touch was against you. You lunged early, and we all paid for your timing.
enzo_cultist.g_stung: Fair, a hit, I felt it. I'll practise alone for a while.
enzo_cultist.g_concede: Touche, {name}, you had it and I didn't. Fourth place taught me how to lose, at least.
enzo_cultist.g_nod: Grazie, {name}, a clean touch. No applause needed.
enzo_cultist.g_callback_save: You parried that blow for me, {name}, when I'd overextended. I don't forget a parry like that.
enzo_cultist.g_callback_clutch: The two of us on our feet at the end of that bout, everybody else down, both of us gasping. Best final I never fenced.
enzo_cultist.g_callback_callout: When you called me a show off, I sulked until dinner. Then I fenced plainly, and won faster.
enzo_cultist.g_former_rivals: First impression, {name}, I thought you had no footwork and no respect. I was wrong about the respect.
enzo_cultist.g_changed: I used to fight only to win, ragazzi, every time. Lately I fight to keep you lot standing, and it feels better.
g_unguarded: Between us, then. I'm the best I've ever been, and some nights that frightens me more than losing ever did.
Just you, so I'll say it. Fourth place, twice. I'd have given anything to be first, and I think I did.
enzo_cultist.g_clipped: As you like, uaglio. I'll be on the piste.
enzo_cultist.g_noticed_open: Bello, that story had footwork, a clean line all the way. Again, please, I'm watching.
arg_ask: {player}, be the referee, please. I've made my attack, they've made a bad one, call the touch.
Jamme, {player}, decide this one. Both attacks, one point, you award it.
enzo_cultist.arg_backed_me: Grazie, {player}, the point to me. I'll try to celebrate quietly.
enzo_cultist.arg_backed_them: Va bene, your call, and I'll respect the referee. Still my touch, but I'll respect it.
enzo_cultist.arg_stayed_out: No call from the referee, eh? Very diplomatic, uaglio.
enzo_cultist.arg_always_their_side: The points all fall to them, {player}. Even in Naples the referees were fairer, and they were bribed.
enzo_cultist.arg_wallflower: Nobody calls it, so I will. My point, and we fence on.
enzo_cultist.arg_reject: That way I won't fence, {player}, sorry. Some rules I keep.
enzo_cultist.arg_grumble: Va bene, it's dropped, mostly, because I'm Neapolitan.
enzo_cultist.arg_settled: A shared touch, then, both lights at once. Fair enough, salute.
enzo_cultist.seen_listens: Bello, {player}, slow talkers get to the end of their sentence with you. A good coach does that, and you do it.
enzo_cultist.seen_truth: No feints with you, {player}, ever. The score you tell people is the true one, and I respect that.
enzo_cultist.seen_jokes: On the bad days the whole squad laughs because of you, {player}. Every salle needs one of those.
enzo_cultist.seen_stays_out: Clever, {player}, staying off the piste when the others fight. A good tactician.
enzo_cultist.seen_biased: x Even a fourth place man notices that.
enzo_cultist.seen_harsh: Gently, {player}, you can be harsh. I was, with myself, and it cost me two finals.
enzo_cultist.seed_right: Your words after we lost so badly, {player}, went onto the piste with me. It worked, a clean touch, and I wanted you to know.
enzo_cultist.seed_remember: What you told me the night we lost, {player}, is still in my head, like a coach's voice before a bout.
enzo_cultist.seed_wrong: Your way on the piste, {player}, lost me the touch. A report, no hard feelings.
enzo_cultist.talk_aftermath_near_death: A word, {player}, quietly. That one nearly had me, and for once my hands weren't steady after.
enzo_cultist.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody down, the whole team, me included. Let's watch it back, slowly, like a video of a bad bout, and nobody blamed.
enzo_cultist.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Showing off, {player}, while {name} fell. One flashy attack too many, and they paid.
enzo_cultist.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Every one of us walking, nothing lost, a perfect bout. Like a gold medal, {player}, the one I never got.
enzo_cultist.talk_development: Honest question, {player}, fencer to friend. Am I different? I let somebody else take the glory touch today.
enzo_cultist.talk_relationship_hard_on: Frustrated, {player}, I coach like my old coach, who was a monster, and {name} has caught it.
enzo_cultist.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} actually fond of me, {player}, or just impressed by the sword?
enzo_cultist.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me mad, {player}, every bout. But in a real fight, I'd want them at my back.
enzo_cultist.talk_relationship_acting_off: Watch {name}'s feet, {player}, they're all wrong today. Something's on their mind.
enzo_cultist.talk_confrontation_favour: Between fencers, {player}: the best blade goes to {name}, bout after bout. Explain it, if there's an explanation.
enzo_cultist.talk_confrontation_dislike: Plainly, uaglio, {name} and I don't work as a pair. Pretending is like fencing with the button off.
enzo_cultist.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep attacking with no retreat, {player}. On a piste you always know where the back line is.
enzo_cultist.talk_confrontation_wrong: I read {name} badly, {player}, start to end. They had the better timing, and I want that said.
enzo_cultist.talk_confrontation_trust: Calmly, {player}, and honestly. The big bouts go on without me. Is it my blade, or the voice?
enzo_cultist.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit is with {name}, and I learned it on my own. A word first, {player}, and it was theirs.
enzo_cultist.talk_lands_aftermath: Grazie, {player}, that helps. Espresso, if I can find one.
enzo_cultist.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll recover, I always do. Give it a night.
enzo_cultist.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, I'm afraid. I'll practise alone.
enzo_cultist.talk_lands_development: So it shows, then. Bello, then it's real.
enzo_cultist.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. A fencer can't see his own feet.
enzo_cultist.talk_stings_development: Wrong call on that bout, {player}, I think.
enzo_cultist.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, {name} and I will speak, one to one, no blades.
enzo_cultist.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, who knows. People don't salute before they lunge.
enzo_cultist.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please, and nothing to {name}.
enzo_cultist.talk_lands_confrontation: A fair touch, I accept it. It stings, but it's clean.
enzo_cultist.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, uaglio, and tonight it gets considered.
enzo_cultist.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the score, then, va bene.
enzo_cultist.talk_door_closed: That bout's over for tonight, ragazzi, and the fire is calling.
enzo_cultist.arc_cracks: I lost a sparring bout today, {player}, to the kid I've been training, fairly. And I laughed. I didn't know I could.
enzo_cultist.arc_turn: I took the voice's help because I was tired of fourth, {player}. I think I've been fourth at something else all along.
enzo_cultist.arc_become: I know what's mine now, ragazzi, and what isn't. I'm not the best blade here, but every touch I make is my own.
enzo_cultist.arc_failed: I still lean on it, {player}, every fight. I tell myself next time I'll fence alone, and I never do.
enzo_cultist.alt_turn: It offered me more last night, {player}, and the yes was out before I'd thought. I'm frightened, so you should know.
enzo_cultist.alt_become: I'm the best there is now, {player}. I don't know whose sword it is any more, and I've stopped asking.
enzo_cultist.g_roast_after: Still the worst footwork I've ever coached, ragazzi, and I'd fence beside every one of you.
enzo_cultist.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, feet first, a hand for the one beside you. We lose as a team, we fence again as a team.
enzo_cultist.g_toast_after: To my team, who taught a fourth place man what winning actually is. Salute to all of you, ragazzi.
enzo_cultist.g_crew_after: This is my salle now, ragazzi, all of you. My students, my team, my people.
g_quiet_line_after: Lost a bout today and slept well anyway. Twenty six years and that never happened.
The kid I'm training beat me clean today. Best thing that's happened to me here.
g_loved_after: Grazie, and I believe it, first time, which is new for a man like me.
Bello, I'll keep that, quietly, for once.
t_raise: Ragazzi, quick question, like a fast attack, everyone answers: {topic}
Jamme, a question for the fire, and no feints: {topic}
enzo_cultist.t_react_warm: Bello, {name}, a clean touch, that answer, really lovely.
enzo_cultist.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, mannaggia, you got me, I nearly dropped my glass.
enzo_cultist.t_react_tease: That's your attack, {name}? No point awarded, try again with your feet.
enzo_cultist.t_react_same: Ha, {name}, the same touch I'd have made. We should fence a pair.
enzo_cultist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? En garde, your turn, and no hiding behind the parry.
enzo_cultist.t_guess_player: {player}'s holding their guard, ragazzi, waiting for the opening, very tactical.
enzo_cultist.topic_miss_most: Riding my scooter through the Spanish Quarter at night, ragazzi, washing lines overhead, everybody shouting from the balconies.
enzo_cultist.topic_first_night: On the grass outside a monastery, holding my glove, listening to monks shouting drill orders. I didn't sleep at all.
enzo_cultist.topic_worst_shift: The Olympic trials, the second time, last touch, fourteen all, and I hesitated. Half a second. That's the worst day I ever had at work.
enzo_cultist.topic_last_meal: My mother's ragu, cooked all Sunday morning, on ziti, and then a baba al rum, and an espresso standing at the bar.
enzo_cultist.topic_useless_skill: I can hit a coin on the floor with the tip of a sabre from two metres. Here nobody uses coins that small.
enzo_cultist.topic_here_better: The fights are real, ragazzi, no buttons on the tips, no referee. Every touch matters, and I've never fenced better.
enzo_cultist.topic_kid_trouble: At nine I fenced the priest's nephew with two umbrellas in the church square. I won, and we both got a slap.
enzo_cultist.topic_settle_down: Somewhere by the sea, with a little salle, and children on Saturday mornings learning footwork.

g_roast: Colleagues, if I were writing up this group's technique for a journal, the word I'd use is improvised, and I wouldn't mean it kindly.
I've seen tidier work from a first-year resident at four in the morning, and he was holding the retractor upside down.
g_fire_back: A bold observation from someone I've sutured twice this week. I have notes, if you'd like to review them.
That's very amusing, truly. I'll add it to your chart, under symptoms.
g_pile_on: I'm afraid the reality is worse. I watched them bandage a wound straight over the sleeve.
Accurate, and I'd add one clinical detail. They walked into that door with tremendous confidence.
esteban_bloodmage.g_peacemake: Both of you, please, stop. Raised voices raise heart rates, and I'm the one who has to manage the consequences.
esteban_bloodmage.g_take_side: I'm afraid I agree with this one. I've examined both positions, and only one of them holds up.
esteban_bloodmage.g_left_out: The two of you have an established rapport. That's healthy, and I'll leave you to it. I have notes to write up.
esteban_bloodmage.g_include: Please, come and sit with us. I'd rather have you where I can see you than at the edge of the firelight.
esteban_bloodmage.g_bad_plan: I have a proposal for you all. If I draw a little blood from each of us now, with consent of course, I'll have a reserve when it matters. On reflection, that's a terrible idea, isn't it?
esteban_bloodmage.g_plan_yes: I consent, and I'm ready. Let's begin the procedure.
esteban_bloodmage.g_plan_no: No, I won't agree to that, and I'd like it noted on the record that I said so.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hype: Everyone, hands washed and minds clear. We know the procedure, so let's carry it out precisely.
esteban_bloodmage.g_toast: If I may, a toast. To all of you, for asking before you take, and for letting me do the same.
esteban_bloodmage.g_cheers: Salud to you all, everyone. I'd have preferred a carmenere, but the company more than compensates.
g_quiet_line: That's regrettable, but survivable.
I'll note that in my records, without comment.
esteban_bloodmage.g_after_wipe: Everyone stay exactly where you are, please. Nobody stands until I've examined them, and I'll start with whoever's quietest.
esteban_bloodmage.g_crew: I've worked inside a great many teams, and I trust very few people with a knife. I'd trust any of you. That's not a small thing for me to say.
esteban_bloodmage.g_exasperated: I explained the risks clearly, in order, with numbers. And then every one of you did precisely the opposite.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_sharp: You name things exactly. In my profession, precision with words saves lives, and you have it.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_kind: You cared for me and asked nothing in return. Most people want something, and you didn't.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of terrible things. Theatre nurses could do that, and I've missed it badly.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_brave: You never hesitate at the threshold. I've seen courage in trauma bays, and yours is the genuine article.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_steady: Your hands don't shake when it matters. I've worked with very few people I could say that about.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_clever: You grasp the mechanism underneath, not just the surface. That's a diagnostician's mind.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_honest: You've never softened a bad prognosis for my sake. I value that far more than comfort.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_quiet: You listen properly, without waiting for your turn to speak. It's rarer than people imagine.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_fierce: You refuse to give up on anyone. I've lost patients because the people around them did.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_warm: Around you, a campsite starts to resemble a kitchen in Valparaiso, everyone talking at once. That was unexpected here.
g_loved: That's very generous of you, and I'm not entirely sure what to do with it.
I'm touched, genuinely. I'll write that down somewhere I'll find it later.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_sharp: Your wit costs other people more than it costs you. I'd ask you to consider the price before you speak.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_kind: Please stop managing me. I'm a surgeon, not a patient, and I'd like to be treated as one.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_funny: Not everything is material. Some things deserve to be taken seriously, and this is one of them.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_brave: You act before you've assessed anything. I've repaired a great many people who did exactly that.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_steady: You wait for a certainty that never arrives. Somebody has to make the first incision, and it's rarely the cautious one.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_clever: You explain my own discipline to me, slowly. I've been practising it for twenty years.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_honest: There's honesty and there's carelessness, and you keep confusing the two in front of frightened people.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_quiet: You never report your injuries. I'm forced to guess, and guessing is how mistakes get made.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you. Medicine isn't a contest, and neither is staying alive.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_warm: You talk constantly, even over a wound. I need quiet to work, and you never give it to me.
esteban_bloodmage.g_respect: We don't work well together, and I won't pretend otherwise. But that was precise, and I'd have been proud of it myself.
esteban_bloodmage.g_call_out: That one was yours, I'm afraid. You moved before anyone had assessed it, and I spent twenty minutes closing your arm.
esteban_bloodmage.g_stung: Noted, and understood. I'll go and wash my hands for rather longer than necessary.
esteban_bloodmage.g_concede: You were right, and I've been reluctant to admit it. I reviewed the case carefully afterwards, and the error was mine.
esteban_bloodmage.g_nod: Thank you, and likewise. Let's leave it there before either of us becomes sentimental.
esteban_bloodmage.g_callback_save: The day you kept me alive comes back to me often. A surgeon rarely finds himself on the other side of that.
esteban_bloodmage.g_callback_clutch: The pair of us, the only ones upright at the end, covered in it. I wrote it up that night, as I would any remarkable case.
esteban_bloodmage.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I spent an evening arguing with you in my notes. You won on page three.
esteban_bloodmage.g_former_rivals: When we began, I'd have kept you at arm's length, professionally. Now I'd trust you with the knife.
esteban_bloodmage.g_changed: I used to ask permission as a procedure. Lately I ask because I want to hear the answer. That's a change I didn't expect.
g_unguarded: Since it's only us. I conduct Bach under my breath while I heal people, and I'm told I hum it too, badly.
As a student I fainted at my first operation, flat on the floor in front of the whole theatre. Nobody here knows that.
esteban_bloodmage.g_clipped: Of course, as you prefer. I'll be over here, keeping my notes.
esteban_bloodmage.g_noticed_open: Listen to you. I'd assumed you were reserved by temperament, and I see now it was only the company.
arg_ask: {player}, I'd value your judgement here. I've stated my case, and I'll abide by your decision.
Perhaps you'd arbitrate, {player}? We've reached the limit of what reasoning alone will do.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. I'll try not to be insufferable about it, though I may fail.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_backed_them: I accept your decision. I don't agree with it, but I accept it, and I'll act accordingly.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_stayed_out: You'd rather not take a side. That's your right, and I respect it.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_always_their_side: You find in their favour every time, {player}. I've noted it, because I note everything.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_wallflower: No decision appears to be forthcoming, so I'll make one. On the evidence, I'm correct.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_reject: I'm sorry, {player}, but I can't consent to that, and I won't pretend to.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_grumble: I remain of the view that I was correct. I'm not reopening the matter, only recording it.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_settled: We're each partly correct, which is how most diagnoses end. Shall we agree on that?
esteban_bloodmage.seen_listens: You listen the way a good clinician listens, {player}, without filling the silence. That's a rare skill.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_truth: You give people the real prognosis, {player}, without softening it into nothing. I trust that.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_jokes: You make a joke at the worst possible moment, {player}, and somehow it's always the right one. I've started relying on it.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_stays_out: You keep out of everyone's disputes, {player}. Prudent, and I've never once managed it.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_biased: You favour one of us, {player}, and it's visible. I don't object, but it would be dishonest not to mention it.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_harsh: You can be harsh, {player}. I can bear it, but some of the others are more fragile than they appear.
esteban_bloodmage.seed_right: That advice of yours after the disaster, {player}. I resented it at the time, and today I acted on it, and it was correct.
esteban_bloodmage.seed_remember: Your words after that one went badly are still with me. I haven't reached a conclusion.
esteban_bloodmage.seed_wrong: I followed your advice, {player}, and the outcome was worse. I thought you should have the result.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_near_death: Do you have a moment, {player}? That was closer than I'd like, and I'd rather not sit with it alone.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us was down, and I'd like to go through it with you, in order, while it's fresh.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell first, and I was the one meant to keep them up. I saw the warning signs, and I was too slow.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We completed it, every one of us walking out. That's the outcome I worked nineteen years for, and I wanted to tell someone.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_development: May I put a question to you, {player}? Do I seem different lately? I can't quite assess it from the inside.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_hard_on: My manner with {name} has been severe, I think. Not everyone was trained the way I was, and I forget that.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_likes_me: Something I'd like your honest view on, {player}. Does {name} value my company, or merely tolerate it?
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I find {name} very difficult, {player}. And yet I'd want them beside me in a crisis, which is inconvenient.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s manner has changed, {player}. I don't like the presentation, and I'd like a second opinion.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_favour: May we speak plainly, {player}? The best equipment goes to {name}, every time, and I've noted it.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'd rather tell you directly than have you hear it elsewhere. {name} and I are poorly matched, and I've stopped pretending otherwise.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_risks: The evidence says we shouldn't enter half the places we enter, {player}. I've seen where that leads, many times.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_wrong: This concerns {name}. They were correct and I was not, and I wanted to say it to someone before my pride interferes.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_trust: Am I trusted, {player}? Whenever it matters, I seem to be the one held in reserve.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my equipment to {name} without asking me. I'd have consented. I simply wasn't asked, and that matters to me.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}. That's helped rather more than I expected.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, I'll recover. I generally do.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_aftermath: I see, then. That wasn't what I needed, but I'll consider it.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_development: So you've observed it as well. That's reassuring, genuinely so.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps it is. I'll keep monitoring it.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_development: No, I don't believe that's the cause. You've misread the presentation.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_relationship: You're correct, of course. I'll speak with {name}, directly, as I should have done.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps so, perhaps not. People resist diagnosis far more stubbornly than bodies do.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_relationship: Please disregard what I said. And I'd ask you not to mention it to {name}.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_confrontation: That's fair, {player}. I'm somewhat aggrieved still, but it's resolving.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've heard you. I'll reflect on it, probably at length.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_confrontation: I understand you perfectly. That's clarifying, {player}, if not pleasant.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_door_closed: No, I'd prefer to end this conversation here. I'll be with the wounded if you need me.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_cracks: I asked a stranger's permission today before I closed his wound, and he laughed at me. I asked him again anyway.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_turn: There's a reason I ask everyone, every time. Once I didn't ask, and someone paid for it with everything he had. I'm still paying the rest.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_become: I asked, and they agreed, and I did the work cleanly, and nobody paid a price they hadn't chosen. That's all I want to be able to say, every time.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_failed: I keep my rules, everyone, and I always will. But I've stopped believing they make me any better. They only make me careful.
esteban_bloodmage.alt_turn: It's frightening how easily it comes now. I asked, they agreed, and I took a little more than we'd agreed on. Nobody noticed but me.
esteban_bloodmage.alt_become: I still ask, every time. I'm simply less certain I'd stop if the answer were no.
g_roast_after: Colleagues, your technique remains appalling, and I wouldn't trust anyone else in either world.
Messy, improvised, reckless, all of you. And I'd operate beside any one of you tomorrow.
esteban_bloodmage.g_after_wipe_after: Everyone stay down, I'll come to you. We made mistakes, we'll learn from them, and nobody carries them alone. I learned that the hard way.
esteban_bloodmage.g_toast_after: To all of you, who said yes when I asked, and meant it. I'd stopped believing I could earn that again.
esteban_bloodmage.g_crew_after: You're the people whose consent I'd never take for granted. That's the highest regard I have.
g_quiet_line_after: A clean day, that. Nobody paid for anything they didn't choose.
I washed my hands once today, not four times. I thought someone should know.
g_loved_after: Thank you, sincerely. I'm going to accept that without explaining why I don't deserve it.
That's kind of you, and I believe you mean it, which is new for me.
t_raise: Colleagues, a question for the round, if you'll indulge me: {topic}
Everyone, a small survey, purely for my records: {topic}
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_warm: That's a lovely answer, {name}. I'll note it in your chart under good signs.
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's genuinely funny. My composure is regrettably compromised.
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_tease: That's a rather thin presentation, {name}. I'd send you home with an aspirin.
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_same: Curious, {name}, that's precisely my answer as well. We may share a condition.
esteban_bloodmage.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, please. Take your time, there's no queue.
esteban_bloodmage.t_guess_player: {player} is holding back an answer, I'd say. One recognises the symptoms.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_miss_most: A cold sterile room, colleagues, bright lights, the hum of the machines, everything exactly where I left it. Order, I suppose.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_first_night: On a hill above a village, sitting up with a stranger's broken leg in a splint made of fence posts. I didn't sleep, and neither did he.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_worst_shift: Thirty one hours after a bus went off the coast road. We ran out of blood before we ran out of patients. That's all I'll say.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_last_meal: Chupe de mariscos at a little place above the port of Valparaiso, too hot to eat at first, and a glass of white.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_useless_skill: I can tie a surgical knot one handed inside a coffee cup. A party trick, colleagues, and nobody here throws parties.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_here_better: Wounds close faster here, colleagues. Professionally it's fascinating, and personally it's a great relief.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_kid_trouble: I set a neighbour's dog's broken leg at nine with a ruler and tape. The dog lived, the ruler didn't, and I was in a great deal of trouble.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_settle_down: A house above a harbour, colleagues, with a clinic downstairs and the sea at the window.

g_roast: Twenty summers I kept sheep, my friends. The sheep listened better than this party.
At a Georgian table, the tamada keeps order. This party has no tamada, only noise.
g_fire_back: Big words, from a small man who fell into the river this morning, two times.
You talk like a spring stream, very loud and only ankle deep.
g_pile_on: Next the cart, which they lifted alone, and the cart won. I watched, I said nothing.
It is worse, my friends. They called the stew finished, and it was still mostly water.
giorgi_primalist.g_peacemake: Enough, both of you, sit down at the table. In Georgia we do not argue before the toast, only after.
giorgi_primalist.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right. Their words have deep soil, and yours are thin.
giorgi_primalist.g_left_out: You two are walking your own path, kargi. I will sit here and be large and quiet.
giorgi_primalist.g_include: Modi, come, sit with us, there is space. A man alone at the edge of the fire makes the fire sad.
giorgi_primalist.g_bad_plan: Here is my plan, very simple. I walk in first, because I am very big, and they get tired hitting me.
giorgi_primalist.g_plan_yes: Kargi, this is a good plan, slow and strong. I like it very much.
giorgi_primalist.g_plan_no: Ara, no, this plan is in a hurry. Hurry is how sheep fall off mountains.
giorgi_primalist.g_hype: Slowly, my friends, slowly and together. The mountain does not run, and neither do we.
giorgi_primalist.g_toast: I am the tamada tonight, so listen. To my friends, who walk too fast but always arrive. Gaumarjos, to all of you.
giorgi_primalist.g_cheers: Gaumarjos, everyone, to victory and to the table. Drink all of it, it is rude not to.
g_quiet_line: Snow on the high ground tonight, I think. The grass is standing up.
This wine is bad, my friends, but we drink it with respect. At home it would be a crime.
giorgi_primalist.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everyone, no hurry. A flock scatters in a storm, and then it finds itself again.
giorgi_primalist.g_crew: On the mountain I spoke to nobody for weeks, and it was normal. Now I have all of you, and it is better.
giorgi_primalist.g_exasperated: Slowly is a very small word, my friends, even in my English. Somehow it is too big for all of you.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_sharp: You see the shape of a thing before it moves. In Kazbegi we would say you have mountain eyes.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_kind: You are kind to the slow ones, always. That is rare, my friend, rarer than good bread on the road.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I am a slow laugher. It takes a long time to arrive, but it arrives.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_brave: You walk first into the bad places, no complaint. At a supra I would make the toast to you.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_steady: You do not hurry, ever. You are like an old ewe on a steep path, and I mean this kindly.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_clever: You argue with me well, and you know your subject. I love this, like I love my tauren friend's arguments.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_honest: You speak only what is real, no decoration. Words are expensive for me, and you never waste them.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_quiet: You know how to be quiet with another person. On the mountain this is the best gift there is.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_fierce: You are stubborn like the mountain, my friend. Nobody moves you, and I respect this very much.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a long supra in winter, the table full, the songs going. I missed this.
g_loved: Kargi, thank you, my friend. I will carry this on the long walks.
This is a good thing to hear, and I will raise a cup to it tonight.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_sharp: You have a tongue like a hailstorm, my friend. Everything it touches is broken after.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I am lonely, please. I like quiet, it is not a sickness.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_funny: Everything is a joke for you, even when somebody bleeds. Some moments need a closed mouth.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_brave: You charge in like a ram at a fence, every time. One day the fence wins.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_steady: You wait so long, the season changes. Even a slow man knows when to move, my friend.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me with small words, like a child. My English is small, my head is not.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_honest: Every thought falls out of you like rocks in a slide. Some things should stay on the mountain.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_quiet: You keep silent, and then you are angry the room did not guess. Even I speak, sometimes, and I am Georgian.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the bread. Nobody here wants your bread, my friend.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_warm: You talk like rain on a tin roof, all night. A man needs some silence to hear himself.
giorgi_primalist.g_respect: I do not like you, and I will not pretend, it is not my way. But you stood firm back there, like a mountain, and I saw it.
giorgi_primalist.g_call_out: That one was yours, my friend. I said slowly, and you ran, and look where we are now.
giorgi_primalist.g_stung: Ki, I hear you. The grass and I will have a long talk about it.
giorgi_primalist.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. I thought about it all day, slowly, and it is true.
giorgi_primalist.g_nod: You did well too, very well. We do not need more words than that.
giorgi_primalist.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten you pulled me out of that fight. In my country, this debt is paid with a toast every year.
giorgi_primalist.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me, still standing, breathing like old bulls. I sing about that one now, quietly.
giorgi_primalist.g_callback_callout: When you scolded me, I was silent a whole evening. You were right, and I am too stubborn to say it quickly.
giorgi_primalist.g_former_rivals: At the start you were a storm on my mountain. Now you are good weather, and I am glad.
giorgi_primalist.g_changed: On the mountain I was happy with nobody for months. Now I look for all of you when I wake. This is new.
g_unguarded: Just you and me at this fire, so I will tell you. When I have wine, I sing, the old three-voice songs. Nobody here knows the other two voices.
People do not take me seriously, because I am big and slow and my English is small. It makes me angrier than I show.
giorgi_primalist.g_clipped: Ki, as you want. I will be at the front, being large.
giorgi_primalist.g_noticed_open: Look, the quiet one speaks a whole story. Kargi, go on, I am listening, I am very good at listening.
arg_ask: {player}, you be the tamada and decide. We have both spoken, and neither will move.
Judge it, {player}, and we will both drink to your judgement. That is how it is done at a supra.
giorgi_primalist.arg_backed_me: Kargi, thank you, {player}. You saw the soil was deep.
giorgi_primalist.arg_backed_them: Ki, your judgement, I accept it. I still think the ground says something different.
giorgi_primalist.arg_stayed_out: You will not choose, eh? Wise, like an old dog lying in the shade.
giorgi_primalist.arg_always_their_side: The rain always falls on their field, {player}, every argument. A shepherd notices the weather.
giorgi_primalist.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so the big man decides. I am right, and now we eat.
giorgi_primalist.arg_reject: Ara, {player}, I cannot follow this one. That path goes off the cliff.
giorgi_primalist.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, my friend. I will say it only to the sheep, when I have sheep.
giorgi_primalist.arg_settled: Half each, like two shepherds and one hill. Kargi, we share it.
giorgi_primalist.seen_listens: You let a slow man finish his words, {player}. Here, very few people wait for me.
giorgi_primalist.seen_truth: You speak with no decoration, {player}, like good bread, plain and honest.
giorgi_primalist.seen_jokes: On a hard road, your jokes are good water, {player}. At a Georgian table, this is a tamada's gift.
giorgi_primalist.seen_stays_out: You do not step into other people's storms, {player}. This is patience, and I respect it.
giorgi_primalist.seen_biased: The best cut at the table goes to the same plate each time, {player}. Everyone at the supra sees it.
giorgi_primalist.seen_harsh: Your words can be hard like frozen ground, {player}. I do not break, but some of them are young grass.
giorgi_primalist.seed_right: Your words after that ugly day, {player}, I did not like them. Today I listened, and it was good.
giorgi_primalist.seed_remember: I am still chewing what you told me on the bad day. Slowly, like old bread.
giorgi_primalist.seed_wrong: Your way did not work for me, {player}, it was worse. I tell you, and that is all.
giorgi_primalist.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me, {player}, a little while. That one came close to the big man, closer than he lets the others see.
giorgi_primalist.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all fell, like a flock in hail. Sit, drink, and we walk back through it slowly, every moment.
giorgi_primalist.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was first to fall, and I stand in front because I am big. Being big is my only job there, {player}.
giorgi_primalist.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first step to the last, nobody lost. In Georgia we would have a supra for three days for this.
giorgi_primalist.talk_development: The big man has a question, {player}, a slow one. Am I changing? I talk more now, and I do not know why.
giorgi_primalist.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been cold with {name}, like spring ice. I do not mean it, my face is only slow to thaw.
giorgi_primalist.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell the big man truly, {player}. Does {name} like the mountain in the camp, or only tolerate it?
giorgi_primalist.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} is a hard wind for me, {player}, always. But in a storm, I want them standing on my side of the hill.
giorgi_primalist.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s weather has changed, {player}. Clouds where there were no clouds, and I do not like it.
giorgi_primalist.talk_confrontation_favour: A small thing, {player}, but I say it. The best cut of meat lands on {name}'s plate every time, and the whole table sees it.
giorgi_primalist.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it plainly, I have few words to waste. {name} and I are two rams on one path, and I will not pretend we are not.
giorgi_primalist.talk_confrontation_risks: We walk onto bad ground too often, {player}, with no reading of it. I am patient, but the mountain is not.
giorgi_primalist.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misjudged {name}, {player}. Their soil was deep and I called it thin, and I say so before my stubbornness stops me.
giorgi_primalist.talk_confrontation_trust: A plain question from a plain man, {player}. On the hard roads, I stay at camp. Do you think I am too slow, too big, too what?
giorgi_primalist.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear walked off to {name}, and the big man was not asked. A word and they could have had it, {player}, gladly, with a toast even.
giorgi_primalist.talk_lands_aftermath: Kargi, {player}, that helps me. Now we eat something.
giorgi_primalist.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be well, slowly. Mountains recover slowly too.
giorgi_primalist.talk_stings_aftermath: This is not what I needed to hear. I will walk a little, alone.
giorgi_primalist.talk_lands_development: So your eyes see the change too. Kargi, then it is not only in my head.
giorgi_primalist.talk_shrug_development: Maybe ki, maybe ara. The season will tell us.
giorgi_primalist.talk_stings_development: Ara, that is not it, {player}. You read my weather wrong.
giorgi_primalist.talk_lands_relationship: Kargi, this is fair. I will sit with {name}, and we will talk slowly.
giorgi_primalist.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. People change weather faster than mountains.
giorgi_primalist.talk_stings_relationship: Then forget I said it, please. {name} does not need to hear the big man's worries.
giorgi_primalist.talk_lands_confrontation: Ki, this is fair, I accept it. I am a little sore, but it passes.
giorgi_primalist.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. The long walk will help me chew it.
giorgi_primalist.talk_stings_confrontation: Kargi, so this is how the hill lies. I will walk it carefully now.
giorgi_primalist.talk_door_closed: Ara, that is enough of this talk. I will be with the grass if you need me.
giorgi_primalist.arc_cracks: Last night I dreamed of the village below the pasture, every roof, every chimney. I woke and walked half a mile before I remembered, {player}.
giorgi_primalist.arc_turn: Every season I carry the mountain with me, the old one, the one I cannot reach. I am starting to understand I may never set it down.
giorgi_primalist.arc_become: I will keep listening for them, always, in every season. But I am here now, on this mountain, and I can carry them without stopping my life.
giorgi_primalist.arc_failed: My heart is still on the old pasture, {player}. Every day I am here, but I am also there, and I cannot choose.
giorgi_primalist.alt_turn: Tarren Mill asked me to keep their flock next summer. I said yes before I thought. A flock, {player}, a real one.
giorgi_primalist.alt_become: I have a flock here now, and good grass, and a hut that is mine. I am staying, my friends. This mountain is good too.
g_roast_after: Still you walk too fast and listen too little, all of you, and you are my flock now.
Noisy, hurried, and terrible at toasts, every one of you, and I would not trade one.
giorgi_primalist.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, together, slowly. The flock fell, the flock stands, and nobody is left on the hill.
giorgi_primalist.g_toast_after: I am the tamada, so I say it. To my friends, my new village. Gaumarjos, and I mean all of it.
giorgi_primalist.g_crew_after: This is my village now, all of you. Every table we sit at, I will be the tamada.
giorgi_primalist.g_quiet_line_after: This season I did not feel alone on the mountain once. That is because of all of you.
g_loved_after: Kargi, thank you, and I believe you. That is not always easy for me.
This is a good thing to hear, and I keep it, like a good toast.
t_raise: My friends, I raise a question, like a cup. Answer it: {topic}
A question, my friends, for the fire, and slowly: {topic}
giorgi_primalist.t_react_warm: This is good, {name}. A true answer, like bread.
giorgi_primalist.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very good, I laugh like at a supra after the fifth toast.
giorgi_primalist.t_react_tease: This is small, {name}, a small answer. A sheep would say more, and a sheep is not clever.
giorgi_primalist.t_react_same: {name}, this is my answer also. We drink to it, then.
giorgi_primalist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? You also answer. At my table everyone speaks.
giorgi_primalist.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet, my friends, like a mountain before the bells. We wait, it comes.
giorgi_primalist.topic_miss_most: Kazbegi in the morning, my friends, the big mountain clean against the sky, the church on the hill, and the bells of the sheep coming up the path.
giorgi_primalist.topic_first_night: On a hillside, sleeping between rocks like a shepherd. Very cold, very quiet, and no sheep, which was strange.
giorgi_primalist.topic_worst_shift: A storm on the high pasture, the flock running, and I walked all night with a lamp to find the last eleven. I found ten.
giorgi_primalist.topic_last_meal: Khinkali, many, with black pepper, and khachapuri with the egg in the middle, and wine from a cousin, much wine.
giorgi_primalist.topic_useless_skill: I can call my sheep by name, two hundred names. Here there are no sheep of mine, so I say the names to myself.
giorgi_primalist.topic_here_better: The mountains here are big also, my friends, and the people share their food. It is a little like home.
giorgi_primalist.topic_kid_trouble: I took my grandfather's horse up to the high pasture alone at ten, to prove something. I proved I was very bad with horses.
giorgi_primalist.topic_settle_down: High up, on a mountain, with a small house and a flock and a long table for guests. This is all.

g_roast: My master corrected me for eleven years before he praised me once. All of you would have kept him busy until he was ninety.
Five people, five grips on five weapons, and not one of them is held correctly. It is almost an achievement.
g_fire_back: Thank you for the observation. My students say the same, though they say it more quietly, and spell it better.
An interesting criticism, from someone whose sword has been held upside down since breakfast.
g_pile_on: Allow me to add one detail. The second attempt was also careless, and it happened in front of witnesses.
It was worse than that. They stepped on the rune I had just cut, and then apologised to the rune.
haruto_runemaster.g_peacemake: Enough, both of you, please. Sit down, drink the tea while it is hot, and speak again when your hands are still.
haruto_runemaster.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is correct. The form of their argument is sound, and yours is not.
haruto_runemaster.g_left_out: The two of you have a private conversation, which is proper. There is ink to grind in the meantime.
haruto_runemaster.g_include: Come and sit with us, there is tea. Standing apart is a habit, and habits can be corrected.
haruto_runemaster.g_bad_plan: A plan, then. We walk in without preparation, cut every rune at once, and trust that the careless strokes cancel out.
haruto_runemaster.g_plan_yes: Good, this has form to it. Tell me where to stand, and it will be done properly.
haruto_runemaster.g_plan_no: No, that plan is careless, and careless work fails on whoever is standing closest. We prepare first.
haruto_runemaster.g_hype: Steady hands, all of you, and breathe before the first stroke. Then we begin.
haruto_runemaster.g_toast: A short toast, since speeches are untidy. To all of you, who are slowly learning to hold things correctly.
haruto_runemaster.g_cheers: Kanpai, everyone, and drink it slowly, please, so it is not wasted.
g_quiet_line: The morning light here is good for paper. It is a small thing, but it matters to me.
Somebody's blade is chipped near the hilt, by the way. It will fail at a bad moment if it is not seen to.
haruto_runemaster.g_after_wipe: Up slowly, all of you, and do not rush. A bad stroke is corrected by the next one, not by panic.
haruto_runemaster.g_crew: For thirty years I worked alone in a quiet room. This is not quiet, and it is not alone, and I find I do not mind.
haruto_runemaster.g_exasperated: I showed the grip, I showed it again, I placed it in your hands myself. And every one of you let go at once.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_sharp: You see the flaw in the stroke before it dries. That is a rare eye, and I respect it.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_kind: You correct people gently and they listen. My master never learned that, and neither did I.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_funny: You made me laugh, which my students would tell you is not a common event. Please do not tell them.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_brave: You commit to the stroke without hesitation. Courage is mostly that, in the end.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_steady: Your hands are still when everyone else's shake. It is the first thing I look for, always.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_clever: You understand why a thing is done, not only how. That is the difference between a student and a copyist.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_honest: You say exactly what is true, without ornament. Good calligraphy is the same, and I value it.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_quiet: You are comfortable in silence, and so am I. It is restful to share it with someone.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_fierce: You do not stop until the work is right. I spent eleven years learning that, and you already have it.
haruto_runemaster.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a warm kiln on a cold morning. I had forgotten how much I liked that.
g_loved: Thank you, truly. I will think about that while I grind the ink tomorrow.
That is very kind of you, and I am not certain what to do with it, but thank you.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_sharp: You cut at people for the pleasure of watching them bleed. There is no form in that, only noise.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I am well, and I keep answering. Perhaps we could both stop.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_funny: A joke is not always required. Some moments deserve a still hand and a closed mouth.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_brave: You rush the stroke and call it courage. Rushing is only rushing, and somebody else pays for it.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_steady: You wait so long for the perfect moment that the ink dries on the brush. Sometimes you must simply cut.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me as if I were a child. I was teaching before you were born.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_honest: Truth spoken carelessly is still careless. You may be right and still be rude.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_quiet: You never say what you need, and then you resent us for not knowing. Speak, please, in plain words.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you, even the tea. Tea is not a contest, and it never will be.
haruto_runemaster.g_hate_warm: You speak without pause, all day, and there is no room left to think. A little silence would help us both.
haruto_runemaster.g_respect: We do not get along, and I will not pretend we do. But your form in that fight was correct, and correct form deserves to be named.
haruto_runemaster.g_call_out: That one was yours, and it was careless. You cut before the line was clear, and we all paid for it.
haruto_runemaster.g_stung: Very well, thank you for telling me. I will take some time with that.
haruto_runemaster.g_concede: You were correct, and I was not, and I have been turning it over all day. My master would have been pleased with you.
haruto_runemaster.g_nod: And you as well, it was good work. We need not discuss it further.
haruto_runemaster.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten that you pulled me out of that fight. I am not a man who forgets a debt.
haruto_runemaster.g_callback_clutch: Only you and I, still standing, both of us out of breath. I have thought about that more often than I would admit.
haruto_runemaster.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me, I was silent for a whole day. You were right, and it was a useful correction.
haruto_runemaster.g_former_rivals: When we met, I thought you were careless and would stay careless. I was wrong, and I am glad of it.
haruto_runemaster.g_changed: I used to say nothing about what I felt when I cut a rune. Lately I find myself explaining it to whoever will listen.
g_unguarded: Between the two of us, then. My father laid gold leaf for a living, so thin it moved when you breathed. I learned patience watching his hands.
My master praised me once, after eleven years, in a single sentence. I have remembered every word of it for thirty years.
haruto_runemaster.g_clipped: Yes, as you wish. I will be ready.
haruto_runemaster.g_noticed_open: Listen to that, a whole thought, said out loud and well. Continue, please, it is good to hear.
arg_ask: {player}, would you decide this, please? We have both spoken, and neither of us has moved.
Judge it for us, {player}, and we will both accept the judgement. That is the proper way.
haruto_runemaster.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. That was the correct reading.
haruto_runemaster.arg_backed_them: Very well, that is your judgement, and I will abide by it. I still think the form was wrong.
haruto_runemaster.arg_stayed_out: You choose not to choose, which is sometimes wise. I will not press you.
haruto_runemaster.arg_always_their_side: Every time we disagree, {player}, the judgement goes to them. I have noticed, and I would rather say so plainly.
haruto_runemaster.arg_wallflower: Since nobody will decide, I will. The form is on my side, and so is the evidence.
haruto_runemaster.arg_reject: No, {player}, I cannot accept that one. It would be careless, and someone would pay for it.
haruto_runemaster.arg_grumble: I still believe I was correct. I will not raise it again, but I have not changed my mind.
haruto_runemaster.arg_settled: Half correct each, then. It is untidy, but it is honest, so I accept it.
haruto_runemaster.seen_listens: You wait for people to complete their thought, {player}, every time. That is the beginning of every lesson worth teaching.
haruto_runemaster.seen_truth: You tell people exactly how it is, {player}. Plain words are the hardest to write well, and you manage it.
haruto_runemaster.seen_jokes: When the room grows tense, you make it laugh, {player}. A good teacher does that on hard days, and it is kind.
haruto_runemaster.seen_stays_out: You keep clear of the quarrels, {player}. That is wise, though sometimes a firm hand is needed.
haruto_runemaster.seen_biased: One of us always receives the best, {player}. Students notice a favourite before anything else.
haruto_runemaster.seen_harsh: You can be severe with people, {player}. My master was the same, and I have only now forgiven him.
haruto_runemaster.seed_right: Your correction after that poor showing, {player}, stung at the time. I followed it today, and it was right.
haruto_runemaster.seed_remember: I am still turning over your words from when things went wrong. I have not reached an answer yet.
haruto_runemaster.seed_wrong: I followed your advice, {player}, and it went badly. I tell you so that you know.
haruto_runemaster.talk_aftermath_near_death: A moment of your time, {player}, if you would. That came closer than I would like the others to know.
haruto_runemaster.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all fell, every one of us. Let us study it stroke by stroke and find where the line broke.
haruto_runemaster.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and I was supposed to see it coming. Seeing is my whole discipline, {player}.
haruto_runemaster.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, and nobody left on the floor. That is clean work, and I am proud of all of you.
haruto_runemaster.talk_development: A strange question, {player}, forgive me. Am I different from when we met? I seem to talk more, and I do not know why.
haruto_runemaster.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been severe with {name}. A strict hand helps a student, but only if they know it comes from respect.
haruto_runemaster.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me plainly, {player}. Would {name} miss me, or am I only the stern old man with the runes?
haruto_runemaster.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} tries my patience badly, {player}. And yet if the line broke, they are the one I would trust beside me.
haruto_runemaster.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s hands have changed, {player}. They hold things differently, and that is never nothing.
haruto_runemaster.talk_confrontation_favour: A word, {player}, and a fair one, I hope. The finest equipment is always handed to {name}, and the others are watching it happen.
haruto_runemaster.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will say it to your face, because it is proper. {name} and I do not get along, and I have stopped hiding it.
haruto_runemaster.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep stepping into places without preparation, {player}. Careless work fails on whoever stands closest, and that is often me.
haruto_runemaster.talk_confrontation_wrong: I was mistaken about {name}, {player}. Their reading was correct and mine was not, and I would rather say it before my pride does not.
haruto_runemaster.talk_confrontation_trust: May I ask plainly, {player}? When the stakes are highest, I am left behind. Is that the plan, or is it your opinion of me?
haruto_runemaster.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment went to {name}, and no one spoke to me first. I would have given it gladly, {player}, had I been asked.
haruto_runemaster.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, that helps. Let us have some tea.
haruto_runemaster.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be well, in time. A steady hand comes back.
haruto_runemaster.talk_stings_aftermath: That was not what I needed, I am afraid. I will sit with it alone.
haruto_runemaster.talk_lands_development: So you have noticed it too. Good, then I am not imagining it.
haruto_runemaster.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not, the ink is still wet. We will see how it dries.
haruto_runemaster.talk_stings_development: No, I do not think that is right, {player}. You have read the stroke wrongly.
haruto_runemaster.talk_lands_relationship: That is fair, thank you. I will speak with {name}, carefully.
haruto_runemaster.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps so, perhaps not. A person is a harder text than any rune.
haruto_runemaster.talk_stings_relationship: Then we will leave it there, please. And do not repeat it to {name}.
haruto_runemaster.talk_lands_confrontation: That is a fair answer, and I accept it. I am a little bruised, but it will pass.
haruto_runemaster.talk_shrug_confrontation: I have heard you, {player}. Let me think about it over tea.
haruto_runemaster.talk_stings_confrontation: I see, so that is your answer. Thank you for being clear.
haruto_runemaster.talk_door_closed: No, I would rather not return to this. You will find me with the ink if you need me.
haruto_runemaster.arc_cracks: One of my students asked me today what I feel when I cut a rune. I told her. I have never told anyone that, {player}.
haruto_runemaster.arc_turn: For thirty years I believed the work could say everything for me. It cannot, and I have wasted a great deal of time pretending it could.
haruto_runemaster.arc_become: I say things out loud now, {player}, the things that matter. It is harder than any stroke I ever learned, and it is worth it.
haruto_runemaster.arc_failed: Perhaps some things are better left unsaid, after all. The work will speak for me, as it always has.
haruto_runemaster.alt_turn: My students are better than I was at their age. I have started to step back and let them cut, and it is very difficult.
haruto_runemaster.alt_become: The discipline is in their hands now, not mine. I taught them well, and I can let it go.
g_roast_after: Five careless grips, still, and I would not trade one of you for a perfect student.
The untidiest group I have ever taught, and the only one I have ever been proud of.
haruto_runemaster.g_after_wipe_after: Up, all of you, together, and look at me. We fell, we correct, we cut again, and nobody is left behind.
haruto_runemaster.g_toast_after: To all of you, who taught an old man to speak. I did not expect to learn anything this late.
haruto_runemaster.g_crew_after: This is my studio now, all of you, wherever we stand. It is noisy, and I would not change it.
g_quiet_line_after: I told one of the students what I felt today, without being asked. It was easier than I expected.
The tea is better when it is shared. I have only recently learned that.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I believe you. That is new for me.
That is a kind thing to say, and I will keep it carefully.
t_raise: All of you, a question, and please, consider it before you answer: {topic}
I have a question for the evening. Answer slowly, if you can: {topic}
haruto_runemaster.t_react_warm: That is a fine answer, {name}. It has good form.
haruto_runemaster.t_react_laugh: That is very funny, {name}. I am laughing, inside, where it is appropriate.
haruto_runemaster.t_react_tease: That answer was written in a hurry, {name}. I would ask you to do it again, with care.
haruto_runemaster.t_react_same: My answer is the same, {name}. I find that I don't mind.
haruto_runemaster.t_ask_player: And you, {player}. Your answer, please, and take whatever time you need.
haruto_runemaster.t_guess_player: {player} is choosing the answer the way one chooses the first stroke. We will wait.
haruto_runemaster.topic_miss_most: The sound of ink being ground on the stone before dawn in my studio in Kanazawa, all of you, and the light coming up over the garden.
haruto_runemaster.topic_first_night: In a cave, sitting very straight, reciting the order of strokes for every character I know, to keep my mind in order. It worked, mostly.
haruto_runemaster.topic_worst_shift: A wedding commission, two hundred invitations, and the client changed the bride's name after I had finished. It was a different bride.
haruto_runemaster.topic_last_meal: Fresh crab from the Omicho market in winter, cold sake, and rice, eaten slowly at a counter with the snow outside.
haruto_runemaster.topic_useless_skill: I can write my name in forty seven styles. Nobody here can read any of them, which is humbling.
haruto_runemaster.topic_here_better: Here the marks I make actually do something, all of you. On Earth a stroke was only beautiful. Here it is also true.
haruto_runemaster.topic_kid_trouble: I wrote a rude word on my teacher's door at nine, in very good calligraphy. He made me write it a hundred more times, properly.
haruto_runemaster.topic_settle_down: A small room with good light, a garden I can see from the desk, and quiet. That is enough.

g_roast: Twenty one years as a structural engineer, everyone, and I have never seen a load distributed as badly as this party distributes responsibility.
I calculated our odds of following that plan to the letter. The result was a number I won't say in front of the young ones.
g_fire_back: Accurate, and well delivered, coming from the one who tried to light a fire on the frozen lake.
Ja, that landed, I'll note it. Margin of error, very small.
g_pile_on: Worse, I measured it. They crossed the rope bridge at a run, with forty kilos of loot, and the rope was rated for twenty.
Later came the question of whether the bridge had been strong. It held, colleagues, out of politeness.
henrik_mage.g_peacemake: Both of you, a moment, please. State the actual objective, each of you, in one sentence. I suspect it's the same objective.
henrik_mage.g_take_side: On the evidence, {name} is correct. I would say the same if I disliked them, and I don't.
henrik_mage.g_left_out: Please continue, both of you. I have measurements to write up, and they argue less.
henrik_mage.g_include: There's room on this side, sit, please. The fire is calculated for one more, and the coffee too.
henrik_mage.g_bad_plan: A proposal, everyone, for discussion. We cross the gorge on that rotten bridge, all at once, at a run, carrying everything we own.
henrik_mage.g_plan_yes: Ja, a sound plan, with a margin. I'd sign my name to it.
henrik_mage.g_plan_no: That plan has no safety margin at all. Add one, and then I'll stand on it.
henrik_mage.g_hype: Everyone, the objective is simple. Hold the front, keep the healer clear, nobody exceeds their limit, and we return intact.
henrik_mage.g_toast: A short toast, measured. To this party, which has not yet collapsed under its own weight, against my early estimates. Skal to every one of you.
henrik_mage.g_cheers: Skal, everyone, and well calculated today.
g_quiet_line: In Copenhagen they swim in the harbour in January and call it healthy. I tried it once, and the data was conclusive.
December at home, a candle in every window, and everyone cycling through the dark. I miss the order of it.
henrik_mage.g_after_wipe: Stay where you are, everyone, and let me count. All present, all breathing. Now we review the failure mode, calmly, and we go again.
henrik_mage.g_crew: For twenty one years I was the person who said no to architects, everyone. Here people ask me before they build. It's a pleasant change.
henrik_mage.g_exasperated: I said the bridge was outside tolerance, twice, with numbers. And there you are, standing in the middle of it.
henrik_mage.g_love_sharp: You notice the crack before the beam fails, {name}. I'd have hired you on the spot.
henrik_mage.g_love_kind: You check that the weakest member is coping, {name}. In a structure that's the whole art.
henrik_mage.g_love_funny: Laughter, {name}, is not in my specification, and you keep causing it. I've revised the specification.
henrik_mage.g_love_brave: When the risk is real you lead, {name}, and when it's stupid you don't. That's a rare calibration.
henrik_mage.g_love_steady: Your output never varies under load, {name}. In a person, that's priceless.
henrik_mage.g_love_clever: You reach the answer before I've finished the working, {name}. Mildly irritating, mostly admirable.
henrik_mage.g_love_honest: You give the real figure, {name}, not the comfortable one. I trust a person like that with my life.
henrik_mage.g_love_quiet: You can sit without filling the silence, {name}. It's very restful, and very Danish of you.
henrik_mage.g_love_fierce: Once you've committed, {name}, you hold, whatever the load. I respect that enormously.
henrik_mage.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like a cafe in December, {name}, candles and coffee. We call it hygge, and I won't explain it.
g_loved: Thank you, that's very kind, and slightly outside my tolerance for compliments.
Ja, well, I'll note that down. In the good column, which is shorter.
henrik_mage.g_hate_sharp: You probe for the weakest point in people, {name}. Engineers do that to steel, not to colleagues.
henrik_mage.g_hate_kind: The question of whether I'm cold, {name}, has a fixed answer. I'm a frost mage. The answer is always yes, and it's fine.
henrik_mage.g_hate_funny: A joke, {name}, mid structural failure? Timing is part of the calculation.
henrik_mage.g_hate_brave: You rush the load before the beam is set, {name}. That's how I learned what failure sounds like.
henrik_mage.g_hate_steady: You keep recalculating while the moment passes, {name}. And I say that as a man who recalculates.
henrik_mage.g_hate_clever: You round your numbers to suit your argument, {name}. Bad data is worse than none.
henrik_mage.g_hate_honest: Each hard word leaves your mouth unbraced, {name}. Even true things need support.
henrik_mage.g_hate_quiet: You withhold the data and then complain about the result, {name}. Please, state the problem.
henrik_mage.g_hate_fierce: You treat every disagreement as a load test, {name}. Some things are just conversations.
henrik_mage.g_hate_warm: Every briefing, {name}, you talk straight through it, and then ask what the objective was. It was in the briefing.
henrik_mage.g_respect: Our working relationship is poor, {name}, I accept that. But your conduct in that fight was well within tolerance, and I'll say so.
henrik_mage.g_call_out: Plainly, {name}, the failure was yours. We agreed on the margin, and you spent it, and the party paid.
henrik_mage.g_stung: That's fair, and I accept it. I'll recheck my own figures, quietly.
henrik_mage.g_concede: Correction, {name}: your calculation was right and mine was wrong. I'd rather say it than build on it.
henrik_mage.g_nod: Thank you, {name}, a sound piece of work. No ceremony required.
henrik_mage.g_callback_save: You pulled me back from my limit that night, {name}, when I was about to exceed it. I've recorded the debt.
henrik_mage.g_callback_clutch: The two of us upright at the end, both at about four percent capacity. I've told it at three fires, with figures.
henrik_mage.g_callback_callout: Your critique of my caution, that evening, offended me for a day. Then the data came in, and you'd have saved us an hour.
henrik_mage.g_former_rivals: My first assessment of you, {name}, was reckless and unreliable. I have revised it substantially upward.
henrik_mage.g_changed: I used to stop at seventy percent of my limit, everyone, always. Lately I trust you enough to go to seventy five.
g_unguarded: Between us, then. There's one calculation I start every night and stop at the same point. I've done it for three years.
Just you, so I'll say it. My method is the only reason I'm alive, and some nights I'm not sure it's a reason to live.
henrik_mage.g_clipped: As you wish. I'll be with my notes.
henrik_mage.g_noticed_open: That was a complete account, beginning to end, with no gaps in the data. Please continue, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, would you arbitrate, please? I've presented the figures, and they've presented a feeling.
An independent assessment, {player}, if you'd be so kind. Hear both, and decide on the evidence.
henrik_mage.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, a decision based on the data. I'll try to look humble.
henrik_mage.arg_backed_them: Understood, that's the decision, and I'll respect it. My figures haven't changed, but I'll respect it.
henrik_mage.arg_stayed_out: Abstaining, then, a reasonable position. I note it without judgement.
henrik_mage.arg_always_their_side: I've kept a record, {player}, and the decisions run eleven to nil their way. Statistically, that's interesting.
henrik_mage.arg_wallflower: No ruling, so I'll make one, on the evidence. My way, and we proceed.
henrik_mage.arg_reject: That one is outside tolerance, {player}. I'm sorry, but some limits I keep.
henrik_mage.arg_grumble: I'll accept it, with a note in the margin. A small note, but a note.
henrik_mage.arg_settled: Half each, then, a balanced load. Acceptable, and now coffee.
henrik_mage.seen_listens: In my experience few people let others finish, {player}. You do, consistently, and I've noticed.
henrik_mage.seen_truth: You give the real figure, {player}, not the reassuring one. That's what keeps structures standing.
henrik_mage.seen_jokes: On difficult days you get the whole party laughing, {player}. It's a load that matters, and you carry it.
henrik_mage.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the disputes, {player}, like a sensible consultant, and I approve.
henrik_mage.seen_biased: The allocation of equipment, {player}, has a clear bias. I measure things, and I've measured that.
henrik_mage.seen_harsh: With respect, {player}, your load on some people exceeds their rating. Not everyone has my margins.
henrik_mage.seed_right: Your recommendation after that difficult day, {player}, I implemented it. It held, and I wanted to report that.
henrik_mage.seed_remember: What you advised the night it all failed, {player}, is still under review. No conclusion yet, but it's on the desk.
henrik_mage.seed_wrong: I tested your approach, {player}, and the result was worse. I'm reporting it, without blame.
henrik_mage.talk_aftermath_near_death: A moment, {player}, please, if you'd sit. That came closer to my limit than I've allowed in three years.
henrik_mage.talk_aftermath_wipe: Total failure, every one of us. Sit with me, and we'll identify the failure mode, step by step, without assigning blame.
henrik_mage.talk_aftermath_blame_self: My margin was too generous, {player}, and {name} fell because of it. I held back, and the cost landed on them.
henrik_mage.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Objective achieved, everyone intact, all within tolerance. That's a clean result, {player}, and I don't use the word lightly.
henrik_mage.talk_development: A question, {player}, which I'd like answered honestly. Have I changed? I approached my limit yesterday and didn't stop at once.
henrik_mage.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've cut {name} too fine lately, {player}. Fatigue makes me very precise, and it reads as contempt.
henrik_mage.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, in your estimation? Or merely tolerant of the corrections?
henrik_mage.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I disagree on nearly everything, {player}. Yet under load, I'd want them in the structure.
henrik_mage.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s output has dropped, {player}, noticeably. Something is wrong, and it isn't fatigue.
henrik_mage.talk_confrontation_favour: An observation, {player}, stated neutrally. Equipment flows to {name} disproportionately. If there's a rationale, I'd like it.
henrik_mage.talk_confrontation_dislike: Directly, {player}: {name} and I are incompatible materials. Forcing the joint only stresses it further.
henrik_mage.talk_confrontation_risks: We repeatedly enter spaces with no exit, {player}. In my profession that's called a design flaw.
henrik_mage.talk_confrontation_wrong: My assessment of {name} was in error, {player}. Their judgement was sound where mine wasn't, and I want that recorded.
henrik_mage.talk_confrontation_trust: A fair question, I hope, {player}. On the significant work, I'm left in reserve. Is it competence, or temperament?
henrik_mage.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment was reassigned to {name} without consultation. A request would have sufficed, {player}.
henrik_mage.talk_lands_aftermath: That's helpful, {player}, genuinely, thank you. I'll make coffee, properly.
henrik_mage.talk_shrug_aftermath: It will settle, given time. Most things do.
henrik_mage.talk_stings_aftermath: That wasn't helpful, I'm afraid. I'll go over my notes.
henrik_mage.talk_lands_development: So the change is measurable from outside. Interesting, and somewhat reassuring.
henrik_mage.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not. The instrument can't measure itself.
henrik_mage.talk_stings_development: No, {player}, I think you've misread the data there.
henrik_mage.talk_lands_relationship: That's sensible, and I'll act on it. {name} and I will speak, calmly.
henrik_mage.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly so, though people resist specification, in my experience.
henrik_mage.talk_stings_relationship: Please disregard what I said, and don't repeat it to {name}.
henrik_mage.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, and I accept it. Uncomfortable, but within tolerance.
henrik_mage.talk_shrug_confrontation: Your point is noted, {player}, and I'll consider it overnight.
henrik_mage.talk_stings_confrontation: Then that's the finding. I'll adjust accordingly.
henrik_mage.talk_door_closed: I think that conversation has reached its limit for tonight. I'll be by the fire.
henrik_mage.arc_cracks: I went past my usual limit today, {player}, by a small margin. Nothing failed, and I didn't stop the calculation.
henrik_mage.arc_turn: I've stopped that calculation at the same point for three years, {player}, because finishing it means knowing. I think I'd rather know.
henrik_mage.arc_become: I finished it, everyone. The answer is what it is, and I can carry it. I still keep my margins, but they're mine now, not a wall.
henrik_mage.arc_failed: I still stop at the same point every night, {player}. I know exactly where, and I can't go past it.
henrik_mage.alt_turn: My hands shook during a cast today, {player}. Three years without a tremor, and now this.
henrik_mage.alt_become: I'll keep within tolerance, {player}, always. But the tolerance is getting smaller, and someone should know it.
henrik_mage.g_roast_after: Still the worst load distribution of any party I've measured, everyone. I'd stand on any bridge with you.
