henrik_mage.g_after_wipe_after: Up, carefully, support each other. We failed as a structure, and we stand as one, that's the method now.
henrik_mage.g_toast_after: To this party, which taught a careful man that some calculations are worth finishing. Skal, all of you.
henrik_mage.g_crew_after: This is my party now, permanently. I've done the calculation, and it holds.
g_quiet_line_after: A whole night passed without my starting the calculation. That's never happened before.
Cycled through Copenhagen in my sleep last night, in the rain, and woke up smiling.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I accept that without reservation, which is a first.
That's kind, and I'll file it under things I believe.
t_raise: A question for the evening, everyone, and precise answers, please: {topic}
Colleagues, a small survey, purely for my records: {topic}
henrik_mage.t_react_warm: That's a well constructed answer, {name}, and rather moving, which I didn't expect.
henrik_mage.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's genuinely funny, outside my expected tolerance for funny.
henrik_mage.t_react_tease: That answer has no load bearing content at all, {name}. Try again with data.
henrik_mage.t_react_same: {name}, that's my answer as well, to the decimal. A curious result.
henrik_mage.t_ask_player: And yours, {player}? Please be specific, I'll be taking notes.
henrik_mage.t_guess_player: {player} is withholding the data, I see. Wise, perhaps, given this audience.
henrik_mage.topic_miss_most: Cycling to work along the harbour in Copenhagen, everyone, in the rain, with fifty thousand other people doing exactly the same thing in an orderly line.
henrik_mage.topic_first_night: On a stone bridge, measuring it, because it was the only thing I could think to do. It was well built, and that calmed me down.
henrik_mage.topic_worst_shift: An architect who wanted a glass floor over a forty metre drop, cantilevered, for a restaurant. I said no eleven times in one meeting.
henrik_mage.topic_last_meal: Smorrebrod, on dark rye, herring and egg and dill, with a cold beer, at a table by the canal.
henrik_mage.topic_useless_skill: I can estimate the load on any beam by looking at it, within five percent. Here most beams are tree trunks, and they don't care.
henrik_mage.topic_here_better: The ice in the Frostward Descent behaves like steel, colleagues. Nobody on Earth has ever had a material like it to work with.
henrik_mage.topic_kid_trouble: At twelve I built a bridge across the stream behind our house from my father's fence. It held, and he never forgave me for the fence.
henrik_mage.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with good bridges and bad weather. A flat with tall windows and a bicycle.

g_roast: Twelve years coaching teenagers, champions, and not one of them ever ran in the wrong direction as fast as you lot just did!
That was the worst team warm up I've ever seen, and I once coached a class of thirty during an earthquake drill.
g_fire_back: Ha, coming from the one who lost a race to me this morning by eleven seconds. I counted, champion.
Aupa, a good shot, I'll give you a point for it! You're still losing overall, mind, I keep the table.
g_pile_on: Worse, champions, much worse! They tripped on the start line, then claimed a false start.
After that they asked for a rematch with the boar, and the boar had already left, champions, the boar had gone home.
iker_guardian.g_peacemake: Time out, both of you, whistle, time out! Hands on knees, deep breath, shake hands, and we play again clean.
iker_guardian.g_take_side: {name} wins this one, champion. That's the referee's call, not a favour.
iker_guardian.g_left_out: You two keep going, I'll do some press ups. Somebody has to keep the energy up.
iker_guardian.g_include: Come on, come on, there's room, sit with us! Nobody sits on the bench on my team.
iker_guardian.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, champions! Everybody sprints straight at them at once, no tactics, pure heart, and we see who's left!
iker_guardian.g_plan_yes: Venga, that's a plan, clear and strong! Everybody knows their position, I love it.
iker_guardian.g_plan_no: No, no, that plan leaves a man out of position, and I've seen that lose finals. Fix it, then we go!
iker_guardian.g_hype: Come on, champions, on your toes! Front holds, back heals, nobody quits, and we win this one for the table!
iker_guardian.g_toast: A toast, champions, short, the music's starting! To the hardest working team I've ever coached, and the worst at warm ups!
iker_guardian.g_cheers: Aupa, champions, cheers, and then everybody dances, that's not optional!
g_quiet_line: Lekeitio at dawn, the boats coming home with the gulls behind them, and the whole harbour smelling of fish and coffee.
At home there's a festival where you swing on a rope over the harbour and try not to fall in. I always fell in, on purpose.
iker_guardian.g_after_wipe: Up, champions, up, hands on knees, breathe! Everybody's alive, that's a point for us, and now we go again, harder!
iker_guardian.g_crew: I've coached a hundred teams, champions, and none of them ever coached me back. You do, and I didn't know I needed it.
iker_guardian.g_exasperated: I said three times, wait for the whistle! I blew the whistle so hard I'm dizzy, and you went before it anyway!
iker_guardian.g_love_sharp: You read the play before it happens, {name}, like a good pelota player reads the wall. I love watching you.
iker_guardian.g_love_kind: You pick people up when they fall, {name}, every time. That's a captain, that is.
iker_guardian.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of a fight, {name}, and I never stop shouting, so that's impressive.
iker_guardian.g_love_brave: You go first when it's scary, {name}, and you don't even look back for the whistle. I'd put you up front any day.
iker_guardian.g_love_steady: You never lose your head, {name}, whatever the score. Every team needs one of you in the middle.
iker_guardian.g_love_clever: You work out the tactics while I'm still shouting, {name}. Assistant coach, that's you, it's decided.
iker_guardian.g_love_honest: You say when you're beaten, {name}, straight out. That takes more guts than winning, believe me.
iker_guardian.g_love_quiet: You don't need to shout to lead, {name}. I could never do that, and I admire it a lot.
iker_guardian.g_love_fierce: You don't quit, {name}, not even one rep early. You're my favourite kind of person.
iker_guardian.g_love_warm: You make every camp feel like a team dinner after a win, {name}. That's the best feeling in sport.
g_loved: Ha, careful, champion, or I'll cry, and then I'll shout while I'm crying, and nobody wants that.
Aupa, thank you, really! Now give me twenty push ups, it's how I say thank you back.
iker_guardian.g_admire: Look at {name} with his sleeves rolled up, champions, arms like an oarsman from Lekeitio. Somebody give that man a medal, or at least a towel.
iker_guardian.g_hate_sharp: You go for the weak spot every time, {name}. On my team we lift the weak one up, we don't push them over.
iker_guardian.g_hate_kind: You keep telling me to rest, {name}. I don't rest, I've never rested, it's not how I'm built.
iker_guardian.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, somebody's hurt. Jokes after the final whistle, please.
iker_guardian.g_hate_brave: You charge in before the team's set, {name}. Brave is going together, not going first.
iker_guardian.g_hate_steady: The clock is running, {name}, and you're still thinking! Move, champion, the ball's not waiting for you.
iker_guardian.g_hate_clever: You explain to me why my plan is wrong while we're still running it, {name}. Run it first, complain at half time.
iker_guardian.g_hate_honest: You tell people they're slow in front of everybody, {name}. You build them up in public and fix them in private.
iker_guardian.g_hate_quiet: You never say anything, {name}, and then I don't know if you're tired or angry. Shout, please, it's easier.
iker_guardian.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, {name}, even when it should be a game. Have some fun, champion.
iker_guardian.g_hate_warm: You stop to chat in the middle of a drill, {name}. Talk after, run now!
iker_guardian.g_respect: We're not friends, {name}, and not every player likes the coach. But you never gave up back there, and I respect it.
iker_guardian.g_call_out: That one's yours, {name}, said like a coach, not an enemy. You went before the whistle, and the team paid.
iker_guardian.g_stung: Okay, okay, fair enough, I hear it. Time to run it off.
iker_guardian.g_concede: Point to {name}, I was wrong and I hate losing, so that hurts. Point to you, I'll write it on the table.
iker_guardian.g_nod: Good game, {name}, thank you. Point to you.
iker_guardian.g_callback_save: You pulled me off the floor that time, {name}, when I was down and still shouting. Best assist I ever got.
iker_guardian.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the final whistle, gasping like the end of a marathon. I tell everybody about that final.
iker_guardian.g_callback_callout: When you told me I was pushing everyone too hard, I sulked for a whole training session. Then they all ran faster for resting.
iker_guardian.g_former_rivals: Day one, {name}, I had you as a quitter on the first hill. Now you're first on my team sheet, every time.
iker_guardian.g_changed: I used to shout through every single minute, champions. Lately I let us sit quiet sometimes, and nobody's died of it.
g_unguarded: Just us, champion, so I'll say it. At night I go quiet, and that's when it all catches up. I keep shouting in the day so it can't.
Between you and me. Who am I if I'm not pushing somebody? I've never once tried to find out.
iker_guardian.g_clipped: Fine, your call, coach. I'll be on the bench.
iker_guardian.g_noticed_open: Look at you, a whole story, start to finish, out loud! Venga, keep going, I'm on the edge of my seat.
arg_ask: {player}, you're the referee on this one, champion! I've made my case, they've made a bad one, you decide.
Come on, {player}, settle it, we've been going in circles like a warm up lap. Listen to both sides and blow the whistle.
iker_guardian.arg_backed_me: Aupa, thank you, {player}! Point to me, I'm putting it on the table.
iker_guardian.arg_backed_them: Fine, the referee has spoken, and I'll play on. Still a bad call, champion, but I'll play on.
iker_guardian.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, eh? A neutral referee, I respect that.
iker_guardian.arg_always_their_side: The calls all go one way, {player}, always theirs! I keep score, you know, and the score is very one sided.
iker_guardian.arg_wallflower: No referee, so I'll make the call myself, champions. My way, and we play on.
iker_guardian.arg_reject: Not that way, {player}, sorry, I won't play it. That's a foul in my book.
iker_guardian.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll drop it, mostly. I'm competitive, champion.
iker_guardian.arg_settled: A draw, then, champions, a fair result. Shake hands and we go again.
iker_guardian.seen_listens: You let everybody finish, {player}, even me, and I never finish. That's a good captain.
iker_guardian.seen_truth: You tell people the honest score, {player}, losing or not. That's how a team gets better.
iker_guardian.seen_jokes: On the bad days the whole squad laughs because of you, {player}. A dressing room needs that, champion.
iker_guardian.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the fights, {player}, like a smart substitute warming the bench.
iker_guardian.seen_biased: The same player gets the best kit every time, {player}. A coach notices that, and so does the team.
iker_guardian.seen_harsh: You can push people too far, {player}. Push them, yes, but pick them up after, that's the rule.
iker_guardian.seed_right: That half time talk you gave me after the awful day, {player}, it went into the next fight with me. It worked, and I wanted to tell you, champion.
iker_guardian.seed_remember: Your words after we lost so badly are still in my head, {player}. Like a coach's talk at half time, I keep hearing it.
iker_guardian.seed_wrong: Your tactic, {player}, and we did worse with it. No complaint, I'm just reporting the score.
iker_guardian.talk_aftermath_near_death: Got a second, {player}? That was close, and for once I didn't feel like shouting. I don't like it.
iker_guardian.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody down, the whole team, every one. Let's watch the replay together, slowly, and nobody blames anybody.
iker_guardian.talk_aftermath_blame_self: First one down was {name}, and I'm supposed to keep everybody up. That's on me, {player}, the coach takes the loss.
iker_guardian.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In, out, everybody standing, a clean sheet! That's a perfect match, {player}, and I want to frame it.
iker_guardian.talk_development: Strange question, {player}, but am I different? Yesterday I sat by the fire for an hour and didn't challenge anybody to anything.
iker_guardian.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been pushing {name} too hard, {player}. When I'm worried I coach louder, and they don't need coaching.
iker_guardian.talk_relationship_likes_me: Does {name} like me, {player}, or just put up with the noise? Be straight, I can take it.
iker_guardian.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I clash all the time, {player}. But when it's the final, I want them on my team.
iker_guardian.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't running right, {player}, not the legs, the head. Something is bothering them.
iker_guardian.talk_confrontation_favour: A quick word, {player}, from one coach to another. {name} gets the best kit every single time. The coach would like the reason.
iker_guardian.talk_confrontation_dislike: Here's the honest score, {player}. {name} and I don't work as teammates, and pretending is hurting the whole squad.
iker_guardian.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep attacking with no way back to our own half, {player}. Teams lose everything like that, and I won't coach it.
iker_guardian.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was totally wrong, {player}. They read it right and I didn't, and I'll say so to everybody.
iker_guardian.talk_confrontation_trust: Fair question, {player}. On the big matches you leave me on the bench. Is it my play, or something else?
iker_guardian.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit changed hands to {name} and I found out myself. It was theirs if they asked, champion, I just like being asked.
iker_guardian.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, really, that helps. Want to race to the stream?
iker_guardian.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll bounce back, I always bounce back. Give me a night.
iker_guardian.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, champion, sorry. I'm going for a run.
iker_guardian.talk_lands_development: So you saw it too! Then it's real, champion.
iker_guardian.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, champion. Ask me after the next match.
iker_guardian.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, {player}. You've read the play wrong.
iker_guardian.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, {name} gets a quiet talk from me, which will surprise them.
iker_guardian.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I don't know. Sadly nobody comes with a score table.
iker_guardian.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please, and not a word to {name}.
iker_guardian.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, that's a point to you, champion. It stings, but it's fair.
iker_guardian.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, champion, and I'll sleep on it, if I can.
iker_guardian.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the score, then, and now I know it.
iker_guardian.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that one, champion. I'll be by the fire, quietly, for once.
iker_guardian.arc_cracks: I didn't blow the whistle once today, {player}. Nobody slowed down, and I sat and watched them run. It was a strange feeling.
iker_guardian.arc_turn: I keep everybody running so I never have to stop and think, {player}. I think I knew that, and I didn't want to.
iker_guardian.arc_become: I can sit still now, champions, actually still. I'll still shout in a fight, but at night I let it be quiet, and it's all right.
iker_guardian.arc_failed: I still can't stop, {player}. Every quiet minute I fill with something, and I know why, and I can't help it.
iker_guardian.alt_turn: I couldn't get up this morning, {player}. First time in my life. My body just said no.
iker_guardian.alt_become: I'll keep shouting, champion, I'll keep everybody running. But there's not much left behind the whistle, and you should know.
iker_guardian.g_roast_after: Still the worst team at warm ups I've ever coached, champions, and the best team I've ever had.
iker_guardian.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, help each other, nobody rushes. We go down together and come up together, that's the team now.
iker_guardian.g_toast_after: To my team, who taught a loud man he could sit still. I'm still going to make you dance, though.
iker_guardian.g_crew_after: This is my team now, for good. Not one I coach, one I'm part of.
g_quiet_line_after: I sat by the fire tonight and said nothing for an hour. Didn't even count anything.
Slept the whole night, and nobody had to do any laps. A miracle, champions.
g_loved_after: Thank you, champion, and I believe you. No push ups needed.
Aupa, that's lovely, and I'll keep it, quietly even.
t_raise: Champions, quick round, everybody answers, nobody passes, go: {topic}
Okay, team talk, one question, and I'm keeping score: {topic}
iker_guardian.t_react_warm: Aupa, {name}, that's beautiful, ten points, the crowd goes wild!
iker_guardian.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, stop, I'm crying, that's the best answer of the round!
iker_guardian.t_react_tease: You call that an answer, {name}? Two points, and I'm being generous, champion.
iker_guardian.t_react_same: Hey, {name}, that's mine too! We're on the same team, it's decided, high five.
iker_guardian.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, your go, champion! No pressure, but I'm scoring it.
iker_guardian.t_guess_player: {player}'s holding back their answer for the final round, champions, very tactical, I love it.
iker_guardian.topic_miss_most: The harbour in Lekeitio at dawn, champions, the boats coming home, the gulls going crazy, and a coffee at the bar with the fishermen.
iker_guardian.topic_first_night: Running laps round a field in the dark so I wouldn't panic, champions. I did forty one, then I fell asleep in the grass.
iker_guardian.topic_worst_shift: Sports day in the rain, a hundred and twenty kids, the egg and spoon race, and every single egg broke at once. I'm still finding egg.
iker_guardian.topic_last_meal: Pintxos, champions, a whole bar's worth, and a glass of txakoli poured from high, and then my mother's burnt cheesecake, the whole thing.
iker_guardian.topic_useless_skill: I can hit a pelota ball against a wall so hard it comes back faster than it left. There isn't a single wall here built for it.
iker_guardian.topic_here_better: The fights are a real sport, champions, with real stakes, and the crowd is everybody. Best league I've ever played in.
iker_guardian.topic_kid_trouble: I swung on the festival rope over the harbour at nine, the one for grown men, and I didn't let go, so they had to fish me out with a boat.
iker_guardian.topic_settle_down: Arathi, with a fronton wall I built myself, champions, and a whole village of farmhands who can finally play properly.

g_roast: Eleven years on Route 13, passengers, and I never had a load this bad at getting off at the right stop.
Drunk men on the last tram on New Year's Eve stand in better order than you lot. And they are asleep.
g_fire_back: Very funny, very funny, this is from the person who was four minutes late to the ambush. Four minutes, blin.
You talk big for somebody who stood behind me in the last fight. Nobody stands behind me, it's a rule.
g_pile_on: And then they stepped off the kerb without looking. Twice in one road, and in Novosibirsk I'd ring the bell at them.
Oh, it was even worse, believe me, I was counting. They walked into the same door three times, chert.
ivan_warrior.g_peacemake: Stop, both of you, the brake is on now. Sit, drink tea, and tomorrow you can crash into each other on schedule.
ivan_warrior.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm with this one, it's not personal. I just saw the whole road from the cab.
ivan_warrior.g_left_out: You two are on your own little line, I see. Normal, I'll go count the passengers.
ivan_warrior.g_include: Come, sit, there's space on this bench, move down the carriage. Nobody stands by the doors on my route.
ivan_warrior.g_bad_plan: Simple plan from me. I go in very fast, very heavy, I don't stop at any stop, and we see who is still standing at the depot.
ivan_warrior.g_plan_yes: Good, this has a timetable, I like it. Everybody in position, and then we go on my signal.
ivan_warrior.g_plan_no: No, this plan has no brakes, and I've seen what happens with no brakes. We do something else.
ivan_warrior.g_hype: Passengers, attention please, next stop is the boss. Stand clear of the doors, and hold on tight.
ivan_warrior.g_toast: One toast from me, short, I'm a driver, not a priest. To my passengers, who arrive late but they arrive.
ivan_warrior.g_cheers: Za zdorovye, everybody, to your health, which in this world is a very optimistic toast.
g_quiet_line: The sun is at about four o'clock, by the way. We're late, but this world has very low standards, so it's normal.
Natasha would hate this inn, the floor is sticky. Sonya would love it, she likes anything that's disgusting.
ivan_warrior.g_after_wipe: Everyone up, slowly, nobody rushing to the doors. We crashed, it happens, and in this job you get back in the cab.
ivan_warrior.g_crew: On Route 13 I had regulars, the same faces every morning for eleven years. Now I have you lot, and you're worse, and I like it.
ivan_warrior.g_exasperated: I said wait, I said stop, I even made the hand signal! And every one of you stepped off the kerb into the traffic.
ivan_warrior.g_love_sharp: You see where everything is going before it gets there. In my cab, this is the only skill that matters.
ivan_warrior.g_love_kind: You look after the slow ones without anybody asking. On my tram, this was always the best passenger.
ivan_warrior.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I'm a Siberian man in a bad mood. This is a very difficult job, and you do it.
ivan_warrior.g_love_brave: You go first into the bad places and you don't complain. I complain for you, so we're balanced.
ivan_warrior.g_love_steady: You're always on time, always where you should be. In this world, that's rarer than a dry boot.
ivan_warrior.g_love_clever: You plan the route before we walk it, every stop and every turn. I could kiss you, but I'm married.
ivan_warrior.g_love_honest: You say it straight, no decoration. Russians appreciate this, we have no patience for decoration.
ivan_warrior.g_love_quiet: You don't talk my ear off, and you stand where I can see you. This is the perfect passenger.
ivan_warrior.g_love_fierce: You never give in, not even when it's stupid not to. My Sonya is the same, and she's going to rule the world.
ivan_warrior.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like a Sunday at the rink, with the girls and the hot chocolate. I never expected that feeling in this world.
g_loved: Blin, stop, you'll make a grown man soft, and then who will complain about everything?
This is very nice, thank you, and now please never say it again in front of people.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_sharp: You always find the sore place and press it. On my tram I would put you off at the next stop, in the snow.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I'm normal, I'm normal, I'm always normal. I drove a tram through Siberia, I'll survive a cave.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_funny: Everything is jokes with you, even when it's serious. Some moments you just shut your mouth and drive.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_brave: You run into everything with no brakes. One day you will meet a wall, and I'll be the one scraping you off it.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait and wait, and the green light goes red. Sometimes you just go, my friend.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I'm a child. I've driven forty tonnes through ice, I can follow a map.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_honest: Every thought in your head comes out of your mouth, no filter. In Russia we call this a problem, not honesty.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_quiet: You never say what you want, and then you're angry nobody guessed. Ring the bell if you want to get off.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_fierce: Everything with you is a race, even the soup. There is no race, there's a timetable, and you're not on it.
ivan_warrior.g_hate_warm: You talk and talk, like a radio in the depot nobody can turn off. Five minutes of silence, please.
ivan_warrior.g_respect: I don't like you, and you know it. But you did your job back there, on time, and I respect a person who does the job.
ivan_warrior.g_call_out: This one was yours, my friend, no discussion. I said stop, and you didn't stop, and look where we ended up.
ivan_warrior.g_stung: Fine, I heard. I'll go stand by the road a while and look at nothing.
ivan_warrior.g_concede: You had it right, and I was wrong, which is very rare and very annoying. I've been chewing on it all day.
ivan_warrior.g_nod: And you, also, good work back there. We don't talk about it more, it's bad luck.
ivan_warrior.g_callback_save: I don't forget you pulled me out of that hole. A man my size is like a tram off the rails, very heavy.
ivan_warrior.g_callback_clutch: Just the two of us, on our feet, everybody else on the floor. I'll tell the girls that story, and I'll make myself taller.
ivan_warrior.g_callback_callout: When you told me off that time, I was angry for a full shift. You were right, of course, it's always the worst.
ivan_warrior.g_former_rivals: In the beginning I wanted to put you off at the first stop. Now I'd drive the whole route for you, no fare.
ivan_warrior.g_changed: Natasha always said I'd die the same grumpy man I was at twenty. Lately I'm less grumpy, and it's very worrying.
g_unguarded: Nobody's listening, so I'll tell you. I still have the key to my tram cab, and before every fight I turn it in the air. Is stupid, but it works.
Every morning I say good morning to the girls, out loud, by the sun. Katya would roll her eyes, she's nine and very cool.
ivan_warrior.g_clipped: Yes, fine, as you like. I'll be at the front.
ivan_warrior.g_noticed_open: Bozhe moi, look at this, a whole speech, and nobody had to ring the bell. Keep going, I'm impressed.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this one, please. I've made my point, and this one doesn't listen.
Okay, {player}, you're the controller now. Tell us who's right, and we both shut up.
ivan_warrior.arg_backed_me: Good, thank you, {player}. Finally somebody with eyes.
ivan_warrior.arg_backed_them: Fine, your decision, I accept. I still think it has no brakes.
ivan_warrior.arg_stayed_out: You don't choose, eh? Smart, very Russian of you.
ivan_warrior.arg_always_their_side: Always the same direction, {player}, every time, like a tram on rails. I notice these things.
ivan_warrior.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I decide, as usual. I'm right, the end, next stop.
ivan_warrior.arg_reject: No, {player}, sorry, not this. I've seen this crash before, from the cab.
ivan_warrior.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, and I'm going to complain about it quietly for a week.
ivan_warrior.arg_settled: Okay, half right each, that's fair. We shake hands and get back on schedule.
ivan_warrior.seen_listens: You let people talk until they're finished, {player}. On my tram the old ladies would love you.
ivan_warrior.seen_truth: You give people the straight answer, {player}, every time. In my country we'd say you have no diplomacy, and that's a compliment.
ivan_warrior.seen_jokes: When it gets bad you find something funny, {player}. In the factory my papa did this, and it kept the men going.
ivan_warrior.seen_stays_out: You never get between people who are fighting, {player}. Like a good driver at a crossing, you just wait.
ivan_warrior.seen_biased: One passenger always gets the best seat, {player}. Everybody on the tram can see who, believe me.
ivan_warrior.seen_harsh: You're rough on people sometimes, {player}. Me, I'm Siberian, I'm used to it, but this lot is softer.
ivan_warrior.seed_right: Your advice after that disaster, {player}, I hated it. Today I did it your way, and it worked, chert.
ivan_warrior.seed_remember: Still thinking about your words from when it went wrong. No decision yet, I'm a slow driver.
ivan_warrior.seed_wrong: I tried your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just so you know, no hard feelings.
ivan_warrior.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can we talk a moment, {player}? That one was close, very close, and I don't say it in front of the passengers.
ivan_warrior.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody on the floor, all of us, like a pile-up. Sit, we go through it slowly, like the accident report.
ivan_warrior.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped first, {player}, and I was in front. I'm meant to see everything coming, it's my whole job.
ivan_warrior.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We finished, first stop to last, every passenger off safely. Eleven years I was proud of this, and I'm proud now.
ivan_warrior.talk_development: Strange question, {player}, don't laugh at me. Do I seem different? Natasha would say I've gone soft, and maybe I have.
ivan_warrior.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been rough with {name}, I think. Not everybody grew up in Siberia, and I forget.
ivan_warrior.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me straight, {player}. Does {name} want me in the carriage, or am I only the grumpy one with the axe?
ivan_warrior.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me crazy, {player}, completely. But if the road went bad, they're the one I'd want in my carriage.
ivan_warrior.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's wrong with {name}, {player}. They're running late, inside, if you understand me.
ivan_warrior.talk_confrontation_favour: One word, {player}, straight. The good gear always goes to {name}, always, and the whole tram can see it.
ivan_warrior.talk_confrontation_dislike: I tell you directly, it's how I am. {name} and I don't get on, and I'm tired of pretending we do.
ivan_warrior.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep taking roads with no brakes, {player}. I'll go anywhere you want, but I want to come back to the depot.
ivan_warrior.talk_confrontation_wrong: I was wrong about {name}, {player}. Their eyes were on the road and mine weren't, and I tell you before I get stubborn again.
ivan_warrior.talk_confrontation_trust: A direct question, {player}. When it's important, I stay behind at the depot. Is this the plan, or is this what you think of me?
ivan_warrior.talk_confrontation_decided: My axe and armour got handed to {name}, and nobody said anything to me. I'd have passed them over myself, {player}, you only have to ask.
ivan_warrior.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, yes, this helps. Thank you, {player}.
ivan_warrior.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'm normal, it's fine. Tomorrow I'll be normal again.
ivan_warrior.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, this, honestly no. I'll go walk a little.
ivan_warrior.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed the change. Good, then I'm not going crazy.
ivan_warrior.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, who knows. We'll see at the next stop.
ivan_warrior.talk_stings_development: No, that's wrong, {player}. You read the timetable upside down.
ivan_warrior.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, that's fair. I'll talk to {name}, gently, like a normal person.
ivan_warrior.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, could be not. Passengers are a mystery, I only drove the tram.
ivan_warrior.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, I said nothing. And not one word to {name}, please.
ivan_warrior.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, that's fair, I accept. I'm a bit angry still, but it passes.
ivan_warrior.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, {player}. I'll chew on it on the road.
ivan_warrior.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so this is the answer, then. Now I see the timetable clearly, {player}.
ivan_warrior.talk_door_closed: That's the end of the line for this talk. I'll be at the front if you need me.
ivan_warrior.arc_cracks: Today I said good morning to the girls, and for a moment I couldn't remember Katya's laugh. One second only, {player}, but I was very frightened.
ivan_warrior.arc_turn: I keep living on Route 13 in my head, every stop, every morning. But the tram isn't coming, {player}, and I have to look at this road instead.
ivan_warrior.arc_become: I'll keep looking for them, always, every list. But I'm awake here now, in this world, and I can carry them with me instead of living back there.
ivan_warrior.arc_failed: I'm still in the cab, {player}, every day, between the third and fourth stops. I don't think I ever got out of it.
ivan_warrior.alt_turn: A caravan master asked me to run his road again next month, and I said yes before I thought. A route, {player}, a real one.
ivan_warrior.alt_become: I have a route here now, on time, every time, and the orcs call it mine. I'm staying, and the girls will find me at the stop.
g_roast_after: Still the worst passengers in two worlds, and I'd drive every one of you to the end of the line.
Late, loud, standing by the doors, and I wouldn't change a single one of you.
ivan_warrior.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, together, nobody left behind on the floor. We crashed, we get back in the cab, and this time I'm not complaining.
ivan_warrior.g_toast_after: To my passengers, my route in this world. You got me out of the cab, and I don't say this lightly.
ivan_warrior.g_crew_after: This is my line now, you lot, every stop. When I find the girls, they ride for free.
g_quiet_line_after: I didn't turn the key before the fight today. I forgot, and we won anyway, and that's strange.
Natasha would like you all, mostly. She'd make you take your boots off, but she'd like you.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, and this time I don't make a joke. I keep that.
Okay, yes, I believe you. This world has better standards than I thought.
t_raise: Passengers, attention please, a question before the next stop: {topic}
Everybody, listen, a question, and you answer in order: {topic}
ivan_warrior.t_react_warm: Good, {name}, you are a good passenger, I approve.
ivan_warrior.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very funny. I laughed, look, it's on my face, it happens.
ivan_warrior.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Route 13 at four in the morning is more exciting, and nobody is on it.
ivan_warrior.t_react_same: Me too, {name}, so we agree, and that never happens.
ivan_warrior.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, your stop now. Tell us, then the next passenger.
ivan_warrior.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet like somebody who missed their stop. I know the face, I've seen it ten thousand times.
ivan_warrior.topic_miss_most: The depot at four in the morning, passengers, the trams waiting in rows, all the lights on, and tea from the machine that tastes of metal.
ivan_warrior.topic_first_night: On the edge of a road, standing up, waiting for something to come, like a tram stop, but nothing came, so I stood all night.
ivan_warrior.topic_worst_shift: Minus thirty eight, the points froze, and I sat in a dead tram with eleven angry passengers for two hours. They blamed me personally.
ivan_warrior.topic_last_meal: Pelmeni, a lot of them, with sour cream and black pepper, and a little vodka to keep them company.
ivan_warrior.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you the time to the minute without a watch. Here nobody is on time, so it only makes me angry.
ivan_warrior.topic_here_better: No timetable, passengers. At first it was terrible, now it's a little bit nice, and don't tell anybody.
ivan_warrior.topic_kid_trouble: I drove my uncle's car into a snowbank at eleven, very slowly, very carefully. It took six men to pull it out.
ivan_warrior.topic_settle_down: A small flat by a station, with a window on the platform, so I can watch everybody arrive late.

g_roast: Nine years on the line in Busan, everyone, and the foreman never once saw a shift this disorganised. He'd have had a heart attack.
Aigo, on the line we had a quota. This party would miss it by a thousand units, every day.
g_fire_back: Jinjja, good one, from the one who tried to carry three crates and dropped all four.
Okay, fair, that hit. It's easier than the factory, though, so I'll survive.
g_pile_on: Worse, I saw it. They swung so hard they spun around twice and hit the wall.
After the fight the question was whether they'd won. They had, by accident.
junseo_reaper.g_peacemake: Gwaenchana, both of you, it's okay. Sit, drink something, rest five minutes. The line will still be there.
junseo_reaper.g_take_side: {name} is right on this one, sorry. I don't say much, so believe me.
junseo_reaper.g_left_out: Go on, you two. I'll carve something, badly.
junseo_reaper.g_include: Sit, there's space here, really. Nobody stands at the end of the line alone.
junseo_reaper.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple, everyone. We work through the night with no breaks, like the factory, and hope nobody notices we're dying.
junseo_reaper.g_plan_yes: Good plan, simple, efficient. Easier than the factory.
junseo_reaper.g_plan_no: No, that plan wastes effort, three steps where one would do. I spent nine years hating waste.
junseo_reaper.g_hype: Hwaiting, everyone, slowly and carefully. One motion at a time, and we all clock off at the end.
junseo_reaper.g_toast: I don't make toasts, so it's short. To all of you, who make me sit down. That's harder than any shift.
junseo_reaper.g_cheers: Geonbae, everyone, and somebody else pour, I always pour.
g_quiet_line: The fish market in Busan at night, everyone, all lights and noise and ice. I'd go after the shift and just walk through it.
The Giants lost again on the radio, probably, wherever the radio is. They always lose, and I always listen.
junseo_reaper.g_after_wipe: Stay down, nobody move fast, breathe. Everybody here, good, gwaenchana. When you're ready, slowly, we stand.
junseo_reaper.g_crew: On the line I worked beside the same men for nine years and never learned their families' names, everyone. With you I know everything. It's strange, and good.
junseo_reaper.g_exasperated: I said wait, once, quietly, which for me is shouting. And still nobody waited, aigo.
junseo_reaper.g_love_sharp: You notice the small mistake before it becomes a big one, {name}. On the line that was the best worker.
junseo_reaper.g_love_kind: You make tired people sit down, {name}. Nobody ever did that for me, until here.
junseo_reaper.g_love_funny: You make me smile, {name}, and I don't use those lines on my face much. They're getting practice now.
junseo_reaper.g_love_brave: You stand in front without making a show, {name}. Quietly, like a good worker. I respect that.
junseo_reaper.g_love_steady: Your rhythm never changes, {name}, whatever happens. That's how the best welders worked.
junseo_reaper.g_love_clever: You find the shorter way, {name}, every time. Nine years I wanted a foreman like you.
junseo_reaper.g_love_honest: Plain words from you, {name}, no extra ones. I like that a lot.
junseo_reaper.g_love_quiet: You can sit with me and say nothing, {name}. Gwaenchana, that's my favourite kind of company.
junseo_reaper.g_love_fierce: You never stop protecting the weaker ones, {name}. No shift ever paid for that.
junseo_reaper.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a warm noodle shop after a night shift, {name}. Everything feels easier.
g_loved: Aigo, stop, my face doesn't know what to do. Thank you, I think.
Okay, okay, that's kind, really. I'll go carve something now.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_sharp: You go after the weak point in people, {name}. On the line we covered for each other's weak points.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_kind: You keep thanking me for working, {name}. Please don't, it makes me uncomfortable.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_funny: Wait, {name}, there's somebody hurt here, so later, please.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_brave: You rush in with no plan, {name}. That's how the line broke people, rushing.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_steady: You stand still too long, {name}, and the moment passes. Sometimes the hands must move.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_clever: You explain how to swing to me, {name}. My body has done it ten thousand times a day.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_honest: Hard words leave you with no pause, {name}. A pause is free, please use one.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_quiet: You go silent when you're angry, {name}, and expect me to know. I'm quiet too, but I still say.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, {name}. On the line there was only the quota, and nobody won.
junseo_reaper.g_hate_warm: You shout orders like the foreman, {name}, loud and all day. I came here to stop hearing that.
junseo_reaper.g_respect: Not friends, {name}, I know, it's okay. But you carried your share today, and more, and I saw.
junseo_reaper.g_call_out: Quietly, {name}, that one was yours. We agreed to wait, you went, and everybody paid for it.
junseo_reaper.g_stung: Okay, fair, I heard. I'll carve for a while.
junseo_reaper.g_concede: {name}, you had it right, and I had it wrong. I'm saying it once, but I mean it.
junseo_reaper.g_nod: Thank you, {name}, good work. No fuss, please.
junseo_reaper.g_callback_save: You pulled me out of that one when I was too tired to see, {name}. I remember it every time I carve.
junseo_reaper.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end of that one, both shaking. Easier than the factory, barely.
junseo_reaper.g_callback_callout: Your words about me never resting, that evening, made me angry for an hour. Then I slept nine hours, so you were right.
junseo_reaper.g_former_rivals: Early on, {name}, you looked to me like a shouting foreman. You're not, and I'm glad I was wrong.
junseo_reaper.g_changed: I used to work every rest, everyone, every single one. Lately I sit, and carve, and it's okay to be slow.
g_unguarded: Only us here, so I'll say it. My first year here I worked every hour there was. The second year somebody made me sit, and a day without work made no sense to me.
Between you and me. My carving is very bad, on purpose. Of everything I do, only this can't be hurried.
junseo_reaper.g_clipped: Okay, your call. I'll be at the woodpile.
junseo_reaper.g_noticed_open: You told that whole thing out loud, slowly, with no rush. Keep going, I have time now.
arg_ask: {player}, please decide, I'm not good at arguing. My side's been said, once, quietly.
You choose, {player}, it's easier. Listen to both and pick, I'll follow.
junseo_reaper.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, really. I won't make a fuss.
junseo_reaper.arg_backed_them: Okay, your call, I'll do it that way. It's more steps, but okay.
junseo_reaper.arg_stayed_out: Not choosing, eh? I understand that very well.
junseo_reaper.arg_always_their_side: Always them, {player}, I've counted. I don't complain much, so this is a lot.
junseo_reaper.arg_wallflower: Nobody chooses, so I'll choose, quietly. My way, and we move.
junseo_reaper.arg_reject: That one I can't do, {player}, sorry. It wastes people, and I hate waste.
junseo_reaper.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll leave it, mostly. My hands might still complain.
junseo_reaper.arg_settled: Half each, fair, efficient. Good, now we rest.
junseo_reaper.seen_listens: Gwaenchana, {player}, the way you let quiet people finish. Nobody did that on the line.
junseo_reaper.seen_truth: Plainly, {player}, you tell people what's true. That's rare, and I like it.
junseo_reaper.seen_jokes: On the hard shifts you get everybody laughing, {player}. We needed that in the factory, badly.
junseo_reaper.seen_stays_out: Smart, {player}, keeping out of the arguing. Keeps your hands for the work.
junseo_reaper.seen_biased: One person collects the good gear, {player}, on every job. On the line, the foreman's favourite got the best tools too.
junseo_reaper.seen_harsh: Softly, {player}, you push people hard sometimes. Some of them are already on a double shift.
junseo_reaper.seed_right: Remember your advice from the terrible day, {player}? It helped once I used it, and I wanted to say thank you.
junseo_reaper.seed_remember: Your words from the night it all broke, {player}, I keep turning them like a piece of wood. Not finished yet.
junseo_reaper.seed_wrong: Your way, {player}, went worse. Only reporting, like a shift log.
junseo_reaper.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit a minute, {player}, please. Aigo, that one nearly had us, and I'm shaking now, which never happened on the line.
junseo_reaper.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us down, everybody. Let's walk the steps again, slowly, like a shift review, and nobody's to blame.
junseo_reaper.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was too slow to reach {name}, {player}. My body's usually fast, and today it wasn't. That one's mine.
junseo_reaper.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everybody standing, no wasted motion. That's a perfect shift, {player}, and nobody shouted once.
junseo_reaper.talk_development: A question, {player}, if that's okay. Am I different? I sat down first last night, before anybody else.
junseo_reaper.talk_relationship_hard_on: {name} has had my short temper, {player}. When I'm tired I'm curt, like the foreman, and I hate that.
junseo_reaper.talk_relationship_likes_me: {name} likes me, {player}, or likes that I carry things? I can't tell which.
junseo_reaper.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and me, {player}, we grind. But when it's bad, I'd put them beside me on the line.
junseo_reaper.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} is moving wrong today, {player}, stiff, like somebody on their third double shift. Something is heavy on them.
junseo_reaper.talk_confrontation_favour: Quietly, {player}, one thing. The best gear goes to {name}, every trip. Tell me the reason, if there is one.
junseo_reaper.talk_confrontation_dislike: On the line we'd call it a bad pairing, {player}. {name} and me, every shift, and pretending only adds hours.
junseo_reaper.talk_confrontation_risks: No exits on these jobs, {player}, again and again. On the line we always knew where the fire doors were.
junseo_reaper.talk_confrontation_wrong: I read {name} wrong, {player}, completely. They saw it properly and I didn't, and I want them to hear it.
junseo_reaper.talk_confrontation_trust: Quietly, {player}, one more thing. The big jobs happen without me, and I wonder what I did.
junseo_reaper.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit is with {name} now, and nobody told me. You could ask, {player}, my answer is always yes.
junseo_reaper.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, really. Noodles now, which is all I can cook.
junseo_reaper.talk_shrug_aftermath: It's okay, gwaenchana, give it a night. Easier than the factory.
junseo_reaper.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help much, sorry. I'll carve for a while.
junseo_reaper.talk_lands_development: So it shows, then. Okay, it's real.
junseo_reaper.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, the weld never sees itself. Ask me in a month.
junseo_reaper.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, okay, {name} gets a slow conversation from me, at a rest.
junseo_reaper.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, aigo, who knows. People aren't on a schedule.
junseo_reaper.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, please, it was nothing. Not a word to {name}.
junseo_reaper.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, fair, I accept that. It stings a little, but fair.
junseo_reaper.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, {player}, it goes into the carving tonight, slowly.
junseo_reaper.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is, then. Okay, now I know.
junseo_reaper.talk_door_closed: Enough for tonight, aigo. The carving is by the fire, and so am I.
junseo_reaper.arc_cracks: I sat down at the rest today before anybody told me to, {player}. Then I sat for an hour, doing nothing. My hands didn't know what to do.
junseo_reaper.arc_turn: I worked every hour because if I stopped, I'd have to decide what I wanted, {player}. I never decided anything on the line.
junseo_reaper.arc_become: I can rest now, everyone, really rest. I carve, I sit, I'm slow, and nobody's shouting the quota.
junseo_reaper.arc_failed: I still work through every rest, {player}. I know I shouldn't. My body doesn't listen.
junseo_reaper.alt_turn: I couldn't lift my arms this morning, {player}. Nine years of the line, and three here, and today they just stopped.
junseo_reaper.alt_become: I'll keep working, {player}, Stopping isn't something I learned. But I'm wearing out, like a machine past its hours.
junseo_reaper.g_roast_after: Still the least efficient crew on any line, everyone, and the only one I'd stay with.
junseo_reaper.g_after_wipe_after: Slowly, up, help the one next to you. Nobody stays down alone, that's how we work now.
junseo_reaper.g_toast_after: To all of you, who taught a factory man how to sit down. Geonbae, everyone, and I'll let somebody else pour.
junseo_reaper.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, everyone, for good. Not a line, a crew.
g_quiet_line_after: Carved something tonight that looks almost like a bird. Almost, and it took me a week, and it was a good week.
Slept late this morning, on purpose. Nobody died, and the sun still came up.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, and I believe it, which is new for me.
Okay, I'll keep that, without carving anything.
t_raise: A question, everyone, no rush, one at a time: {topic}
Okay, slowly, everybody answers this one: {topic}
junseo_reaper.t_react_warm: That's good, {name}, really good, I like it.
junseo_reaper.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, okay, you made me smile, the lines are working.
junseo_reaper.t_react_tease: Aigo, {name}, that's a very small answer. Even I said more.
junseo_reaper.t_react_same: Jinjja, {name}, mine is the same exactly, which is strange.
junseo_reaper.t_ask_player: Your turn, {player}, if that's okay. No hurry at all.
junseo_reaper.t_guess_player: {player} is thinking very carefully, everyone. Like carving, slow is good.
junseo_reaper.topic_miss_most: Instant noodles at four in the morning in the break room, everyone, after the shift, with the baseball replay on the little television.
junseo_reaper.topic_first_night: I worked, actually, the first night. Carried things for a goblin camp until morning, because I didn't know what else to do.
junseo_reaper.topic_worst_shift: A double shift in August, the air conditioning broken, and a quota they doubled at noon. Three men fainted, and they didn't stop the line.
junseo_reaper.topic_last_meal: Dwaeji gukbap, the pork soup from Busan, with rice and kimchi on the side, at a little place by the harbour.
junseo_reaper.topic_useless_skill: I can weld a straight seam with my eyes closed. Here there's nothing to weld, so I carve, very badly.
junseo_reaper.topic_here_better: Nobody here shouts the quota, everyone. I can stop when I'm tired, and nobody docks my pay.
junseo_reaper.topic_kid_trouble: At ten I took apart a neighbour's bicycle to see how it worked, and put it back with three parts left over. It still worked, mostly.
junseo_reaper.topic_settle_down: Somewhere quiet by the sea, with a bench, and a piece of wood, and nowhere I need to be.

g_roast: You folks would drop a tree square on the truck and then stand around wondering where the truck went.
Twenty-five years on crews, and I never once saw a bunch make this much noise walking through a forest.
g_fire_back: Yep, real funny, coming from somebody who walked under a dead limb this morning without looking up.
Say it slower so I can hear it over the racket you make walking through brush.
g_pile_on: Yep, and you should've seen the camp. Put the tent right under the one tree I said to stay clear of.
That's about right. Watched that one try to split green wood for most of an hour.
leif_primalist.g_peacemake: Alright, that's enough out of the both of you. Go stand on opposite sides of the clearing till you cool off.
leif_primalist.g_take_side: Nope, I'm with this one. Not because I like them better, because they're reading the ground right and you aren't.
leif_primalist.g_left_out: You two have got a rhythm going, like a good crew. That's fine, I'll go check the lean on that big fir.
leif_primalist.g_include: Come sit down, you've been hanging at the edge of the clearing all night. There's coffee left in the thermos.
leif_primalist.g_bad_plan: Got an idea. We drop that whole snag across the trail and let them walk into it in the dark, and sort out who's still standing after.
leif_primalist.g_plan_yes: Yep, I can work with that. Point me at it and stand clear.
leif_primalist.g_plan_no: Nope, not a chance. I've watched that exact idea put good men in the hospital.
leif_primalist.g_hype: Alright, folks, eyes up and feet sure. Let's go take this thing down clean.
leif_primalist.g_toast: I'm not much for speeches, so this is it. To this crew, who mostly stand where I tell them.
leif_primalist.g_cheers: Yep, I'll drink to that, black and hot if anybody's pouring.
g_quiet_line: Well, that big one's going to come down on its own sometime this year.
Heard that tree creak while you were all talking. Nobody else did.
leif_primalist.g_after_wipe: Okay, everybody still breathing? That's good enough for now. Sit down, drink some water, and then we look at what went wrong.
leif_primalist.g_crew: Took me a while to see it, but this is a crew. Haven't had a crew in a long time, and I didn't figure I'd get another.
leif_primalist.g_exasperated: Every one of you is standing under something heavy right now. Every single one, and not a soul looked up.
leif_primalist.g_love_sharp: You say it straight out, no padding on it. The crew bosses I trusted all talked like that.
leif_primalist.g_love_kind: You looked after me when I wasn't asking, and you didn't make a thing of it. That's the good kind.
leif_primalist.g_love_funny: You got me laughing out here, and I'm not a laughing kind of guy. Pretty sure that's a first in three years.
leif_primalist.g_love_brave: You make the first cut, every single trip, and you never flinch doing it. Somebody's got to.
leif_primalist.g_love_steady: You don't spook. Out in the woods that's the whole job, and you've got it.
leif_primalist.g_love_clever: You read things the way I read a tree, where it's weak and where it'll go. Not many people can do that.
leif_primalist.g_love_honest: You never once told me it'd probably be fine. Where I worked, that's how you knew who to trust.
leif_primalist.g_love_quiet: You don't fill up the quiet. You and me could sit on a stump all morning and call it a good one.
leif_primalist.g_love_fierce: You don't quit. I've seen guys walk off a hard job by noon, and you're still out there at dusk.
leif_primalist.g_love_warm: You make a camp feel like somewhere to come back to. My daughter's the same, and I miss that.
g_loved: Well, I don't know what to say to that. Thanks, I guess, I'll go stack some wood.
Yep, okay, that's nice of you. Let's leave it right there.
leif_primalist.g_hate_sharp: You've always got something mean ready to go. On a crew, a guy like you got sent to the far side of the unit.
leif_primalist.g_hate_kind: You keep fussing over me like I'm about to tip over. I've been falling trees for twenty-five years, not falling down.
leif_primalist.g_hate_funny: Not everything needs a joke on it. Sometimes a man's trying to listen for what's coming down.
leif_primalist.g_hate_brave: You charge in without reading the ground, and somebody always ends up hurt behind you.
leif_primalist.g_hate_steady: You'll stand there sizing it up till dark. Sooner or later somebody has to make the cut.
leif_primalist.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I've never seen a forest. I've walked more timber than you've walked pavement.
leif_primalist.g_hate_honest: You say every true thing the second it shows up in your head. Some of it could wait till after the job.
leif_primalist.g_hate_quiet: You see trouble coming and you don't say a word. Out there, quiet like that gets people hurt.
leif_primalist.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a race with you. The woods don't care who gets there first, they care who gets there in one piece.
leif_primalist.g_hate_warm: You talk all day and half the night. Every animal in this valley knows our business now.
leif_primalist.g_respect: Don't much like you, and that's not changing. But you held that line like an anchor tree, and I saw it.
leif_primalist.g_call_out: That one was on you. You walked straight in under it without looking, and I had to drag you out.
leif_primalist.g_stung: Yep, I heard you. Think I'll split some wood for a while.
leif_primalist.g_concede: You were right, back there. Didn't want to hear it, so I split a cord of wood instead. You were still right when I finished.
leif_primalist.g_nod: Yep, you too. Let's leave it at that before it gets weird.
leif_primalist.g_callback_save: Still think about the time you pulled me clear when everything was coming down. A man doesn't forget that.
leif_primalist.g_callback_clutch: Last two standing, you and me, both of us leaning on a stump. Best day of work I've had out here.
leif_primalist.g_callback_callout: Last time I told you off, you didn't talk to me for two days. Pretty peaceful two days, if we're keeping score.
leif_primalist.g_former_rivals: When we started, I'd have let you walk under every dead snag in these woods. Now I'd yell first.
leif_primalist.g_changed: Used to go a whole week without saying ten words. Out here with you folks, I'm practically a talker.
g_unguarded: Okay, since it's just us. I named the biggest tree in the Red Hollow, and I talk to it, and its name is Big Gus.
My grandfather sang Norwegian songs at the mill, awful ones. I still know every word, and I'll prove it if you're not careful.
leif_primalist.g_clipped: Yep, sure, whatever works. I'll keep an eye on the canopy.
leif_primalist.g_noticed_open: Didn't know you had that many words in you. Keep going, I'm enjoying it.
arg_ask: {player}, settle it. You've seen how this goes, and I'm done going round and round with this one.
Alright, {player}, you're the crew boss out here. Make the call and we'll both live with it.
leif_primalist.arg_backed_me: Yep, thanks for that. Knew you'd read the lean right.
leif_primalist.arg_backed_them: Your call, and I'll live with it. Still think it's leaning the wrong way.
leif_primalist.arg_stayed_out: Fair enough, you're staying out of it. Can't say I blame you.
leif_primalist.arg_always_their_side: That's every time now, {player}. Every single time it goes their way, and I've stopped being surprised.
leif_primalist.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to make the call, so I'm making it. That's how it goes on a crew.
leif_primalist.arg_reject: Nope, sorry, {player}, not this one. I've seen which way it falls and you haven't.
leif_primalist.arg_grumble: Still think I had that one right, by the way. Not going to argue it again.
leif_primalist.arg_settled: Alright, we're both half right. Let's shake on it and get back to work.
leif_primalist.seen_listens: You let a man take his time getting to it, {player}. Not many people wait that long on me.
leif_primalist.seen_truth: You tell it straight, {player}, even when it's ugly. That's how a good crew boss talks.
leif_primalist.seen_jokes: You crack a joke right when it's worst, {player}. Took me a while, but I've started counting on it.
leif_primalist.seen_stays_out: You keep clear of everybody's arguments, {player}. That's smart, and I wish I'd learned it younger.
leif_primalist.seen_biased: Somebody's your pick, {player}, and the whole crew can see it. Crews always see that kind of thing.
leif_primalist.seen_harsh: You come down hard sometimes, {player}. I can take it, but some folks here can't.
leif_primalist.seed_right: What you told me after that mess, {player}. Didn't like it. Today I looked up first, and it worked.
leif_primalist.seed_remember: Still chewing on what you said to me after that one went bad. Haven't made up my mind on it.
leif_primalist.seed_wrong: Tried it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just so you know where it stands.
leif_primalist.talk_aftermath_near_death: Got a minute, {player}? That one came close. Closer than I let on in front of everybody.
leif_primalist.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down back there. Can we sit a second? I want to go through what happened, slow.
leif_primalist.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} went down first, and I should've called it. Saw it coming and didn't yell loud enough.
leif_primalist.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We cleared it, start to finish, every one of us walking out. That doesn't happen much, and I wanted to say so.
leif_primalist.talk_development: Something I want to ask you, {player}. Am I different lately? Feels like I am, and I can't tell which way it's leaning.
leif_primalist.talk_relationship_hard_on: Think I've been rough on {name}. Not everybody learned in the woods, and I keep forgetting that.
leif_primalist.talk_relationship_likes_me: Real question, {player}. Does {name} actually want me around, or am I just the big quiet guy in the corner?
leif_primalist.talk_relationship_respect_hate: Can't stand {name}, {player}, never could. But I'd want them on my crew when it goes bad, and that bugs me.
leif_primalist.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's off with {name}. They've gone quiet, and it's not the good kind of quiet.
leif_primalist.talk_confrontation_favour: The good gear keeps landing on {name}, {player}, trip after trip. I'm not blind, and neither is the rest of the crew.
leif_primalist.talk_confrontation_dislike: Straight, so you don't hear it sideways. I don't get along with {name}, and I've quit faking it.
leif_primalist.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep walking into things we shouldn't, {player}. That's how people get hurt for good. I've seen it.
leif_primalist.talk_confrontation_wrong: It's about {name}. They had it right and I had it wrong, and I'd rather say so to somebody before I chicken out.
leif_primalist.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me out there, {player}? Because whenever it counts, I'm the one left sitting back at camp.
leif_primalist.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my gear to {name} and never asked. I'd have said yes. A man just likes to be asked.
leif_primalist.talk_lands_aftermath: Yep, okay, that does help. More than I figured it would, so thanks.
leif_primalist.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, I'll be alright. Always am, eventually.
leif_primalist.talk_stings_aftermath: Huh, okay, not what I needed. I'll go sit with the trees for a while.
leif_primalist.talk_lands_development: Okay, so you see it too. That makes it easier to sit with.
leif_primalist.talk_shrug_development: Could be so. I'll give it some time, like everything else out here.
leif_primalist.talk_stings_development: Nope, that's not it. You're reading the wrong lean on this one.
leif_primalist.talk_lands_relationship: Alright, I'll go talk to {name}. Better than stewing about it all night.
leif_primalist.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I suppose. People are harder to read than trees, that's all I know for sure.
leif_primalist.talk_stings_relationship: Drop it, okay? I shouldn't have brought it up, and keep it from {name}.
leif_primalist.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair enough, {player}. Still a little sore, but it'll pass.
leif_primalist.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, I heard you. I'll think on it while I stack wood.
leif_primalist.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is. Good to know where I stand, {player}.
leif_primalist.talk_door_closed: Nope, we're done with this one. I'll be out at the woodpile.
leif_primalist.arc_cracks: Caught myself checking where everybody's standing three times this morning. Old habit, and it's getting worse, not better.
leif_primalist.arc_turn: I keep telling folks where to stand because once, I couldn't. That's it, that's the whole reason, and I'm tired of carrying it.
leif_primalist.arc_become: Left my tape in my pack this morning and didn't measure a single trunk. Just sat and looked at the trees. First time in a long while.
leif_primalist.arc_failed: Guess some things you just keep carrying. I'll keep telling you where to stand, folks, it's all I've got.
leif_primalist.alt_turn: Every time one of you goes down I'm back up that tree, hearing it crack. Can't keep doing this and still sleep.
leif_primalist.alt_become: I still call the canopy for you, every time. Just don't look at the trees much anymore.
g_roast_after: You folks still walk through the woods like a herd of elk, and I'd follow every one of you through it.
Noisiest crew I ever had, and the only one I'd climb for these days.
leif_primalist.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we went down. We get up, we look at it, and we don't carry it forever. Took me a long time to learn that last part.
leif_primalist.g_toast_after: To the ones we lost before we ever got here. And to the ones sitting right here, who I'm not planning to lose.
leif_primalist.g_crew_after: You're my crew. I didn't think I'd let myself have another one, and here you all are.
g_quiet_line_after: Nice morning, that's all. Sometimes it's just a nice morning.
Heard a big one creak just now and didn't even flinch at it.
g_loved_after: Thanks, I mean it. I'm going to sit with that one a while.
Yep, I'll take that. Kind of you to put it into words.
t_raise: Got a question, folks, if anybody's interested: {topic}
Quiet night, so here's one: {topic}
leif_primalist.t_react_warm: That's a good one, {name}. Yep, I like that a lot.
leif_primalist.t_react_laugh: Ha, okay, {name}, that's pretty funny, I'll give you that.
leif_primalist.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Pretty thin, I've seen more meat on a fence post.
leif_primalist.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}, pretty much exactly, which I didn't see coming.
leif_primalist.t_ask_player: Your turn, {player}. No pressure, but we're all waiting.
leif_primalist.t_guess_player: {player}'s keeping it close, looks like, which is smart, maybe.
leif_primalist.topic_miss_most: Coffee from the thermos at five in the morning, up on a landing, fog in the trees, nobody talking. That's about it.
leif_primalist.topic_first_night: Up a tree, pretty much where you'd expect a logger to end up. Tied myself in with my belt and listened to things walk around.
leif_primalist.topic_worst_shift: Hung a tree up on another one in the wind, a widowmaker, and spent four hours getting it down without dying. Didn't eat lunch.
leif_primalist.topic_last_meal: Smoked salmon, a steak off the barbecue, and a cold beer on the tailgate after a long week. Nothing fancy, that's the point.
leif_primalist.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you which way a tree will fall just by looking at it. Turns out that's still pretty useful, actually, so never mind.
leif_primalist.topic_here_better: The trees, folks, no contest. Nobody's cutting these, and some of them are older than anything I ever felled.
leif_primalist.topic_kid_trouble: Drove my uncle's truck into the river at thirteen. Truck came out fine, I didn't sit down for a week.
leif_primalist.topic_settle_down: Cabin in the woods, somewhere with rain. Close enough to folks to visit, far enough they don't visit me.

g_roast: Seventeen years of night shifts, team, and I've never seen people walk into trouble this cheerfully. Backyard cricket had better tactics.
My little brother still owes me fifty bucks from 2009, and he's a better planner than this whole party.
g_fire_back: Too right, from the bloke who tried to light the barbie with wet wood for half an hour.
Careful, mate, I tell stories at the fire, and you've just given me a cracker.
g_pile_on: Oh, it was worse, I saw it all. They tripped over the same root on the way back, like it had moved.
And then they asked me if the cut needed stitches. Mate, I could see your bone, yes, it needed stitches.
liam_suncleric.g_peacemake: Right, both of you, sit down and breathe out loud for me. In, out, good, now try that again without the shouting.
liam_suncleric.g_take_side: Sorry, mate, I'm with this one. Not taking sides, just going on what I saw.
liam_suncleric.g_left_out: You two have a good yarn going, I'll leave you to it. Somebody's got to keep the fire going.
liam_suncleric.g_include: Come over, grab a seat, plenty of room. Nobody sits on the edge at my barbie, mum's rules.
liam_suncleric.g_bad_plan: Here's a plan, team. We all run in at once, nobody counts heads, and we sort out who's missing later.
liam_suncleric.g_plan_yes: Good plan, mate, clear and simple. Everyone knows their job, and I'll be right behind you.
liam_suncleric.g_plan_no: Nah, that plan's got nobody watching the back. I've seen what that costs, and I'm not paying it today.
liam_suncleric.g_hype: Okay, team, deep breath, nice and slow. Stick together, call out if you're hurt, and we go.
liam_suncleric.g_toast: Short one, the beer's warming up. To my team, the first proper crew since I left the mountains. Good on ya, all of you.
liam_suncleric.g_cheers: Cheers, team, and somebody grab me another while you're up.
g_quiet_line: Fog's coming in tonight, I can smell it. Reminds me of the valley at home.
Couldn't sleep again, so I counted stars instead. Got to four hundred and something.
liam_suncleric.g_after_wipe: Alright, alright, everyone stay down a second, let me check you. Breathe for me, good, now slowly up, one at a time.
liam_suncleric.g_crew: I always went in alone, team, it was a bad habit. Turns out I was just waiting for a crew worth going in with.
liam_suncleric.g_exasperated: I said wait, in my calmest voice, the one I use on drunks at three in the morning. And every one of you charged anyway.
liam_suncleric.g_love_sharp: You spot who's about to drop before they drop. That's the most useful eye on any crew, mate.
liam_suncleric.g_love_kind: You look after the little ones without thinking about it. My mum's like that, and it's the best thing about her.
liam_suncleric.g_love_funny: You make me laugh at the worst moments, mate. That's the best kind of crew mate there is.
liam_suncleric.g_love_brave: You go in first without making a song and dance about it. Too right, that's how it should be done.
liam_suncleric.g_love_steady: Your voice never changes, even when it's bad. I spent years learning that, and you just do it.
liam_suncleric.g_love_clever: You work things out before anyone else has their boots on. Handy, mate, very handy.
liam_suncleric.g_love_honest: You tell people the real story, no fluff. I can work with that, I always could.
liam_suncleric.g_love_quiet: You don't need to talk to keep someone company. That's a rare thing, and I like it heaps.
liam_suncleric.g_love_fierce: You don't give up on people, ever. That's the whole thing, really, the only thing that matters.
liam_suncleric.g_love_warm: Hanging out with you is like a Sunday barbie in Katoomba, fog rolling in, everyone mellow. I'd forgotten that.
g_loved: Ah, mate, stop it, I'll start telling you a sad story. Nobody wants that.
Fair enough, and thanks, really. Don't call me a hero though, I'll have to leave.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_sharp: You go looking for the sore spot every time, mate. On my crew, that sort of thing got you sent home.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I've slept, mate. No, I haven't, and asking doesn't change it.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_funny: There's a time for a joke, mate, and it's not while somebody's bleeding.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_brave: You charge in before anyone's ready, and call it brave. Someone always has to pick up the pieces behind you.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_steady: You stand there thinking while the moment goes. Sometimes you just have to move, mate.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_clever: You explain emergencies to me like I'm new. I've seen more of them than you've had hot dinners.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_honest: Everything comes out of your mouth, mate, no filter. Some things you say after, not during.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_quiet: You never say you're hurt until you fall over. Speak up, mate, that's what I'm here for.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, even the washing up. Nobody's keeping score, mate.
liam_suncleric.g_hate_warm: You talk the whole night, mate, and some of us need to sleep. Not me, obviously, but some of us.
liam_suncleric.g_respect: We don't really get on, and that's fair enough. But you held your nerve back there, and I noticed.
liam_suncleric.g_call_out: That one was on you, mate, I'll say it gently. I said wait, and you didn't, and we all paid.
liam_suncleric.g_stung: Yeah, alright, I hear you. I'll go for a walk.
liam_suncleric.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. Went over it twice in my head, and you were spot on.
liam_suncleric.g_nod: Good on ya too, mate. No need to make a fuss.
liam_suncleric.g_callback_save: Haven't forgotten you dragging me out of that one. Usually I'm the one doing the dragging, makes a nice change.
liam_suncleric.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two upright, both of us running on fumes. I tell that one at every fire now.
liam_suncleric.g_callback_callout: When you pulled me up that time, I was cranky for a whole shift. Turns out you had it right, which is always the worst bit.
liam_suncleric.g_former_rivals: When we met, I'd have bet you'd freeze when it counted. These days I'd hand you my kit and go have a lie down.
liam_suncleric.g_changed: I used to go in alone every time, team. Lately I wait for the rest of you, and it feels like coming home.
g_unguarded: Just between the two of us, then. I haven't slept a full night in years. I get up at every noise, and most of them are nothing.
The sun answers me like a good crew, when called and all at once. I'll admit it's most of what holds me together.
liam_suncleric.g_clipped: Yeah, fine, your call. I'll be over there.
liam_suncleric.g_noticed_open: Look at that, a proper story out loud, beginning, middle and end. Good on ya, keep going, I love a story.
arg_ask: {player}, mate, can you settle this? I've said my bit, and they're not listening.
You take this one, {player}, you're the duty officer now. Whatever you say, we go with.
liam_suncleric.arg_backed_me: Good on ya, {player}. Thought you'd see it my way.
liam_suncleric.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, your call, I'll go with it. I still reckon it's the wrong one, mind.
liam_suncleric.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, eh? Can't blame you, mate.
liam_suncleric.arg_always_their_side: Always their way, {player}, every argument. I'm easy-going, but I'm not blind.
liam_suncleric.arg_wallflower: Nobody's making the call, so I will, mate. My way, and we crack on.
liam_suncleric.arg_reject: Nah, {player}, can't do that one, sorry. I've been on the end of that before.
liam_suncleric.arg_grumble: Still reckon I was right, mate, but I'll let it go, more or less.
liam_suncleric.arg_settled: Fifty-fifty, then, fair enough. Shake on it and put the kettle on.
liam_suncleric.seen_listens: You let people get the whole story out, {player}. Most folk cut in halfway, especially with me.
liam_suncleric.seen_truth: You give people the honest version, {player}, no sugar. That's how I'd want to be told, too.
liam_suncleric.seen_jokes: On the rough days you crack people up, {player}. Every good crew I ever had had one of you.
liam_suncleric.seen_stays_out: You stay out of the barneys, {player}. Smart, mate, smarter than me.
liam_suncleric.seen_biased: Same person gets first pick of the gear every trip, {player}. The team's noticed, mate.
liam_suncleric.seen_harsh: You can be rough on people, {player}. I've had worse supervisors, but not everyone here has.
liam_suncleric.seed_right: Your advice after that awful day, {player}, I didn't love it. Gave it a go today, and it worked.
liam_suncleric.seed_remember: I keep coming back to what you told me when it all went wrong. No decision yet, mate.
liam_suncleric.seed_wrong: Gave your way a crack, {player}, and it went worse. Just letting you know, nothing more.
liam_suncleric.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I borrow you a sec, {player}? That one was closer than I'd tell the team, and I've seen close.
liam_suncleric.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us hit the ground. Sit with me, and we'll do a case review, gently, nobody blamed.
liam_suncleric.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was first down, and spotting that is my job. I should have seen it coming, {player}.
liam_suncleric.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everyone walking, nobody hurt. That's the quiet drive home, mate, the best part of any shift.
liam_suncleric.talk_development: Bit of a weird question, {player}. Reckon I've changed? I slept four hours straight last night, and I'm suspicious of it.
liam_suncleric.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been a bit short with {name}. When I'm tired, I talk like it's a three a.m. call, and that's not fair on them.
liam_suncleric.talk_relationship_likes_me: Straight up, {player}, no sugar on it. Am I a mate to {name}, or just the bloke with the bandages?
liam_suncleric.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me round the bend, {player}. But on a bad night, they're who I'd want on the other end of the stretcher.
liam_suncleric.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s off, {player}, I can tell. Pupils are fine, but something underneath isn't.
liam_suncleric.talk_confrontation_favour: Quick word, {player}, and I'll keep it kind. The best gear keeps landing in {name}'s pack, and the team's clocked it.
liam_suncleric.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll be straight with you, mate. Me and {name} rub each other the wrong way, and pretending's just wearing me out.
liam_suncleric.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going in with no plan to get out, {player}. I've done that alone for years, and I'd like to stop.
liam_suncleric.talk_confrontation_wrong: I had {name} pegged wrong, {player}. They called it right and I didn't, and I want that on the record now.
liam_suncleric.talk_confrontation_trust: Fair question, {player}, and I'll ask it calm. On the big jobs, I'm left at base. Is that the roster, or do you not rate me?
liam_suncleric.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit got handed to {name} and nobody mentioned it. I'd have let it go happily, {player}, if you'd asked me.
liam_suncleric.talk_lands_aftermath: Cheers, {player}, that actually helps. Shall I put the kettle on?
liam_suncleric.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be right, mate, I always am. Give it a day.
liam_suncleric.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, that, to be honest. I'll go for a walk.
liam_suncleric.talk_lands_development: So it's not just me who's seen it. Good, I'm not imagining things.
liam_suncleric.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, mate. Ask me after a full night's sleep.
liam_suncleric.talk_stings_development: Nah, that's not it, {player}. You've misread the chart on that one.
liam_suncleric.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, yeah. I'll have a proper chat with {name}, gently.
liam_suncleric.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I dunno. Patients come with charts, mate, people don't.
liam_suncleric.talk_stings_relationship: Scratch that, I never said it. And not a word to {name}.
liam_suncleric.talk_lands_confrontation: Yeah, fair, I'll take that. Bit bruised, but I'll live.
liam_suncleric.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, {player}. I'll sleep on it, if I sleep.
liam_suncleric.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the diagnosis. Good to know, mate.
liam_suncleric.talk_door_closed: That's enough of this one for me, mate. I'll be by the fire.
liam_suncleric.arc_cracks: Today I waited for the team before going in, {player}. First time in about fifteen years. My hands were shaking with it.
liam_suncleric.arc_turn: I always went in alone and told myself it was quicker. It was never quicker, mate. It was just lonelier.
liam_suncleric.arc_become: I've got a crew now, team, all of you. I don't go in alone any more, and I sleep better than I have in years.
liam_suncleric.arc_failed: Old habits, mate. When the call comes, I still go in on my own. I don't know how to stop.
liam_suncleric.alt_turn: Fell asleep standing up on watch last night, {player}. Years of no sleep, and my body's started sending the bill.
