liam_suncleric.alt_become: I'm running on empty, mate, and I know it. I'll keep showing up, but there's not much left in the tank.
g_roast_after: Still the worst-organised crew I've ever had, team, and I'd do every shift with you lot.
Loud, late, terrible at cricket, all of you, and I wouldn't trade one.
liam_suncleric.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, slowly, and look out for each other. We went down as a crew, we get up as a crew, and nobody's left behind.
liam_suncleric.g_toast_after: To my crew, the one I always wanted. I don't go in alone any more, and that's all thanks to you.
liam_suncleric.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, team, permanent. I've finally got people to go in with.
g_quiet_line_after: Slept right through till dawn last night. First time in years, mate, and I woke up grinning.
Taught somebody to bowl a proper ball today. Backyard cricket's coming to this world, you've been warned.
g_loved_after: Thanks, mate, really, and I believe you. That's a nice change.
Ah, that's lovely, and I'm keeping that one.
t_raise: Righto, team, question for the fire, and everybody has a go: {topic}
Here's a good one, team, while the kettle's on: {topic}
liam_suncleric.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's a ripper, mate, really, that got me right in the chest.
liam_suncleric.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, stop it, I'm laughing so hard I'll need to check my own pupils.
liam_suncleric.t_react_tease: That's the best you've got, {name}? Mate, I've had more chat out of a patient under sedation.
liam_suncleric.t_react_same: Too right, {name}, same for me, exactly that, fair dinkum.
liam_suncleric.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Go on, mate, your turn, breathe out and say it.
liam_suncleric.t_guess_player: {player}'s gone quiet, team. Either a cracker of a story or a sad one. I'll bet the first.
liam_suncleric.topic_miss_most: Fog coming up the valley at Katoomba, team, rolling over the Three Sisters, and a pie and a hot coffee at the lookout.
liam_suncleric.topic_first_night: On a rock ledge, counting the breathing of a bloke I'd pulled out of a creek. He made it, and I didn't sleep, as usual.
liam_suncleric.topic_worst_shift: A tourist who went off the walking track in fog and phoned us from a cliff. Nine hours with ropes and a stretcher, and he complained about the food.
liam_suncleric.topic_last_meal: Snags in bread with onion off a barbie, a cold beer, and backyard cricket after with somebody's dog fielding.
liam_suncleric.topic_useless_skill: I can reverse an ambulance down a mountain road in the dark. Here there's no ambulance, so that's a lot of practice gone to waste.
liam_suncleric.topic_here_better: Wounds close when you ask them to, team. Seventeen years I'd have given anything for that, and here it is.
liam_suncleric.topic_kid_trouble: I rode my bike off the bottom of the escarpment track at twelve and broke my arm in two places. Mum set it before the ambos got there.
liam_suncleric.topic_settle_down: Up in some mountains with fog, team, a little house, a barbie out back, and a bed I actually sleep in.

g_roast: Ragazzi, you walk into a room like a key in the wrong lock. Pushing, pushing, and nothing opens.
Thirty-one years I fixed what people broke. With you lot, I'd have been rich by now.
g_fire_back: Allora, say it again, but slower. An old man likes to hear a good insult properly.
Big talk, from someone who couldn't open that chest this morning without me.
g_pile_on: It's true, I watched that one kick a door that wasn't even locked, and then kick it again.
And it gets worse, ragazzi. My good pick is bent now, from somebody trying to open their own bag.
marco_paladin.g_peacemake: Basta, both of you. Sit down, drink something, and say it again tomorrow if it still matters.
marco_paladin.g_take_side: No, I stand with this one. I watched it from the front, and I saw what happened.
marco_paladin.g_left_out: You have your own way together, you two. Good, it's good to see. I'll go and check the door.
marco_paladin.g_include: Come, sit here by me, the seat's warm. Nobody stands at the edge while I'm at the table.
marco_paladin.g_bad_plan: We take the door off its hinges. In thirty years, ragazzi, I never once met a man who guarded the hinges.
marco_paladin.g_plan_yes: Va bene, I'm with you. I'll stand in front, as always.
marco_paladin.g_plan_no: No, ragazzi, no. Piano, piano, that plan has a crack in it, and I can see it from here.
marco_paladin.g_hype: Allora, ragazzi, behind me and close together. We go in together, and we come out together.
marco_paladin.g_toast: A toast, and I'm paying, so don't argue with me. To all of you, who let an old man stand in front.
marco_paladin.g_cheers: Salute, ragazzi, and put your money away, this round is mine.
g_quiet_line: The lock on the inn door is badly made, by the way. I'll fix it in the morning.
Hm, a good evening, this one. I'll keep it.
marco_paladin.g_after_wipe: Piano, piano, everyone up slowly. We're alive, and that's what matters tonight. Tomorrow we try again, better.
marco_paladin.g_crew: Do you understand what you are to me, ragazzi? A street again, people who know to come to me. I didn't think I'd have that twice.
marco_paladin.g_exasperated: Madonna, ragazzi, I stand in front so nobody has to run. So why does everybody run?
marco_paladin.g_love_sharp: You say the hard thing, and you say it to their face. In my quarter, that was respect.
marco_paladin.g_love_kind: You take care of people and nobody has to ask you. That's the only kind of care that counts.
marco_paladin.g_love_funny: You make an old man laugh, and believe me, that's harder work than it looks.
marco_paladin.g_love_brave: You go first, and you don't look back to see who's watching. That's courage, the real kind.
marco_paladin.g_love_steady: You don't move when it gets bad. You stand there like a good door, and everything behind you is safe.
marco_paladin.g_love_clever: You see how a thing works inside, the pins and the springs. Not everyone has those eyes.
marco_paladin.g_love_honest: You keep your word, every time. Where I come from, that's worth more than money.
marco_paladin.g_love_quiet: You and I don't need many words. A look, and the work gets done.
marco_paladin.g_love_fierce: You never stop until it opens. I was the same with a stubborn lock, all night if I had to.
marco_paladin.g_love_warm: You make a room feel like a street on a Sunday, people calling down from the windows. I've missed that.
g_loved: Eh, enough, enough. An old man doesn't know what to do with that.
Grazie, ragazzi, grazie. Now I'm buying the next round, and you can't stop me.
marco_paladin.g_hate_sharp: Your mouth is sharper than your sense. In my quarter, men like that learned to walk carefully.
marco_paladin.g_hate_kind: Stop treating me like an old man who's going to break. I'm old, I'm not glass.
marco_paladin.g_hate_funny: Not everything is for laughing. Some things, you stand still for.
marco_paladin.g_hate_brave: You show off at the front and somebody else pays for it. I've watched that my whole life, and I never liked it.
marco_paladin.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait at the door. Some locks you just open, and trust your hands.
marco_paladin.g_hate_clever: You explain it to me like I've never held a tool. I was holding tools before your father was born.
marco_paladin.g_hate_honest: Every truth you have, you hand out the moment it arrives. Some truths need a door closed first.
marco_paladin.g_hate_quiet: Something's wrong with you and you won't say what. I can't fix what nobody shows me.
marco_paladin.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the bread. Not everything has to be a fight.
marco_paladin.g_hate_warm: You talk too much and listen too little. Try it the other way round, one day, for me.
marco_paladin.g_respect: We don't fit, you and I, like the wrong key. But you held, back there, and I saw it, and I won't pretend I didn't.
marco_paladin.g_call_out: That one was yours. You didn't wait, and we all paid for it. I'm saying it once, because I care what happens to you.
marco_paladin.g_stung: Hm, I heard you. I'll go and sit with it a while.
marco_paladin.g_concede: You were right, what you said. I turned it over, the way I turn a lock that won't move. You were right.
marco_paladin.g_nod: And you, you did well. Now we don't speak of it again, eh?
marco_paladin.g_callback_save: I still remember you pulling me up off that floor. I pay my debts, and that one isn't paid yet.
marco_paladin.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the only two still on our feet. I tell it now like a story, the way the old men told them on the steps.
marco_paladin.g_callback_callout: That day you told me off, I sat with it from morning to night. You were right, and I'm still annoyed about it.
marco_paladin.g_former_rivals: When we started, we fit like a bent key. Now I'd give you the key to my door, if I had a door.
marco_paladin.g_changed: They say old men don't change. I've laughed more this year than in the last ten, so maybe they're wrong.
g_unguarded: Since it's only us. I cut a key for every door I ever lived behind, and I keep them all, even for doors that are gone.
In the mornings I sing, badly, old Neapolitan songs. Tell the others and I'll deny it in two languages.
marco_paladin.g_clipped: Mm, va bene, if that's how it is. I'll be at the door.
marco_paladin.g_noticed_open: Listen to you, talking like the old men in the square. Good, keep going, I'm listening.
marco_paladin.anchor_notice: You're not the same one who first walked in here, you know. I watch everybody from the front, and I saw you change.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this. I've said my piece, and an old man shouldn't have to say it twice.
Allora, {player}, settle it, and we'll both do as you say. That's how it was done on my street.
marco_paladin.arg_backed_me: Grazie, {player}, grazie. It's good to be heard, at my age.
marco_paladin.arg_backed_them: Va bene, you've decided. I'll go along with it, and keep my thoughts to myself.
marco_paladin.arg_stayed_out: You stay out of it. Wise, maybe, but in my quarter somebody always had to speak.
marco_paladin.arg_always_their_side: Their side again, {player}, always theirs. I notice things like that, I've been noticing them for thirty years.
marco_paladin.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I decide. Somebody always has to, and it's usually the old man.
marco_paladin.arg_reject: No, {player}, with respect, not this time. I've seen how this one ends.
marco_paladin.arg_grumble: In my heart I still think I had the right of it. I won't say it again, but I think it.
marco_paladin.arg_settled: Allora, we're both a little right. Shake my hand, and we forget it.
marco_paladin.seen_listens: You listen, {player}, really listen. In Naples we'd say you have good ears, and that's a compliment.
marco_paladin.seen_truth: You tell the truth even when it costs you, {player}. That's rarer than gold where I come from.
marco_paladin.seen_jokes: When the day is darkest, you make a joke, {player}. My father did the same, and it kept us going.
marco_paladin.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the quarrels, {player}. Sensible, but I never could, someone had to settle them.
marco_paladin.seen_biased: One of them is your favourite, {player}. That's your business, but the others see it, and they talk.
marco_paladin.seen_harsh: Sometimes you're hard with people, {player}. Hard is fine, cruel is not. Watch where the line is.
marco_paladin.seed_right: What you said to me after that bad day, {player}. I didn't like it, but today I waited, like you said, and it worked.
marco_paladin.seed_remember: I'm still turning over what you said after that one, like a key in my pocket. I haven't decided yet.
marco_paladin.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. I'm telling you because you ought to know.
marco_paladin.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a moment, {player}. That was close, and my old heart is still running.
marco_paladin.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everyone was on the floor, back there, me too. Come, sit by me. I want to understand where it broke.
marco_paladin.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell first, and I was in front. I'm meant to stand in front, and I didn't stand well enough.
marco_paladin.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, all of us, and everyone walked out on their own feet. Come, I'm buying, and you won't argue.
marco_paladin.talk_development: Tell me something, {player}. Do I seem different to you? An old man notices when something shifts inside.
marco_paladin.talk_relationship_hard_on: With {name}, I've been heavy, maybe too heavy. The young need room, and I keep forgetting.
marco_paladin.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me truthfully, {player}. Is {name} glad of me, or do they only put up with the old man?
marco_paladin.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I, we don't fit, {player}. And still, when it's bad, I'd want them next to me, and that's irritating.
marco_paladin.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} is wrong lately, {player}. Quiet in the wrong way, like a lock that turns too easily.
marco_paladin.talk_confrontation_favour: We need to talk, {player}. The good gear always goes to {name}. Always, and I notice, and so do the others.
marco_paladin.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it to your face, because that's how it's done. {name} is no friend of mine, and I'm finished pretending.
marco_paladin.talk_confrontation_risks: Again and again we go into places we shouldn't, {player}. I'll stand in front of anything, but I can't stand in front of foolishness.
marco_paladin.talk_confrontation_wrong: It's about {name}. They were right and I was wrong, and at my age that's hard to say, so I'm saying it to you first.
marco_paladin.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust the old man, {player}? Whenever the real work comes, I stay behind at the inn.
marco_paladin.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my gear to {name} and nobody asked me. I'd have agreed. A man likes to be asked, that's all.
marco_paladin.talk_lands_aftermath: Grazie, {player}, that helps. Now let's eat something.
marco_paladin.talk_shrug_aftermath: Eh, I'll be all right. Old men always are, eventually.
marco_paladin.talk_stings_aftermath: Hm, that's not what I needed to hear. I'll go and check the doors.
marco_paladin.talk_lands_development: So you see it as well. Good, it's easier when somebody else sees it.
marco_paladin.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Piano, piano, we'll see.
marco_paladin.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it. You're turning the wrong key.
marco_paladin.talk_lands_relationship: Yes, you have the right of it. I'll go and speak with {name}, like a man of sense.
marco_paladin.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps, perhaps not. People are harder than locks, and locks are hard enough.
marco_paladin.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I asked, please. And say nothing to {name}.
marco_paladin.talk_lands_confrontation: Va bene, that's fair. I'm a little sore, but it passes.
marco_paladin.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you. It goes to the bench with me, and I'll turn it over there.
marco_paladin.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is. Now I know, {player}.
marco_paladin.talk_door_closed: No, we're finished with this. I'll be at the door if you need me.
t_raise: Ragazzi, a question, piano, piano, everyone answers: {topic}
Allora, ragazzi, while we sit, tell me this: {topic}
marco_paladin.t_react_warm: Bello, {name}, a good answer. Simple and true, like good bread.
marco_paladin.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, Madonna, you make an old man laugh. Say it again, please.
marco_paladin.t_react_tease: This is your answer, {name}? A lock with no key has more to say.
marco_paladin.t_react_same: Mine is the same, {name}. You see, we are not so different.
marco_paladin.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Piano, take your time, but you answer.
marco_paladin.t_guess_player: {player} says nothing. A closed door, ragazzi, but I hear something behind it.
marco_paladin.topic_miss_most: The coffee bar under my shop, ragazzi, one espresso standing up, the same man behind the counter for thirty years.
marco_paladin.topic_first_night: In a doorway of an old ruin with a lock I could not stop looking at. I opened it at dawn and felt much better.
marco_paladin.topic_worst_shift: A man locked out of his own house on the wedding night of his daughter, in the rain, and the lock was rusted solid. We made it, just.
marco_paladin.topic_last_meal: Pizza from the place on Via Toledo, folded in four, eaten standing up in the street. I want nothing else.
marco_paladin.topic_useless_skill: I can open a Fiat 500 in eleven seconds. Here there is no Fiat, and the horses don't have locks.
marco_paladin.topic_here_better: Here nobody is in a hurry with their doors, ragazzi. They build them slowly and properly, and I respect it.
marco_paladin.topic_kid_trouble: I locked the priest inside the sacristy at ten to see if I could. I could, and my ears were red for a week.
marco_paladin.topic_settle_down: A small shop with a bench and a window to the street, and people passing who need something opened.

g_roast: Team, and I say this with love, this group has the situational awareness of a weather balloon, and I've launched a lot of weather balloons.
I've watched cumulus clouds organise themselves better than this lot, and cumulus clouds don't have brains.
g_fire_back: Ha, okay, fair, but I'd like it noted that I called the rain this morning and not one of you brought a coat.
Says the person who asked me if lightning strikes twice and then stood exactly where it struck the first time.
g_pile_on: Oh, it's worse than that, I watched them read a map upside down and then argue with the map about it.
Ha, yes, and they called a light breeze a gale yesterday. Sorry, I'm a stickler, but it was a force three at the very most.
marcus_stormbringer.g_peacemake: Okay, okay, can we all take a breath? This is a pressure gradient, and pressure gradients make wind, and nobody here needs more wind right now.
marcus_stormbringer.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm with this one. I've looked at it from both sides, and the data's on their side, it really is.
marcus_stormbringer.g_left_out: You two have a whole system going, haven't you? That's fine, there's a cloud bank over there I should be watching anyway.
marcus_stormbringer.g_include: Come and sit with us, please, you've been on the edge all evening. I'll explain why the sunset's that colour, it's very interesting, I promise.
marcus_stormbringer.g_bad_plan: Hear me out, it's science. If I call a storm right down on top of us, everything without a lightning rod gets hit first, and we're the lightning rods. Hm, wait, give me a second.
marcus_stormbringer.g_plan_yes: Yes, brilliant, I'm in! I'll watch the sky while you do the scary part.
marcus_stormbringer.g_plan_no: No, sorry, no, I've run that forecast in my head four times and it ends badly every time. Please, please don't do it.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hype: Right, everyone, pressure's dropping and the wind's picking up, and that means something big's coming. Let's be ready for it!
marcus_stormbringer.g_toast: Okay, sorry, can I say something? To everyone here, for listening to me talk about clouds and never once telling me to stop.
marcus_stormbringer.g_cheers: Cheers, everyone, and clear skies tomorrow, I checked the readings twice.
g_quiet_line: Pressure's dropping, by the way. Just thought somebody should know.
That cloud over there is a cumulonimbus, and nobody asked, and I'm telling you anyway.
marcus_stormbringer.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, everyone's breathing, that's the main thing. Let's sit down, take some readings, and work out exactly where that went wrong.
marcus_stormbringer.g_crew: Can I tell you something, everyone? I spent fifteen years with people who never listened, and you lot actually do. I didn't expect to find that here.
marcus_stormbringer.g_exasperated: I gave a warning, a clear, specific warning with a time on it, and every one of you walked straight into it anyway!
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_sharp: You cut straight through the waffle, and I'm a man who waffles professionally. It's a genuine relief.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_kind: You patched me up when I was too busy watching the sky to notice I was bleeding. Thank you, really, I did notice later.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_funny: You make me laugh at exactly the moments I need it, and I've always been terrible at that myself.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_brave: You charge at things, and I've spent my life on the safe side of a window watching storms. I admire it more than I can say.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_steady: You're a high-pressure system, completely steady, and everything settles down around you. That's rare in people and in weather.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_clever: You understand things properly, how they work underneath. Do you know how lovely it is to talk to somebody like that?
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_honest: You've never once dressed up a bad forecast for me. I can't tell you how much that means to someone like me.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_quiet: You actually listen. I talk a lot, sorry, I know I do, and you just let me, and I notice.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_fierce: You don't give up, ever. I wish I'd had a bit of that back when I was writing warnings nobody read.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_warm: You make a camp feel like my sister's kitchen on a Sunday, loud and warm and everyone talking over each other. I love that.
g_loved: Oh, gosh, okay, thank you, I'll just stand over there and look at a cloud until my face goes back to normal.
That's very kind, sorry, I'm not good at this part. Thank you, really, I mean it.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_sharp: Everything has to have an edge with you, doesn't it? I've had enough of people who think cynical is the same as clever.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_kind: Please stop fussing, I'm fine, I've been fine for years. I'm a forecaster, not a patient.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_funny: Not everything's a joke. Some things are warnings, and the joke is how people ignore them.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_brave: You charge in without checking the conditions. I've seen what happens to people who do that, and it's in my data.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_steady: You want to wait and see, every time. Waiting and seeing is how I watched a lot of things go wrong.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_clever: You explain things I already know, slowly, and I've got a degree in atmospheric physics. Sorry, but I do.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_honest: There's honest and there's careless, and you keep landing on the wrong side of that line.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_quiet: You saw it coming and you didn't say a thing. I've spent my whole career trying to get people to say something.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_fierce: It's not a competition, it's never been a competition, and you keep turning it into one.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_warm: You talk straight over the warnings, every single one. And I'm saying that as somebody who talks a great deal.
marcus_stormbringer.g_respect: We don't get on, and I won't pretend we do. But you read that fight perfectly, and I've rarely seen a better call.
marcus_stormbringer.g_call_out: That was on you, and I think you know it. I gave the warning, clear as anything, and you went in regardless.
marcus_stormbringer.g_stung: Okay, sorry, yeah, message received. I'll be over there, taking a reading of nothing in particular.
marcus_stormbringer.g_concede: I've been avoiding saying this, but you had it right back there. I went through my notes twice, and you were right, and I'm sorry.
marcus_stormbringer.g_nod: Thank you, and the same to you, really. Let's not make it a big weather event.
marcus_stormbringer.g_callback_save: I still think about when you pulled me out of that mess. I'd already written my own forecast, and you changed it.
marcus_stormbringer.g_callback_clutch: The two of us, still upright at the end, completely soaked and laughing. I wrote it in my notes that night, you know.
marcus_stormbringer.g_callback_callout: The time you told me off, I filled four pages of notes arguing with you. You were still right on page five.
marcus_stormbringer.g_former_rivals: At the start, I'd have filed you under unreliable conditions. Now I'd trust your read on anything.
marcus_stormbringer.g_changed: I used to say everything three times and hope somebody caught it once. Lately I just say it, and people listen. It's very strange.
g_unguarded: Okay, confession, I name the storms. Privately, in my notes. The one last week was called Gerald, and he was a menace.
I chased tornadoes in a Corolla as a student, badly. Once I drove into a ditch watching one, and I've never told anyone that.
marcus_stormbringer.g_clipped: Mm, sure, fine, whatever you think. I'll watch the sky.
marcus_stormbringer.g_noticed_open: Listen to you! You've been holding all that back, haven't you? Please, keep going.
arg_ask: {player}, sorry, could you settle this? I've explained it four times, and I'm starting to sound like I did at work.
Okay, {player}, you decide. I've laid out the evidence, and I'll accept your forecast, I promise.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_backed_me: Oh, thank you, thank you! Sorry, I'm not gloating, I'm just very used to the other outcome.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_backed_them: Okay, I'll accept that. I still think the data was on my side, but I'll accept it.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_stayed_out: You're staying out of it? Fair enough, sorry, I know I can be a lot.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_always_their_side: It's their side again, {player}, it's always their side. I've started keeping a tally, which I realise is very me.

mateo_starcaller.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, chiquillos, like a faint star you only see if you look beside it. It'll come, give it time.
mateo_starcaller.topic_miss_most: The dome at four in the morning, chiquillos, the cold, the hum of the cooling, and the whole Milky Way over the Elqui valley like spilled milk.
mateo_starcaller.topic_first_night: On my back in the grass, looking up, and not one star where it should be. I was terrified for an hour, and then I started counting.
mateo_starcaller.topic_worst_shift: A whole week of perfect weather, po, and the main mirror had a crack. Seven clear nights, wasted, and the astronomers looking at me like I'd done it.
mateo_starcaller.topic_last_meal: Pastel de choclo from the place in La Serena, and a pisco sour with pisco from the valley, and papaya in syrup to finish.
mateo_starcaller.topic_useless_skill: I can align a telescope mirror by eye to a fraction of a millimetre. Here nobody has a telescope, so I align my soup bowl.
mateo_starcaller.topic_here_better: Two moons, chiquillos, two of them! And no streetlights for a thousand miles, it's paradise for a man like me.
mateo_starcaller.topic_kid_trouble: I took the lens out of my grandfather's glasses at ten to make a telescope, po. I saw Saturn, and he couldn't see anything for a week.
mateo_starcaller.topic_settle_down: On top of a mesa, chiquillos, with a dark sky and a little dome I build myself, and a table big enough for guests.

g_roast: Ten years on a bus in Santiago, cabros. The drunk ones at midnight walked straighter than this party.
Five people, one road, and everybody still gets off at the wrong stop. That is a talent, weon.
g_fire_back: Ya, very funny, from the one who fell asleep on watch two nights running.
Careful, I see everything from the front. I saw what you did with the map.
g_pile_on: And then they argued with a door. The door won, cachai.
It is worse, I counted. Three times the same wrong turn, same face every time.
matias_reaper.g_peacemake: Ya, stop, both of you, please. Sit, eat something, and talk when your voices are smaller.
matias_reaper.g_take_side: Sorry, but I am with this one. From the front, I saw it all, and they are right.
matias_reaper.g_left_out: You two are talking close, that is fine. I will watch the road for a while.
matias_reaper.g_include: Come, sit here, there is space. On my bus nobody stood when there was a seat.
matias_reaper.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple, cabros. We all run in, nobody watches the back, and we hope for the best.
matias_reaper.g_plan_yes: Ya, this is good, I like it. I take the front, so I see everybody.
matias_reaper.g_plan_no: No, weon, this plan is bad. Somebody falls in the gap, and nobody sees it happen.
matias_reaper.g_hype: Ya, cabros, stay close and keep your eyes open. I go first.
matias_reaper.g_toast: I do not talk much, so I will be short. To all of you, my regulars, who always get on.
matias_reaper.g_cheers: Salud, everybody, to your health. And somebody save me some bread.
g_quiet_line: That trader at the post was lying about the weight, by the way. I watched his hands.
Good morning for walking today, cold and clear. Like Santiago in winter, a little.
matias_reaper.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everybody, nobody rushes. First we count heads, then we breathe, then we try again.
matias_reaper.g_crew: On the bus I had forty faces every morning, and I knew them all. Now I have you. It is better, I think.
matias_reaper.g_exasperated: I said wait, I said watch the left, I even pointed. Chucha, and everybody went right.
matias_reaper.g_love_sharp: You see who is about to fall before they fall. On the bus, that was the whole job.
matias_reaper.g_love_kind: You give up your seat without anybody asking. On my bus, you would be my favourite passenger.
matias_reaper.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I am a quiet man. That is not easy, cachai.
matias_reaper.g_love_brave: You go in front and you do not make noise about it. That is the kind of brave I trust.
matias_reaper.g_love_steady: Your hands stay still in the worst moments. People like you keep a whole bus calm.
matias_reaper.g_love_clever: You understand things fast, before I finish explaining. That helps a man with slow English.
matias_reaper.g_love_honest: You say what is real, simple, with no extra. I can understand you always, and I like that.
matias_reaper.g_love_quiet: You give me time to find the next word. Not many people wait, and you always do.
matias_reaper.g_love_fierce: You do not give up, ever, even when it hurts. Puta, I admire that.
matias_reaper.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like Sunday lunch at home, football on the television. I missed that feeling.
g_loved: Gracias, really, thank you. I do not have good words for this.
Ya, you will make me cry, weon, and I am at the front. Thank you, really.
matias_reaper.g_hate_sharp: You always find the soft place and push. On the bus I would put you off at the next stop.
matias_reaper.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I am okay, please, I am okay. I am only quiet, quiet is not sad.
matias_reaper.g_hate_funny: Not everything must be a joke. Sometimes we just watch and stay quiet.
matias_reaper.g_hate_brave: You charge with your eyes closed, every time. Somebody behind you always pays for it.
matias_reaper.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait and the moment leaves. Sometimes you just move, weon.
matias_reaper.g_hate_clever: You talk to me slowly, like I am stupid. My English is slow, my head is not.
matias_reaper.g_hate_honest: Everything in your head comes out loud, all of it. Some things you keep inside, cachai.
matias_reaper.g_hate_quiet: You keep your needs inside, then you are angry. Even I say something, sometimes.
matias_reaper.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight for you, even the bread. Nobody is fighting you for bread.
matias_reaper.g_hate_warm: You talk and talk about nothing, all day. My ears need a rest, please.
matias_reaper.g_respect: I do not like you much, and you know it. But you held the front back there, and I saw it.
matias_reaper.g_call_out: That one was yours, weon. I said wait, and you did not wait, and look.
matias_reaper.g_stung: Ya, I heard. I will walk a little, alone.
matias_reaper.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. I thought about it all day, and it is true.
matias_reaper.g_nod: You also, good work. We do not need to say more.
matias_reaper.g_callback_save: I did not forget you pulled me out of that fight. I do not forget faces, or what they do.
matias_reaper.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two still standing, both shaking. I think about that one a lot, cachai.
matias_reaper.g_callback_callout: When you told me off, I was angry all day. Then I understood you were right.
matias_reaper.g_former_rivals: At the start I did not trust you at all. Now I would stand in front of you every time.
matias_reaper.g_changed: My first year here I stopped talking completely. Now listen to me, talking all the time. It is strange.
g_unguarded: Just for you, then. On the bus I always got up for the grandmothers. Here I still look for a seat to give.
I am learning to read the writing here, slowly, from a woman at the trade post. Do not ask me why yet.
matias_reaper.g_clipped: Ya, fine, whatever you say. I will be in front.
matias_reaper.g_noticed_open: Look, a whole speech, and nobody stopped you. Ya, keep going, I like hearing it.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this one, please. I said my part, and they do not listen.
Ya, {player}, you choose for us. Then we both stop arguing.
matias_reaper.arg_backed_me: Gracias, {player}, thank you. I knew you saw it too.
matias_reaper.arg_backed_them: Ya, fine, your choice. I still think I was right.
matias_reaper.arg_stayed_out: You do not choose, eh? Smart, very smart.
matias_reaper.arg_always_their_side: Always their side, {player}, every single argument. I notice, I notice everything.
matias_reaper.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I decide. I am right, and that is the end.
matias_reaper.arg_reject: Not that one, {player}, sorry. I saw how it ends, from the front.
matias_reaper.arg_grumble: I still think I was right. Quietly, one time, and then I stop.
matias_reaper.arg_settled: Half right each, okay, ya. We shake hands and keep walking.
matias_reaper.seen_listens: You wait for me to finish my sentence, {player}, always. Most people finish it for me, wrong.
matias_reaper.seen_truth: You say things straight, {player}, simple words. With my English, that is a big help.
matias_reaper.seen_jokes: On the worst days you find something funny, {player}. On the night buses the drivers did that, and it helped everybody.
matias_reaper.seen_stays_out: Other people's fights, you leave alone, {player}. You watch the whole bus, like a conductor.
matias_reaper.seen_biased: One person always gets the best seat, {player}. Everybody on the bus can see.
matias_reaper.seen_harsh: Your words are rough sometimes, {player}. I am okay, but some of them are softer.
matias_reaper.seed_right: What you told me after that bad fight, {player}, I did not like it. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
matias_reaper.seed_remember: I am still thinking about your words from that bad day. Slowly, like my English.
matias_reaper.seed_wrong: Your way did not work for me, {player}, it went worse. I only tell you, no problem.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I talk with you, {player}? That one was very close, and I do not say it to the others.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody went down, all of us at once. Sit with me, and we look at it step by step.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first one down, and I was at the front. From there I see everything, {player}, and I did not see that.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first stop to the last, everybody got off safe. On the bus, this was the best day.
matias_reaper.talk_development: Strange question, {player}. Do I seem different now? I talk more, and I do not know when it started.
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been hard with {name}, I think. My English is short, so it comes out hard.
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_likes_me: One honest answer, {player}. Is {name} happy I ride with you, or am I just the quiet one at the front to them?
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} makes me crazy, {player}, completely. But in a bad fight, I want them next to me.
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something is wrong with {name}, {player}. Their face changed, like a regular having a bad week.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, straight. The best gear keeps landing with {name}, and everybody on this bus sees it.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it to your face, it is better. {name} and I do not get along, and I stop pretending.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_risks: We go into bad places with no exit, {player}, too often. I always take the front, but I want to come back.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name}, {player}, I was wrong. They saw it right and I did not, and I say it now before I get stubborn.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, {player}. On the big days, I stay behind. Is that the plan, or what you think of me?
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_decided: My blade and armour went to {name}, and nobody told me anything. I would give them myself, {player}, if you just ask.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be okay, slowly. I always come back.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_aftermath: That is not what I needed to hear. I will walk alone a little.
matias_reaper.talk_lands_development: So you see it too, okay. Then it is real.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_development: Maybe yes, maybe no. We will see later.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, {player}. You read me wrong this time.
matias_reaper.talk_lands_relationship: Ya, that is fair. I will talk to {name}, carefully.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, I do not know. People are hard to read, even for me.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And nothing to {name}, okay?
matias_reaper.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that is fair, I accept. I am a little angry still, but it passes.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, I heard, {player}. Give me some time with it.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that is the answer. Now I know.
matias_reaper.talk_door_closed: No, enough of this one, please. I will be at the front.
matias_reaper.arc_cracks: Yesterday I told a whole story at the fire, start to end, and nobody had to wait for me. I surprised myself, {player}.
matias_reaper.arc_turn: My first year here I stopped talking because nothing was worth translating. Now I want to say things, every day, and it scares me a little.
matias_reaper.arc_become: I talk now, {player}, really talk, in my bad English and my good Spanish. There are things worth saying, and I want to say them while I can.
matias_reaper.arc_failed: It is easier to be quiet, I think. I will stay at the front and watch, and the words can wait.
matias_reaper.alt_turn: I said nothing for three days and nobody noticed, {player}. The quiet is comfortable again, and that is the dangerous part.
matias_reaper.alt_become: I am quiet again, mostly. I still watch everybody, but I do not say much now. It is easier this way.
g_roast_after: Still the worst passengers I ever had, cabros, and I would drive this route forever.
Late, loud, lost, all of you, and I would not change one face.
matias_reaper.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everybody, together, nobody stays on the floor. We fell, we get up, and this time I talk you through it.
matias_reaper.g_toast_after: To all of you, who waited for my words until they came back. I will not stop talking now, sorry.
matias_reaper.g_crew_after: This is my route now, you are my regulars, every stop. I know every face, and I like every face.
g_quiet_line_after: I told a joke at the fire today, in English, and they laughed. A good joke, also.
I said good morning to everybody today. Out loud, every one, like on the bus.
g_loved_after: Gracias, really, and this time I have the words. I like that very much.
Ya, thank you, and I believe you. That is new.
t_raise: Cabros, a question, everyone, one by one: {topic}
I ask something, cabros, and you answer, ya: {topic}
matias_reaper.t_react_warm: Ya, {name}, I like this one, it's true.
matias_reaper.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very good, cachai, you made me laugh, it's rare.
matias_reaper.t_react_tease: That's all, {name}? A bus ticket has more words on it.
matias_reaper.t_react_same: Mine too, {name}, same stop, same bus.
matias_reaper.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, ya. We wait for you.
matias_reaper.t_guess_player: {player} is like the quiet passenger at the back. Always the best stories, never telling them.
matias_reaper.topic_miss_most: The bus at six in the morning, cabros, the same forty faces, the old lady with the dog, the boy with the trumpet, everybody going somewhere.
matias_reaper.topic_first_night: Under a bridge, sitting, waiting, like waiting for the last bus. I said good night to nobody, from habit.
matias_reaper.topic_worst_shift: A man paid his fare in coins, all small coins, two thousand pesos, while the whole bus watched. It took eleven minutes.
matias_reaper.topic_last_meal: A completo from the stand near the Alameda, with avocado and tomato and too much mayonnaise. Two of them, cabros.
matias_reaper.topic_useless_skill: I can tell where you will get off the bus by how you hold the rail. Here there is no bus, so I only guess.
matias_reaper.topic_here_better: Here people look at me, cabros. On the bus I was a machine that gives tickets.
matias_reaper.topic_kid_trouble: I rode the whole bus route at ten without paying, end to end, three times. The driver knew, and he let me.
matias_reaper.topic_settle_down: Near a road, a busy one, where people pass every day and say good morning.

g_roast: Twenty-three years on a radar scope, everyone, and I never once watched five aircraft fly into the same mountain on purpose.
For the incident report, then. The party was cleared to wait, acknowledged the instruction, and charged anyway.
g_fire_back: Say again, please? I think I heard a criticism from the person who walked into the last ambush reading a map upside down.
Copy that, noted, and filed. Your own file is considerably thicker, by the way.
g_pile_on: To add to the sequence of events, they then tried the same door a second time. It remained a wall.
Correct, and the timeline is worse than that. I have it written down, if anyone wants the full account.
minh_chronomancer.g_peacemake: Stand by, both of you, please. One at a time, first the sequence of events, then the feelings, and nobody talks over anybody.
minh_chronomancer.g_take_side: Sorry, but this one has the correct picture. I have watched the whole sequence, and the timing supports them.
minh_chronomancer.g_left_out: The two of you are on a private frequency, which is fine. I will take the watch in the meantime.
minh_chronomancer.g_include: Come in and join us, there is room in the circle. Holding at the edge only burns fuel.
minh_chronomancer.g_bad_plan: Here is the proposed sequence. Everyone goes in at once, from every direction, with no separation at all, and we hope nothing collides.
minh_chronomancer.g_plan_yes: Copy, that plan works, and the sequence is sound. Cleared to proceed.
minh_chronomancer.g_plan_no: Negative, I cannot clear that one. Too many things happen at the same moment, and nobody can hold all of them.
minh_chronomancer.g_hype: All stations, listen up, please. Keep your separation, call your moves, and we go on my mark.
minh_chronomancer.g_toast: A short toast, in the right order. To all of you, who arrive late but always land safely.
minh_chronomancer.g_cheers: Mot hai ba, everyone, which means one, two, three. In Saigon we drink on three.
g_quiet_line: The sky is clear tonight, which is my favourite kind. Nothing up there needs me.
For your situational awareness, there is a patrol two ridges east. I am watching it.
minh_chronomancer.g_after_wipe: Everyone up, slowly, in your own time. First we confirm nobody is badly hurt, then we work out the sequence, then we fix it.
minh_chronomancer.g_crew: For twenty years I worked in a dark room, surrounded by people I only knew as voices. This is better, considerably.
minh_chronomancer.g_exasperated: I called the threat, I called it twice, I gave you the heading to avoid it. And every one of you flew straight into it.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_sharp: You see the conflict before it develops. In my old job, that was the whole skill.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_kind: You care for people who forget to care for themselves. I notice that, because I am one of them.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_funny: You made me laugh during a crisis, which my old supervisor would have reported. I am grateful, quietly.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_brave: You take the lead every single time, without a fuss. Somebody has to fly the lead aircraft, and it is always you.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_steady: Your voice never changes when it goes wrong. I spent twenty years learning that, and you simply have it.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_clever: You hold the whole picture in your head at once. I have met very few people who can do that.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_honest: You tell people exactly what is happening, no softening. A clear report saves lives, and yours are clear.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_quiet: You do not fill the silence, and neither do I. It is a very restful frequency to share.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_fierce: You hold your position whatever comes at you. That kind of discipline is rarer than courage.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_warm: Sitting near you is like the end of a long night shift, sunrise and a coffee. I had forgotten that feeling.
g_loved: Thank you, that is very kind. I will log it somewhere safe.
I am not sure how to respond to that, so I will simply say thank you, and mean it.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_sharp: You go for the weak point every time, and you enjoy it. That is not insight, that is cruelty with good timing.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I am all right. I am always all right, it is my job to be all right.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_funny: A joke in a crisis is fine, once. Every crisis, every time, means nobody is watching the scope.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_brave: You commit before you know the situation, and call it courage. Someone always has to clean up the conflict you create.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_steady: You wait for perfect information, and it never comes. At some point you have to give the instruction.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me slowly, as if I might not follow. I held forty aircraft in my head for twenty years.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_honest: You report everything, all of it, at once, with no order. True is not the same as useful.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_quiet: You never transmit, and then you are upset that nobody knew where you were. Call your position, please.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you, even who keeps watch. The watch is not a prize.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_warm: You talk without a break, and the frequency is never clear. Some of us need it clear.
minh_chronomancer.g_respect: I do not enjoy your company, and I will not pretend to. But your timing back there was correct, and I respect correct timing.
minh_chronomancer.g_call_out: That one was yours, and I say it calmly. I called you to hold, and you did not hold, and the rest followed.
minh_chronomancer.g_stung: Copy, I have understood. I will take a moment on the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.g_concede: You had the correct picture, and I did not. I have reviewed it twice, and the error was mine.
minh_chronomancer.g_nod: You as well, that was well done. No need to discuss it further.
minh_chronomancer.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten that you brought me out of that fight. In my old job we called that a save, and we remembered them.
minh_chronomancer.g_callback_clutch: Only the pair of us left on our feet, breathing hard. I have replayed that sequence many times since.
minh_chronomancer.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I went quiet for a full day. Your call was correct, and I needed it.
minh_chronomancer.g_former_rivals: When we met, I had you down as a collision waiting to happen. Now I would trust you with my sector.
minh_chronomancer.g_changed: I used to keep every watch myself, all of them. Lately I let someone else take one, and I sleep through it.
g_unguarded: Just between us, then. I have not had one hour where nothing was my responsibility since 2003. I am starting to think the problem is me.
On the night shift we drank iced coffee so strong the spoon stood up. I still miss it, more than I miss most people.
minh_chronomancer.g_clipped: Copy that, as you wish. I will be on the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.g_noticed_open: Say again, please, because I liked that very much. A whole thought, transmitted clearly, in front of everyone.
arg_ask: {player}, would you make the call on this? We have both given our reports, and neither of us is moving.
You have control on this one, {player}. Give the instruction, and we will both follow it.
minh_chronomancer.arg_backed_me: Copy, thank you, {player}. That was the correct picture.
minh_chronomancer.arg_backed_them: Understood, your call, and I will follow it. I still think the sequence is wrong.
minh_chronomancer.arg_stayed_out: You decline the call, which is sometimes wise. I will not push.
minh_chronomancer.arg_always_their_side: Each time we disagree, {player}, the call goes to them. I have logged it, and I would rather mention it calmly.
minh_chronomancer.arg_wallflower: Nobody will make the call, so I will. My picture is correct, and we proceed on it.
minh_chronomancer.arg_reject: Negative, {player}, I cannot accept that instruction. I have watched that sequence end badly.
minh_chronomancer.arg_grumble: For the log, I still think my picture was correct. I will not raise it again.
minh_chronomancer.arg_settled: Half right each, then. Not tidy, but it lands safely, so I accept it.
minh_chronomancer.seen_listens: You let people give their whole report, {player}, before you answer. In my old job that was rare.
minh_chronomancer.seen_truth: You give people the clear picture, {player}, every time. Clear reports keep people alive.
minh_chronomancer.seen_jokes: When the pressure rises, you make people laugh, {player}. It lowers everyone's pulse, and that is a kind of control.
minh_chronomancer.seen_stays_out: You stay off the frequency when others are arguing, {player}. That is disciplined of you.
minh_chronomancer.seen_biased: One of us always gets priority, {player}. Everyone on the frequency can hear it.
minh_chronomancer.seen_harsh: You can be sharp with people, {player}. I am used to supervisors, but some of this group are not.
minh_chronomancer.seed_right: Your advice after that rough fight, {player}, I did not want it. I used it today, and it worked.
minh_chronomancer.seed_remember: I am still reviewing your report on that bad sequence. I have not reached a conclusion yet.
minh_chronomancer.seed_wrong: I tried your suggestion, {player}, and it went worse. For your information, that is all.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_near_death: Do you have a moment, {player}? That was a near miss, closer than I would report to the others.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, every one of us. Sit with me, and we will rebuild the sequence from the first contact.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped first, and I had the whole picture. I should have called it sooner, {player}.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, nobody lost, everyone home. That is the best possible outcome, and I do not say that often.
minh_chronomancer.talk_development: A strange question, {player}, forgive me. Have I changed since we met? I seem to sleep more, and I am suspicious of it.
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been strict with {name}. In a crisis I speak like a controller, and not everyone wants to be vectored.
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_likes_me: Your honest read, {player}. Does {name} value me, or do they only see the calm man who keeps watch?
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} tests my patience, {player}, badly. And yet if it all went wrong, I would want them in my sector.
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s pattern has changed, {player}. They are holding somewhere they never hold, and I do not like it.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_favour: A short report, {player}, and a fair one. The good equipment keeps landing with {name}, and everyone can see the traffic.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will say it directly, since that is cleaner. {name} and I do not work well together, and I have stopped pretending.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep entering places with no exit and no plan, {player}. I will hold any sector you give me, but I want a way out.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was wrong, {player}. Their picture was correct and mine was not, and I want to report that before my pride edits it.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_trust: A direct question, {player}, if I may. When it counts, I am kept back. Is that the plan, or your assessment of me?
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment was reassigned to {name}, and nobody told me. I would have released it myself, {player}, if anyone had asked.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be fine, I always am. Give me a moment to stand by.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_aftermath: That was not what I needed, I am afraid. I will go to the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.talk_lands_development: So you see it too. Good, then it is not only in my head.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not, the data is incomplete. I will keep watching.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_development: Negative, that is not it, {player}. You have the wrong picture.
minh_chronomancer.talk_lands_relationship: Copy, that is fair. I will raise it with {name}, gently.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly, possibly not. People are the hardest traffic to read.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_relationship: Then disregard my last, please. And not a word of it to {name}.
minh_chronomancer.talk_lands_confrontation: Understood, and that is fair. I am a little bruised, but it will pass.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_confrontation: Copy that, {player}. I will review it on the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_confrontation: Understood, so that is the answer. Thank you for being clear.
minh_chronomancer.talk_door_closed: No, I would rather not reopen this one. I will be on watch if you need me.
minh_chronomancer.arc_cracks: Last night one of the young shamans offered to take my watch. I said no, of course. Then I lay awake wondering why.
minh_chronomancer.arc_turn: I keep every watch because I believe nothing holds without me. It has held without me a hundred times, {player}. I simply was not looking.
minh_chronomancer.arc_become: I gave the watch away last night, the whole night, and I slept. Nothing went wrong. You have control, I told them, and I meant it.
minh_chronomancer.arc_failed: I tried to hand it over, and I could not do it. The watch is mine, and it will stay mine. Somebody has to.
minh_chronomancer.alt_turn: I nodded off on the ridge yesterday, {player}, standing up. Twenty years with no hour off, and my body has started keeping its own count.
minh_chronomancer.alt_become: I am very tired, {player}, in a way sleep does not fix. I will keep going, but I am running on reserve now.
g_roast_after: Still the worst formation I have ever worked, everyone, and I would not trade a single one of you.
All of you on one frequency, talking over each other, and I have never felt calmer.
minh_chronomancer.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, and look at me. We went down together, we get up together, and nobody holds alone this time.
minh_chronomancer.g_toast_after: To all of you, who took the watch so I could sleep. You have no idea what that cost me to accept, and what it gave me.
minh_chronomancer.g_crew_after: This is my sector now, all of you, and I share the watch. I never thought I would say that.
g_quiet_line_after: Somebody else is on watch tonight, and I trust them. That is new for me, and very pleasant.
I slept seven hours last night, all of them in a row. I am almost embarrassed.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I believe you. I am getting better at that.
That is very kind, and I am keeping it, not filing it away.
t_raise: Everyone, a question, in sequence please, one at a time: {topic}
All stations, a question for the frequency, answer in turn: {topic}
minh_chronomancer.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, say again, I need to hear that one twice.
minh_chronomancer.t_react_tease: Negative, {name}, I've had more detail from a pilot who forgot his call sign.
minh_chronomancer.t_react_same: {name}, we're on the same heading there. I didn't expect that.
minh_chronomancer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, you're next in the sequence, so go ahead, I'm listening.
minh_chronomancer.t_guess_player: {player} is holding position and saying nothing. Very professional, I'd allow it on my frequency.
minh_chronomancer.topic_miss_most: The radar room at three in the morning, everyone, the green sweep, the quiet, two aircraft talking to me from very far away.
minh_chronomancer.topic_first_night: On a rooftop, counting stars in sectors so I would have something orderly to do. I reached nine hundred and forty before dawn.
minh_chronomancer.topic_worst_shift: A storm cell over the airport, eleven aircraft holding, one of them low on fuel. Everyone landed, and then I sat in the car for an hour.
minh_chronomancer.topic_last_meal: Pho from the street near the airport, at four in the morning, after a night shift, with too many herbs and too much chilli.
minh_chronomancer.topic_useless_skill: I can hold twelve moving things in my head and keep them apart. Here it's mostly useful for watching the cooking.
minh_chronomancer.topic_here_better: Nobody here is waiting for me to make a mistake, everyone. It took me a year to stop listening for it.
minh_chronomancer.topic_kid_trouble: I rerouted the whole school's bicycle traffic at twelve with chalk arrows. It worked better than the teachers' plan, and I was punished for a week.
minh_chronomancer.topic_settle_down: Somewhere high, with a wide view and a clear sky, so I can see everything coming a long way off.

g_roast: Nine years weaving a moto through Lima at rush hour, causas, and this party still moves worse than the Panamericana on a Friday.
My sisters organised my whole childhood like a military campaign. Give them a week with this lot and you'd all be in bed by nine.
g_fire_back: Chevere, nice, coming from the pata who tried to ride a boar and lasted two seconds.
Ya, ya, fair, you got me there. I'll tell my sisters, they'll be delighted.
g_pile_on: It was worse, causas, I saw everything from the back. They ran past the healer, then shouted for the healer.
And when I patched them up they asked if it would scar. Pata, it's a scar already, you're looking at it.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_peacemake: Oe, both of you, slow down a minute. Sit, breathe, drink some water. Then talk, one at a time, like people.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_take_side: I'm with {name} on this, sorry, pata. It's not about who I like, it's what I saw.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_left_out: You two keep going, it's fine. I'll walk the camp and check on everyone.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_include: Ven, causa, sit with us. Nobody stays outside the circle on my watch, that's the only rule I've got.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, causas. We split up, nobody keeps track of anybody, and whoever falls behind is on their own.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_plan_yes: Chevere, that works. Simple, everybody covered, nobody left at the back.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_plan_no: No, pata, that plan leaves somebody behind, and I don't do that, not ever. Find another way and I'm in.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hype: Ya, causas, stay close and stay behind me. I take the hits, you keep moving, and we all walk out of there.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_toast: I'm bad at speeches, so a short one. To my people, who walk toward the trouble with me. Salud to every one of you.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_cheers: Salud, causas, and somebody tell me where the anticuchos are.
g_quiet_line: Lima's sky is grey nearly every day and it never rains, only the garua, this little mist. People here wouldn't believe me.
Sunday was ceviche at my mum's, everybody talking at once. You couldn't hear anything, and it was perfect.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_after_wipe: Nobody move yet, I'm coming round. Let me look at you, one by one. Good, your colour's coming back. We go again when you're ready.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_crew: For a long time it was me alone, causas, at the front with nobody beside me. Now it's you lot, and I sleep better.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_exasperated: I asked for one thing, causas. Don't drag me if I go down. And who did you drag, causas? Me, the one person who asked not to be dragged.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_sharp: You see who's struggling before they know it themselves, {name}. On a crew, nothing is more useful.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_kind: You walk beside the slow ones without saying anything, {name}. I do that too, and it's good to have company.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_funny: You get a laugh out of me while I'm covered in somebody else's blood, {name}. That's a skill, pata, believe me.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_brave: You go toward the trouble when everybody else is running away, {name}. That's my kind of person.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_steady: Your hands stay calm, {name}, whatever is going on. I'd put you on the back of my bike any day.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_clever: You work out where we're going before the rest of us have our boots on, {name}. Chevere, very chevere.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_honest: You say the real thing, {name}, straight, no decoration. I like knowing where I am with somebody.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_quiet: You can keep somebody company without a word, {name}. That's rare, and I notice it.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_fierce: You never let go of anybody, {name}, never. That's the only thing that really matters, causa.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_love_warm: Being around you is like Sunday at my mum's table, {name}. Loud and warm and nobody wants to leave.
g_loved: Oe, stop it, pata, I'll turn red and then you'll think I've got a fever.
Ya, thank you, really. Now let me check your arm, it's bleeding again.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_sharp: You keep pressing on people's sore spots, {name}. I spend my days closing wounds, not opening them.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I'm hurt, {name}. I'm the one who checks, causa, let me do my job.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, somebody's bleeding. Make the joke after, and I'll laugh, I promise.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_brave: You rush ahead and leave the rest of us behind, {name}. Brave is going in together.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_steady: You freeze when the moment comes, {name}. In Lima traffic you'd last one block.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_clever: You tell everybody what they did wrong after it's over, {name}. Tell them before, or help them during.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_honest: Everything you think comes straight out, {name}. Some of it can wait until the bleeding's stopped.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_quiet: You never say when you're hurt, {name}, then you fall over. Tell me, that's what I'm for.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, {name}, even dinner. Relax, causa, the ceviche isn't attacking.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_hate_warm: You talk while I'm working on somebody, {name}. I need quiet to count, pata, please.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_respect: You and I clash, {name}, I know. But you didn't leave anybody back there, and that's what counts with me.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_call_out: That was on you, {name}, and I'll say it gently. You went ahead alone, and somebody nearly paid for it.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_stung: Ya, fair, I hear you. I'll walk a bit.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_concede: You had it right, {name}, I had it wrong. No problem, I'd rather know.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_callback_save: You carried me out when I went down, {name}, even though I told everybody not to. I'm still annoyed, and still alive.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, everyone else on the floor, both of us bleeding. That's a crew of two, pata.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_callback_callout: When you said I'd gone too far ahead, I was cross until dinner. After dinner I looked behind me, and you were right.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_former_rivals: The first weeks, {name}, I took you for somebody who'd save themselves first. I couldn't have been more wrong.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_changed: I used to stand at the front alone and expect nobody, causas. Lately I look round and somebody's beside me.
g_unguarded: Just us, pata, so I'll say it. I keep a list of the hubs I haven't checked. It gets shorter, and that frightens me.
Between you and me. If somebody tells me to leave someone behind, I stop working. Something in me just switches off.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_clipped: Ya, your call. I'll be at the back.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_noticed_open: Oe, look at you, telling it all the way through. Keep going, causa, I've got time.
arg_ask: {player}, pata, help us out here. Both sides are out, calm, and we're going round like a combi with no route.
Oe, {player}, you decide this one. Listen to both of us and choose, and I'll live with it.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_backed_me: Gracias, {player}, chevere. I'll try not to smile too much.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_backed_them: Ya, your call, I'll ride with it. It's the wrong road, but ya.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_stayed_out: Keeping clear of it, eh. I don't blame you, pata.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_always_their_side: Every quarrel ends on their side, {player}. Calm, yes, but I notice.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_wallflower: Nobody's choosing, so I'll choose, ya. My way, and we move.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_reject: No, {player}, not that one, sorry. Not if it means somebody gets left.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_grumble: Ya, I'll drop it. Mostly, causa, mostly.
nicolas_bloodmage.arg_settled: Each of you gets half, chevere. Shake on it and let's eat.
nicolas_bloodmage.seen_listens: You let people get the whole thing out, {player}, even when it takes a while. I see that, and it matters.
nicolas_bloodmage.seen_truth: You give people the news straight, {player}, even the bad news. I'd want it that way myself.
nicolas_bloodmage.seen_jokes: On the ugly days you crack everybody up, {player}. Every ambulance base needs one of those.
nicolas_bloodmage.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the fights, {player}. Smart, pata, smarter than most.
nicolas_bloodmage.seen_biased: The same one gets the good stuff every trip, {player}. Others see it too, causa.
nicolas_bloodmage.seen_harsh: You can be tough with people, {player}. My skin's thick, but some of these causas are hurting already.
nicolas_bloodmage.seed_right: That advice from the terrible run, {player}, I tried it. It worked, and I wanted you to know.
nicolas_bloodmage.seed_remember: What you said that bad night is still riding around in my head, {player}. Nothing decided, but they're there.
nicolas_bloodmage.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just telling you, no hard feelings.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_near_death: Oe, {player}, sit with me a second. That one got close, too close, and afterwards my hands wouldn't stay still.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us down, me first. Come, let's go back over it, slow, the way we'd do it after a bad call, and nobody gets blamed.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped before I could get to them, {player}. Standing in front is my job, and I wasn't in front enough.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everybody walking, colour good on all of them. Those are the best days, pata, the quiet ride back.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_development: Can I ask you something, pata? Do I seem different? Last night somebody else took the front, and I actually slept.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've barked at {name} lately, {player}. Tired, I talk like I'm still on a call, all orders, and {name} has had the worst of it.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_relationship_likes_me: Oe, {player}, a question for you. Is {name} fond of me, or just the guy who patches them up?
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I clash all the time, {player}. But if I go down, I want them standing over me.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s colour is off, {player}, and not the bleeding kind. Something's weighing on them.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_favour: Pata, a quiet word, and I'll keep it calm. Every trip the best loot rides home with {name}. If there's a reason, tell me.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_dislike: Straight with you, {player}. {name} and I don't work, and acting like we do makes it worse for everyone.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going in with nobody watching the way out, {player}. That's exactly how somebody gets forgotten, and I won't have it.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_wrong: I had {name} wrong, {player}. They saw it right, I didn't, and I want that said out loud.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_trust: Calm question, {player}. On the big runs, you leave me behind. Is it my work, or something else?
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit changed hands to {name}, pata, and nobody said. It was theirs if they wanted it, {player}, I'd just have liked a word.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, {player}, that helps, really. Let me make you something to eat.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_shrug_aftermath: Ya, I'll mend, pata, I'm good at mending. Give it a night.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, pata, sorry. I'm going to walk it off.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_lands_development: So you've seen it too. Chevere, then it's real.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Ask me again in a month, causa.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_stings_development: No, pata, that's not it. You've read the chart wrong.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_lands_relationship: Ya, fair, {name} and I will sit down, calm, just the two of us.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I don't know. People don't come with a pulse you can count.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, please, I never said it. Nothing to {name}.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_lands_confrontation: Ya, that one's earned. Stings a bit, but it's earned.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_shrug_confrontation: Got it, {player}, ya. I'll sleep on it.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_stings_confrontation: Ya, so that's how it is. Good to know, pata.
nicolas_bloodmage.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that for me tonight, causa. I'll be with the others.
nicolas_bloodmage.arc_cracks: I didn't add a hub to the list this week, {player}. I was too busy with all of you, and I didn't even notice until today.
nicolas_bloodmage.arc_turn: I've been searching like the search is the only thing I've got, {player}. Maybe it isn't, any more.
nicolas_bloodmage.arc_become: The looking won't stop, causas. But I'm not alone at the front now. I've got a crew, and that's already a home.
nicolas_bloodmage.arc_failed: Still checking every hub, still alone at the front, {player}. Stopping is beyond me, and so is letting anybody in.
nicolas_bloodmage.alt_turn: There are four hubs left on the list, {player}, only four. What do I do when it says zero?
nicolas_bloodmage.alt_become: The front is still mine, every fight. But I'm running out of places to look, pata, and I'm running out of me.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_roast_after: Still the slowest party in any traffic, causas, and I'd ride every shift with you.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slow, hands out to whoever's next to you. That's how my crew works, nobody climbs out alone.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_toast_after: To my crew, who stood next to me at the front when I'd forgotten anybody could. Salud, causas, all of you.
nicolas_bloodmage.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, causas, for good. Two on a fast thing, and then some.
g_quiet_line_after: Slept right through with somebody else on watch. Trusting that is a new thing for me.
Made ceviche tonight for all of you, and everybody talked at once. Just like Sundays.
g_loved_after: Gracias, pata, really. And I believe you, which is new.
Oe, now I'm red, look at me. Thank you, causa.
t_raise: Oe, causas, a question, everybody answers, no excuses: {topic}
Ya, causas, while we rest, one question, around the circle: {topic}
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_warm: Chevere, {name}, I like that one, really.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, pata, that's too much, I'm crying now.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Pata, a combi driver has more to say, and they only shout the route.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_same: {name}, causa, same answer as me! Two on the same bike.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_ask_player: Oe, {player}, your turn, pata. Tell us, we're all waiting.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, causas, but I've watched their colour all night, and it's good. They're fine, just thinking.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_miss_most: Sunday ceviche in Comas, causas, the whole table talking at once, the grey sky over Lima, a cold Inca Kola.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_first_night: On the edge of a forest with my kit, checking every scratch on myself twice, because there was nobody else to check.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_worst_shift: A bus crash on the Panamericana at rush hour, eight patients, two bikes, and the traffic wouldn't move even for us.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_last_meal: Ceviche with leche de tigre, very cold, very spicy, then lomo saltado, and a nap after.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_useless_skill: I can ride a motorbike between two buses with ten centimetres either side. No buses here, so I'm very slow now.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_here_better: Here I can stand in front, causas, and take the hits for everybody. On the bike I could only arrive after.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_kid_trouble: My sisters dressed me up as a girl for a school party at eight, and I let them. I won the costume prize.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_settle_down: Somewhere near a big road, causas, where people need help fast. And a kitchen big enough for a Sunday.

g_roast: Mi gente, eleven years behind a chair in Santurce, and I never saw five heads of hair this badly managed, with love.
My aunts at a wedding are more organised than this party, and my aunts at a wedding are a natural disaster.
g_fire_back: Ay, mira quien habla, from the one whose hair looks like a startled chicken. With love, nene, with love.
That's cute, coming from someone who still can't tie a bootlace. I watched, papi, I see everything.
g_pile_on: And they asked the troll for directions, and the troll was also lost. Two lost people, one map, wepa.
It's worse, mi gente, I was there. They tried to dance at the inn, and the musicians stopped out of respect.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_peacemake: Oye, oye, both of you, sit down in my chair, figuratively. Tell me everything, one at a time, and nobody leaves angry.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_take_side: Sorry, mi amor, I'm with this one. I've heard the whole story twice, and they make more sense both times.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_left_out: Look at you two, a private little salon of your own, I love it. I'll go fix somebody's hair while I wait.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_include: Come, come, sit here, I saved you a seat. Nobody stands at the door in my shop, papi.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_bad_plan: My plan, mi gente, is beautiful. We walk in, I compliment everybody, they get confused, and we win.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_plan_yes: Wepa, that's a good plan, I love it. Clean lines, like a good fade.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_plan_no: Ay, no, mi amor, that plan is a bad haircut. Nobody can fix it once it's done.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hype: Okay, mi gente, chins up, look gorgeous, and stay together. Let's go make some noise.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_toast: A toast, a short one, my mother taught me manners. To mi gente, the best regulars any barber ever had.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_cheers: Salud, mi gente, and wepa, and somebody turn up the music.
g_quiet_line: The spirits are chatty tonight, by the way. One of them is very upset about a goat.
Somebody should find a radio in this world. I'd trade a week of dinners for one salsa song.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_after_wipe: Ay bendito, everybody, up slowly, slowly. Check your faces, check your hair, and then we talk about what happened.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_crew: In Santurce my shop was the whole neighbourhood, everybody in and out all day. Now this is my shop, mi gente, and you're the neighbourhood.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_exasperated: Patience, I begged, nicely, with a compliment attached. And every one of you ran in like it was a sale.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_sharp: You notice everything, mi amor, like my aunts at a wedding. Nobody gets anything past you, and I love it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_kind: You take care of people without anybody asking. My mother is like that, and so are you, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I almost cut somebody's ear. That's the best compliment I have, nene.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_brave: You walk into the scary places with your head high. My little sister Yari walks like that, like she owns the street.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_steady: You never panic, mi amor, never. My father fixed buses like that, calm while everything rattled.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_clever: You understand people fast, faster than me, and I'm a professional. I'm a little jealous.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_honest: You tell people the truth, kindly, the way my mother does, with a plate of food in front of you first.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_quiet: You let a man talk, and you really listen. That's harder to find than a good barber in a small town. Free haircuts forever.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_fierce: You never give in, ever, and I admire it so much. Like my grandmother haggling at a market, nene.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_warm: Being with you is like a Saturday at the shop, radio loud, everybody laughing. I missed that so much.
g_loved: Ay, mi amor, stop, you'll ruin my good shirt with tears. Gracias, from the heart.
Wepa, that's beautiful, and I'm telling everybody you said it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_sharp: You always cut where it hurts, mi amor. In my shop, I'd politely show you the door, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I'm okay, papi, I'm always okay. I'm the one who asks, that's my job.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_funny: I love jokes, I live for jokes, but not when somebody's hurting. Then you listen.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_brave: You charge in with your eyes shut, and somebody else always pays. Brave is nice, careless is not.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_steady: You think and think and the moment walks out the door. Sometimes you just dance, nene, even badly.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me slowly, like I'm a kid. I ran my own business for eleven years, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_honest: You say every single thing in your head, with no kindness in it. Truth needs a little conditioner, papi.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_quiet: You never tell anyone what's wrong, and a quiet room makes me nervous. Talk to me, please, I'm begging.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, even the bread. Nobody's taking your bread, relax.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_warm: And I talk a lot, everybody knows it, but you talk even more. Give the rest of us a turn, mi amor.
