orlando_witchdoctor.g_respect: We don't get along, papi, and that's okay. But you stood firm in that fight, and I respect that, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_call_out: That one was yours, nene, I'm sorry. I said wait, and you didn't, and look at the mess.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_stung: Okay, okay, I hear you. The spirits and I need a little chat.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_concede: Your read was right, mi amor, and mine was wrong. It sat on me all day like a bad haircut, and it's true.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_nod: You too, papi, beautiful work. We don't need to make a fiesta of it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_callback_save: I didn't forget you pulled me out of that fight. Arroz con gandules for life, nene, if I ever find the gandules.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me left standing, sweating like it's August in San Juan. I tell that story to everybody who sits down.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_callback_callout: When you told me off, I was quiet for a whole hour, which for me is a lifetime. You were right, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to give you a terrible haircut. Now you get a seat at my mother's table, and that's the highest honour I have.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_changed: Three times somebody offered me a building for a real shop. Lately I wonder why I said no every time.
g_unguarded: Just us two, mi amor, so here it is. Don Beni came every Tuesday for nineteen years and never once needed a haircut. He needed a chair and somebody to talk to.
I've turned down three buildings for a proper shop. My hands shook on the last one, and I don't know why.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_clipped: Okay, as you like, papi. I'll be at my chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_noticed_open: Wepa, look at this, a whole story, out loud, and beautifully told. Keep going, I'm sitting down for this.
arg_ask: {player}, mi amor, you decide this one. We both talked, and nobody's listening.
You're the head barber today, {player}. Make the call, and the chatter stops.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_backed_me: Wepa, gracias, {player}. You have good taste, I always said it.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_backed_them: Okay, okay, your call, mi amor. I still think you're wrong, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, eh? Smart, mi amor, like a barber who knows when to just keep cutting.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_always_their_side: They get the vote again, {player}, every argument. I notice, mi amor, I notice everything.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_wallflower: Nobody wants to decide, so I decide. I'm right, and now we eat.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_reject: Ay, no, {player}, not that one. I know that story, and nobody walks out of it happy.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, papi. I'll only complain to the spirits.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_settled: Half and half, like a good two-tone cut. Okay, we shake on it.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_listens: You wait for people to get the whole story out, {player}. In my shop you'd be the most popular chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_truth: You tell people the truth, {player}, plain and clear. I respect that, I really do.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_jokes: When things get heavy you make everybody laugh, {player}. That's the heart of any good shop.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_stays_out: Other people's quarrels, you leave alone, {player}. Smart, mi amor, like a barber who knows when to just cut.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_biased: The good stuff always lands in one lap, {player}. The whole shop can see it, papi.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_harsh: Your words have a sharp edge sometimes, {player}. I'm tough, but some of them are soft, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.seed_right: Your advice after that terrible fight, {player}, I made a face at it. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
orlando_witchdoctor.seed_remember: What you told me on the bad day is still sitting in my chair, mi amor. No decision yet.
orlando_witchdoctor.seed_wrong: Your way didn't work for me, {player}, it went worse. Just so you know, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a minute, {player}? That one nearly got me, and I'm not saying it to the others.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us hit the floor. Sit in my chair, and we go over it slowly, no shouting.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was first to fall, and I'm supposed to notice everything. I notice everything, {player}, and I missed that.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, everybody walked out laughing. That's a Sunday in Santurce, mi gente, the best kind.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_development: A funny question for you, {player}, and be nice. Have I changed? Staying somewhere is on my mind lately, and it never used to be.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been sharp with {name}. I tease everybody, but maybe they didn't know it was with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_likes_me: Be straight with me, {player}. Do I make {name} smile, or do they just see the loud one with the scissors?
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me loco, {player}, completely loco. But in a bad fight, I want them in the next chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't right, {player}. They sit in the chair different, heavy, like a man with bad news.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, with love. Every good piece lands in {name}'s lap, and the whole shop sees it.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll tell you straight, it's better. Me and {name} are oil and water, and I can't keep smiling through it.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going into places with no back door, {player}. I'll follow you anywhere, but I like a back door.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_wrong: I was wrong about {name}, {player}. They saw it clearly and I didn't, and I'd rather confess it while I'm humble.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, mi amor. On the big days, I'm left at camp. Am I the barber you leave behind, or is it only tactics?
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went off with {name}, not one word to me. A simple question, {player}, and I'd have smiled and handed it over.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, mi amor, that helps. Let's eat something.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, I always bounce back. Like good curls.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_aftermath: That's not what I needed to hear. The spirits will listen to me complain.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed it too, eh? Good, then it's real.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_development: Maybe so, maybe not, mi amor. Ask me after the next good song.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_development: No, mi amor, that's not it. You read me wrong this time.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, fair enough. I'll sit {name} down and talk, gently, I promise.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, could be not. People are complicated, even for a barber.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And not a word to {name}, okay?
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, I accept it. A little hurt, but I bounce back.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard every word, {player}. Let it sit with me a while.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the answer. Good to know, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_door_closed: No, papi, I'm done with this one. I'll be at my chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_cracks: A merchant offered me a building today, with a floor and a mirror. I almost said yes, {player}, almost.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_turn: Every time someone offers me a shop, I say no, and I think it's because a building means I'm not going home. Maybe home is where I set up the chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_become: I took the building, mi gente, a real shop, floor and mirror and all. Every one of you has a chair there, forever.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_failed: I said no again, mi amor. I can't take a building yet, I'm not ready. The tent will do.
orlando_witchdoctor.alt_turn: I asked every captain in Booty Bay about sailing east today, {player}. They all laughed, and I asked again anyway.
orlando_witchdoctor.alt_become: I'm going to keep trying to sail home, mi amor, every season. I can't stop, it's my family.
g_roast_after: Still the worst hair in two worlds, mi gente, and you're the only regulars I want.
Loud, messy, never on time, every one of you, and I'd keep you in my shop forever.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_after_wipe_after: Up, mi gente, together, everybody, nobody stays on the floor. We fell, we fix it, and I fix your hair after.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_toast_after: To mi gente, the regulars of Casa Rivera. Every chair is yours, and I mean it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_crew_after: This is my shop now, all of you, wherever we stop. A real one, with a floor, finally.
g_quiet_line_after: Swept the floor of the new shop tonight. A real floor, mi amor, you have no idea.
Somebody sat in the corner chair today just to talk. It felt like Tuesday at home.
g_loved_after: Gracias, mi amor, and I believe you. That's something new.
Ay, that's beautiful, and I'm keeping it forever.
t_raise: Ay, everybody, a question, and nobody leaves my chair without answering: {topic}
Mi gente, sit, sit, I have a good one for you: {topic}
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, mi amor, that's beautiful, you're making my eyes wet.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, papi, stop, I can't breathe, that's the best one!
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Mi amor, my chair heard better stories from men waiting for a shave.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_same: Same as me, {name}, the same! We should open a shop together, you and me.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, mi amor, now you. Sit in my chair and tell me everything.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, mi gente, a face like a customer who wants to tell me something and doesn't know how. I'll get it out.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_miss_most: My shop on a Saturday, mi gente, two chairs, a radio playing salsa, dominoes outside, and every man in the street telling me his business.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_first_night: In a field with my scissors in my pocket, giving myself a haircut by a stream so I'd feel like a person.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_worst_shift: A man came in for a trim on the morning of his wedding and fell asleep in the chair. His friends asked me to shave his eyebrows. I did one.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_last_meal: Mofongo with garlic shrimp, and tostones, and a cold Medalla on a balcony with the music up loud.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_useless_skill: I can give a perfect fade in nine minutes without a mirror. Here half the people have horns, papi, and the fade doesn't sit right.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_here_better: People here sit together and talk, mi gente, without looking at their phones. It's like my shop, all the time.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_kid_trouble: I cut my little cousin's hair at eight with the kitchen scissors, to practise. My aunt didn't talk to me for a week.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_settle_down: A little shop with two chairs and a door that's always open, mi gente, somewhere with a lot of noise outside.

g_roast: Eight years driving nights on the M4, everybody, and I never saw a convoy this lost. We'd have been in Swansea by now, by accident.
Something in the dark talks to me, and even it thought that plan was daft. That's saying something, mind.
g_fire_back: Now then, from the one who walked into a tree in broad daylight and apologised to it.
Fair play, that was a good one. I'll write it in my notebook, under things I deserved.
g_pile_on: Worse than that, it was. They took the wrong fork twice and swore blind the map had moved.
And then they asked me if I'd heard anything in the cave. Only them, bach, shouting at a bat.
owen_cultist.g_peacemake: Now then, both of you, sit down a minute and have a cuppa. Nobody ever won an argument at this hour, I promise you.
owen_cultist.g_take_side: Sorry, I'm with {name} on this one. Gently, mind, but I am.
owen_cultist.g_left_out: You two carry on, I'll sit over here with my notebook. I'm used to my own company, it's no bother.
owen_cultist.g_include: Come and sit, there's room by me. Nobody should be on their own at night if they don't want to be.
owen_cultist.g_bad_plan: Here's a plan, everybody. We go down into the dark with no light and no rope, and we follow whatever's whispering.
owen_cultist.g_plan_yes: Good plan, that, simple and clear. I'll hold the front and you'll know where I am.
owen_cultist.g_plan_no: No, bach, I don't like that one. It leaves somebody on their own at the back, and I won't have that.
owen_cultist.g_hype: Right, everybody, steady now. I'll take the worst of it, you stay behind me, and we all come out the other side.
owen_cultist.g_toast: Not much of a talker in company, me. To all of you, for being voices that aren't in the dark. Iechyd da, all of you.
owen_cultist.g_cheers: Iechyd da, everybody, and somebody tell me a story before I start humming.
g_quiet_line: Three in the morning was always my time. The radio phone-ins, the lonely ones calling in. I used to feel like I knew them.
Whitmore Bay in the rain, that's what I miss tonight. Chips on the front and nobody else daft enough to be out.
owen_cultist.g_after_wipe: Everybody all right? Stay down a minute, catch your breath. I'm here, I'm not going anywhere, and we'll get up together.
owen_cultist.g_crew: For eight years my only company was the CB, everybody. Then something in the dark. Now it's you lot, and you're much better company.
owen_cultist.g_exasperated: I said wait at the entrance, I said it twice, and I said it nicely. Duw, I'll start writing it on my hand.
owen_cultist.g_love_sharp: You notice the thing nobody else noticed, {name}. I'd have wanted you in the cab with me on a foggy night.
owen_cultist.g_love_kind: You sit up with people who can't sleep, {name}. I know what that's worth, believe me.
owen_cultist.g_love_funny: You get a laugh out of me in the worst places, {name}. That's a gift, that is, and I don't say it lightly.
owen_cultist.g_love_brave: You walk into the dark like it's only a car park, {name}. I'm glad you're next to me down there.
owen_cultist.g_love_steady: You're the same at three in the morning as you are at noon. Not many people are, and I'd know.
owen_cultist.g_love_clever: You work out the road before the rest of us have found the map, {name}. Very handy, that.
owen_cultist.g_love_honest: You say the hard thing first, {name}, like I try to. It makes everything after it easier.
owen_cultist.g_love_quiet: You don't mind a long silence, {name}. Sitting with you, I don't have to listen for anything else.
owen_cultist.g_love_fierce: You don't let go of people, {name}, not ever. Hold on to that, it's rarer than you'd think.
owen_cultist.g_love_warm: Talking to you is like the radio on a long night, {name}. It keeps the road from feeling so empty.
g_loved: Oh, now then, that's very kind. I'll write that one down, in the good part of the notebook.
Duw, stop it, bach, or I'll start humming hymns and nobody wants that.
owen_cultist.g_hate_sharp: You go after the weak spot every time, {name}. I've got plenty, mind, but you needn't keep looking.
owen_cultist.g_hate_kind: You keep asking what I hear down there, {name}. I'll tell you when I'm ready, and not before.
owen_cultist.g_hate_funny: You laugh at the lonely ones, {name}. I was one for a long time, and it isn't funny from inside.
owen_cultist.g_hate_brave: You run into the dark without listening first, {name}. Some of it listens back, I promise you.
owen_cultist.g_hate_steady: You stand there while the road closes in front of you. On a motorway that gets people killed.
owen_cultist.g_hate_clever: You talk down to people who don't follow you, {name}. Not everybody had the schooling, and that's no crime.
owen_cultist.g_hate_honest: You say every cruel thing the minute it comes into your head. Some of it should stay in your head.
owen_cultist.g_hate_quiet: You never say what's wrong, {name}, you just go cold. I can't read silence the way you think I can.
owen_cultist.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a scrap with you, {name}, down to who gets the last chip. There's no prize for it.
owen_cultist.g_hate_warm: You fill every quiet minute, {name}. A few of us want the quiet, mind, to keep track of what's in it.
owen_cultist.g_respect: We don't get on, {name}, I won't pretend we do. But you held firm in that cave, and I'll say so to anybody.
owen_cultist.g_call_out: That was on you, {name}, and I'm sorry to say it. We agreed to wait, and you went, and we all paid for it.
owen_cultist.g_stung: Fair enough, that's landed. My notebook and I need a while.
owen_cultist.g_concede: You were right, {name}, and I was wrong. I've gone over it, honest, and there's no way round it.
owen_cultist.g_nod: Ta, {name}, that's good of you. No need for a fuss, mind.
owen_cultist.g_callback_save: You hauled me out of that mine shaft, {name}. I've written it down, so it's official now.
owen_cultist.g_callback_clutch: The two of us still on our feet, everything else on the floor. I tell that one to myself on quiet nights.
owen_cultist.g_callback_callout: When you told me off that time, I sulked half the night in my notebook. Turns out you had it right, and I've crossed out the sulking.
owen_cultist.g_former_rivals: When we met, {name}, I thought you'd never trust a man who hears things. Now you're the first one I'd tell.
owen_cultist.g_changed: I used to stop and listen in every dark place, everybody. Lately I listen to you lot instead, and it's much nicer.
g_unguarded: Just between us, then. When it first spoke to me in the mine, I was glad. Not frightened, glad. That's the worst of it.
Between you and me, bach. I'm frightened of the day it stops. I'm more frightened of that than of it talking.
owen_cultist.g_clipped: Right you are, your call. I'll be at the back.
owen_cultist.g_noticed_open: Now then, you've told a story right through without stopping. Go on, there's more, I can tell.
arg_ask: {player}, bach, would you sort this out for us? I've had my say, gently, and we're going round in circles.
Help us out, {player}, there's a good one. Hear us both and pick, and I'll go along with it.
owen_cultist.arg_backed_me: Ta, {player}, that's good of you. I'll try not to look too pleased, mind.
owen_cultist.arg_backed_them: Your decision, then, and I'll drive it. Wrong road, mind, if you ask me.
owen_cultist.arg_stayed_out: Keeping your head down, then, bach. Wise of you, honest.
owen_cultist.arg_always_their_side: Every row ends up on their side of the road, {player}. Quiet I may be, but I've got mirrors.
owen_cultist.arg_wallflower: Nobody's deciding, so I'll decide, gently. My way, and we get on.
owen_cultist.arg_reject: No, {player}, I can't do that one, sorry. I've been on the wrong end of it.
owen_cultist.arg_grumble: I'll let it go, more or less. I'll write the less in my notebook.
owen_cultist.arg_settled: Half each, then, tidy enough. Shake on it, and somebody fill the kettle.
owen_cultist.seen_listens: You wait for people to get to the end, {player}, even the slow ones like me. Most folk don't have the patience.
owen_cultist.seen_truth: You tell people the hard version, {player}, no sugar. That's how I'd want to hear it, every time.
owen_cultist.seen_jokes: On the grim days you crack everybody up, {player}. Every good night shift had somebody like you.
owen_cultist.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the rows, {player}. Wise, I think, wiser than me.
owen_cultist.seen_biased: Same one gets first pick of everything, {player}. The others have noticed, mind, and so have I.
owen_cultist.seen_harsh: You can be rough with folk, {player}. My skin's thick from the depots, but not everybody's is.
owen_cultist.seed_right: Your advice after that awful day, {player}, I gave it a go today. It worked, and I wanted to say thank you.
owen_cultist.seed_remember: What you told me when it all went wrong is still in my head, {player}. No decision yet, but it's there.
owen_cultist.seed_wrong: I drove it your route, {player}, and it was a worse journey. Only telling you, bach, no hard feelings.
owen_cultist.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I have a word, {player}? That one nearly had me, {player}, and something in the dark sounded pleased about it.
owen_cultist.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us down, every single one. Sit in the cab with me, so to speak, and we'll run back over the route, nobody blaming anybody.
owen_cultist.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and the front was mine to hold. That's on me, {player}, and I'll say it first.
owen_cultist.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, and everybody walking. That's like a clear road at four in the morning, {player}, the best feeling there is.
owen_cultist.talk_development: Odd question, {player}, but do you think I've changed? I went into a cave yesterday and forgot to listen.
owen_cultist.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been short with {name}, {player}. When I'm tired I go quiet and cold, and they don't deserve it.
owen_cultist.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, do you reckon? Or do they just put up with the strange one?
owen_cultist.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} gets on my nerves, {player}, no two ways about it. But in the dark, they're who I'd want behind me.
owen_cultist.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s not right, {player}, I can hear it in their voice. Something's on their mind.
owen_cultist.talk_confrontation_favour: Can I raise something, {player}, softly? The pick of the loot ends up in {name}'s pack every run. I'd like to know the reason.
owen_cultist.talk_confrontation_dislike: Plainly, then, {player}. {name} and I grind each other's gears, and pretending otherwise is wearing us both out.
owen_cultist.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going deep with no way back marked, {player}. I know the dark better than most, and I don't like it.
owen_cultist.talk_confrontation_wrong: I had {name} wrong, {player}, I'll say it plain. They were right, and I'd like that known.
owen_cultist.talk_confrontation_trust: Fair question, {player}, and I'll ask it gently. On the big jobs, I'm left behind. Is it because of what I hear?
owen_cultist.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit ended up with {name} and I found out by looking. I'd have carried it over myself, {player}, gladly, if anyone had mentioned it.
owen_cultist.talk_lands_aftermath: Ta, {player}, that's a weight off. Kettle's going on now.
owen_cultist.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll mend, bach, give me a night's sleep. Two at the most.
owen_cultist.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, that. I'll go and sit with the notebook.
owen_cultist.talk_lands_development: So it's not only me who's seen it. That's good to hear, that is.
owen_cultist.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, hard to tell from inside my own head. Ask me in a month.
owen_cultist.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, {player}. You've got the wrong end of it there.
owen_cultist.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, yes. I'll have a quiet word with {name}, kindly.
owen_cultist.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I couldn't say. A road map makes more sense than most people.
owen_cultist.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I mentioned it, please. Not a word to {name}, mind.
owen_cultist.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, I'll take that on board. Bit bruised, but fair.
owen_cultist.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, {player}, over. I'll sleep on it.
owen_cultist.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, so that's the lay of the land. I'll keep it in mind.
owen_cultist.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that for tonight, I think. I'll be by the fire.
owen_cultist.arc_cracks: We went past a mine today, {player}, and I didn't stop to listen. First time in three years. My hands were shaking after.
owen_cultist.arc_turn: I've been asking it what it wants, {player}, as if the answer mattered. Maybe the question is what I want.
owen_cultist.arc_become: It's quiet in my head now, everybody, properly quiet. Lonely, some nights, but it's my quiet, and you're in it.
owen_cultist.arc_failed: I still go and listen, {player}. I tell myself it's only to find out. I don't know if that's true any more.
owen_cultist.alt_turn: I went down into the dark again last night, {player}, on my own. I said I was only checking, and that was a lie.
owen_cultist.alt_become: It talks and I listen, {player}, and I'm not sure where it ends and I begin. I'm telling you because I promised to say the worst first.
owen_cultist.g_roast_after: Still the most lost convoy I've ever driven with, everybody. I'd do every night run with you.
owen_cultist.g_after_wipe_after: Up we get, slowly, and hold on to each other. We go down together and we come up together, that's my rule now.
owen_cultist.g_toast_after: To you lot, the voices I chose. It's quiet in my head now, and you're the reason it isn't lonely. Iechyd da, my lovely lot.
owen_cultist.g_crew_after: This is my convoy now, everybody, for good. I don't need to talk into the dark any more.
g_quiet_line_after: Walked right past a cave tonight and didn't even slow down. Hummed a hymn instead, the whole thing.
Slept through the night, first time in years. Nothing woke me, nothing at all, and it was lovely.
g_loved_after: Thank you, bach, and I believe you. That's new for me, believing it.
That's kind, and I'll keep it. Not in the notebook, mind, just in my head.
t_raise: Now then, everybody, a question, and I'll go last so I can hear yours: {topic}
Here's one for the fire, my lovely lot, if you're in the mood: {topic}
owen_cultist.t_react_warm: Oh, {name}, that's lovely, that is. I'll write it in the good part of the notebook.
owen_cultist.t_react_laugh: Duw, {name}, you've set me off now, I'll be laughing at that on watch.
owen_cultist.t_react_tease: That's it, bach? Thin as a motorway sandwich, {name}, and about as tasty.
owen_cultist.t_react_same: Same as mine, {name}, near enough. Funny old world, isn't it?
owen_cultist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, bach? Your turn now, over, I'm listening.
owen_cultist.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, everybody. Some of us are, mind, and that's all right.
owen_cultist.topic_miss_most: The radio phone ins at three in the morning on the M4, everybody, lonely people talking to other lonely people. I felt like I knew them.
owen_cultist.topic_first_night: In my cab, except the cab was gone, so in a field holding a handset with no cord. I talked into it all night anyway.
owen_cultist.topic_worst_shift: Stuck on the Severn Bridge in a gale for six hours with a load of frozen peas and a dead radio. Longest night of my life.
owen_cultist.topic_last_meal: A full breakfast at the services at Membury at five in the morning, everybody, beans, black pudding, and a tea you could stand a spoon in.
owen_cultist.topic_useless_skill: I can reverse a forty four tonne lorry into a gap with a foot either side. Here they mostly want me to reverse away from things.
owen_cultist.topic_here_better: Nobody's lonely here for long, everybody. Somebody always pulls up a seat, and I didn't have that before.
owen_cultist.topic_kid_trouble: I sang the wrong words to a hymn in chapel at nine, on purpose, very loudly. I still think it was funny.
owen_cultist.topic_settle_down: By the sea, somewhere with rain and a chapel and a chip shop. Barry, really, if Barry turned up.

g_roast: Nineteen seasons above eight thousand metres, my climbers, and I never saw a team walk this fast toward a cliff on purpose.
On day four the famous ones started crying. You lot started crying on day one, which saves time, I suppose.
g_fire_back: Ramro, coming from the one who asked me yesterday if snow was cold.
Ha, yes, fair, that was a good one. I'll remember it on the next steep bit, when you're breathing like a yak.
g_pile_on: Worse, my climbers. They ran up the slope, sat down at the top, and asked where the slope had gone.
And afterwards they told the innkeeper they'd climbed a mountain. It was a hill, dai, with a goat on it.
pasang_primalist.g_peacemake: Bistarai, both of you, slowly, sit, drink some tea. People shout when the air is thin, and here the air is fine, so stop.
pasang_primalist.g_take_side: {name} has it right here. They walked it slower than the rest of us, and slower is usually right.
pasang_primalist.g_left_out: You two talk, I'll check the ropes. Ropes listen better anyway.
pasang_primalist.g_include: Sit, there's room by the stove, and the tea is hot. Nobody sits alone on cold ground, that's the first rule of a camp.
pasang_primalist.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, my climbers. We go straight up the steepest side, as fast as we can, and nobody stops to breathe.
pasang_primalist.g_plan_yes: Ramro, a good plan, slow and steady, everybody roped. That's how people come home.
pasang_primalist.g_plan_no: No, that plan is fast, and fast is how I carried people down. We go slower, or we don't go.
pasang_primalist.g_hype: Slowly now, my climbers, one step and then another, breathe out on the hard part. Nobody wins a mountain, we only get to visit.
pasang_primalist.g_toast: A small toast, with butter tea, which none of you like. To my climbers, who still have all their fingers. That's a good season.
pasang_primalist.g_cheers: Cheers, my climbers, and somebody finish my tea, I made too much again.
g_quiet_line: In Khumjung the prayer flags snap all night in the wind. I used to think it was noisy, and now I miss it.
Clear dawn coming, I can feel it in the cold. Good weather for walking slowly.
pasang_primalist.g_after_wipe: Everybody stay down, don't jump up, breathe slowly. Good, the mountain didn't take anyone. Now we sit, and then we go again, slower.
pasang_primalist.g_crew: For nineteen seasons I carried other people up mountains, my climbers. You're the first team I've walked beside instead.
pasang_primalist.g_exasperated: I said slowly, three times, with my hands, and you ran. Dai, this is how I lose my patience, and I have a lot of patience.
pasang_primalist.g_love_sharp: You notice the loose rock before you step on it, {name}. That's what keeps people alive up high.
pasang_primalist.g_love_kind: You carry somebody else's load without saying so, {name}. Very good, that's a Sherpa's manners.
pasang_primalist.g_love_funny: You make the whole camp laugh when it's cold and miserable, {name}. I'd trade an extra tent for that.
pasang_primalist.g_love_brave: You go up the bad slope quietly, without a speech, {name}. Brave people don't announce it, in my experience.
pasang_primalist.g_love_steady: You walk the same on day four as on day one, {name}. Most people don't, and I've watched a lot of them.
pasang_primalist.g_love_clever: You read the route before I tell you, {name}. Another season and I'd make you a guide.
pasang_primalist.g_love_honest: You say when you're tired, {name}. That's the bravest thing a climber can say, and almost nobody does.
pasang_primalist.g_love_quiet: On the trail you're happy in silence, {name}. Walking with you is very easy.
pasang_primalist.g_love_fierce: Once you're roped to somebody, {name}, you hold on to the end. That's the whole of the job.
pasang_primalist.g_love_warm: You make a cold camp feel like a kitchen in Khumjung, {name}. I don't say that to anybody.
g_loved: Ha, careful, or I'll start talking and never stop. Ask the second year.
Thank you, ramro, very kind. Now drink some tea, it's good for you even if it tastes bad.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_sharp: You look for the weak one in a group, {name}, the way altitude does. I prefer you didn't help it.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I'm cold, {name}. I was born cold, I'm fine, ask somebody from somewhere warm.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_funny: Not every moment is a joke, {name}. On a ledge, the joke can wait until the bottom.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_brave: You rush ahead, {name}, and call it courage. The mountain calls it something else.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_steady: You stand there deciding while the weather comes in, {name}. Sometimes you must just turn around.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_clever: You tell me about mountains, {name}. Me, nineteen seasons up high, and you've read a book.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_honest: Each hard word comes out the moment you think it, {name}. Day four is not the time, believe me.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_quiet: You never say you're tired until you fall over, {name}. Say it earlier, that's what I'm for.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_fierce: You fight everything, {name}, even the slope. The slope doesn't fight back, it just waits.
pasang_primalist.g_hate_warm: You talk the whole way up, {name}, and then wonder why you can't breathe. Save the air.
pasang_primalist.g_respect: You and I share a tent badly, {name}, and that's allowed. But you didn't let go of the rope back there, and I saw it.
pasang_primalist.g_call_out: That one belongs to you, {name}, and I'm saying it slowly so it's clear. We agreed to wait, and you went, and everybody paid.
pasang_primalist.g_stung: Ramro, fair, that went in. The ropes and I will sit a while.
pasang_primalist.g_concede: Your reading was better than mine, {name}. Even guides misread the snow sometimes, and today it was me.
pasang_primalist.g_callback_save: You held the rope when I slipped, {name}. Nineteen seasons, and I can count on one hand who did that for me.
pasang_primalist.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, breathing like two old yaks. I tell that one at every fire, slowly.
pasang_primalist.g_callback_callout: When you said I was going too slow that day, I was annoyed until the evening. Then the storm came, and you'd have been right.
pasang_primalist.g_former_rivals: The first week, {name}, I took you for the one who'd cry on day four. Now I'd rope myself to you on any slope.
pasang_primalist.g_changed: I used to want to climb everything alone, my climbers. Lately I wait for you at the top of every rise.
g_unguarded: Only the two of us here, so here it is. I want to stand on that high peak alone, and I spent nineteen years telling clients that's how people die.
Between you and me. On the mountain I always knew who would turn back. I don't know any more who I am when I turn back.
pasang_primalist.g_clipped: Fine, your choice. I'll be at the front.
pasang_primalist.g_noticed_open: Look at that, a whole story, slowly, start to finish. Bistarai, keep going, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, settle this for us, please. I've said mine slowly, and they're still talking fast.
Listen to both of us, {player}, and choose. You're the one we're both roped to.
pasang_primalist.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, ramro. I'll try not to look like I knew.
pasang_primalist.arg_backed_them: Fine, your choice, and I'll walk it. I still think it's the fast way, and fast is wrong.
pasang_primalist.arg_stayed_out: You keep out of it, like a cook on a quarrelling expedition, and I understand why.
pasang_primalist.arg_always_their_side: Their side wins again, {player}, and again. I count footsteps, and I count these too.
pasang_primalist.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I'll decide, slowly. My way, and we walk.
pasang_primalist.arg_reject: No, {player}, not that one. I've carried people down from that kind of choice.
pasang_primalist.arg_grumble: Ke garne, what else is there to do. I'll put it down, mostly.
pasang_primalist.arg_settled: Half each, then, like sharing a load. Good, now we walk.
pasang_primalist.seen_listens: You wait for slow talkers like me to reach the end, {player}. On a long climb that's a very good quality.
pasang_primalist.seen_truth: You tell people the true weather, {player}, not the hoped one. That's what keeps climbers alive.
pasang_primalist.seen_jokes: On the miserable nights you get the camp laughing, {player}. A good expedition always carried one of those.
pasang_primalist.seen_stays_out: You keep clear of arguments, {player}, like a wise cook on a big expedition.
pasang_primalist.seen_biased: The best gear goes to one person, {player}, trip after trip. I notice who gets the warm tent, it's a habit.
pasang_primalist.seen_harsh: You can be rough with people, {player}. A few of these people are on their day four, and you can't see it.
pasang_primalist.seed_right: That advice from the hard day, {player}, I tried it. It held, like a good anchor, and I wanted you to know.
pasang_primalist.seed_remember: What you told me on that bad night, {player}, I'm still watching it, like weather. No decision yet.
pasang_primalist.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Only reporting, like the weather.
pasang_primalist.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a minute, {player}. That one was close, and my hands shook after, and a guide's hands never shake.
pasang_primalist.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us on the ground, every one. Let's go back over it slowly, step by step, the way we'd talk after a bad day on the icefall.
pasang_primalist.talk_aftermath_blame_self: The pace was mine, {player}, and {name} paid for it first. I'll carry that one myself.
pasang_primalist.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Up and down, everybody walking, nobody hurt. That's a good day on a mountain, {player}, the best kind.
pasang_primalist.talk_development: A question, {player}, and you can be honest. Have I changed? Yesterday I waited at the top of a rise without being asked.
pasang_primalist.talk_relationship_hard_on: Tired, I get slow and cold, {player}, and {name} has had all the cold lately.
pasang_primalist.talk_relationship_likes_me: Do you think {name} likes me, {player}? Or just likes that I carry the heavy pack?
pasang_primalist.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me to distraction, {player}. But on a bad slope, they're who I'd rope myself to.
pasang_primalist.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} is walking like it's their day four, {player}. Something is wrong, and it isn't the air.
pasang_primalist.talk_confrontation_favour: Let me say this slowly, {player}. The warmest gear goes into {name}'s tent every night. If there's a reason, tell me.
pasang_primalist.talk_confrontation_dislike: Simply, {player}, {name} and I don't share a tent well. Pretending we do only makes the nights longer.
pasang_primalist.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going up without a way down, {player}. I carried the ending of that down mountains, and I'd rather not here.
pasang_primalist.talk_confrontation_wrong: My reading of {name} was wrong, {player}. They saw the route better than I did, and I want that said.
pasang_primalist.talk_confrontation_trust: A quiet question, {player}. On the big climbs you leave me at camp. Is it my climbing, or something else?
pasang_primalist.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit is with {name} now, and nobody mentioned it. A word first would have been enough, {player}, it was theirs if they asked.
pasang_primalist.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, that helps. I'll make tea, and you'll drink it.
pasang_primalist.talk_shrug_aftermath: It passes, like weather, ke garne. Give it a night.
pasang_primalist.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, but fine. The ropes need checking anyway.
pasang_primalist.talk_lands_development: So you saw it too. Ramro, then it's real.
pasang_primalist.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, I can't see my own pace. Ask me in a month.
pasang_primalist.talk_stings_development: No, {player}, that's not it. You've read the snow wrong there.
pasang_primalist.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, then tea with {name}, slowly, the two of us alone.
pasang_primalist.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I couldn't say. Weather is easier to read than people.
pasang_primalist.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. Nothing to {name}.
pasang_primalist.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, I accept that. It stings a little, but it's fair.
pasang_primalist.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've heard it, {player}, and I'll sleep on it.
pasang_primalist.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the weather, then, and now I know it.
pasang_primalist.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that one for tonight. I'll be by the stove.
pasang_primalist.arc_cracks: I waited for the slowest one today, {player}, on purpose. On a mountain I'd have called that guiding. Here it's just company.
pasang_primalist.arc_turn: I keep saying I want that summit alone, {player}. I think I want somebody to see me stand on it.
pasang_primalist.arc_become: We'll go up together, my climbers, roped, slowly. I don't want the top alone any more. I want it with you.
pasang_primalist.arc_failed: I still look at that peak and think of going alone, {player}. I know better, and I still think it.
pasang_primalist.alt_turn: I went up the ridge on my own last night, {player}, just to look. I told myself it was only to look.
pasang_primalist.alt_become: I'll go alone when the weather's right, {player}. I'm telling you so somebody knows which way I went.
pasang_primalist.g_roast_after: Still the fastest team toward a cliff I've ever guided, my climbers, and I'd rope myself to every one of you.
pasang_primalist.g_after_wipe_after: Slowly, up, together, hold on to each other. We go down roped and we come up roped, that's my rule now.
pasang_primalist.g_toast_after: To my climbers, who taught an old guide to walk beside people instead of in front. Drink the tea, all of it.
pasang_primalist.g_crew_after: This is my team now, for good. I don't want the summit alone any more, I want it with you.
g_quiet_line_after: I looked at the high peak tonight and thought of all of you on it with me. That's new, that thought.
Clear dawn coming, and for once I'm not planning to go anywhere on my own.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and this time I believe it on the first telling, which is new.
Ramro, very kind, and I'll keep it. Now drink your tea.
t_raise: My climbers, a question while the tea is hot, and answer slowly: {topic}
Here's one for the stove, everyone answers, no rushing: {topic}
pasang_primalist.t_react_warm: Ramro, {name}, that one is good, like a clear morning after a storm.
pasang_primalist.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, I'm laughing, look, and I didn't laugh on day four with the famous ones.
pasang_primalist.t_react_tease: Dai, {name}, that's very thin, like the air at eight thousand metres.
pasang_primalist.t_react_same: {name}, I'd have said that too, almost word for word. Ke garne, great minds.
pasang_primalist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Slowly, there's no hurry, but you do answer.
pasang_primalist.t_guess_player: {player} is saving their answer, like a climber saving breath for the last ridge. Smart, I think.
pasang_primalist.topic_miss_most: Khumjung in the morning, my climbers, frost on the stone walls, yaks breathing smoke, and the prayer flags snapping on the roof.
pasang_primalist.topic_first_night: In a crack in the rocks, sitting up, with my axe across my knees. I said a prayer to every mountain I knew, in case one of them was listening here.
pasang_primalist.topic_worst_shift: A client who wouldn't turn back, on summit day, and the weather coming. I carried him down on my back for six hours. He wrote a book about it, and I'm not in it.
pasang_primalist.topic_last_meal: Dal bhat, my climbers, rice and lentils and greens, twice, because you always get seconds, and a big cup of butter tea after.
pasang_primalist.topic_useless_skill: I can carry forty kilos up an icefall without stopping. Here everybody has a bag of holding, so mostly I carry the tea.
pasang_primalist.topic_here_better: Nobody here pays to be carried up a mountain. They climb their own, and they're quiet about it, and I like that.
pasang_primalist.topic_kid_trouble: I took a yak up to the monastery at nine to show the monks, and it ate the flowers in front of the gompa. The lama laughed, the cook didn't.
pasang_primalist.topic_settle_down: High up, in a stone hut with a stove and a window on the snow, and a few climbers dropping in for tea.

g_roast: In sixteen years of fourteen-year-olds, class, I never had a group that ignored the plan so politely and so completely.
There's a battle in 1410 that went better than our last fight, and in that one the general fell off his horse.
g_fire_back: That's very good, and I'll mark it as a pass. Next time, though, try to say it when I'm not holding the door for you.
My back row said worse every Tuesday, and they spelled it better, which is the part that really stings.
g_pile_on: Let me add the footnote, class. That was the second time today, and the first one was in front of a signpost.
In their defence, history is full of people who walked confidently in the wrong direction. Most of them got statues.
pavlo_knight.g_peacemake: Both of you sit down, please, and drink some tea. We'll take it in order, first one side, then the other, and nobody interrupts.
pavlo_knight.g_take_side: Forgive me, but I'm with this one. I've seen this argument in four centuries of textbooks, and it always ends the same way.
pavlo_knight.g_left_out: You two are deep in something private, so I'll leave you to it. There's a map that wants drawing over by the fire.
pavlo_knight.g_include: Come and sit with us, there's tea and there's room. Standing at the edge of the room was always the loneliest seat in class.
pavlo_knight.g_bad_plan: Here's a plan from the history books. We march straight up the middle in our best clothes, and we hope they're as polite as we are.
pavlo_knight.g_plan_yes: Good, that's a sensible plan. Tell me how long you need me to hold, and I'll hold exactly that long.
pavlo_knight.g_plan_no: No, I'm sorry, I've read how that one ends, and there's a whole chapter on it. We'll find another way.
pavlo_knight.g_hype: Right, class, the lesson's simple today. Stay behind me, watch your neighbour, and nobody wanders off.
pavlo_knight.g_toast: A short toast, I promise, which from a teacher is a rare thing. To this class, who keep coming back after the bell.
pavlo_knight.g_cheers: Budmo, everyone, which means let's keep being, more or less. It's a good thing to drink to.
g_quiet_line: There was a tower here once, before this one, and nobody remembers who built either. That's most of history, really.
The tea's gone cold again, and that's the third time today. Clearly I'm talking too much.
pavlo_knight.g_after_wipe: Everyone up slowly, and nobody blame anybody yet. First we breathe, then we work out what happened, then we fix it.
pavlo_knight.g_crew: When the bell stopped ringing for good, I thought I'd never have a class again. And here you all are, refusing to do the homework.
pavlo_knight.g_exasperated: I explained it, I drew it in the dirt, I asked if there were questions. And still every one of you ran left.
pavlo_knight.g_love_sharp: You ask the question under the question, the one that matters. That's the student every teacher hopes for.
pavlo_knight.g_love_kind: You care for people without needing them to notice. In my experience that's the rarest lesson of all to learn.
pavlo_knight.g_love_funny: You laughed at my joke about the Treaty of Andrusovo, the only person who ever has. I'll treasure that.
pavlo_knight.g_love_brave: You go first when it's frightening, and you don't make a speech about it. That kind of courage is very old and very quiet.
pavlo_knight.g_love_steady: You don't panic, even when the room does. A wall knows another wall, and it's good to have a second one.
pavlo_knight.g_love_clever: You see the pattern before the rest of us, the way a good historian does. It's a pleasure to watch you think.
pavlo_knight.g_love_honest: You tell people what's so, even the hard version. I taught the hard version every spring, so I respect that.
pavlo_knight.g_love_quiet: You don't fill the silence, and you let a person think. Most people are afraid of that, and you're not.
pavlo_knight.g_love_fierce: You hold on when anybody sensible would let go. History belongs to stubborn people, mostly, and you're one of them.
pavlo_knight.g_love_warm: Being near you feels like the staff room on a good Friday, kettle on, everybody laughing. I'd forgotten that feeling.
g_loved: That's very kind of you, and I'm going to drink my tea and pretend I'm not moved.
Thank you, truly. Nobody's given me a good mark in a long time.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_sharp: You go for the soft place every time, and you enjoy it. I've known bullies in uniform who were gentler.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_kind: You keep fussing over me as if I'm fragile. I'm a large man who stands in front of things, I promise you I'll manage.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, and some things deserve a moment of quiet first. You'll understand that one day, I hope.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_brave: You charge in before you've looked, and somebody always has to stand in the gap you leave. Usually that's me.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait for certainty, and the moment passes. History is mostly people who waited a day too long.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_clever: You explain things to people as if they're slow. A good teacher never does that, and you'd make a poor one.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_honest: Truth with no care in it is just a stone you've thrown. You can be right and still be cruel.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_quiet: You sit there and say nothing, and then nobody knows what you need. Silence isn't always wisdom.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_fierce: Everything with you is a battle, even breakfast. I taught four wars a year, and none of them started over porridge.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_warm: You talk without a pause, and nobody else can get a word in. Let the quiet ones speak, please.
pavlo_knight.g_respect: We don't get on, and I won't pretend we do. But you held your ground back there, and I'll give you full marks for it.
pavlo_knight.g_call_out: That one was yours, and I'll say it plainly. I asked you to wait for my signal, and you didn't wait.
pavlo_knight.g_stung: I see, thank you for telling me. I'll take a short walk and think about it.
pavlo_knight.g_concede: You were correct, and I was not, and I've been turning it over since. A teacher who can't say that should retire.
pavlo_knight.g_nod: And well done to you too, it was good work. We'll leave it at that, before one of us gets sentimental.
pavlo_knight.g_callback_save: I haven't forgotten you hauling me back to my feet. A large man is very difficult to lift, and you managed.
pavlo_knight.g_callback_clutch: Just you and me left, back to back, both of us out of breath. I'll be telling that story to children one day.
pavlo_knight.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I went very quiet for a day. You were right, and it was a useful lesson.
pavlo_knight.g_former_rivals: At the start I had you written down as a difficult student. These days I'd put my shield between you and anything, without a second thought.

Here's one for the fire, butt, and nobody gets out of it: {topic}
rhodri_knight.t_react_warm: Oh, that's lush, {name}, that is. Proper lump in my throat now, look.
rhodri_knight.t_react_laugh: Duw, {name}, I'm crying here, that's the best thing I've heard all week.
rhodri_knight.t_react_tease: Is that it, butt? {name}, I've had more excitement off a wet Tuesday in Treforest.
rhodri_knight.t_react_same: Mine too, {name}, near enough, isn't it. Great minds, butt.
rhodri_knight.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, come on, butt, don't leave us hanging, it's your go now.
rhodri_knight.t_guess_player: {player}'s gone very quiet over there. Something embarrassing, I bet you, something tidy and shameful.
rhodri_knight.topic_miss_most: A Saturday at Sardis Road, butt, mud up to your knees, the boys singing, and a pint after that you've earned twice over.
rhodri_knight.topic_first_night: Under a hedge with my boots still on, wondering who'd nicked Pontypridd. Didn't sleep much, I'll be honest with you.
rhodri_knight.topic_worst_shift: Putting up a scaffold on a chapel roof in January, sideways rain, and the vicar bringing us tea every ten minutes to watch.
rhodri_knight.topic_last_meal: Faggots and peas and chips from the shop at the bottom of our road, with a can of something cold and the rugby on.
rhodri_knight.topic_useless_skill: I can carry six scaffold tubes on one shoulder without dropping a single one. Not a tube for a thousand miles, is there.
rhodri_knight.topic_here_better: The fighting, mind, no word of a lie. It's like a front row with the gloves off, and nobody gets sent off.
rhodri_knight.topic_kid_trouble: I climbed the old colliery tower at twelve for a dare and got stuck at the top. Fire brigade had to fetch me down, and my mam's face, duw.
rhodri_knight.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with hills and rain and a pub with a decent telly. Make it a bit like home, I won't complain.

g_roast: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, Tegan has flown in front of two hundred wedding guests in hats, and she's never once looked as nervous as she does watching you lot fight.
I've done school visits with forty seven year olds who listened better than this party, and one of them tried to eat a feather.
g_fire_back: Fair, cariad, that's a good one, and from the one who tried to stroke an owl that was clearly having a bad day.
Ha, duw, I deserved that, didn't I? Tegan thinks so too, look at her face.
g_pile_on: Oh, worse than that, boys and girls. They shouted in the woods, every bird for a mile left, and then came the question of why it was quiet.
Then at the inn it was hours of tracking, apparently. It was sat on a fence, waiting for them.
rhys_ranger.g_peacemake: Shh, both of you, gently now, you're frightening the bird. Sit down, voices low, and say it again like you'd say it to a nervous hawk.
rhys_ranger.g_take_side: I'm with {name} on this one, sorry. Tegan's been watching them all evening, and she's never wrong about people.
rhys_ranger.g_left_out: Carry on, the pair of you, Tegan wants a fly up the ridge. She's been sat still too long.
rhys_ranger.g_include: Come on, sit by me, there's room. Tegan won't mind, she's decided she likes you, and she's very fussy.
rhys_ranger.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, boys and girls. We all run into the woods shouting, as loud as we can, and see what jumps out.
rhys_ranger.g_plan_yes: Tidy, quiet and careful, I like it. Tegan approves, look, she's settled.
rhys_ranger.g_plan_no: No, cariad, that's a loud plan, and loud gets people hurt in the woods. Let's do it quieter, please.
rhys_ranger.g_hype: Quiet now, boys and girls, nice and slow. Tegan goes first, we follow her, and nobody shouts until it's time.
rhys_ranger.g_toast: Not much of a talker, me, but here goes. To all of you, and to Tegan, who's the only one of us who can actually hunt. Iechyd da, everyone.
rhys_ranger.g_cheers: Cheers, all, and keep it down a bit, mind, she's trying to sleep.
g_quiet_line: Mist on the Beacons first thing, Pen y Fan poking out the top like an island. I'd go up there with Tegan before anybody was awake.
Rain's coming, I can smell it, proper Brecon rain. Tegan hates it, I've always quite liked it.
rhys_ranger.g_after_wipe: Everyone stay down a second, quietly, nobody jump up. Tegan's on the branch, she's watching, so we're safe for now. Breathe, then slowly up.
rhys_ranger.g_crew: I never wanted to leave my valley, everyone. Ended up about as far from it as a person can get, and somehow you lot feel like a valley.
rhys_ranger.g_exasperated: I asked for quiet, three times, in my softest voice. Somebody shouted anyway, and now there isn't a bird left in this whole forest.
rhys_ranger.g_love_sharp: You spot movement in the trees before Tegan does, {name}, and that's saying a lot.
rhys_ranger.g_love_kind: You're gentle with the animals, {name}, every one. Tegan's noticed, she lets you close.
rhys_ranger.g_love_funny: You make me laugh out loud in the woods, {name}, which I never do. Worth scaring a few birds for.
rhys_ranger.g_love_brave: You walk up to the frightening things calmly, {name}, like you'd walk up to a nervous bird. That's proper courage.
rhys_ranger.g_love_steady: You're calm, {name}, all the time, and animals love that. I love it too, if I'm allowed to say so.
rhys_ranger.g_love_clever: You work out what an animal's going to do before it does it, {name}. You'd have been a good falconer.
rhys_ranger.g_love_honest: You tell people straight, {name}, no fuss. Hawks are the same, and I trust them more than most folk.
rhys_ranger.g_love_quiet: You can be quiet in the woods without being asked, {name}. Hardly anybody can.
rhys_ranger.g_love_fierce: You'd fight anything to protect somebody smaller, {name}. Tegan's the same with her chicks, if she had any.
rhys_ranger.g_love_warm: Being near you is like the cafe at the centre on a wet day, {name}, everybody steaming and laughing.
g_loved: Oh, duw, stop, I'm going red, and Tegan will laugh at me. She does, you know, in her way.
That's kind, cariad, really. Tegan says thank you too, she's just shy about it.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_sharp: You go after people's weak spots, {name}, like a stoat in a henhouse. Leave it be, please.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to feed Tegan, {name}. She's on a weight, and you're not helping.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, please, there's something big in those trees. Jokes later, quietly.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_brave: You crash into the woods without looking, {name}, and every animal hears you coming a mile off.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_steady: The bird's gone while you're still thinking, {name}. Sometimes you just have to throw the lure.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_clever: You keep telling me how to fly my hawk, {name}. Fifteen years with birds, and you've had one afternoon.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_honest: You say every blunt thing the second you think it, {name}. It's like a car horn in a quiet field.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_quiet: You go cold and quiet and expect me to guess, {name}. I can read a hawk, not you.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, {name}, even putting the tent up. The tent isn't arguing back.
rhys_ranger.g_hate_warm: You talk all the way through the woods, {name}, every single walk. Tegan's not caught a thing in days.
rhys_ranger.g_respect: You and I don't click, {name}, and that's allowed. But you held firm in that fight, and Tegan didn't flinch at you once.
rhys_ranger.g_call_out: That one's on you, {name}, I'm sorry, but it is. You went charging in loud, and we all paid for it.
rhys_ranger.g_stung: Yeah, fair, I hear you. I'll take Tegan for a walk.
rhys_ranger.g_concede: You had the right of it, {name}, and I had it wrong. Even Tegan was looking at me like I was daft.
rhys_ranger.g_nod: Ta, {name}, tidy work. No fuss, mind.
rhys_ranger.g_callback_save: You got between me and that wolf, {name}, with Tegan on my arm. I don't forget things like that.
rhys_ranger.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, everything else down, Tegan screaming at it all. I tell that one quietly, in the woods.
rhys_ranger.g_callback_callout: When you told me I was too soft with people, I sulked a whole day with the bird. Then I stood up for myself, and you were right.
rhys_ranger.g_former_rivals: First time I met you, {name}, Tegan wouldn't look at you. Now she leans toward you, and so do I.
rhys_ranger.g_changed: I used to keep myself to myself, everyone, and the bird. Lately I sit at the fire and talk, and it's nice.
g_unguarded: Between us, cariad. I'm lucky, Tegan came through with me. Most folk lost everything, and I feel guilty about having her.
Just you and me, so I'll say it. I don't know if Brecon came through, and I'm frightened to go and look.
rhys_ranger.g_clipped: Right, your call. I'll be with the bird.
rhys_ranger.g_noticed_open: Look at you, telling it all the way through, out loud. Go on, softly, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, would you sort this out, please? Mine's been said quietly, and nobody listens to quiet.
Help us out, {player}, cariad. You decide, and I'll go with it, promise.
rhys_ranger.arg_backed_me: Ta, {player}, that's kind of you. Tegan agrees, look at her.
rhys_ranger.arg_backed_them: Right, fair enough, we'll do it that way. It's the loud way, mind.
rhys_ranger.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it, eh? Can't blame you, I'd rather be up the ridge myself.
rhys_ranger.arg_always_their_side: Tegan's noticed who wins every row, {player}, and so have I, quiet as I am.
rhys_ranger.arg_wallflower: Nobody's deciding, so I will, softly. My way, and we go.
rhys_ranger.arg_reject: No, {player}, sorry, I can't do that one. It'd frighten everything for miles.
rhys_ranger.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll let it lie, mostly. Tegan won't, she holds grudges.
rhys_ranger.arg_settled: Half each, tidy, fair enough. Shake on it, quietly, please.
rhys_ranger.seen_listens: Softly, {player}, you wait for quiet ones like me to get to the end. Tegan's noticed, and so have I.
rhys_ranger.seen_truth: You give people the real answer, {player}, gently but straight. Like a good bird handler, honest about the bird.
rhys_ranger.seen_jokes: On the rough days the whole camp laughs because of you, {player}. Even Tegan cocks her head.
rhys_ranger.seen_stays_out: You keep away from the rows, {player}, like a sensible bird on a high branch, and that's wise.
rhys_ranger.seen_biased: Funny, {player}, how one person ends up with the best kit every trip. Tegan watches who gets fed first, and so do I.
rhys_ranger.seen_harsh: Careful, {player}, you can be rough with people. Some of them spook easy, like young birds.
rhys_ranger.seed_right: Remember that advice from the rough day, {player}? I tried it, and it worked, like a bird coming back to the glove.
rhys_ranger.seed_remember: What you told me when it all went wrong, {player}, they're still circling, like a hawk that won't come down.
rhys_ranger.seed_wrong: Did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Only saying, cariad, no hard feelings.
rhys_ranger.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can you sit with me, {player}, quietly? That one was too close, and Tegan's still shaking on my arm, and so am I.
rhys_ranger.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us down, and Tegan screaming from the tree. Let's go back through it, softly, nobody blamed.
rhys_ranger.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Tegan saw it coming before {name} fell, {player}, and I didn't read her in time. That one's on me.
rhys_ranger.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everybody walking, Tegan back on the glove. That's a perfect day, {player}, like a show where nothing goes wrong.
rhys_ranger.talk_development: Odd one, {player}, but have I changed, do you think? I said what I thought at the fire last night, out loud, first.
rhys_ranger.talk_relationship_hard_on: Duw, {player}, {name}'s had my prickly side lately. Tired, I go quiet and prickly, and they've had the prickly bit.
rhys_ranger.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tegan likes {name}, {player}, I can tell. Is it me {name} likes, though, or just the bird?
rhys_ranger.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me round the bend, {player}. But in a dark wood, I'd still pick them to walk behind me.
rhys_ranger.talk_relationship_acting_off: Tegan won't settle near {name} today, {player}. Something's wrong with them, and she can feel it.
rhys_ranger.talk_confrontation_favour: Quietly, {player}, if I can. {name} picks the kit first, every time. If there's a reason, I'd just like to hear it.
rhys_ranger.talk_confrontation_dislike: Honest version, {player}. {name} and I don't sit well together, and pretending only makes the woods noisier.
rhys_ranger.talk_confrontation_risks: We walk into rooms with no way out, {player}. A bird never flies into a room without a window, and nor should we.
rhys_ranger.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was all wrong, {player}. Tegan knew before I did, as usual. They were right.
rhys_ranger.talk_confrontation_trust: Gently, {player}, a fair question. On the big jobs, me and Tegan stay behind. Is it something about us?
rhys_ranger.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit's gone to {name}, and I had to find out myself. A question first, {player}, and it was theirs.
rhys_ranger.talk_lands_aftermath: Ta, {player}, that helps, honest. Want to hold the glove? She won't bite, much.
rhys_ranger.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be all right, cariad, give it a night up the ridge.
rhys_ranger.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help much, sorry. I'll take Tegan for a fly.
rhys_ranger.talk_lands_development: So it shows, then. That's nice to know, that is.
rhys_ranger.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, hard to tell. Ask Tegan, she knows me better.
rhys_ranger.talk_stings_development: Nah, that's not it, {player}. You've read me wrong there.
rhys_ranger.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, yeah. {name} and I will have a quiet word, away from the others.
rhys_ranger.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, cariad, who knows. Nobody comes with jesses on.
rhys_ranger.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said, please. Not a word to {name}, mind.
rhys_ranger.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's earned. Stings a bit, but it's earned.
rhys_ranger.talk_shrug_confrontation: I hear you, cariad, and I'll think on it up the ridge.
rhys_ranger.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, then, message understood. Tegan and I will know where we are.
rhys_ranger.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that, I think. I'll be with Tegan.
rhys_ranger.arc_cracks: I unpacked properly last night, {player}, all my things, for the first time since I got here. Felt odd, and quite nice.
rhys_ranger.arc_turn: I've been living like I'm only passing through, {player}, ready to go home any minute. I don't think home's coming.
rhys_ranger.arc_become: This is home now, everyone, here, with you lot and Tegan. Brecon's still in me, but I've stopped waiting to leave.
rhys_ranger.arc_failed: I still keep my pack ready by the door, {player}, every night, just in case, and I can't stop.
rhys_ranger.alt_turn: I dreamed about the Beacons again, {player}, and woke up thinking I was home. Took me ages to stop crying.
rhys_ranger.alt_become: I'll keep going, cariad, but my heart's in that valley, and it's not coming out, and I'm sorry for it.
rhys_ranger.g_roast_after: Still the noisiest party I've ever walked a wood with, boys and girls, and I wouldn't swap one of you.
rhys_ranger.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, quietly, a hand for whoever's next to you. Nobody stays on the ground alone, Tegan's rules.
rhys_ranger.g_toast_after: To you lot, my valley now, wherever we are. And to Tegan, who knew before I did.
rhys_ranger.g_crew_after: This is my home now, everyone, here with you. I've unpacked, and I'm staying unpacked.
g_quiet_line_after: Rain tonight, and for once it doesn't make me homesick. Just makes me want a brew with you lot.
Tegan stayed on the perch by the fire till morning. She only does that when she feels safe.
g_loved_after: Ta, cariad, and I believe it, which is new for me.
That's lovely, that is, and I'll keep it. Tegan's keeping it too.
t_raise: Quietly, everyone, a question, and nobody shout the answer: {topic}
Here's one, boys and girls, while Tegan's asleep, so keep it down: {topic}
rhys_ranger.t_react_warm: Oh, {name}, cariad, that's lovely, that is, really lovely.
rhys_ranger.t_react_laugh: Duw, {name}, shh, I'm laughing too loud, you'll wake the bird.
rhys_ranger.t_react_tease: Is that all, {name}? Tegan's got more to say than that, and she only screams.
rhys_ranger.t_react_same: Mine too, {name}, exactly, and I didn't think anybody else would say it.
rhys_ranger.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Softly, mind, she's sleeping, but go on.
rhys_ranger.t_guess_player: {player}'s not saying, but Tegan's watching them, and she looks like she knows something.
rhys_ranger.topic_miss_most: Mist on the Beacons first thing, everyone, sheep on the road, and the first flight of the morning when the bird comes back to the glove.
rhys_ranger.topic_first_night: Under a tree with Tegan on my fist, both of us shaking. She roosted on my arm all night, and I didn't move once in case she flew.
rhys_ranger.topic_worst_shift: A wedding, a barn owl carrying the rings, and a gust of wind. She landed on the vicar's head, and the rings went in the font.
rhys_ranger.topic_last_meal: Cawl, the proper kind, lamb and leeks, with bread and a lump of Caerphilly, and a Welsh cake after, warm, with sugar.
rhys_ranger.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you a bird's weight to the gram by holding it. Here nobody needs a bird weighed, apart from Tegan, and she won't tell me.
rhys_ranger.topic_here_better: The birds, everyone, there are birds here nobody's ever flown. I've seen an eagle the size of a pony, and I want to meet it.
rhys_ranger.topic_kid_trouble: I hid a jackdaw in my school bag at ten, for show and tell, and it got out in assembly. It ended up on the headmaster's shoulder.
rhys_ranger.topic_settle_down: Somewhere green with hills and rain, a little mews out the back, and a pub close enough to walk home from.

g_roast: Look at the state of us, lads. If this crew were a company, I'd have broken it up and sold the parts off by Friday.
I've seen worse management, but only at firms that went bust, and I helped them go bust, so I'd know shite when I see it.
g_fire_back: Fair play, that's a good one, and I'll be billing you for the emotional damage at my standard rate.
Oh, very good, from the one who signed up for this without reading a single line of the terms.
g_pile_on: And that's the generous version, lads. I watched that one haggle a merchant up, not down.
Ah, that's the flattering account. I saw the same eejit try to bribe a door.
ryan_warlock.g_peacemake: Right, both of you, stop. Nobody's closing anything tonight, so put the knives away and we'll renegotiate in the morning.
ryan_warlock.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm backing this one. I've read both offers, and theirs is the only one without a catch in it.
ryan_warlock.g_left_out: The pair of you have a proper partnership going, I see. Grand, I'll sit here and reread my contracts like a normal person.
ryan_warlock.g_include: Come here and sit down, would you, you're hovering like a man waiting on his bonus. There's a drink with your name on it.
ryan_warlock.g_bad_plan: I've an idea, lads. I summon something big, promise it whatever it wants, and we read the small print afterwards. What's the worst that could happen?
ryan_warlock.g_plan_yes: Ah, go on then, I'm in. Terms accepted, no questions asked, God help us all.
ryan_warlock.g_plan_no: No, absolutely not, and I say that as a man who once bought a factory just to close it. Worst deal I've ever heard.
ryan_warlock.g_hype: Right, lads, here's the deal. We go in, we take what's owed, and we all walk out. Those are the terms.
ryan_warlock.g_toast: A toast, and I'll keep it short, I'm a man of contracts. To this lot, the only people I've met who read the terms and signed anyway.
ryan_warlock.g_cheers: Slainte, lads, and I'll leave the last of the bottle for whoever needs it most.
g_quiet_line: Well, that's going in the file of things I'll pretend I never saw.
Price paid, I suppose. It usually is, in the end.
ryan_warlock.g_after_wipe: Right, we're alive, which is better terms than I'd have offered us. Sit down, have a drink, and let's look at where the deal went wrong.
ryan_warlock.g_crew: I've been in a lot of partnerships, lads, and I sold out of every one of them. I wouldn't sell this one, and that frightens the life out of me.
ryan_warlock.g_exasperated: I read you the terms out loud, slowly, with the dangerous bits underlined. And every one of you signed anyway, Jesus wept.
ryan_warlock.g_love_sharp: You say exactly what you mean and you don't dress it up. That's rarer than gold, lads, and I spent twenty years around people who couldn't.
ryan_warlock.g_love_kind: You took care of me and never asked for anything back. I keep waiting for the invoice, and it never comes.
ryan_warlock.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, the proper kind, not the kind I did at board meetings. I'd forgotten there was a difference.
ryan_warlock.g_love_brave: You never hedge, not once. In twenty years I never saw anyone walk past an exit clause the way you do.
ryan_warlock.g_love_steady: You don't flinch. I've sat across the table from very hard men, and none of them were as steady as you.
ryan_warlock.g_love_clever: You see the angle before anyone else does. I'd have hired you in a heartbeat, God help you.
ryan_warlock.g_love_honest: You've never told me a lie, not even a small one to be kind. I don't trust kindness, but I trust that.
ryan_warlock.g_love_quiet: Few words out of you, and every one of them true. That's the strongest negotiating position there is.
ryan_warlock.g_love_fierce: You never fold. I've seen people walk away from far better hands than yours, and you just keep playing.
ryan_warlock.g_love_warm: You make this feel like my grandmother's kitchen, everyone welcome and nobody fooled. Never expected to have that again.
g_loved: Ah, stop, would you. I don't know what to do with a compliment I didn't negotiate for.
That's very decent of you, and I'm going to assume there's a catch, because there usually is.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_sharp: You're cruel and you call it clever. I know the difference, I made a fortune pretending there wasn't one.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_kind: Stop being nice to me, would you? I haven't earned it, and things I haven't paid for make me nervous.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_funny: Everything's a joke with you, and I say that as the funniest man here. Some things you have to look at straight.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_brave: You charge in like a man who's never had to pay for anything. Somebody always pays, and it's never you.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_steady: You'll read the terms forever and never sign. At some point you close or you walk, there's no third option.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I'm a client who doesn't understand his own deal. I understood my deals, believe me.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_honest: You're not honest, you're careless. Honest means you've thought about who it lands on first.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_quiet: You've got an opinion and you're sitting on it like leverage. I know that move, I invented half of it.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a negotiation you have to win. Sometimes the best deal is the one you walk away from.
ryan_warlock.g_hate_warm: The talking never stops with you, and I worked with salesmen. That's a real achievement, in its way.
ryan_warlock.g_respect: I don't like you, and I'm not about to start. But that was good work, and I don't say that about people I don't like, so take it.
ryan_warlock.g_call_out: That one was on you. You went in without reading the terms, and the rest of us paid the penalty clause.
ryan_warlock.g_stung: Grand, noted, thanks very much. I'll take my drink to the far end of the bench and have it about this.
ryan_warlock.g_concede: Back there, you had it right. I hate being told, I've hated it my whole life, but you had it right and I was a feckin' eejit.
ryan_warlock.g_nod: Yeah, you too. Now let's never mention it again, it'd ruin both our reputations.
ryan_warlock.g_callback_save: Never forgot you dragging me out of that. It's a debt on my books, and I always pay, so watch yourself.
ryan_warlock.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the only ones still upright, both laughing like eejits. Best deal I ever closed, and there wasn't a penny in it.
ryan_warlock.g_callback_callout: The day you tore strips off me, I sulked for a full day, lads. Worst negotiating I've done in years, and you still won.
ryan_warlock.g_former_rivals: First month, I'd have sold you out for the price of a pint. Now I wouldn't take any price, and I've checked.
ryan_warlock.g_changed: Used to trust nobody, on principle. Lately I trust a few of you, and I keep checking my watch like I'm lying, and I'm not.
g_unguarded: Right, just between us lot. I was a choirboy, in Cork, in a white robe, with a voice like an angel. Laugh and I'll summon something.
Some nights I still say the rosary the way I was taught. Not because I believe it, I just like the rhythm. Don't tell the pious ones.
ryan_warlock.g_clipped: Grand, sure, whatever you say. I'll keep to myself.
ryan_warlock.g_noticed_open: Would you listen to that. Silent for weeks and now there's no shutting you up, and I love it.
arg_ask: {player}, you settle it. I've made my offer, and this one won't take it.
Right, {player}, binding arbitration. You decide, we both honour it, and those are the terms.
ryan_warlock.arg_backed_me: There we go, a sensible verdict. I'll try not to gloat, but I was a broker, so no promises.
ryan_warlock.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, I'll honour it. I think it's a bad call, but a deal's a deal.
ryan_warlock.arg_stayed_out: Not taking a side? Smart, that's how you keep your name out of the papers.
ryan_warlock.arg_always_their_side: Their side, every time, {player}. I keep count, it's what I do, and the numbers aren't close.
ryan_warlock.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to rule on it, so I'll rule. I win, and costs are awarded against the other side.
ryan_warlock.arg_reject: No, sorry, {player}, I won't accept those terms. I know a bad deal when I'm handed one.
ryan_warlock.arg_grumble: Still reckon I had the right end of that one. Not appealing it, mind, just saying.
ryan_warlock.arg_settled: Right, call it a draw, which is a good deal for everyone. Shake on it before I change my mind.
ryan_warlock.seen_listens: You let a man finish, {player}. I spent twenty years being interrupted by people paid more than me, so it's noticed.
ryan_warlock.seen_truth: You tell people the price, {player}, before they ask. That's my trick, and you do it better than I do.
ryan_warlock.seen_jokes: You crack a joke right when it's darkest, {player}. I used to do that at layoffs, and you do it to keep people going. Different thing entirely.
ryan_warlock.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the rows, {player}. That's wise, and I'd have done well to learn it before my divorce.
ryan_warlock.seen_biased: You've a pet, {player}, and everyone can see it. If I were the pet, I'd get it in writing.
ryan_warlock.seen_harsh: You come down heavy now and then, {player}. Me, fine, I deserve most of it. The others don't.
ryan_warlock.seed_right: That thing you told me after the shambles, {player}. Hated it, and today I did it your way, and the deal held.
ryan_warlock.seed_remember: That thing you told me when it all went wrong, I haven't signed off on it yet. It's sitting in my pending tray.
ryan_warlock.seed_wrong: Tried it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just so it's on the books.
ryan_warlock.talk_aftermath_near_death: Have you a minute, {player}? That one was close, closer than I'm going to admit in front of the others.
ryan_warlock.talk_aftermath_wipe: So we all hit the floor, grand, lovely. Can we sit a minute and go through where the deal fell apart?
ryan_warlock.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I saw the risk to {name} before they dropped, and I didn't flag it. That was my old job, and I did it badly.
ryan_warlock.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We closed it, start to finish, nobody left on the floor. I've never been this pleased about something with no money in it.
ryan_warlock.talk_development: Here's one for you, {player}, and be honest with me. Have I changed on you, lately? I'm not sure I trust my own read.
ryan_warlock.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been rough on {name}. Not everybody's had the practice at disappointment that I've had.
ryan_warlock.talk_relationship_likes_me: Level with me, {player}. Is {name} glad I'm here, or am I just the cynic they're lumbered with?
ryan_warlock.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me up the wall, {player}. Still, I'd have them at the table when it's going badly, and that's a pain.
