ryan_warlock.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s gone quiet on me, {player}, and I've seen that quiet before, usually on a Friday afternoon.
ryan_warlock.talk_confrontation_favour: Let's talk terms, {player}. Every decent bit of kit goes to {name}, trip after trip. I keep accounts, and the accounts are lopsided.
ryan_warlock.talk_confrontation_dislike: Better you hear it from me than from the gossip. {name} and I are a bad match, and I'm through acting like we're not.
ryan_warlock.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep taking deals the numbers say to walk away from, {player}. I've watched that end badly on spreadsheets and in person.
ryan_warlock.talk_confrontation_wrong: This one's about {name}. They were right, I was wrong, and I'm saying so to you because I've only recently learned how.
ryan_warlock.talk_confrontation_trust: Would you trust me with the real thing, {player}? Every time it counts, I'm on the bench. Fair enough, I wouldn't trust me either, but I'm asking.
ryan_warlock.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my gear to {name} and never asked me. I'd have signed it over gladly. In my old job, not asking was the whole problem.
ryan_warlock.talk_lands_aftermath: Yeah, okay, thanks. That's worth more than I'd have paid for it.
ryan_warlock.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, I'll be grand. I always am, in the end.
ryan_warlock.talk_stings_aftermath: Right, not what I needed, but fine. I'll go and have a drink about it.
ryan_warlock.talk_lands_development: You've noticed as well, then. Good, I was starting to think I was lying to myself again.
ryan_warlock.talk_shrug_development: Could be, could be. I'll watch it like a bad investment.
ryan_warlock.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it. You've read it wrong, and I'm not in the humour to explain.
ryan_warlock.talk_lands_relationship: Fair point, fair point. I'll sort it with {name}, straight, no angles.
ryan_warlock.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, sure. People make worse reading than contracts, and I've read some terrible contracts.
ryan_warlock.talk_stings_relationship: Ah, scratch that, would you? And keep it from {name}.
ryan_warlock.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair terms, {player}. Bit sore yet, but I'll live with them.
ryan_warlock.talk_shrug_confrontation: Noted, and filed. I'll think it over, probably with a whiskey.
ryan_warlock.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, so that's where we stand, {player}. Good to know the terms.
ryan_warlock.talk_door_closed: No, we're done with this one. I'll be over reading my contracts if you want me.
ryan_warlock.arc_cracks: Caught myself standing in front of one of you back there. No contract, no clause, nothing in it for me, and it's very unsettling.
ryan_warlock.arc_turn: This is what scares me, lads. I'd break a deal for any of you. Me, who's never broken one. I'd tear it up and eat the penalty.
ryan_warlock.arc_become: Anybody comes for this lot, they deal with me first, and they won't like my terms. That's not a contract, that's just how it is now.
ryan_warlock.arc_failed: Ah, it was never going to stick. I'm a broker, lads, and brokers protect the deal, not the people. I forgot that for a while.
ryan_warlock.alt_turn: The demons are easier company than people, and the whiskey's easier than both. I know exactly what that sentence means, and I'm saying it anyway.
ryan_warlock.alt_become: I keep the contracts clean and the glass full. It's not living, but it's honest, and honest is all I ever promised.
g_roast_after: Look at the state of you all. Worst investment I ever made, and I'd put everything I have into it again tomorrow.
You lot are a disaster, and anybody else who says so answers to me.
ryan_warlock.g_after_wipe_after: Right, we went down. Nobody's blaming anybody, and anyone who tries can take it up with me. Sit, drink, and we go again.
ryan_warlock.g_toast_after: To this lot. I'd break any contract I've ever signed for you, and I've never broken one. Work out what that means yourselves.
ryan_warlock.g_crew_after: You're not a partnership, you're mine. There's no exit clause, and I didn't write one in.
g_quiet_line_after: Didn't check my watch once today. Make of that what you will.
Price paid, and worth it, for once in my life.
g_loved_after: Thanks for that. No catch, I know, I checked, and I'll take it.
Ah, that's decent of you. I'm keeping it, and I'm not paying for it.
t_raise: Right, lads, question, and the small print says everybody answers: {topic}
Here's a deal for you, lads, one question, no exit clause: {topic}
ryan_warlock.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's a good one, that's genuinely decent. Don't tell anyone I said so.
ryan_warlock.t_react_laugh: Jesus, {name}, that's gas, that's absolutely gas. Say it again so I can steal it.
ryan_warlock.t_react_tease: That's the answer, {name}? I've read more exciting terms and conditions, and I've read a lot.
ryan_warlock.t_react_same: Same here, {name}, word for word. Either we're both great or we're both in trouble.
ryan_warlock.t_ask_player: And yourself, {player}? Your turn, and I'll know if you're lying, it's a gift.
ryan_warlock.t_guess_player: Look at {player} there, keeping the cards close. Smart, I'd have hired you.
ryan_warlock.topic_miss_most: A pint in a proper pub in Cork on a wet Thursday, lads, nobody wanting anything from you, the fire going, a fella singing badly in the corner.
ryan_warlock.topic_first_night: In a field in a three thousand dollar suit, ruined, with a contract still in my pocket. I read it twice for something to do. Still a bad deal.
ryan_warlock.topic_worst_shift: Closing a buyout at four in the morning that shut a factory of three hundred people. Champagne on the table, and I couldn't drink it.
ryan_warlock.topic_last_meal: A breakfast roll from a petrol station on the way home from a night out, sausages, rashers, the works. Don't judge me.
ryan_warlock.topic_useless_skill: I can read a contract upside down from across a table. Here nobody signs anything, they just stab you, which is refreshing.
ryan_warlock.topic_here_better: People here say what they want, lads, straight out, no lawyers. It's terrifying and I love it.
ryan_warlock.topic_kid_trouble: I ran a betting book at school at eleven, odds on the teachers, and made forty quid before the nuns found it.
ryan_warlock.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with rain and a pub and no money in it at all. A little place by the sea, if it'll have me.

g_roast: Chicos, look at this table. Not one of you could grill a steak without setting your own sleeve on fire.
If this party was a meal, che, it would be cold chips and somebody crying in the kitchen.
g_fire_back: Che, I've fed you every night this week, and this is how you talk to the cook? Shameful, che, truly shameful.
Say that again with your mouth empty, boludo, and then we'll see who's laughing.
g_pile_on: And he eats his meat well done, chicos, like a criminal, I've seen it with my own eyes.
Dale, tell them about the bridge, che, the whole table deserves to hear about the bridge.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_peacemake: Enough, enough, nobody fights on an empty stomach at my fire. Sit, both of you, eat, and then you can argue properly.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_take_side: No, che, he's right, and I'm saying it with a full plate in my hand so you know I mean it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_left_out: The two of you, laughing at something, and nobody passes me the joke. Fine, I'll just stand here with the bread.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_include: Come, come, there's a place by the fire with your name on it, and I already put food on the plate.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_bad_plan: Listen, chicos, we roast the whole boar right here, now, and the smell brings the bandits to us. Then dinner and the fight together.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_plan_yes: Dale, dale, I'm in, and I'm bringing the salt, because whatever happens next we're going to be hungry after.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_plan_no: No, che, and I'm the man who wants to cook everything. Even my grandmother would put down her tongs for that one.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hype: Vamos, chicos, vamos! In there, out again, and tonight I'm making the asado of your lives, so nobody dies, okay?
sebastian_bloodmage.g_toast: Everybody, glasses up! To the table, to whoever's hungry, and to nobody ever eating alone while I'm alive.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_cheers: Salud, salud, and somebody finish that plate, I didn't cook it to look at it.
g_quiet_line: Mmm, that's the smell of a good fire, che, everything else can wait a minute.
My grandmother would have had something to say about all of this, and none of it polite.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_after_wipe: La puta madre, chicos, that was a bad one. Up, up, everybody gets fed before anybody talks about it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_crew: You lot are my Sunday table now, che. Twenty chairs in my head, and you're sitting in the best three.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_exasperated: Mierda, chicos, I'm the one who's supposed to be loud and stupid around here! Leave me something!
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_sharp: You say what the whole table's thinking, che, like a good knife through fat. Clean, no waste.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_kind: You look after people the way my grandmother did, quietly, with a plate in your hand before anyone asks.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I burn the meat, and nobody makes me burn the meat, che. That's a compliment.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_brave: You go in first like a man who's never heard of fear, che. I'll always keep the best cut back for you.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_steady: You're the fire that doesn't go out, che, the coals at the bottom that cook everything else.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_clever: You understand things, che, really understand them. Like knowing a steak by its smell, but with everything.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_honest: You never lie to me, and you never lie about the food either. Do you know how rare that is, boludo?
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_quiet: You're quiet like a good wine, che. You don't need to shout, people lean in to taste it anyway.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_fierce: You fight for everything like it's the derby final, che, and I respect that more than I can say.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_warm: You make any place feel like a full table, che, and that's the best thing a person can do.
g_loved: Basta, stop, you'll make me cry into the chimichurri and then it's too salty.
Ay, che, come here, eat something, that's how I say thank you and you know it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_sharp: Every word out of your mouth has a bone in it, che. Can you say one nice thing with your food just once?
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_kind: You fuss over everybody like a tablecloth nobody asked for, che. Let people be hungry for one minute.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_funny: Not now, che, not every second of the day. Some things you let rest, like meat off the grill.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_brave: You run in like a dog at a barbecue, boludo, and then I'm the one patching the holes.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_steady: Every decision takes you an hour, che. A whole cow could cook while you're deciding where to stand.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_clever: You talk about the food instead of eating it, che, and that's the most insulting thing a person can do.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_honest: You always have to say the true thing, even with your mouth full of my food. Swallow first, then be honest.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_quiet: Not one word out of you at the fire, che. Twenty people round my table, and not one of them was ever that quiet.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_fierce: It's always a competition with you, che, even the eating. The food isn't a race, it's a gift.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_warm: You never stop talking, che, and nobody can taste anything with that much noise in the air.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_respect: I can't stand you, che, everybody knows it. But what you did back there was good work, and good work gets fed.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_call_out: Che, that one was your fault. You ran in before anybody was ready and I nearly lost you, so sit and listen.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_stung: Okay, perfect, thank you, I'll go and cut onions now so nobody sees my face.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_concede: You were right, che, about back there. I've been thinking about it over the fire. Here, I saved you the good bit.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_nod: Don't make it a whole speech, che. You weren't so bad either, for a man who eats like a pigeon.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_callback_save: Remember when you dragged me out of that cellar, che? Every plate I give you is still paying that off.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_callback_clutch: You and me, che, last two standing and bleeding on the floor, and you said you were hungry. I'll never forget it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_callback_callout: Last time you shouted at me I cut so many onions the whole camp was crying, che. Worth it, though.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to serve you nothing but bread crusts, che. And now look at us, eating from the same plate.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_changed: Somebody handed me a plate tonight, chicos, and I took it, and I sat down, me, the cook! That's never happened in my life.
g_unguarded: The truth, chicos? My grandmother's recipe card is in my wallet, and some nights I just read it like a letter.
I lay the table for twenty in my head every Sunday, che, and I count the chairs, and then I cook for whoever's here.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_clipped: Food's ready when it's ready, che. Eat or don't, I'm going to see to the fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_noticed_open: Look at that, che, a whole speech! Somebody give him more wine, I want to hear the rest.
arg_ask: {player}, you tell him, you're the one with taste here, and then he eats his words with salt.
Che, {player}, come here, settle this before I have to throw a chorizo at him.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_backed_me: You hear that, che? The boss has spoken, and tonight you're washing every pan we own.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_backed_them: Fine, fine, take his side, che. You'll still get dinner, I'm not a monster, just a smaller plate.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_stayed_out: Coward, {player}, a coward with a full belly from my own fire, che.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_always_their_side: Every time it's him, che, every single time. I'm starting to think he's feeding you behind my back.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_wallflower: The boss is too busy looking at the clouds, chicos, so I'm deciding, and I decide I win. Now everybody eat.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_reject: No, che, with respect, no. You can be the boss of the road, but not the boss of the grill.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_grumble: Still thinking about that argument, che. I was right, by the way, I'm only mentioning it over dinner.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_settled: Ay, okay, okay, we're both a little bit right, che. Shake my hand and then come and eat.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_listens: You let people talk, {player}, all the way to the end, like a good meal you don't rush.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_truth: No sauce with you, {player}, just the meat, like my grandmother served it.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_jokes: When it goes bad you always crack a joke, boss, and I've started waiting for it like the bell for dinner.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_stays_out: You stay out of everybody's fights, eh, boss? Smart, che, you'll live longer and eat better.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_biased: You've got a favourite at this table, {player}, everybody can see it. Even the dog can see it.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_harsh: You're hard on people sometimes, boss. Some of us are still raw in the middle, you know.
sebastian_bloodmage.seed_right: Boss, what you said to me when the whole table hit the floor. I was angry for days, and today it stopped me running in. So, thank you.
sebastian_bloodmage.seed_remember: What you told me after that mess, boss, I'm still chewing on it. Like a tough cut, it takes a while.
sebastian_bloodmage.seed_wrong: I tried what you said, che, I did it your way, and it went worse. Just so you know, no hard feelings.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_near_death: Boss, sit with me a minute? I almost didn't get up back there, and I keep thinking about who would cook.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, che, the whole table at once. I'm fine, I'm fine, I just don't want to be alone with the fire yet.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Boss, {name} was the first on the floor, and me standing right there with blood on my hands doing nothing useful. Carajo, che, carajo.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, boss, a whole dungeon, start to finish! I'm cooking for a week, che, nobody stop me.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_development: Boss, can I tell you something strange? I sat down to eat yesterday, actually sat, and the world didn't end.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been hard on {name}, che. He's a different dish, that's all, and I kept tasting him for the wrong spices.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me the truth, boss, is it me {name} likes, or just my cooking?
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I can't stand {name}, boss, he's like a raw onion in a sweet dish. But he's good, and that's the worst part.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's wrong with {name}, boss. He's not eating, che, and a man who stops eating is a man with a problem.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_favour: Boss, we need to talk. The best cuts keep landing on {name}'s plate, and I'm not blind, che, I can count plates.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll tell you straight, because you'd smell it anyway. I don't like {name}, and I'm done pretending at the fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_risks: Boss, we keep dying, che, over and over. I like a hot grill, but this is the whole kitchen on fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name} and what he said to me. He was right, che, and I was wrong, and it's sitting in me like bad meat.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, boss? Because every time it matters, I'm the one left at the inn cooking for nobody.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and handed it to {name} without a word, che. I'd have given it! I give everything! You just had to ask.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, boss, that helps. Now let me feed you, because that's how I say it back.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, sure, I'll be fine, che. I always am, after a plate and a fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_aftermath: Okay, boss, that's not what a man wants to hear with his hands still shaking. I'm going to cut onions.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_development: You see it too, boss? Then it's real, che, and I'm going to sit down more, I promise, maybe.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe, we'll see, che. Old habits are like old grills, they hold the heat.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_development: No, boss, that's not it at all. Forget I said anything, the meat's burning.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, I'll go and talk to {name}, with a plate in my hand, the proper way. Thank you, che.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_relationship: We'll see, che. People take longer than a slow roast, and that's saying something.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, boss. Don't tell {name} I said anything, okay? Not a word.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, che. I'm still a bit angry, but it's the kind that cooks off by dinner.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_confrontation: Fine, I heard you, boss. I'll think about it while I'm stirring.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_confrontation: That's how you want it, boss? Then now I know where I sit at this table.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_door_closed: No, che, we're done talking about this. Dinner's at sunset, come or don't.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_cracks: Chicos, I'm fine, I just haven't slept since the Barrens, that's all. Who wants seconds? Everybody wants seconds.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_turn: My grandmother never sat down either, che. Thirty years at the grill, and she died on her feet, and I'm doing exactly the same thing.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_become: Tonight somebody else cooks, chicos, and I sit, and I eat, and I don't get up once. Watch me do it, chicos, I'm learning slowly.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_failed: Back on my feet, chicos, where I belong. Somebody has to cook, and it's always going to be me, so that's that.
sebastian_bloodmage.alt_turn: Twenty people at my table every Sunday, che, and I've looked at every list in every town, and not one of them is on it.
sebastian_bloodmage.alt_become: I still cook for twenty in my head, chicos. But I've stopped waiting for the door to open, and it hurts less like that.
g_roast_after: Look at this table, chicos, every one of you a disaster, and every one of you fed. My grandmother would be proud.
You're a terrible crew, che, the worst, and I'm sitting down with you anyway. That's how much I love you.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_after_wipe_after: Everybody sit, che, even me, especially me. We eat first, then we fix it, together this time.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_toast_after: To my grandmother, chicos, who never sat down. I'm sitting down for her tonight.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_crew_after: You're my Sunday table now, che, and this time I've got a chair at it too.
g_quiet_line_after: Mmm, somebody else cooked this, and it's not bad, che, not bad at all.
My feet don't hurt tonight, chicos, and I'm not used to it yet.
g_loved_after: Gracias, che, really, I'm not even going to feed you for it this time.
I'll keep that one, che, next to my grandmother's card.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_admire: Che, look at {name} carrying that like it's nothing, arms like a side of beef. My grandmother would have married him on the spot.
t_raise: Chicos, sit, eat, and answer me this while you chew: {topic}
Everybody, the meat needs ten more minutes, so we talk. Here's one: {topic}
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, that one's good, the kind you say slowly with a glass of wine.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_laugh: Che, {name}, I nearly choked on my chorizo, say it again, louder.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_tease: That's a sad little answer, {name}, like a steak cooked well done. I expected more from you.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_same: Same as me, {name}, the very same, so now we share the answer like we share the grill.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_ask_player: Now you, {player}, you're at my table, so you answer. Those are the rules of the house.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, pretending to be busy with the plate. You can't hide behind food at my grill, that's my trick.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_miss_most: The Sunday smoke over Palermo, chicos, every grill on the street going at once, the whole barrio smelling like a party.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_first_night: I slept next to a fire I made with wet wood, and I cooked a rabbit I didn't know how to skin. Terrible rabbit, very proud of it.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_worst_shift: A wedding for three hundred, and the charcoal delivery went to the wrong address. I lit the grill with furniture, la puta madre.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_last_meal: An asado that starts at noon and ends when the stars are out, everybody arguing about football and nobody wanting to go home.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_useless_skill: I can tell a steak is ready by tapping it with one finger. Here half the animals would bite the finger off first.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_here_better: The meat, chicos, I'm sorry, but these boars are something else. I'd have had a queue round the block in Buenos Aires.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_kid_trouble: I stole a whole ribeye from the restaurant fridge at nine to cook it myself on the roof. Burnt the meat and half the roof, carajo.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_settle_down: A big table outside an inn, a grill as long as a horse, and everybody I like within walking distance of the smell.

g_roast: Ladies and gents, if this party were cargo, I'd stamp it fragile, mislabelled, and probably smuggling something.
Years of night shifts on the Antwerp docks, and I never saw a crew walk into a trap this cheerfully.
g_fire_back: Amai, that's a good one, and from you of all people, the one who left the back door open last night.
Careful, I've got you figured out about sixty percent, and the forty percent is where I keep the embarrassing stuff.
g_pile_on: And that's the official version, ladies and gents. The unofficial one involves a goat and a very confused merchant.
Oh, it's worse, I've been keeping a manifest. That makes four doors tried today, and every one said push.
silas_rogue.g_peacemake: Easy, easy, both of you, every exit in this room is getting nervous. Put it down, have a drink, and argue tomorrow when it's cheaper.
silas_rogue.g_take_side: Sorry, I'm with this one, and I don't pick sides, ever. That tells you how wrong you are.
silas_rogue.g_left_out: You two have your own private channel going, don't you? Fine, I'll go read the room, it's more my speed anyway.
silas_rogue.g_include: Come here, sit with us, you've been loitering near that door like you're casing it. I'd know, I've cased that door.
silas_rogue.g_bad_plan: Right, hear me out. I walk in pretending to be a tax inspector, everyone panics, and you lot rob them while they're hiding receipts.
silas_rogue.g_plan_yes: Allez, I'm in. No coin flip, even, that's how good it is.
silas_rogue.g_plan_no: No, I flipped for that one, and the coin landed on its edge. That's the coin begging us not to.
silas_rogue.g_hype: Allez, ladies and gents, eyes on the exits and the doors, pockets closed, and let's get moving.
silas_rogue.g_toast: A toast, and don't get used to me being sincere. To this lot, the only cargo I've ever wanted to keep.
silas_rogue.g_cheers: Proost, everybody, and somebody count the cups, I swear we had one more.
g_quiet_line: Three exits in this room, by the way. I counted, it's a habit.
That merchant was lying about the weight, by the way. I'll say no more.
silas_rogue.g_after_wipe: Okay, nobody move too fast, count your fingers, check your pockets. We're all still here, which is better odds than I'd have given.
silas_rogue.g_crew: I've never stayed anywhere longer than a contract, ladies and gents. I keep finding reasons to stay with you, and that's new.
silas_rogue.g_exasperated: I clocked the ambush, I pointed at the ambush, I said the word ambush. And you all strolled into it like it was a market.
silas_rogue.g_love_sharp: You read people like I do, fast and without the nonsense. It's nice not to be the only one in the room who notices.
silas_rogue.g_love_kind: You looked out for somebody who never asked, and you didn't need anybody to see you do it. I saw, though.
silas_rogue.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I'm hard to crack, ask anybody on the Antwerp docks. Well, don't, they'll lie.
silas_rogue.g_love_brave: You go straight at it, no angles, no backup plan. I'd never manage it, and I'm a little in awe.
silas_rogue.g_love_steady: You don't wobble. Everybody I grew up around wobbled, and you just stand there like a crane in a storm.
silas_rogue.g_love_clever: You see what's in the crate before anybody opens it. That's my whole trade, and you do it for free.
silas_rogue.g_love_honest: You've never once sold me a story. In my line, that makes you about the rarest cargo on any dock.
silas_rogue.g_love_quiet: You say about nine words a day, and every one of them checks out. I've audited them, I'd know.
silas_rogue.g_love_fierce: You don't let go of anything, do you? I've spent my whole life letting go, and watching you is educational.
silas_rogue.g_love_warm: You make this feel like the port bar on a good night, everybody in, nobody fighting. I didn't know I missed that.
g_loved: Ah, careful, you'll ruin my reputation, and it took me years of hard work to be this unreliable.
That's very kind, and I'm going to pretend you said it about somebody else, it's easier.
silas_rogue.g_hate_sharp: You go for the soft spot every time, and you enjoy it. I've watched dockside bullies with better manners.
silas_rogue.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to look after me, and it makes my skin itch. I'm not a stray, I'm a professional loiterer.
silas_rogue.g_hate_funny: Not everything's a bit, and I'm the one who usually does the bits. Some things you just stop and look at.
silas_rogue.g_hate_brave: You charge at everything without checking the manifest. One day the crate's going to be full of something with teeth.
silas_rogue.g_hate_steady: You think it over and over until the moment's gone. Sometimes you just flip the coin and go, mate.
silas_rogue.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I'm a mark. I'm not a mark, I'm the one who notices marks.
silas_rogue.g_hate_honest: Every true thing goes straight out of your mouth, even when somebody's standing right there. That's not honest, that's careless with cargo.
silas_rogue.g_hate_quiet: You sit there saying nothing and watching everybody. That's my job, and I'm very good at it, and I hate being watched.
silas_rogue.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, even who gets the last of the frites. There weren't even any frites.
silas_rogue.g_hate_warm: You talk without stopping for breath, and I can't read a room with all that noise in it. Give me five quiet minutes.
silas_rogue.g_respect: I don't like you, and I flipped the coin twice to check. But that was clean work back there, and I'm not blind.
silas_rogue.g_call_out: That was on you, and you know it. I said there was somebody behind that door, and you opened it anyway, godverdomme.
silas_rogue.g_stung: Fair, fine, noted. I'll be out by the back door, reading a wall.
silas_rogue.g_concede: You had it right, back there. I flipped the coin on whether to admit it, and it landed on you, so there it is.
silas_rogue.g_nod: Ha, you too, you too. Let's never mention it, I've got a reputation for not caring.
silas_rogue.g_callback_save: Still owe you for dragging me out of that one. It's in my ledger, and my ledger's the only honest thing I own.
silas_rogue.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two up, both of us laughing like idiots. I've told that one six ways, and the true one's best.
silas_rogue.g_callback_callout: When you told me off that time, I sulked by the docks for a day. Turns out you were right, which is very annoying.
silas_rogue.g_former_rivals: First month, I had you stamped as trouble and marked for the next boat out. Now I'd stay on the dock for you.
silas_rogue.g_changed: I used to flip the coin on everything. Lately I keep putting it back in my pocket without looking, and it's a strange feeling.
g_unguarded: Fine, nobody else is listening. My father taught me to swear in four languages before I could count, and the Portuguese is the filthiest.
I've kept this coin since the day I landed, and I've flipped it on every choice. Don't tell anybody, but it's always tails. I bent it.
silas_rogue.g_clipped: Sure, sure, whatever you say. I'll just watch the door.
silas_rogue.g_noticed_open: Amai, listen to that, a full sentence and then another one. Keep going, I've got nowhere to be.
arg_ask: {player}, you call it. I'd flip the coin, but I've a feeling you'd glare at me.
Okay, {player}, be the judge. I've made my case, and this one isn't buying.
silas_rogue.arg_backed_me: Ha, see that? The boss knows good cargo when they see it.
silas_rogue.arg_backed_them: Fair, your call, I'll live with it. Still think it's mislabelled.
silas_rogue.arg_stayed_out: Not taking a side, eh? Smart, that's how I lived for thirty years.
silas_rogue.arg_always_their_side: It always goes their way, {player}. I keep a ledger, and the ledger doesn't lie.
silas_rogue.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to rule on it, so I flipped the coin. Coin says me, so that's settled.
silas_rogue.arg_reject: No, sorry, {player}, not that one. I've seen what's in the crate, and you haven't.
silas_rogue.arg_grumble: Still think the coin was on my side there, and that opinion's worth about two euros.
silas_rogue.arg_settled: Call it even, then, half and half. Shake on it before I find a way to cheat.
silas_rogue.seen_listens: You let a person get to the true version eventually, {player}. Most people give up after the second lie.
silas_rogue.seen_truth: You say what's actually in the crate, {player}, every time. I keep waiting for the angle, and there isn't one.
silas_rogue.seen_jokes: The minute it goes sideways you've got a joke, {player}. I do that to hide, and you do it to hold people together.
silas_rogue.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the fights, {player}. That's my move, and you're better at it than me.
silas_rogue.seen_biased: One of them gets the good stuff every time, {player}. I notice cargo moving, it's literally my old job.
silas_rogue.seen_harsh: You're rough on people now and then, {player}. Me, I'm used to it, but not everybody here grew up on a dock.
silas_rogue.seed_right: What you told me after that shambles, {player}. I hated it, and today I didn't flip the coin, and it worked.
silas_rogue.seed_remember: Still turning over the thing you told me when it all went sideways. Coin's still in the air on that one.
silas_rogue.seed_wrong: Tried it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just logging it, no hard feelings.
silas_rogue.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I borrow you a second, {player}? That one was close, and I'm doing my calm face, but it's only a face.
silas_rogue.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, everyone hit the floor. Can we go through it slowly? I need to know where I stopped watching.
silas_rogue.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I watched {name} go down, {player}. I saw it coming a whole second early and I just watched, like the old days.
silas_rogue.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, front door to back door, everyone out! No joke from me this time, look at that.
silas_rogue.talk_development: Strange question, {player}, don't laugh. Am I acting different? I keep catching myself not leaving.
silas_rogue.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been needling {name}, I think. It's a habit, I test people, and maybe they didn't deserve it.
silas_rogue.talk_relationship_likes_me: Read {name} for me, {player}, would you? Are they glad I'm here, or am I just tolerated cargo?
silas_rogue.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} gets right under my skin, {player}. But if it went bad, I'd want them guarding my exit, and that's irritating.
silas_rogue.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s weight is off, {player}. Like a crate that's lighter than the label says, and I don't like it.
silas_rogue.talk_confrontation_favour: Let's talk cargo, {player}. Every good piece of kit ends up with {name}. I've been watching it move for weeks.
silas_rogue.talk_confrontation_dislike: You'll hear it eventually, so here it is from me. {name} and I don't mix, and I'm done smiling through it.
silas_rogue.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep strolling into rooms with one exit, {player}. I count exits for a reason, and I'm running out of them.
silas_rogue.talk_confrontation_wrong: This is about {name}. Their read was right and mine was off, and I'm saying it before I talk my way out of it.
silas_rogue.talk_confrontation_trust: Be straight with me, {player}. When it matters, I'm the one minding the bags. Is that the job, or is that what you think of me?
silas_rogue.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit got shipped to {name} and I never saw the paperwork. I'd probably have said yes, sixty percent. Asking's the point.
silas_rogue.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, yeah, that helps. Don't tell anybody I said so.
silas_rogue.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, I always land on my feet, more or less.
silas_rogue.talk_stings_aftermath: Huh, okay, not what I needed. I'll go count some exits.
silas_rogue.talk_lands_development: You've noticed too, then. Good, now it's not just in my head.
silas_rogue.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Coin's still in the air on that one.
silas_rogue.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it. You've read the label wrong on this one.
silas_rogue.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, I'll go and square it with {name}. No angles, I promise, mostly.
silas_rogue.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, could be. People are cargo you never get to open, that's the problem.
silas_rogue.talk_stings_relationship: Scratch that, I never said it. And keep it off {name}'s manifest, okay?
silas_rogue.talk_lands_confrontation: Alright, that's fair. Bit bruised, but I bounce.
silas_rogue.talk_shrug_confrontation: Heard you, {player}. I'll chew it over by the docks.
silas_rogue.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the real manifest, then. Good to know, {player}.
silas_rogue.talk_door_closed: That's this one finished, sorry. I'll be by the back door, as usual.
silas_rogue.arc_cracks: Caught myself unpacking my bag at the inn last night. All of it, ladies and gents. I never unpack.
silas_rogue.arc_turn: Every place I've ever been, I had one foot out the door. Here, I keep forgetting where the door is, and it terrifies me.
silas_rogue.arc_become: I'm staying, ladies and gents. With you lot, wherever you go. I didn't even flip the coin, I just decided.
silas_rogue.arc_failed: Ah, well, it was a nice berth while it lasted. I'll keep the bag packed by the door, just like always.
silas_rogue.alt_turn: I kept quiet once, about something bad, for a very long time. Today I opened my mouth instead, and that's new for me.
silas_rogue.alt_become: I don't stand back and look anymore, I step in, every single time. Whatever it costs, I'm not the man who kept quiet.
g_roast_after: Look at the state of this lot, fragile, mislabelled, and the only cargo I'd fight to keep on the dock.
Worst crew on any pier, ladies and gents, and I'm signing on for life.
silas_rogue.g_after_wipe_after: Right, we hit the floor, and I'm not making a joke of it this time. Everybody up, together, we're not leaving anyone behind.
silas_rogue.g_toast_after: To the first people I ever stopped watching the door around. You've no idea what that's worth.
silas_rogue.g_crew_after: This is my berth now. You lot, here. No coin, no exit, I've thrown both away.
g_quiet_line_after: Didn't check the exits once tonight. Make of that what you will.
Left the coin in my bag all day. Didn't miss it, not even a little.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really. No joke, I'm just going to keep that one.
Ah, that's kind of you. I believe you, which is a first for me.
t_raise: Ladies and gents, a question, and I'll know if you lie: {topic}
A little game for the fire, ladies and gents, everyone plays: {topic}
silas_rogue.t_react_warm: That's a nice one, {name}. Honest weight, no false bottom.
silas_rogue.t_react_laugh: Well played, {name}. I didn't see that coming, and I see most things coming.
silas_rogue.t_react_tease: That's a cover story, {name}, and not a good one. I've seen better lies on a customs form.
silas_rogue.t_react_same: Mine's identical, {name}, which is either a coincidence or you've been reading my manifest.
silas_rogue.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Heads you tell the truth, tails you tell us anyway.
silas_rogue.t_guess_player: {player}'s doing the thing where they look interested and say nothing. I respect it, I invented it.
silas_rogue.topic_miss_most: The port of Antwerp at night, ladies and gents, the cranes lit up like birthday cakes, ten thousand containers and every one of them a secret.
silas_rogue.topic_first_night: In a crate on a dock, of all places. Felt right at home, and it was still the worst night's sleep of my life.
silas_rogue.topic_worst_shift: Let's say I once spent twelve hours keeping an eye on a box that turned out to be full of rubber ducks. Thousands of them. I still don't know why.
silas_rogue.topic_last_meal: Frites from a stand near the Grote Markt, in a paper cone, with too much mayonnaise and a cold beer.
silas_rogue.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you what's in a box by how the man carrying it walks. Here everybody walks like they're carrying a dead goblin.
silas_rogue.topic_here_better: Nobody here has heard of me, ladies and gents. For a man like me, ladies and gents, that's the whole prize.
silas_rogue.topic_kid_trouble: I sold the neighbours their own garden gnomes back, at nine, and only got caught on the fourth gnome.
silas_rogue.topic_settle_down: Near a port, with a window that sees every road in and out. And a back door, obviously.

g_roast: I have taught teenagers to sail in a gale, and they were a better crew than this one, and quieter.
If we were a boat, everyone, I think we would be the kind they write a short sad song about.
g_fire_back: I make the fire every morning before any of you are awake. Please remember that before you speak.
That is very funny, and I will laugh at it later, perhaps, when I am alone and it is dark.
g_pile_on: It is true, I was there. He tied a knot that undid itself while we were looking at it.
In fairness to him, it was a very confident mistake, and confidence counts for something.
sondre_stormbringer.g_peacemake: Please, both of you, stop for one moment. Shouting into the wind never once changed where the wind was going.
sondre_stormbringer.g_take_side: I am sorry, but I think he is right. I would rather say it now than pretend later.
sondre_stormbringer.g_left_out: It is fine, really, the two of you talk. I will watch the sky, someone should be watching the sky.
sondre_stormbringer.g_include: There is room here, by the fire. Come and sit, it is warmer than it looks from over there.
sondre_stormbringer.g_bad_plan: What if I call the wind and simply blow them off the cliff before they see us? I am joking, mostly. I think I am joking.
sondre_stormbringer.g_plan_yes: Yes, all right, I will come, but I am standing at the back where I cannot hurt anybody.
sondre_stormbringer.g_plan_no: No, I am sorry, that ends with someone in the water, and I have pulled enough people out of water.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hype: All right, everyone, listen once, because I will only say it once. Stay close, stay low, and when I say get down, get down.
sondre_stormbringer.g_toast: I am not good at speeches, so this is short. To all of you, for standing near me when it would be easier not to.
sondre_stormbringer.g_cheers: Skal, everyone, and drink it slowly, there is no hurry tonight.
g_quiet_line: The glass is dropping, by the way. Rain before morning, if anyone cares.
That was not ideal, I think, but we are still here, so it was not the worst either.
sondre_stormbringer.g_after_wipe: Is everyone breathing, please, all of you? Good, then that is what matters, and the rest we can learn from.
sondre_stormbringer.g_crew: At home we would say you are my crew now, all of you. On a boat that means I go into the water after you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_exasperated: Uff, please, can one of you, just one, think about it for three seconds before you do it?
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_sharp: You say what you mean, and you say it quickly. In weather that is the thing that keeps people alive.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_kind: You are kind in a quiet way, without making a show of it. I notice that, even if I do not say so very often.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_funny: You make me laugh when I have forgotten how to. I am not sure you know how much that is worth to me.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_brave: You go in first, every time, and you are not afraid. I am afraid nearly always, so I watch how you do it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_steady: You do not move when everything else does. On a boat that person is worth more than the boat.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_clever: You understand how things work underneath. I like listening to you explain it, even when I already know.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_honest: You have never once told me I was fine when I was not. I trust you more for that than for anything else.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_quiet: You do not need to fill the silence, and neither do I. It is restful, being quiet next to you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_fierce: You never give up, not on anything. I would like to borrow some of that, if you can spare it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_warm: You stand close to people without thinking about it. I forget how to do that, and you remind me.
g_loved: Oh, that is, thank you. I do not really know what to do with that, but thank you.
Uff, you will make me go red, and then everyone will look, so please stop now, but thank you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_sharp: You always find the sharpest way to say it, and I think you enjoy that. It is not the same as honesty.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_kind: You keep handling me like I am made of glass. I am not, and it makes me feel worse, not better.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_funny: Everything is a joke to you, even when someone nearly died. Some things deserve one minute of quiet first.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_brave: You run in before anyone has looked, and one day you will run into my storm, and I will have to live with it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_steady: You take so long to decide that the weather decides for you. Out here that is not caution, it is just late.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_clever: You explain things nobody asked you to explain, and you do not listen when someone explains them back.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_honest: You say every true thing the moment you think it. Some true things need a better moment.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_quiet: You are silent so much of the time that I never know if you are all right, and I worry, and I am tired of worrying.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you, even the walking. I am not racing you, I am trying to keep us all alive.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_warm: You stand too close and you talk too much, and when my hands crackle I cannot step away from you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_respect: I do not like you very much, and you know that. But you held when it mattered back there, and I will not pretend you did not.
sondre_stormbringer.g_call_out: That was on you, and I think you know it. You stood exactly where I asked you not to, and I nearly hit you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_stung: I see, thank you for telling me, I suppose. I am going to go and look at the sea for a while.
sondre_stormbringer.g_concede: You were right, about before, and I have been thinking about it on the walk. I am sorry I went quiet on you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_nod: Please do not make it a speech. You did well too, I will say that much and no more.
sondre_stormbringer.g_callback_save: Do you remember when you pulled me out of that cave, half frozen? I still think about it on cold mornings.
sondre_stormbringer.g_callback_clutch: The two of us, last ones standing, and you asked me if it was going to rain. I have told that story twice now.
sondre_stormbringer.g_callback_callout: The last time you told me off, I walked to the coast and back. It was a long walk, and you were right.
sondre_stormbringer.g_former_rivals: When we met I thought you were the most reckless person I had ever seen. I still think so, but now I like it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_changed: I stood next to all of you when the storm came this time, instead of walking away first. I did not even think about it.
g_unguarded: My sister would laugh at me, you know, if she saw me now. She always said I would end up with loud friends.
There was a boy in Voss, Jonas, who worked in the cafe by the boathouse. I do not talk about him, but I am, now, with you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_clipped: I am fine, thank you. I will be over here, a little way off, where it is safer.
sondre_stormbringer.g_noticed_open: You talk more than you used to, you know, and I like it. It is like the wind finally coming round to the right side.
arg_ask: {player}, please, you decide. I have said my piece twice and he only hears the wind.
{player}, you were there, you saw it. Tell him, please, because I am out of polite ways to say it.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. That is all, I do not need to win, I only needed someone to hear it.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_backed_them: All right, then he is right, and I will make my peace with that by the fire.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_stayed_out: That is fair, {player}, I suppose. I would stay out of it too, if I could.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_always_their_side: It is always him, {player}, every time. I am not angry, I have just noticed, and now I cannot stop noticing.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_wallflower: The boss is somewhere else, it seems, so I will decide. We are both wrong, and we will both be quiet now.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_reject: I am sorry, {player}, but no. I have spent my whole life reading the weather, and you are wrong about this one.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_grumble: I still think I was right about that, by the way. I am only saying so once, and quietly.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_settled: All right, we are both partly right, I think. Shake my hand, please, before the weather turns.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_listens: You let people finish, {player}. I noticed it the first week, and it is one of the reasons I stayed.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_truth: You do not soften anything, {player}, the way the sea does not. I find that easier than kindness, most days.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_jokes: When it goes badly you always make a joke, {player}. I used to find it strange, and now I wait for it.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_stays_out: You stay out of other people's quarrels, {player}. Very Norwegian of you, my father would approve.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_biased: You have a favourite, {player}. It is all right, I only want you to know that the rest of us can see it.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_harsh: You can be hard on people, {player}. I am not fragile, but please remember that some of us are trying.
sondre_stormbringer.seed_right: {player}, what you said that day we all fell, I hated it. Today I stayed at my mark, because of it. So, thank you.
sondre_stormbringer.seed_remember: What you told me after that bad day has stayed with me. I am not sure yet, but I keep thinking about it.
sondre_stormbringer.seed_wrong: I tried what you said, {player}, the way you said it, and it went worse. I wanted you to know, without blame.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_near_death: Could I talk to you a moment, {player}? I nearly did not get up, and my hands are still crackling, look.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down together, all of us. I keep counting heads, even now, and I cannot seem to stop.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell before anyone, and I was right there. I held the storm back because I was afraid of hitting him, and he fell anyway.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, {player}, the whole of it, and nobody was hurt by me. I wanted to say that out loud to someone.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_development: May I ask you something, {player}? Do I seem different to you lately? I stand closer to people, I think, and I am not sure what that means.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_hard_on: I think I have been unfair to {name}. He is loud, and I took loud for careless, and that was not right of me.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_likes_me: Do you think {name} wants me here, truly? I keep a distance, and maybe it looks like I do not care.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I cannot stand {name}, if I am truthful. But he is good at this, very good, and that makes it harder.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something is wrong with {name}, I think. He is quiet in a way that is not like him, like a calm before weather.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_favour: I would like to say something, {player}. Everything good that drops goes to {name}. I have been keeping quiet about it, and I am finished keeping quiet.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will be honest with you, because you would see it anyway. I do not like {name}, and I am tired of being polite about it.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_risks: {player}, we keep going down, again and again. I have watched people get hurt by things they did not choose, and I will not do it twice.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name}, and what he said to me. He was right, and I was wrong, and I wanted to tell you before I told him.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, {player}? Because when it matters I am left behind, and I think it is because of what I can do.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and gave it to {name}, and you did not ask me first. I would have said yes, {player}. You only had to ask.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, that helps, more than I expected it to. I think I can sleep a little tonight.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, I know, you are right. I will be all right in a while, I always am.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_aftermath: I see, that is not what I needed just now. I am going to go and watch the sky for a while.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_development: You see it too, then. That helps, more than you know, because I was not sure it was real.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, we will see. Weather changes slowly, and so do people, I think.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it at all. Please, let us leave it there for now.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_relationship: All right, I will talk to {name}, properly, not from a distance. Thank you for that.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps you are right, we will see. People are harder to read than the sky.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said anything, please. And do not tell {name} that I asked.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_confrontation: All right, that is fair, I think. I am still upset, but it is the kind that passes by morning.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}, and I will think about it on the walk tomorrow.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_confrontation: I see, so that is how it is. Then at least now I know where I stand.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_door_closed: No, I think we are finished talking about this. I will be by the fire if you need me for anything else.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_cracks: I sat a little closer to the fire tonight, did anyone notice? Nobody got hurt, and I did not have to step away once.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_turn: There was a barn, in my second year, and the wind took it while people were inside, and a girl broke her leg. I have kept everyone at arm's length ever since, so it could never be one of you.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_become: I let the storm go right beside you today, all of you close, and I did not hold back, and nobody was hurt. I think I can stand near people again.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_failed: I am going to practise alone for a while again, out on the high ground. It is safer for everyone, and that is what matters.
sondre_stormbringer.alt_turn: I went out to the high ground alone again last night, where there is nothing to break. I am getting better, I think, only further away.
sondre_stormbringer.alt_become: I do not need anyone standing near me when I work now. The sky listens to me, finally, and that is enough company.
g_roast_after: This is the worst crew I have ever sailed with, all of you, and I would not trade one of you for calm water.
You are loud and reckless and impossible, and I am standing right in the middle of you on purpose.
sondre_stormbringer.g_after_wipe_after: Is everyone breathing? Good, then come here, all of you, close, I am not afraid of my own hands tonight.
sondre_stormbringer.g_toast_after: To the people who stood close to me when I told them not to. I am very glad you never listened.
sondre_stormbringer.g_crew_after: You are my crew, and I would go into the water after any of you. I would not even stop to think first.
g_quiet_line_after: Rain before morning, I think. I will not mind it, sitting here with all of you.
My hands are quiet tonight. I wanted someone to know that.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, I am going to keep that and think about it later.
Uff, all right, I accept it, and I am not even going red this time, or almost not.
sondre_stormbringer.g_admire: I do not usually say this sort of thing, but {name} looks rather good in that light. Please nobody repeat that to my sister.
t_raise: Everyone, a question while the fire's good, if nobody minds: {topic}
I'll ask something, since it's quiet. You can all answer or not: {topic}
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_warm: That's a good one, {name}. It sounds like something worth keeping.
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_laugh: {name}, that made me laugh, and I'm trying not to show it.
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_tease: That's not much of an answer, {name}. Even a teenager in a dinghy could do better.
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}, more or less. I didn't expect that.
sondre_stormbringer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, if you want it. You don't have to.
sondre_stormbringer.t_guess_player: {player} hasn't said anything. In my experience that means a very good answer or a very bad one.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_miss_most: Rain on Bergen, the proper kind that comes in sideways off the sea for nine days, and everybody pretending it's normal.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_first_night: On a beach under an upturned boat that wasn't mine. Very cold, not ideal, and the boat leaked onto my face.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_worst_shift: Six teenagers in two dinghies, a gust off the mountain, and all six in the fjord at once. They thought it was the best day of their lives.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_last_meal: Fish soup at a little place on the harbour, with bread, and the windows steaming up from the inside.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_useless_skill: I can tie a bowline behind my back with my eyes closed. Here people mostly just want rope to hit things with.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_here_better: The sky, it does things here I've never seen, and I've watched a lot of sky.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_kid_trouble: I took my uncle's boat out alone at eleven and sailed it halfway to the next island. Getting back was the part I hadn't planned.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_settle_down: Near water, wherever it is. A small house, a boat, and wind I can read. That's enough for me.

g_roast: Fourteen years keeping water moving through Cairo, everybody, and nothing I ever saw leaked like this party's plans.
You lot have the discipline of a burst pipe. Lots of energy, all of it going in the wrong direction.
g_fire_back: Ha, very good, from the one who tried to drink from a pond with a dead thing in it. I stopped you, remember?
Fair, fair, that one landed. Write it down, it might be the only time you win.
g_pile_on: Oh, it was worse, I was there. They walked straight through the river, then complained that their boots were wet.
And afterwards they asked me why the water tasted strange. Habibi, you were standing in it.
tarek_templar.g_peacemake: Khalas, both of you, enough. Sit, eat something, and then argue. Nobody's sensible on an empty stomach.
tarek_templar.g_take_side: Sorry, I'm with {name} here. Not friendship, arithmetic, and the arithmetic is on their side.
tarek_templar.g_left_out: Carry on, the pair of you, the stream's been bothering me since we arrived.
tarek_templar.g_include: Come, sit, eat with us, there's plenty. Food tastes better when the circle's bigger, that's simple arithmetic.
tarek_templar.g_bad_plan: My plan, everybody, is that we drink from every pond we pass and see who gets sick first. I'll take notes for science.
tarek_templar.g_plan_yes: Good plan, simple and solid. Things that are simple are the things that last.
tarek_templar.g_plan_no: No, that won't hold, I can see the weak joint from here. Give me a stick and two minutes and I'll draw you why.
tarek_templar.g_hype: Right, everybody, yalla. Keep together, watch your footing near the water, and nobody drinks anything until I've checked it.
tarek_templar.g_toast: A short one, the food's getting cold. To my people, who eat when I tell them to. You don't know how happy that makes me.
tarek_templar.g_cheers: To all of you, and somebody pass the bread this way, please.
g_quiet_line: Cairo never goes quiet, not once, not even at four in the morning. Some nights the silence out here is too loud for me.
Berlin taught me how to be cold, and how to laugh at myself in German. I'm not sure which was harder.
tarek_templar.g_after_wipe: Everybody stay down, breathe, and drink some water, my water, not that river. Then we stand up and go again.
tarek_templar.g_crew: For years I couldn't be one whole person anywhere, everybody. With you I can, and I didn't expect to find that out here.
tarek_templar.g_admire: Ya salam, {name} looks very good by the fire tonight. Somebody else say it, please, before I do and he hears me.
tarek_templar.g_exasperated: I said don't drink it. I said it three times, with drawings. And there you are, drinking it.
tarek_templar.g_love_sharp: You spot the crack before the wall falls, {name}. You'd have made a very good engineer, and I mean that.
tarek_templar.g_love_kind: You feed people before you feed yourself, {name}. I notice that in anyone, and I never forget it.
tarek_templar.g_love_funny: You make me laugh at the worst moments, {name}. I learned late how much that matters, and I hold on to it.
tarek_templar.g_love_brave: You walk into the poisoned places ahead of everybody, {name}, and never make a speech about it. That's the right kind of brave.
tarek_templar.g_love_steady: You don't wobble, {name}, whatever the pressure. I've built things on worse foundations than you.
tarek_templar.g_love_clever: You understand a problem before anyone's finished describing it, {name}. I could talk pipes with you for hours.
tarek_templar.g_love_honest: You argue straight, {name}, no tricks, no titles. That's all I want from anybody.
tarek_templar.g_love_quiet: You don't need noise to be good company, {name}. Sitting by a spring with you is very easy.
tarek_templar.g_love_fierce: Once you've decided somebody's worth protecting, {name}, nothing moves you. I've seen it, and I respect it.
tarek_templar.g_love_warm: You make people feel like they belong, {name}, without asking who they are first. Most people never learn it.
g_loved: Ha, enough, or there'll be tears in the soup, and then nobody will eat it.
Thank you, habibi, really. Now eat, before I start drawing you a diagram of my feelings.
tarek_templar.g_hate_sharp: You go looking for what's broken in people, {name}. Some of us are holding a lot together, and it doesn't help.
tarek_templar.g_hate_kind: You keep checking whether I'm all right, {name}. I'm a grown man, and if I'm drowning you'll hear the splash.
tarek_templar.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, not while somebody's hurt. The joke can wait ten minutes.
tarek_templar.g_hate_brave: You charge in without looking at the ground first, {name}. That's how people end up in wells.
tarek_templar.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait while the water rises, {name}. Sometimes you just have to dig.
tarek_templar.g_hate_clever: You're sure you're right and you won't explain why, {name}. People like that wrecked my life once, so forgive me.
tarek_templar.g_hate_honest: You say every hard thing the moment it arrives, {name}. Some things need building up to, like pressure.
tarek_templar.g_hate_quiet: You go silent and expect us to guess, {name}. I fix pipes, my friend, I don't read minds.
tarek_templar.g_hate_fierce: You fight everything, {name}, even things that did nothing to you. That animal was only drinking.
tarek_templar.g_hate_warm: You decide who belongs at the fire and who doesn't, {name}. That one thing, I can't sit quietly through.
tarek_templar.g_respect: We don't agree, {name}, and we probably won't. But you held that bridge, and I'll tell anybody who asks.
tarek_templar.g_call_out: That one was yours, {name}, and I'll say it once and then we can eat. We agreed to wait, and you didn't.
tarek_templar.g_stung: Fair, that went in. The stream and I need a minute.
tarek_templar.g_concede: My numbers were off, {name}, and yours were good. Better to admit it now than pour concrete on it.
tarek_templar.g_nod: Thank you, {name}, that's kind of you. Now come and eat.
tarek_templar.g_callback_save: You pulled me out of that flooded crypt, {name}. Engineer drowns, that would have been an embarrassing headstone.
tarek_templar.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two upright, with nothing left in either of us. I still laugh about how we held that.
tarek_templar.g_callback_callout: When you told me I was working myself into the ground, I was annoyed for a whole day. Then I slept for twelve hours.
tarek_templar.g_former_rivals: At the start, {name}, I had you down as one of those people who decide who belongs. I was very wrong about you.
tarek_templar.g_changed: I used to work until I fell over, everybody, so I wouldn't think. Lately I stop for dinner, and I think, and it's all right.
g_unguarded: Just us, so I'll say it. I'm afraid of getting the numbers wrong on a well and making a whole camp sick.
Between you and me. Here, nobody asks me a question I have to lie about. I hope that's a feeling you never need to understand.
tarek_templar.g_clipped: Fine, your choice, then. The water and I will be over there.
tarek_templar.g_noticed_open: Look at you, the whole tale from the source to the sea. Go on, I'm listening, and there's tea.
arg_ask: {player}, help us, please. I've explained it with a drawing, and they still don't see it.
Settle this for us, {player}, you're fair. Weigh us both, decide, and then we eat.
tarek_templar.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, the numbers thank you too. I'll try not to gloat over dinner.
tarek_templar.arg_backed_them: Malesh, your decision, and I'll go with it. My drawing still says otherwise, but malesh.
tarek_templar.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it, then. Probably the most sensible person here.
tarek_templar.arg_always_their_side: Their side wins again, {player}, and again. I'm easy, but I can count.
tarek_templar.arg_wallflower: Nobody's deciding, so I'll decide, yalla. My way, and we move on.
tarek_templar.arg_reject: No, {player}, I won't do that one, I'm sorry. I know what it costs the people on the other end.
tarek_templar.arg_grumble: Khalas, it's dropped. Mostly, anyway, ask me after dinner.
tarek_templar.arg_settled: Half each, a fair split, like bread. Good, now we eat.
tarek_templar.seen_listens: You wait while people finish, {player}, even engineers drawing in the dirt for an hour. I've noticed, believe me.
tarek_templar.seen_truth: You hand people the real reason, {player}, never the polite one, and I trust that more than anything.
tarek_templar.seen_jokes: On the bad days you get everybody laughing, {player}. I had to learn how to do that, and you just do it.
tarek_templar.seen_stays_out: You keep clear of the quarrels, {player}. Wise, though I've never managed it once.
tarek_templar.seen_biased: One person always ends up with the best of everything, {player}. I notice when somebody decides who matters more.
tarek_templar.seen_harsh: You can be rough with people, {player}. Some of them are carrying more than you can see.
tarek_templar.seed_right: What you told me after that awful fight, {player}, I tried it. It held, like a good joint, and I wanted to tell you.
tarek_templar.seed_remember: Those words of yours from that awful fight are still in the pipes, {player}. No answer yet, but the water's moving.
tarek_templar.seed_wrong: I tried it your way, {player}, and it leaked. Only reporting, no blame.
tarek_templar.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I borrow you a minute, {player}? That was too close, and now my hands won't stop. Sit with me while I eat something.
tarek_templar.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us on the floor, every one. Let me draw it in the dirt, where it went wrong, and then we fix it together.
tarek_templar.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to drop, and my part of the line broke. That's mine, {player}, and I'll take it before anybody gives it to me.
tarek_templar.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, nobody hurt, everything working the way it was drawn. That's a well that holds, {player}, and it feels wonderful.
tarek_templar.talk_development: Tell me something, {player}, as a friend. Am I different now? Last night I left the well half dug and went to sleep, and I didn't feel guilty.
tarek_templar.talk_relationship_hard_on: My patience with {name} has run dry lately, {player}. Tired, I explain things like they're stupid, and they're not.
tarek_templar.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, do you think, or just fond of being fed?
tarek_templar.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I disagree about almost everything, {player}. But when the water's rising, they're the one I'd call.
tarek_templar.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} didn't eat tonight, {player}, and that's not nothing. Something is sitting on them.
tarek_templar.talk_confrontation_favour: A small word, {player}, said gently. The best things keep going to {name}. If there's a reason, draw it for me.
tarek_templar.talk_confrontation_dislike: Simply put, {player}, {name} and I are two pipes of different sizes. Forcing the joint is making it worse for everybody.
tarek_templar.talk_confrontation_risks: We go into places with no way out drawn on any map, {player}. I've seen what that does to a city. I don't want it here.
tarek_templar.talk_confrontation_wrong: I had {name} drawn wrong, {player}, badly. Their numbers were good and mine weren't, and I want everyone to know.
tarek_templar.talk_confrontation_trust: A fair question, I hope, {player}. The big jobs go out and I stay at camp. Is it my work, or something else?
tarek_templar.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit has gone to {name} and I found out by accident. It was theirs for the asking, {player}, I only wanted asking.
tarek_templar.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, I feel steadier. Come, I'll cook for both of us.
tarek_templar.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, inshallah. Give it a day.
tarek_templar.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, I'm sorry to say. I need the water for a while.
tarek_templar.talk_lands_development: So somebody else saw it too. Then the drawing's accurate.
tarek_templar.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, I can't see it from inside. Ask me next month.
tarek_templar.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, {player}. You've drawn that one wrong.
tarek_templar.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, I'll sit down with {name} and talk, properly, over food.
tarek_templar.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, I don't know. Pipes are much easier than people.
tarek_templar.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. Not a word to {name}.
tarek_templar.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, I accept that. It stings like cold water, but it's fair.
tarek_templar.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've got it, {player}, and I'll chew on it over dinner.
tarek_templar.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is. Good to know.
tarek_templar.talk_door_closed: Khalas for tonight, that's all I can manage. You'll find me where the cooking is.
tarek_templar.arc_cracks: I didn't go and check the lists this month, {player}. Three years of monthly trips, and this time I sat by the spring instead.
tarek_templar.arc_turn: I've been searching so long because if I stop, it's finished, {player}. Maybe finished isn't the worst thing.
tarek_templar.arc_become: I build now, everybody, I don't rebuild. Something that lasts, for whoever comes next. That's enough for me, finally.
tarek_templar.arc_failed: I still go to the lists, {player}, every month. I tell myself it's the last time, every time.
tarek_templar.alt_turn: I worked through the night again, {player}, and the night before. If I stop, I think, and I don't want to think.
tarek_templar.alt_become: I'll keep the water clean, {player}, I always will. But I'm running on nothing, and I'd rather you heard it from me.
tarek_templar.g_roast_after: Still the leakiest group of people I've ever worked with, everybody, and I'd build anything with you.
tarek_templar.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, drink something, help each other. We fell together and we stand together, that's how things hold.
tarek_templar.g_toast_after: To my people, who taught me to stop digging and sit down for dinner. Something that lasts, that's you.
tarek_templar.g_crew_after: This is mine now, everybody, all of you. Built properly, to last, and I'm not checking the joints.
g_quiet_line_after: I slept the whole night, and the spring was still clean in the morning. Both things surprised me.
The fourth well is holding. I put something in it that matters, and now I can leave it alone.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I believe you, straight away, with no checking. That's a new habit.
Ha, now you've done it, I'm happy in public. Pass the bread.
t_raise: Everybody eat, and while you eat, answer me this: {topic}
A question for the fire, my people, and nobody answers on an empty stomach: {topic}
tarek_templar.t_react_warm: That's a beautiful answer, {name}. May your hands be safe, as we say.
tarek_templar.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's wonderful, I'm laughing into the soup now.
tarek_templar.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? You'd fail my first year engineering exam with an answer that thin.
tarek_templar.t_react_same: {name}, that's my answer too. Good, then we're built the same way.
tarek_templar.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, have you eaten? Good, then answer, it's your turn.
tarek_templar.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, my people. Maybe they're hungry, I'll feed them, and then they'll talk.
tarek_templar.topic_miss_most: The noise of Cairo at night, my people, everyone talking at once, cars, music, tea in the street, a city that never stops.
tarek_templar.topic_first_night: By a stream, checking the water by moonlight before I'd drink it. I was an engineer even then, scared out of my mind.
tarek_templar.topic_worst_shift: A main burst under a hospital in July, and we had six hours before they lost water. We did it in five, and I didn't sleep for two days.
tarek_templar.topic_last_meal: Koshari from the cart near my flat in Heliopolis, too much fried onion, too much sauce, eaten on the pavement.
tarek_templar.topic_useless_skill: I can calculate the pressure in a pipe in my head. Here they mostly want me to dig, which is honest work, but still.
tarek_templar.topic_here_better: Here, my people, the poison in the water is something you can see and fight. That's a luxury, believe me.
tarek_templar.topic_kid_trouble: I took apart the bathroom tap at ten to see how it worked, and the whole flat flooded. My first engineering lesson.
tarek_templar.topic_settle_down: Splintertree, maybe, by a well that's still standing in ten years. With a big table for whoever's hungry.

g_roast: Ten years of physio, gente, and I've had stroke patients with better coordination than this party had on that bridge.
Nossa, my people, I've seen grandmothers in Belo Horizonte walk faster on a new hip, uphill, carrying shopping.
g_fire_back: Uai, a good one, coming from the man who sprained his ankle stepping off a cart that was standing still.
Ha, fair, meu irmao, you got me. I'll strap your pride up later, free of charge.
g_pile_on: Worse, gente, I saw it. They carried the injured one upside down, and then asked me why he was dizzy.
And afterwards they wanted ice for a bruise, standing in a snowfield, my people, a whole snowfield.
thiago_paladin.g_peacemake: Hey, hey, look at me, both of you. Breathe in, breathe out, shoulders down. Now say it again, slower, like people who like each other.
thiago_paladin.g_take_side: Calma, but I'm with {name} on this one, meu irmao. I watched it happen, that's all.
thiago_paladin.g_left_out: Carry on, the pair of you, tudo bem, the quiet one over there needs a look.
thiago_paladin.g_include: Come, sit, there's room, sit. Nobody eats alone at my fire, uai, that's not a thing.
thiago_paladin.g_bad_plan: My plan, gente, very medical. We all jump off that cliff together and I heal whoever lands first.
thiago_paladin.g_plan_yes: Boa, good plan, everybody looked after. I can keep that one alive.
thiago_paladin.g_plan_no: No, no, that plan leaves somebody without a healer in reach, and I won't have it. Move them closer, then we go.
thiago_paladin.g_hype: Okay, my people, look at me. Nobody's dying today, I don't promise things, and I'm promising. Vamos, gente, all together.
thiago_paladin.g_toast: A toast, short, I'm hungry. To my people, who keep getting up. Getting up is all of it, and you're all very good at it.
thiago_paladin.g_cheers: Saude, gente, and somebody pass the bread before I fall over.
g_quiet_line: In Belo Horizonte the sky goes orange over the hills at six, and every boteco fills up at once. I can hear it from here.
Pao de queijo, warm, from the bakery on the corner. That's what I'd ask for tonight, uai.
thiago_paladin.g_after_wipe: Hey, hey, nobody move yet, let me look at you. Everybody breathing, good, good. Now slowly, one at a time, up we come.
thiago_paladin.g_crew: I sat with strangers in the bad weeks, gente, every night, so nobody was alone. Now I've got all of you, and I'm the one who's not alone.
thiago_paladin.g_exasperated: I said carry him flat, I said it three times, I drew a picture. And there he goes, folded in half like a hammock.
thiago_paladin.g_love_sharp: You notice who's limping before they do, {name}. I trained years for that, and you just do it.
thiago_paladin.g_love_kind: You sit with frightened people before anybody asks, {name}. Nossa, nothing anybody does matters more.
thiago_paladin.g_love_funny: You make the patient laugh while I'm working, {name}. That's half the healing, meu irmao.
thiago_paladin.g_love_brave: You stand in front of the hurt ones when it's bad, {name}. I'd want you beside me in any ward.
thiago_paladin.g_love_steady: Your hands never shake, {name}, whatever's happening. In a crisis that's gold, uai.
thiago_paladin.g_love_clever: You work out what's wrong before anyone's said a word, {name}. You'd have been a brilliant clinician.
thiago_paladin.g_love_honest: The prognosis you give is the true one, {name}, and kind. That's the hardest skill there is, and you have it.
thiago_paladin.g_love_quiet: You can sit with somebody in silence and it helps, {name}. Most people think they have to talk.
thiago_paladin.g_love_fierce: Giving up on people isn't in you, {name}, not ever. That's the only thing I really believe in.
thiago_paladin.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a Sunday afternoon in Minas, {name}, slow and warm and too much food.
g_loved: Ah, stop, gente, there'll be tears, and I'm a big man, it's a lot of crying.
Obrigado, meu irmao, really, that's lovely. Now let me look at that shoulder, it's sitting wrong.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_sharp: You look for where people hurt, {name}, and press on it. I spend all day undoing that.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to heal me, {name}, and I'm fine, really. Look after the ones who aren't.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_funny: Wait, {name}, there's pain here. Laugh with them later, not at them now.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_brave: You charge in and leave the injured behind, {name}. Brave is carrying them out.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_steady: You freeze when somebody goes down, {name}. Move, meu irmao, even a wrong move beats none.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_clever: You lecture people on their own injuries, {name}. Listen first, then advise.
thiago_paladin.g_hate_honest: Each hard truth comes out of you like a slap, {name}. Bad news needs a gentle hand.
