sides.berat_tinker: talk them through it, a scared patient bleeds faster
sides.esteban_bloodmage: work fast and quiet, the talking can come after

arguments.third: Esteban works and Berat talks, and the patient says it's the best care they've ever had.
lines: berat_tinker
Esteban, canim, you can't just put your hands on a frightened man and start. Tell him what you're doing first, the fear makes everything worse.
esteban_bloodmage
With the bleeding he had, Berat, every sentence costs him a little more. I'd rather he lived to complain about my manners.
berat_tinker
Aman, thirty years of frightened people in my chair, and the ones I talked to never bit me once. Give me the first minute, that's all.

sides.dan_warrior: the big lad takes the front, that's what he's for
sides.marco_paladin: the front belongs to whoever has the Light to hold it

arguments.third: They take the front together, shoulder to shoulder, and argue about it the whole fight.
lines: dan_warrior
Marco, love, I'm stood at the front, and that's where I'm staying. You go and do your glowing from behind me.
marco_paladin
Thirty-one years I've stood at a door, Dan, and I'll stand at this one. The Light holds better than a shield, ragazzo.
dan_warrior
Your Light's very nice, but my shield's the one getting hit. Sod it, there's room for two, budge up then.

sides.ivan_warrior: we leave at first light, which means first light
sides.diego_tinker: we leave when the thing I'm building is finished

arguments.third: Ivan gives Diego ten minutes, and Diego builds a clock in eleven.
lines: ivan_warrior
Diego, the sun came up twenty minutes ago. In my world, twenty minutes late is a disciplinary hearing, and here it's breakfast.
diego_tinker
Listen, listen, Ivan, ten more minutes and this thing tells us exactly when the sun comes up. We'll never be late again!
ivan_warrior
I already know when the sun comes up, my friend, I watched it happen. It happened without you, and it was very rude.

sides.berat_tinker: a guest never cooks, it's an insult to the house
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: the man with the fire and the meat feeds the table

arguments.third: Sebastian cooks the meat, Berat makes everything else, and the table can't move after.
lines: berat_tinker
Sebastian, sit, sit, you're my guest tonight. In Izmir, a guest who cooks is a guest who's been insulted.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Berat, in Buenos Aires the man with the fire feeds the people, and look, I have the fire. Sit down yourself!
berat_tinker
Mashallah, so stubborn, you'd fight a grandmother for the kitchen. Fine, you take the meat, and I'll feed everyone else until they cry.

sides.haruto_runemaster: cut the rune properly, however long it takes
sides.diego_tinker: a quick fix now beats a perfect one tomorrow

arguments.third: Diego builds his quick fix, and Haruto cuts the proper rune under it while it holds.
lines: haruto_runemaster
Diego, that gadget will fail the first time anyone leans on it. A rune cut properly would hold for a hundred years.
diego_tinker
Listen, listen, Haruto, a hundred years is lovely, but the wolves are coming tonight! Mine works in ten minutes.
haruto_runemaster
Then it will fail in eleven, on whoever is standing closest. Careless work always picks the wrong person.

sides.minh_chronomancer: a proper watch rota, written down, everyone takes a turn
sides.dan_warrior: the big lad takes first watch and the rest sleep

arguments.third: Minh writes the rota, and Dan takes first watch on it, officially.
lines: minh_chronomancer
Dan, I have drawn up a watch rota, four shifts, rotating. You are on third, and I would like you to sleep until then.
dan_warrior
Give over, love, I'll take first and second, I'm awake anyway. You need your kip more than I do.
minh_chronomancer
That is precisely what I tell myself every night, and look where it got me. Third shift, Dan, please, and I will try to sleep too.

sides.tomas_warrior: retie the tent ropes with proper knots before the storm
sides.bakyt_hunter: six generations of felt tents never needed new knots

arguments.third: Tomas reties two ropes his way, Bakyt leaves the rest his way, and they compare in the morning.
lines: tomas_warrior
Bakyt, mate, those tent ropes are tied with a knot I've never seen, and I've seen every knot there is. Let me retie them before the wind.
bakyt_hunter
My grandfather's grandfather tied this knot, friend, on the high pasture in worse wind than this. Drink your tea, it will hold.
tomas_warrior
Your grandfather's grandfather didn't have my shoulder telling him a storm's coming. Two ropes, my way, and we see who's dry tomorrow.

sides.matias_reaper: the quiet one at the back is the thief
sides.silas_rogue: the loud one at the counter is the thief

arguments.third: They watch both, and it turns out the two traders are working together.
lines: matias_reaper
Silas, the thief is the quiet one by the door, I am sure. On the bus, the quiet ones by the door were always the problem.
silas_rogue
Amai, no, mate, it's the loud one at the counter, sixty percent. All that noise is cargo with the wrong label on it.
matias_reaper
Ya, okay, we watch both, and we see. Loser buys the empanadas, cachai.

sides.tomas_warrior: nothing hangs over the camp without a safety line
sides.diego_tinker: the lantern contraption is perfectly balanced, it needs no line

arguments.third: Diego's lantern stays up, with Tomas's safety line on it, and Diego paints the line gold so it looks deliberate.
lines: tomas_warrior
Diego, there's a forty-pound lantern machine hanging over where people sleep, on one rope. Do haje, nothing goes up without a safety.
diego_tinker
My friend, my friend, it is perfectly balanced, I did the numbers twice! A safety line would ruin the whole look.
tomas_warrior
Numbers don't stop a rope fraying at three in the morning. A safety line, or it comes down, and I'm not arguing during the lift.

sides.pavlo_knight: praise a student often, and the work grows
sides.haruto_runemaster: praise rarely, so it means something when it comes

arguments.third: Haruto agrees to praise his students once a month, and Pavlo agrees to make it count.
lines: pavlo_knight
Haruto, tell your students when they do well, please, and often. A fourteen-year-old who hears it once a year stops trying.
haruto_runemaster
My master praised me once in eleven years, Pavlo, and I have remembered that sentence for thirty. Rare praise is never forgotten.
pavlo_knight
And how many of his other students stayed long enough to hear it, do you think? I would guess very few, my friend.

sides.liam_suncleric: light a backburn and let the fire meet nothing
sides.cristobal_knight: cut a firebreak and hold the line by hand

arguments.third: They cut the break together, and Liam lights a small backburn off it while Cristobal watches the wind.
lines: liam_suncleric
Mate, if that grass goes up, we backburn from the creek. Fire meets burnt ground, runs out of food, done.
cristobal_knight
Hermano, a backburn in this wind? She'll jump it and laugh at us. We cut a break by hand, wide, and we hold it.
liam_suncleric
Holding it by hand is how you lose people, and I'd rather not lose anyone today. Small backburn, off your break, deal?

sides.giorgi_primalist: the wolves taking the sheep must be driven off or killed
sides.callum_venomancer: find out why they're hungry and move them on

arguments.third: Callum tracks the pack to find what pushed it down, and Giorgi guards the flock until he's back.
lines: giorgi_primalist
Callum, the wolves took three sheep this week. A shepherd does not talk with wolves, my friend. He stands in front of the flock.
callum_venomancer
Fair enough, mate, but something's pushed them down off the high ground. Find that, and the wolves go home on their own.
giorgi_primalist
And while you are finding it, the wolves are eating. Kargi, go and look, quickly, and I will stand here being large.

sides.orlando_witchdoctor: Haruto needs a proper haircut, and soon
sides.haruto_runemaster: his hair is tied back correctly and needs nothing

arguments.third: Orlando trims it, and Haruto corrects his grip on the scissors, and both of them are pleased.
lines: orlando_witchdoctor
Haruto, mi amor, please, sit in my chair for ten minutes. That hair has been tied back the same way since the old world.
haruto_runemaster
It is tied back correctly, and it has given me no trouble for thirty years. I do not see the problem.
orlando_witchdoctor
The problem is it's beautiful hair and you're hiding it, with love. Ten minutes, and you can correct how I hold the scissors.

sides.cristobal_knight: Valparaiso is the heart of Chile, and the Wanderers are its team
sides.matias_reaper: Santiago is the real Chile, and nobody cares about the Wanderers

arguments.third: They agree Chile is the best country in two worlds, and argue about the football all night anyway.
lines: cristobal_knight
Matias, hermano, tell them the truth. Valparaiso is the soul of Chile, the hills, the port, the Wanderers, everything.
matias_reaper
Ya, the soul, okay. Santiago is the whole body, weon, and nobody in Santiago remembers the Wanderers play football.
cristobal_knight
Chucha, the disrespect! Come to the port one day and say that, and my mother will feed you until you take it back.

sides.minh_chronomancer: Liam sleeps tonight, and Minh keeps watch
sides.liam_suncleric: Minh sleeps tonight, and Liam keeps watch

arguments.third: Both of them sleep, and the youngest in camp keeps watch, under protest from both.
lines: minh_chronomancer
Liam, you have been awake for two days. I will take the watch, and you will sleep. That is the sequence.
liam_suncleric
Mate, you've got bags under your eyes I could carry shopping in. You sleep, I'll watch, I don't sleep anyway.
minh_chronomancer
That is precisely the problem with both of us, I think. Perhaps tonight neither of us is the right person for this job.

sides.giorgi_primalist: a good evening needs wine and a toast
sides.bakyt_hunter: a good evening needs tea and quiet

arguments.third: A toast with tea, which offends Giorgi slightly and pleases Bakyt enormously.
lines: giorgi_primalist
Bakyt, my friend, a table without wine is only furniture. One cup, one toast, and then your tea, I promise.
bakyt_hunter
Tea first, always tea first, friend. Wine makes young men loud and old men sleepy, and I am already old.
giorgi_primalist
Then I make the toast with tea, and the ancestors will forgive me. Gaumarjos, to stubborn old herders, both of us.

sides.orlando_witchdoctor: a party lives on music and talk
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: a party lives on the grill

arguments.third: Sebastian runs the grill, Orlando runs the room, and nobody goes home before dawn.
lines: orlando_witchdoctor
Sebastian, mi amor, a party is music and talk. Without a radio and somebody to listen, you just have people eating standing up.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Orlando, without a grill it's a meeting, not a party! The smoke is what calls people in, ask any neighbourhood in Buenos Aires.
orlando_witchdoctor
Then you feed them and I keep them, papi, that's a deal. Your grill, my chairs, and the spirits can dance if they want.

sides.yiannis_paladin: an octopus that size belongs on the grill with lemon
sides.callum_venomancer: an octopus that clever belongs back in the water

arguments.third: Callum lets it go, and Yiannis catches a smaller, less clever one for supper.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Ela, Callum, look at this beauty, eight arms and not one of them wasted. A little lemon, a little oil, and the grill will be pleased.
callum_venomancer
Mate, it just opened a jar to get at that crab. That's one of the smartest animals in the sea, you can't eat a genius.
yiannis_paladin
In Chania we eat geniuses every Sunday, child, and we live to ninety. Clever or not, the octopus knows the sea gives and takes.

sides.rhodri_knight: build a scaffold tower up the wall, tied in properly
sides.tomas_warrior: rig a rope and pulley from the top, quicker and lighter

arguments.third: Rhodri's scaffold goes up, Tomas rigs a hoist off the top of it, and they argue about whose idea it was.
lines: rhodri_knight
Tomas, butt, a tower's what that wall wants, tied in every two metres. Tidy, solid, and nobody's dangling off a string.
tomas_warrior
Rhodri, that's a whole load-in of boards and tubes for a ten-minute lift. One line, one pulley tied off up top, and the crew's done before lunch.
rhodri_knight
Duw, and if your one rope goes, somebody's going for a swim, isn't it? Scaffold first, then you can hang your pulley off my nice tidy tower.

sides.leif_primalist: that dead tree makes good firewood, fell it
sides.bakyt_hunter: that tree marks water and shade, leave it standing

arguments.third: Leif fells the deadwood beside it instead, and Bakyt shows him the spring under the roots.
lines: leif_primalist
That one's dead standing, Bakyt. Twenty minutes with the axe and we've got wood for a week. Pretty easy call.
bakyt_hunter
Look at the grass around it, friend, greener than the rest. That tree is standing on water, and the herders use it to find the spring.
leif_primalist
Huh, didn't see that. Okay, I'll drop the one behind it, nope, the other one. You read ground better than I read timber, maybe.

sides.marcus_stormbringer: a front is coming, the pressure's dropping, make camp now
sides.minh_chronomancer: the sky is clear to the horizon, keep moving

arguments.third: They push on for an hour, and make camp just as the rain arrives, which both of them claim as being right.
lines: marcus_stormbringer
Minh, the pressure's dropping, I can feel it in my ears, and those cirrus up there mean a front within the day. Sorry, anyway, we should make camp.
minh_chronomancer
I have watched that horizon for an hour, Marcus. Clear to the edge, no traffic, nothing developing. I would continue for now.
marcus_stormbringer
Clear now, yes, that's the trap, it always looks clear before it isn't! One more hour, then, and I'll say I told you so very politely.

sides.marco_paladin: the lock is the problem, open it quietly
sides.matias_reaper: the lock is easy, the guard watching it is the problem

arguments.third: Matias keeps the guard talking about football, and Marco opens the lock while he does.
lines: marco_paladin
Allora, Matias, this lock is old work, very good work. Give me two minutes, piano, piano, and it opens without a sound.
matias_reaper
The lock is easy, Marco. The guard at the corner has looked at this door four times. He is the problem, not the lock.
marco_paladin
Va bene, you see people, I see locks. You keep him busy, ragazzo, and I will be quiet.

sides.esteban_bloodmage: operate here and now, the wound won't wait for a town
sides.liam_suncleric: stabilise, pack it, and move to somewhere safe first

arguments.third: Liam packs and stabilises, they carry the patient to cover, and Esteban operates there.
lines: esteban_bloodmage
Liam, this bleed needs a surgeon's hands now, not in an hour. I can close it here, on this ground, if you'll hold the light.
liam_suncleric
Mate, we're in the open with things still moving in the trees. Pack it, splint it, get them under cover, then you work your magic.
esteban_bloodmage
Very well, colleague, cover first, ten minutes, no more. After that the prognosis changes, and I will be operating wherever we are.

sides.ryan_warlock: read every line of the lease before signing for a shop
sides.orlando_witchdoctor: a handshake and a good feeling is enough

arguments.third: Ryan reads the lease out loud at the fire, Orlando cuts his hair while he does, and they sign together.
lines: ryan_warlock
Orlando, lad, before you take any building, give me the papers. Twenty years in Boston taught me the nice ones hide the worst clauses.
orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, Ryan, papi, the merchant shook my hand and looked me in the eye. That's the contract, in Santurce that's everything.
ryan_warlock
In Boston that's how you lose the shop and the shirt, and they'd keep the shirt. Humour me, I'll read it while you fix my hair.

sides.marco_paladin: the jars need real locking lids before something escapes
sides.callum_venomancer: a tied cloth is fine, the animals aren't trying to get out

arguments.third: Marco makes three locking lids for the worst crates, and Callum keeps cloth on the rest.
lines: marco_paladin
Callum, ragazzo, a cloth and string on a crate of death adders. Madonna, give me one evening and I make you lids that close properly.
callum_venomancer
No worries, Marco, they're happy in there, mate, adders aren't plotting anything. If they wanted out they'd have gone already.
marco_paladin
Thirty-one years, I learned one thing, everything wants out eventually. Three proper lids, for the bad ones, and I sleep better.

sides.pavlo_knight: the old road is safe, travellers have used it for centuries
sides.giorgi_primalist: the ground on that road is moving, take the high path

arguments.third: They take the high path, and Pavlo makes a note that the old road has finally changed after four hundred years.
lines: pavlo_knight
Giorgi, the old road has carried travellers through this valley for four hundred years. History is a very reliable guide, in my experience.
giorgi_primalist
History did not walk here this spring, my friend. The ground is soft and the stones are leaning. That road is going to slide.
pavlo_knight
And why do you think that is, I wonder? Very well, the high path, and I will write down that the land outvoted the history books.

sides.silas_rogue: the stranger at the fire is lying about who he is
sides.callum_venomancer: the stranger is just frightened, like any cornered animal

arguments.third: They feed the stranger and watch him, and he turns out to be both lying and terrified.
lines: silas_rogue
Callum, the stranger at the fire, sixty percent he's lying. Says he's a merchant, walks like a man who's never carried anything heavier than a secret.
callum_venomancer
Could be, mate, but look at his hands, he's shaking. That's not a liar, that's something cornered and scared out of its mind.
silas_rogue
Amai, it can be both, you know, the scared ones lie best. We feed him, and we watch him, and we'll both be right by morning.

sides.ivan_warrior: we leave at first light, which means sleeping now
sides.cristobal_knight: the village is having a fiesta tonight, and we're invited

arguments.third: One dance, Ivan's timetable, and Cristobal is asleep before Ivan is, for once.
lines: ivan_warrior
Cristobal, we leave at first light, which is five hours from now. In five hours I want everyone asleep, not dancing.
cristobal_knight
Hermano, the village invited us to their fiesta! You don't say no to a fiesta, it's rude, my mother would disown me.
ivan_warrior
Your mother is not driving this tram, my friend. One dance, then bed, and if you are late tomorrow I leave you here to dance alone.

sides.tarek_templar: the boy who stole bread was hungry, feed him and let it go
sides.adrian_templar: the rule is the same for everyone, he pays for the bread

arguments.third: The boy works an afternoon for the baker, and Tarek feeds him at the end of it.
lines: tarek_templar
Adrian, habibi, he took one loaf because he hadn't eaten in two days. Feed him, and nobody needs a ruling.
adrian_templar
If I let him off because I feel sorry for him, Tarek, the next one gets off because I like him. The rule has to be the same, properly.
tarek_templar
Then make the rule fair and kind at once, my friend. He works the afternoon for the baker, and I cook his dinner myself.

sides.emre_rogue: a door that old deserves to be opened and read
sides.owen_cultist: a sealed door in the dark is sealed for a reason

arguments.third: Emre studies the lock for an hour without opening it, and Owen keeps watch and hums.
lines: emre_rogue
Look at this door, my friends, older than the walls around it. Somebody very serious made this, Owen, and I'd like to hear what they had to say.
owen_cultist
Now then, Emre, I know a bit about things that wait in the dark. Somebody sealed it, bach, and they didn't do that for fun.
emre_rogue
Tamam, then I'll only read it, I won't open it. Even a closed door tells you who it's afraid of, and you can stand guard and hum.

sides.marco_paladin: a good safe is opened slowly, by feel, one wheel at a time
sides.emre_rogue: listen to it first, the safe tells you where it's weak

arguments.third: Marco feels the wheels while Emre listens with his ear to the door, and they open it in half the time.
lines: marco_paladin
Allora, Emre, a safe like this, you go piano, piano. One wheel, then the next, you feel it in the fingers. Thirty one years, this is how.
emre_rogue
Your fingers are very good, Marco, but you're not listening. Put your ear to it, the safe has been telling us where it's tired for five minutes.
marco_paladin
Madonna, two locksmiths and one safe, we will be here until morning. Va bene, I feel, you listen, and nobody tells the ragazzi how long it took.

sides.berat_tinker: proper Turkish tea, all day, in little glasses
sides.emre_rogue: Turkish coffee, strong, once, and done properly

arguments.third: Tea all day and one coffee after dinner, and they argue about whose grandmother made it better.
lines: berat_tinker
Emre, brother, family, it's tea, all day, little glasses, twenty of them! In Izmir nobody trusts a man who drinks coffee before noon.
emre_rogue
Twenty glasses of tea is a tea house, Berat, not a drink. One coffee, very strong, and a man can think until sunset.
berat_tinker
Tea all day, then, and your one coffee after dinner, and I'll fix the stains on your teeth for free afterwards. Open wide, you'll need it.

sides.rhodri_knight: the valleys are the heart of Wales, everybody knows it
sides.owen_cultist: the coast is where Wales breathes, Barry and the sea

arguments.third: They agree Cardiff is too posh for either of them, and sing the same hymn badly.
lines: rhodri_knight
Owen, butt, you're from Barry, isn't it? Lovely, but the valleys are the real Wales, Ponty and the rugby and the chapels on every hill.
owen_cultist
Duw, Rhodri, the valleys are lovely if you like rain sideways. Barry's got the sea, mind, and the chips, and the island in the fog.
rhodri_knight
Fair play, the chips are tidy, I'll give you that. We can both agree Cardiff's too posh for us, can't we, and sing something together.

sides.owen_cultist: three in the morning is the loneliest hour
sides.minh_chronomancer: three in the morning is the calmest hour

arguments.third: They take the late watch together, Minh calls out the stars like traffic, and Owen says it's the least lonely he's been at that hour.
lines: owen_cultist
Three in the morning, Minh, that's the loneliest hour there is. Eight years in a cab, I'd know, the whole country asleep but me.
minh_chronomancer
For me it was the calmest hour, Owen. Two aircraft on the scope, a quiet frequency, nobody shouting. I liked it very much.
owen_cultist
Then we'll take the late watch together, bach. You call out the stars like your aircraft, and I'll find out if it's lonely with company.

sides.liam_suncleric: if you go down, I'm dragging you out, promise or no promise
sides.nicolas_bloodmage: get everyone else out first, and don't drag me

arguments.third: They agree the medic who's still standing decides, and both of them know who that will be.
lines: liam_suncleric
Mate, this rule of yours, don't drag me, it's rubbish and you know it. You go down, I'm dragging you out, and you can complain about it at the barbie.
nicolas_bloodmage
Pata, you know the job. You get the others out first, then me. I've watched people die because somebody wasted a minute on the wrong patient.
liam_suncleric
Fine, here's the deal, whoever's still standing calls it. And we both know that's going to be me, so start practising your complaining.

sides.yiannis_paladin: the stream is running and cold, drink, it's fine
sides.tarek_templar: running and cold means nothing, check it first

arguments.third: Tarek checks it, it's clean, and Yiannis is unbearable about it for the rest of the day.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Ela, Tarek, look, the water is running and cold and singing over the stones. A good stream, my friend, drink, it's a gift.
tarek_templar
Running and cold tells me nothing, Yiannis. The worst spring I ever mapped was running and cold, and it made a camp sick for a week.
yiannis_paladin
Then check it, child, check it, and when it's clean I'll be very gracious. Not too gracious, I'll be a little unbearable.

sides.rhodri_knight: referees ruin the game, let the boys play
sides.adrian_templar: without a referee it isn't a game, it's a brawl

arguments.third: They mark out a rough pitch, Rhodri plays, and Adrian blows the whistle exactly twice.
lines: rhodri_knight
Adrian, butt, I've had a referee ruin every final I ever played. Let the boys sort it out on the pitch, that's proper rugby, isn't it.
adrian_templar
With respect, Rhodri, without a referee it isn't a game, it's a brawl with a ball in it. Somebody has to stay neutral when nobody else wants to be.
rhodri_knight
Duw, there's a speech, I nearly cried. Go on, then, mark out a pitch, and you can blow that whistle twice, and not one more time.

sides.adrian_templar: fall back to the ridge as planned, everyone, now
sides.nicolas_bloodmage: not without the one who's still down there

arguments.third: Adrian holds the ridge with the rest, and Nicolas goes down for the straggler with one other person, not alone.
lines: adrian_templar
Squad, the plan is the ridge, now, together. Nicolas, I know, but if we stay we lose four to save one, and I've done the sum.
nicolas_bloodmage
Then I'm the one who doesn't do the sum, Adrian. There's somebody still down there, and I don't leave people. Not for a plan, not for anything.
adrian_templar
Then you don't go alone, that's my condition. Take one more with you, and the rest of us hold the ridge until you're back, properly.

sides.tarek_templar: dig a well by the camp, it's safer and it lasts
sides.giorgi_primalist: the sheep know a good spring, follow the flock and drink there

arguments.third: They follow the animals to the spring, and Tarek sinks a well beside it so the water stays clean.
lines: tarek_templar
Giorgi, if we dig a well here by the camp, it lasts for years. Give me a few days and some stone, and nobody needs to walk for water.
giorgi_primalist
Twenty summers I follow the sheep, my friend. They find good water before any man. Follow them, and the spring is already there.
tarek_templar
Then we follow your sheep and I build at the spring they choose. Your animals do the surveying, and I do the stone, a fair split.

sides.ivan_warrior: stay on the road in line, like a tram, steady and safe
sides.nicolas_bloodmage: weave through, the gap is there, take it

arguments.third: Ivan leads the slow way with the carts, Nicolas scouts ahead through the gaps, and they meet at the far side within a minute.
lines: ivan_warrior
Nicolas, a road is a road, my friend. You stay in line, steady, like Route 13, and everybody arrives. Weaving is how passengers get hurt.
nicolas_bloodmage
Pata, nine years on a moto in Lima, if I waited in line people died in the back of taxis. The gap is there, you take it.
ivan_warrior
Fine, you weave, I drive the carts, and we see who is late. I am never late, my friend, eleven years and never.

sides.iker_guardian: push the pace, we'll be at the top by noon
sides.pasang_primalist: slowly, or half of us won't reach the top at all

arguments.third: Pasang sets the pace, and Iker runs up and down the line encouraging everybody, which tires only Iker.
lines: iker_guardian
Pasang, champion, at this speed we'll reach the top next week! Come on, double time, everybody can do it, I believe in them!
pasang_primalist
Iker, everybody can do it once, yes. Then on day four they sit down and don't get up. Bistarai, slowly, and they all arrive.
iker_guardian
Okay, okay, your pace, the mountain expert wins. But I'm allowed to cheer, that's not running, that's coaching!

sides.mateo_starcaller: travel by night, the stars are clear and I can navigate
sides.driss_shaman: travel at dawn, the ground is safer when you can see it

arguments.third: They leave two hours before dawn, Mateo navigating by the stars and Driss reading the ground as the light comes.
lines: mateo_starcaller
Driss, po, look at that sky, not a cloud, every star exactly where I mapped it. We could walk all night and never lose the road.
driss_shaman
The stars are beautiful, my friend, but the ground has holes in it, and holes don't show in starlight. In the desert we start at dawn.
mateo_starcaller
Then we split it, ya. Two hours before dawn, I steer by the stars, and you take over when you can see your holes.

sides.rhys_ranger: quiet in the woods, Tegan can't hunt with shouting
sides.iker_guardian: the team needs encouragement, loud encouragement

arguments.third: Iker coaches in sign language in the woods, badly, and Tegan catches three rabbits.
lines: rhys_ranger
Iker, please, I'm asking nicely, can you stop shouting come on in the woods? Every animal for a mile has run off, and Tegan's sulking.
iker_guardian
Rhys, champion, the team needs energy! If I stop shouting, they'll slow down, I know these people!
rhys_ranger
Then shout with your hands, cariad, wave, point, anything. Tegan will love you for it, and she doesn't love anybody.

sides.bakyt_hunter: an eagle is the true hunting bird, strong enough for a wolf
sides.rhys_ranger: a hawk is quicker and smarter, and she works with you

arguments.third: They fly both birds together at dusk, and argue for an hour about which one actually caught the hare.
lines: bakyt_hunter
Rhys, my friend, your hawk is very pretty. But my eagle takes a fox, a wolf even. That is a hunting bird, jakshy.
rhys_ranger
Your eagle's lovely, Bakyt, honest. But Tegan turns on a coin and comes back when I whistle. Yours comes back when she's finished thinking about it.
bakyt_hunter
Ha, this is true, she thinks a lot, like a grandmother. Tonight we fly both, and the hare decides who is best.

sides.cristobal_knight: straight up the gully, it's quicker, I've climbed worse
sides.pasang_primalist: the gully is where the stones come down in the afternoon

arguments.third: They take the gully at dawn, before the sun loosens the stones, and Cristobal admits it was very loud up there.
lines: cristobal_knight
Pasang, hermano, straight up that gully and we're at the top in an hour. I've climbed burning hillsides worse than that.
pasang_primalist
Burning hills don't throw rocks at you, Cristobal. That gully does, every afternoon, when the sun warms the ice. I've watched it all week.
cristobal_knight
Okay, okay, you've watched it, I've only looked at it. Dawn, then, before the rocks wake up, and I'll stop calling you slow.

sides.iker_guardian: let them play, the game needs energy, not whistles
sides.adrian_templar: without rules the game is a brawl, and somebody gets hurt

arguments.third: Adrian referees the match properly, Iker coaches both sides at once, and nobody's quite sure who won.
lines: iker_guardian
Adrian, my friend, you've blown that whistle nine times in ten minutes! Let them play, venga, the game's dying of boredom.
adrian_templar
Nine fouls, Iker, nine. If I let them play like that, somebody's going to the healer with a broken ankle, and it'll be a farmhand.
iker_guardian
Okay, you keep the whistle, I keep the shouting, and between us we'll make a real team. Spain against Spain, the referee always wins.

sides.mateo_starcaller: the sky will clear by midnight, stay up and observe
sides.marcus_stormbringer: that front isn't clearing tonight, go to sleep

arguments.third: They both stay up, the sky clears at three in the morning, and they each insist it was their forecast.
lines: mateo_starcaller
Marcus, po, those clouds are moving east, it'll be clear by midnight. Stay up with me, it's going to be a beautiful night.
marcus_stormbringer
Sorry, Mateo, but that's a slow front with a lot of moisture behind it. Clear by three at the earliest, and I'd bet on dawn.
mateo_starcaller
Then we both stay up and see who's right, ya, with tea. I'll bring the star chart, you bring your terrible weather jokes.

sides.driss_shaman: ration the water, we have three days to the next spring
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: a proper meal needs a proper pot of water

arguments.third: Sebastian grills instead of boiling, and Driss lets him have one pot for the tea.
lines: driss_shaman
Sebastian, my friend, that pot is half our water, and the next spring is three days away. Forgive me, but the pasta can wait.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Driss, you can't feed people on rations and good manners! They need a hot meal, a big one, it's medicine.
driss_shaman
Then grill the meat, my friend, which needs no water at all, and leave me one pot for tea. Everyone eats, and everyone drinks.

sides.ryan_warlock: take the goblins' contract, the money's good, sort the details later
sides.driss_shaman: not without a proper water allowance written in

arguments.third: Ryan rewrites the contract with a water clause, Driss reads it twice, and the goblins sign it, grumbling.
lines: ryan_warlock
Driss, lads, the goblins are offering double for this run. Sign it, we'll sort the small print once we're moving.
driss_shaman
The small print is where the water lives, Ryan. I've refused two contracts over the water allowance, and both came back with a better one.
ryan_warlock
Jesus, a man after my own heart, you're right, it's always the clause they hide. Give it here, I'll write the water in myself.

sides.ivan_warrior: everybody sleeps by midnight, we leave at six
sides.mateo_starcaller: the best sky is at three in the morning, and I'll be fine

arguments.third: Mateo sleeps until two, Ivan wakes him with a tram bell, and they watch the sky together for an hour.
lines: ivan_warrior
Mateo, it's midnight, and you are still lying in the grass looking up. We leave at six, and I don't wait for passengers.
mateo_starcaller
Ivan, po, the best part of the night is at three, the dark between the moons. Half an hour, I promise, I'll be fresh as anything.
ivan_warrior
You said half an hour last night, and it was three hours. Fine, sleep now, I wake you at two, and then you look, and I look too.

sides.rhys_ranger: turn that machine off, it's terrifying the hawk
sides.diego_tinker: it's nearly working, she just needs five more minutes

arguments.third: Diego works on it inside the tent, and Tegan watches him through the flap with great suspicion.
lines: rhys_ranger
Diego, please, cariad, that machine's been clanking for an hour, and Tegan's pulling her feathers out. Turn it off, I'm begging you.
diego_tinker
Five minutes, my friend, she's nearly working, I can hear it, sure, sure! When she's done she'll be very quiet, I promise.
rhys_ranger
Then finish her inside the tent, with the flap shut. Tegan can glare at you from out here, and she will, mind.

sides.enzo_cultist: the best pizza fritta is on Via Toledo, everyone knows
sides.marco_paladin: the best is the little window off Vico Lungo, for fifty years

arguments.third: They agree to disagree, and agree that anybody from outside the Spanish Quarter wouldn't understand anyway.
lines: enzo_cultist
Marco, uaglio, you're from the Quartieri too, so you know. The best pizza fritta is the stand on Via Toledo, no question.
marco_paladin
Allora, Enzo, no, the stand on Via Toledo is for tourists. The little window off Vico Lungo, the old woman, fifty years. That is pizza fritta.
enzo_cultist
Mannaggia, the old woman with the cat? Okay, okay, she's very good, I'll give you that. But Toledo is faster when you're late.

sides.enzo_cultist: that touch was mine, clean, before the counter
sides.adrian_templar: it was simultaneous, no point to either of you

arguments.third: They fence the point again with Adrian refereeing properly, and Enzo wins it, fairly, by a hair.
lines: enzo_cultist
Adrian, you saw it, you're a referee. My touch landed first, clean, before his counter. That's my point.
adrian_templar
With respect, Enzo, I saw both land at once. Simultaneous, no point awarded, and I'd make the same call in a final.
enzo_cultist
Madonna, a real referee, at last, and he's against me. Fine, again, from en garde, and you watch my feet this time, properly.

sides.leif_primalist: notch it on the downhill side, let it fall down the slope
sides.eino_barbarian: fall it across the slope, it won't slide into the camp

arguments.third: Eino cuts the notch, Leif sets the back cut, and the tree lands exactly between both of their marks.
lines: leif_primalist
Eino, notch her on the downhill side and she'll go right down the slope, nice and easy. Pretty simple, I figure.
eino_barbarian
Downhill, it slides, into the camp. Across the slope, it stops. I've seen both.
leif_primalist
Huh, yep, fair, I didn't look at the camp. Okay, you notch, I'll do the back cut, and we'll see who's buying the coffee.

sides.berat_tinker: Eino needs to talk, it's not healthy to keep everything in
sides.eino_barbarian: talking is not required, the silence is fine

arguments.third: Berat talks, Eino listens, and once an hour Eino says one word, which Berat celebrates like a birthday.
lines: berat_tinker
Eino, my dear, family, you've said four words today, I counted! Open your mouth, I'll even check your teeth while you talk.
eino_barbarian
Four is enough. Teeth are fine, thank you.
berat_tinker
That's six now, he's warming up! Okay, I talk, you listen, and every hour you give me one word, deal?

sides.tomas_warrior: the bridge looks fine, rig a line and cross it now
sides.henrik_mage: measure the load first, the left cable is fraying

arguments.third: Henrik measures, Tomas rigs a safety line to the good cable, and they cross one at a time.
lines: tomas_warrior
Henrik, the bridge looks solid, crew. I'll rig a line across, everybody clips in, and we're over in ten minutes.
henrik_mage
Looks solid is not a load rating, Tomas. The left cable is fraying at the third anchor. I'd like twenty minutes to measure.
tomas_warrior
Twenty minutes, then, and I'll tie the safety line to your good cable. You measure, I rig, and nobody falls today.

sides.diego_tinker: switch it on now and see what happens, that's how you learn
sides.henrik_mage: calculate what happens first, and stand further back

arguments.third: Diego switches it on from behind Henrik's ice wall, and the thing only partly explodes.
lines: diego_tinker
Henrik, my friend, she's ready, I'm switching her on, sure, sure! The only way to know is to try, that's science!
henrik_mage
That is the opposite of science, Diego. Science is knowing before you try. Give me five minutes and a pencil, please.
diego_tinker
Five minutes, okay, but I'm switching her on at the end anyway! Build me a wall of ice to hide behind, and we'll both be happy.

sides.thiago_paladin: carry him flat, on a stretcher, four people, slowly
sides.liam_suncleric: fireman's carry, now, we can't wait for a stretcher out here

arguments.third: They build a quick stretcher from two spears and a cloak, and carry him flat but fast.
lines: thiago_paladin
Liam, meu irmao, his back might be hurt, we carry him flat, four of us, on a stretcher. Slowly, please, I'm begging.
liam_suncleric
Mate, we're in the open with things in the trees. Fireman's carry, now, and we sort the back out under cover.
thiago_paladin
Then a stretcher in two minutes, two spears and a cloak, uai. Flat and fast, both of us happy, and nobody's spine folded in half.

sides.thiago_paladin: the boy who ran from the fight deserves another chance
sides.ryan_warlock: he ran once, he'll run again, don't count on him

arguments.third: They give the boy a small job at the back, and he does it, and Ryan says nothing for once.
lines: thiago_paladin
Ryan, the boy ran, yes, he was terrified. Give him another chance, meu irmao, people get braver if somebody believes in them.
ryan_warlock
And people who run once run twice, lads, I've watched it in boardrooms for twelve years. Don't build anything on him.
thiago_paladin
Then a small job, at the back, nothing that kills anybody if he runs. And if he stays, you buy him a drink.

sides.iker_guardian: ten more reps, everybody, come on, push through
sides.junseo_reaper: rest when the body says rest, I did nine years of pushing

arguments.third: Iker counts reps for everybody else, and Jun-seo carves, and Iker lets him, eventually.
lines: iker_guardian
Jun-seo, champion, ten more reps, come on, push through, you're the fastest one here, venga, venga!
junseo_reaper
Iker, I did nine years of ten more. The foreman shouted it every hour. Today I rest, please.
iker_guardian
Okay, okay, no shouting, I hear you. You carve, and I'll count your cuts instead, quietly, it's still coaching.

sides.dan_warrior: I buy the first round, always, sit down
sides.junseo_reaper: I pour for everybody, it's what I do

arguments.third: Dan buys the round, Jun-seo pours it, and neither of them lets the other say thank you.
lines: dan_warrior
Sit down, lad, I'm getting these, I always get the first round. Don't argue, it's tradition.
junseo_reaper
Dan, please, I always pour, at every rest, for everyone. If I don't pour, my hands don't know what to do.
dan_warrior
Right, then, I pay and you pour, and neither of us says thank you. Sorted, that's a proper shift agreement.

sides.henrik_mage: your flourishes cost time and margin, fight plainly
sides.enzo_cultist: style is part of the blade, uaglio, it frightens them

arguments.third: Henrik times Enzo's next fight with and without the flourish, and the flourish costs four tenths of a second.
lines: henrik_mage
Enzo, I timed your last fight. The spin before the final strike cost you four tenths of a second and most of your safety margin.
enzo_cultist
Four tenths of a second of pure beauty, Henrik! The enemy sees that and knows he's losing, it's half the fight.
henrik_mage
Then flourish when they're already down, and fight plainly when they're not. I'll keep timing, and we'll both learn something.

topics.question: what's the one thing from home you miss most, people aside?

player.text: Hot showers, every single day of my life.
Knowing what tomorrow would look like.
You first, I'm still thinking.
Ask me another night, if that's all right.

topics.question: where did you sleep your first night here, after it happened?

player.text: Up a tree, cold, and very angry about it.
I didn't sleep, I just sat up until it got light.
I want to hear everyone else's first.
Somewhere I'd rather not go back to, even in a story.

topics.question: what was the worst day you ever had at work, back on Earth?

player.text: Any day that started with a meeting about meetings.
The day I realised I was good at a job I hated.
Mine's boring next to these, keep going.
I'll skip this one, I left all that behind.

topics.question: if you could have one meal tonight, any meal at all, what would it be?

player.text: Whatever's cooking right now, I'm starving.
Something somebody made for me without being asked.
Tell me about yours, I'll steal the best one.
Don't make me think about food I can't have.

topics.question: what's the most useless thing you're still very good at?

player.text: Parallel parking, and there isn't a car for a thousand miles.
Pretending I'm fine, which turns out to be useless here.
I want to hear what everyone else has got.
Nothing I'm going to admit to in front of this lot.

topics.question: be fair, what's one thing that's actually better here?

player.text: No alarm clocks, ever.
The company, mostly, which I didn't expect.
Go round first, I want to hear the answers.
Ask me when nothing's trying to eat us.

topics.question: what's the worst trouble you ever got into as a kid?

player.text: Too much to pick from, and some of it's still classified.
Nothing big, I was the one who never got caught.
This I have to hear, who's first?
I'll keep my childhood to myself, thanks.

topics.question: when all this is over, where would you settle down?

player.text: Anywhere with a roof that doesn't leak.
Wherever this lot ends up, probably.
I'm still deciding, tell me yours.
Let's get through tomorrow first.

lines: esteban_bloodmage
Colleagues, a professional question. When {player} takes a hit and walks it off, as they always do, should we intervene?
liam_suncleric
Nah, mate, if they're breathing fine and the colour's good, I sit them down for five minutes and a cup of tea.
nicolas_bloodmage
I check the colour twice, ya. But {player} holds their side all the way back sometimes, causas, I've seen it.
esteban_bloodmage
Then two of us have noticed and nobody has acted. That's a poor record for three medics, and I include myself.
liam_suncleric
Fair point, Esteban, though you'd have had them on a table with your sleeves rolled up by now, admit it.
esteban_bloodmage
I would have examined them properly, yes. That's what the word medicine means, Liam, despite what the Blue Mountains taught you.
nicolas_bloodmage
Oe, both of you, before you start. Let's just ask {player} how they feel.

options.text: I'm fine, stop fussing, all three of you.
reply: liam_suncleric
Ha, fair enough, that's a patient who's going to live. Kettle on, then.
esteban_bloodmage
Noted, under protest. I'll check them tomorrow regardless.

options.text: Since you ask, it does hurt. Somebody have a look.
reply: nicolas_bloodmage
Ya, I knew it, thank you for saying it, pata. Sit down, I'll look.
esteban_bloodmage
And I'll observe, quietly, with only minor comments.

options.text: Whoever's least smug gets to look.
reply: liam_suncleric
That rules Esteban out, then, sorry, mate.
esteban_bloodmage
It rules everyone out, I'd say. Nicolas, you're the least objectionable, go on.

silent: liam_suncleric
Not answering, eh? That's a yes, they hurt. Nicolas, you're up, mate.

lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Chicos, it's simple, I do the meat, everybody else stands back and admires. That's how a grill works.
yiannis_paladin
Ela, Sebastian, the meat is nothing without the fish, and the fish is mine. Children, tell him.
tarek_templar
And neither of you is cooking anything until I've checked the water you washed it in. That stream is a disgrace.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Tarek, you check water like my grandmother checked boyfriends, very suspicious and never satisfied.
tarek_templar
Your grandmother was right, then, about both. Meanwhile {player} hasn't eaten since this morning, and that's the real problem here.
yiannis_paladin
Panagia mou, the child is starving while three old men argue about the stove. Shame on all of us.
sebastian_bloodmage
Fine, fine, first plate to {player}, and then we go back to arguing about who's best. Nobody touches my grill.
minh_chronomancer
Four in the morning, and here we are again, the three of us. I believe this is a pattern, gentlemen.
owen_cultist
Night people, see, it's in the bones. Eight years on the M4 and you never sleep proper again, mind.
ivan_warrior
Eleven years on Route 13, and I sleep perfectly well. I'm awake because Owen is humming.
owen_cultist
Duw, was I? Sorry, bach, I don't always notice. Chapel hymns, they creep in when it's quiet.
minh_chronomancer
It's fine, it helps me keep time. Owen hums, I count, Ivan complains, and {player} sleeps through all of it.
ivan_warrior
{player} sleeps like a passenger at the end of the line. Mouth open, very peaceful, I'm jealous.
owen_cultist
Leave them be, now then. Somebody in this camp ought to get a full night, and it won't be us three.
emre_rogue
Marco, have you noticed {player} carries a knife and no picks? One day they'll try it on a chest, my friend, a kitchen knife on a chest.
marco_paladin
Madonna, I've thought the same. The lock will cry, Emre, I'll hear it from the road.
emre_rogue
We have to teach them, it's a moral duty. Somebody who treats a lock like that will eventually treat a door like that.
marco_paladin
Allora, I teach the patience, you teach the listening, and {player} learns to put the knife away first.
emre_rogue
Agreed, though your patience is slower than my listening, and my listening is very slow.
marco_paladin
Piano, piano, my friend, that's the whole lesson. The lock was never in a hurry, only the knife.

options.text: Fine, teach me. No knives, I promise.
reply: emre_rogue
Tamam, a student at last. Sit down, and be quiet, that's the first lesson.
marco_paladin
And the second is also be quiet. You'll be good, I think, eventually.
marco_paladin
It opened, yes, the way a window opens when you throw a chair through it.
emre_rogue
We'll try again in a week, when the lock has stopped grieving.

silent: emre_rogue
Silence, which in a student is promising. We start tomorrow, whether you agree or not.

lines: rhodri_knight
Owen, butt, I've been teaching {player} to say Llanfairpwllgwyngyll and it's a disgrace, isn't it.
owen_cultist
Now then, Rhodri, nobody says the whole thing on the first go. Took me till I was twelve, and I'm from Barry.
rhodri_knight
Barry, that's barely Wales, mind, that's Cardiff's back garden. Ponty's the real thing.
owen_cultist
Duw, here we go. You valleys boys and your hills, all rain and no chips.
rhodri_knight
We've got chips, we've got rugby, and we've got a choir in every chapel. {player}, back me up here, butt.
owen_cultist
Don't drag the poor soul into it. They can't even say the name of the village yet.
adrian_templar
Callum, I gave the plan once, clearly. Front holds, back heals, nobody wanders off. And then you wandered off.
callum_venomancer
Mate, there was a snake, a beauty, a new one, nobody's ever seen it. I couldn't just leave it there.
adrian_templar
There were also four bandits, which everybody had seen, and {player} was in the middle of them.
callum_venomancer
And {player} was fine, mate, they handled it, they always do. I was gone for thirty seconds.
adrian_templar
Forty one seconds. I count, Callum, it's what I did for twenty one years, and it was forty one.
callum_venomancer
Strewth, you actually counted, didn't you? Fair enough, I'll give you that, that's dedication.
adrian_templar
It isn't dedication, it's the minimum. {player}, you were there, tell him.

options.text: Adrian's right, Callum. Stay with the group.
reply: adrian_templar
Thank you, {player}, fairly said. That's all I wanted.
callum_venomancer
Yeah, alright, I hear you. I'll stay put, mostly, unless it's a really good snake.

options.text: I was fine. But next time, take me with you to see the snake.
reply: callum_venomancer
Ha, now that's a deal, mate! You and me, snake hunting, Adrian can count.
adrian_templar
Hostia, now there are two of them. I'll start counting for both of you, then.
adrian_templar
Fair enough, it's ours to settle. Callum, forty one seconds, and we'll leave it there.
callum_venomancer
Forty one, mate, fine, I'll get it down to twenty.

silent: callum_venomancer
Nobody's backing you, Adrian, see? Forty one seconds of my life well spent, mate.
adrian_templar
Silence isn't agreement, Callum. I'll be keeping count.

lines: ryan_warlock
I'll say it, lads, since nobody else will. People here are no better than at home. Same greed, worse teeth.
pavlo_knight
And why do you think that is, Ryan? Because you've decided it already, so every greedy man proves you right.
ryan_warlock
Or because I spent twelve years watching people sell their own grandmothers, and I'm good at spotting the type.
pavlo_knight
Then spot this one, Ryan. {player} walks into other people's trouble every week for nothing, and never asks for a fee.
ryan_warlock
True enough, I've watched it. That's either a very good person or a very bad investor.
pavlo_knight
In my experience, class, the two often go together. You might try it some time.
ryan_warlock
I might, teacher, I might. Don't hold your breath, mind, I've got a reputation to keep.
leif_primalist
Quiet night, this. Yep, the three of us, nobody talking, and {player} doing all the talking. Works for me.
haruto_runemaster
I find it restful. {player} talks, and the three of us listen, like a good audience at a recital.
matias_reaper
On the bus it was the same, ya. One talks, forty listen, and the forty are happy.
leif_primalist
Huh, that's true, I never thought about it like that. Somebody has to fill the air, I guess, and it's not going to be me.
haruto_runemaster
Nor me, I'm afraid. I spent twenty years making one mark a day and saying nothing.
matias_reaper
Then we are the passengers, cabros, and {player} is the radio. It's good, ya, a good bus.
sebastian_bloodmage
Chicos, four of us at one fire, and we all speak Spanish, and nobody can understand anybody else. Que hermoso, chicos.
orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, papi, you speak Argentinian, that's singing, not Spanish. Puerto Rico speaks it properly, mi amor.
cristobal_knight
Properly, he says? Hermano, you drop half the letters, it's like listening to a radio in a tunnel!
nicolas_bloodmage
And Chileans, pata, you talk so fast even Chileans need subtitles. Cachai, weon, all that.
cristobal_knight
Oye, that's Chilean poetry, Nicolas. Peruvians just say causa to everything and hope for the best.
orlando_witchdoctor
Mi gente, enough, {player} is sitting there looking at us like we're a telenovela with no subtitles.
sebastian_bloodmage
Then {player} learns one word tonight, che, and it's the most important one, which is asado.

reply: sebastian_bloodmage
Perfecto, a fluent speaker already! First plate, chicos, the student has earned it.
cristobal_knight
One word and you're already more Argentinian than me, que verguenza.

options.text: Teach me something from all four of you.
reply: orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, mi amor, a diplomat! Okay, one word each, and nobody fights.
nicolas_bloodmage
Mine is chevere, pata, it means good, and it fixes most things.

options.text: I understood all of it, actually.
reply: cristobal_knight
All of it? Hermanos, we've been insulting each other in front of a witness!
orlando_witchdoctor
Then you heard what he said about my letters, and you'll defend my honour, papi.

silent: nicolas_bloodmage
{player} says nothing, causas. Smart, that's how you survive a table like this one.

lines: marcus_stormbringer
So the interesting thing about tonight's sky, team, is the pressure gradient, which, sorry, I'll keep it short, is fascinating.
berat_tinker
Marcus, family, you're beautiful, come here, I'm hugging you now, nobody stop me.
dan_warrior
Give over, the pair of you. One of you's explaining the clouds and the other's hugging the bloke explaining the clouds.
berat_tinker
Dan, my dear, you need a hug more than anyone here. Your jaw is so tight I can hear your molars from here.
dan_warrior
My molars are fine, ta. {player}, tell them I don't need a hug, love, before he gets any closer.
marcus_stormbringer
Statistically, Dan, you're the one who'd benefit most. I could show you the numbers, sorry, if you like.
dan_warrior
You lot are a nightmare. Right, one hug, and if either of you mentions it tomorrow I'm off home.
giorgi_primalist
Bakyt, my friend, look at {player} walking. Like a lamb on the first day, all legs, very brave.
bakyt_hunter
Jakshy, a good lamb. It doesn't know the mountain yet, but it walks anyway. This is the best kind.
giorgi_primalist
In Kazbegi we put the young ones in the middle of the flock, so the wolves find the old ones first.
bakyt_hunter
In the Tian Shan the same. Then we are the old ones, Giorgi, and {player} walks in the middle.
giorgi_primalist
Good, then this is decided. Old shepherds on the outside, my friend, and the lamb safe inside.
silas_rogue
A little game, ladies and gents. I read each of you from across the fire, and you tell me if I'm wrong.
diego_tinker
Me first, me first, my friend, read me, I'm an open book, a very messy book with pictures!
silas_rogue
Diego, you've taken apart four things today and put back three. The fourth is in your left pocket.
diego_tinker
That's, okay, that's frightening, yes, it's a hinge, I'll put it back, sure, sure, later.
tomas_warrior
Don't read me, Silas, I'm not interested in being read. I check my knots, I go to bed.
silas_rogue
You already did, Tomas, twice, and you checked {player}'s straps when they weren't looking. Kind of you.
tomas_warrior
Somebody has to, crew, they tie a knot like a man who's never fallen. Don't make it a thing, Silas.
tarek_templar
Adrian's doing it again, {player}. Standing at the edge with his hands behind his back, waiting for permission.
adrian_templar
I'm not waiting for anything, Tarek. I'm standing, which is allowed, and I'm counting heads.
tarek_templar
You counted them ten minutes ago, habibi. There are still the same number of heads, I promise you.
adrian_templar
Then I'll count them again properly, to be thorough. It isn't a crime to be thorough.
tarek_templar
It's a crime to let the food go cold. {player}, tell him to sit, he listens to you more than me.

options.text: Adrian, sit down. There's a place next to me.
reply: adrian_templar
Well, if you insist, then I'll sit, properly. Thank you, {player}.
tarek_templar
You see that, {player}? Three years I've been trying that. Here, bread, both of you.

options.text: Let him count. Tarek, just save him a plate.
reply: tarek_templar
Fine, a plate saved, and I'll guard it like a well. He'll come, he always does.
adrian_templar
I will come, eventually, once I've finished. Thank you for the plate, Tarek.

silent: tarek_templar
Nobody's going to make you, then, Adrian. So I'm just going to put the bread next to you and walk away.
adrian_templar
That's very sneaky, Tarek. Fine, I'm sitting, and only because the bread is warm.

lines: cristobal_knight
Esteban, two men from Valparaiso, and you've never once come to a fiesta. Not one, hermano, it's a scandal.
esteban_bloodmage
I spent nineteen years sewing up what came out of those fiestas, Cristobal. I've seen enough of them from the other end.
cristobal_knight
Ay, that's dark, even for you. You need to dance, it would do you good, doctor's orders.
esteban_bloodmage
I'm the doctor, so the orders are mine, and they say no. You, on the other hand, should stop running into burning things.
cristobal_knight
Somebody has to run in, Esteban, or there's nothing left for you to sew up afterwards.
esteban_bloodmage
That's a fair point, and an irritating one. {player}, I'd appreciate it if you didn't encourage him.
giorgi_primalist
Three mountain men at one fire, my friends. In Kazbegi this would need a toast, and a long one.
bakyt_hunter
In the Tian Shan also, jakshy. But first tea, because a toast without tea is only noise.
pasang_primalist
Butter tea, then, I made plenty. Nobody likes it, but it's very good for you at altitude.
giorgi_primalist
This is terrible, Pasang, really terrible. I'll have another cup, to be polite.
bakyt_hunter
Look at {player}, friends, drinking it with a brave face, like a young herder at his first feast.
pasang_primalist
Ramro, a good sign, that face. On day four they'll ask for it, and then they'll be one of us.
mateo_starcaller
Chiquillos, look, that's the one I've named the Lantern, the bright one low in the south. Isn't it beautiful, po?
minh_chronomancer
It's also moving, Mateo, slowly, on a heading of about two hundred. I've been tracking it for an hour. I think it's a planet.
marcus_stormbringer
Sorry, both of you, but there's a band of high cloud coming in from the west in about forty minutes, so enjoy it while it lasts.
mateo_starcaller
Ay, Marcus, you always do this, you bring the clouds with you like a bad uncle.
minh_chronomancer
He doesn't bring them, he forecasts them. Although he does seem pleased when he's right.
marcus_stormbringer
Only a little pleased, team. {player}, back me up, I said cloud by midnight, didn't I?

reply: marcus_stormbringer
Thank you, {player}, vindicated, and I'll try not to mention it again until breakfast.
mateo_starcaller
Ya, ya, fine, but the Lantern will still be there tomorrow, po, and so will I.

options.text: I wasn't listening, I was looking at the Lantern.
reply: mateo_starcaller
You see, chiquillos? A true observer, {player} looked up! There's hope for this party.
minh_chronomancer
Copy that, one vote for the sky, none for the weather. Marcus, you're outnumbered.

options.text: Minh, is it a planet or not?
reply: minh_chronomancer
I'll confirm by dawn, {player}. Sequence first, then conclusions.
mateo_starcaller
If it's a planet, I'm naming it after all four of us, po, and the cloud gets nothing.

silent: minh_chronomancer
No answer from {player}, which on my frequency means carry on. So, carry on, everyone.

lines: iker_guardian
Champions, it's decided, tomorrow there's a match in that field, five a side, and Adrian's refereeing!
adrian_templar
I agreed to referee, Iker, I didn't agree to a crowd. And I'll be applying the laws properly, everyone should know that now.
rhys_ranger
I'll watch from the trees, if that's all right, with Tegan. She's not keen on shouting, and there'll be a lot of it.
iker_guardian
No, no, Rhys, you're in goal, you've got the best hands here! You catch a hawk, you can catch a ball.
adrian_templar
He doesn't have to play if he doesn't want to, Iker. Nobody's forced onto my pitch.
iker_guardian
Fine, fine, the referee has spoken. {player}, you're on my team, obviously, unless you want to lose.

options.text: I'm on your team, Iker. Let's win.
reply: iker_guardian
Aupa, that's my champion! Tomorrow we train at dawn, then we win at noon.
adrian_templar
And I'll be watching you both very closely, properly, with the whistle.

options.text: I'll keep goal with Rhys in the trees.
reply: rhys_ranger
Oh, tidy, thanks, cariad. We'll keep score from up there, quietly.
iker_guardian
Two substitutes in a tree, champions, that's a first. Fine, but you're cheering.
adrian_templar
A linesman, at last. Thank you, {player}, I'll explain offside tonight, properly, twice.
iker_guardian
Two referees on one pitch? Ostia, we'll never get a goal past either of you.

silent: iker_guardian
No answer means yes, champion, you're on my team. Training at dawn!

lines: driss_shaman
Mateo, my friend, I've guided caravans by the stars for twenty eight years. Tonight I'd like to hear them from a man who knows their names.
mateo_starcaller
Ay, Driss, that's the nicest thing anybody's said to me in a year, po. But these aren't my stars, I'm naming them as I go.
driss_shaman
Then name one for the caravans, please, a bright one in the south. Something a lost traveller could follow home.
mateo_starcaller
Done, ya, that one there, the bright one over the Flats. I'll call it the Guide, and it goes on the map tonight.
driss_shaman
Shukran, my friend. {player}, you're our witness, so the name is official.
rhodri_knight
Three Welshmen at one fire, boys, isn't it lush? We need a song, a proper one, all together now!
rhys_ranger
Not too loud, Rhodri, please, Tegan's only just settled. She's not a big fan of male voice choirs.
owen_cultist
Now then, we can do it quiet, mind. Calon Lan, low and slow, the way they sing it at a funeral.
rhodri_knight
A funeral, Owen? Duw, I wanted a party, not a wake. Fine, low and slow, but I'm doing the harmony.
rhys_ranger
Tegan's watching {player}, boys. I think she wants to know if they can sing.
owen_cultist
Go on, bach, have a go with us. Nobody's judging, except the hawk, and she judges everybody.

options.text: Fine, but I don't know the words.
reply: rhodri_knight
Nobody knows the words, butt, that's half of Welsh singing. Just hum and look moved.
rhys_ranger
Tegan's settled, look. That's a good sign, that is.
owen_cultist
Fair enough, an audience, tidy. Right, boys, from the top, softly.
rhodri_knight
An audience of one and a hawk, the best crowd I've had in years.

silent: rhodri_knight
Shy, is it? Never mind, the three of us will carry it. From the top, boys.

lines: dan_warrior
Four of us who did proper shifts, round one fire. Steel, trams, rigging, and Jun-seo's shipyard. Nobody here's had a lie in for thirty years.
ivan_warrior
Eleven years on Route 13, I woke at three every morning. I still wake at three, here, with no tram.
junseo_reaper
Five in the morning for me, the end of the night shift. My body still wants to clock off at five.
tomas_warrior
Load out at two in the morning, every tour. I still check the rigging in my sleep, crew.
dan_warrior
And {player} sleeps till the sun's up, look at them, never done a night shift in their life, the lucky sod.
junseo_reaper
It's okay, it's easier than the factory for everyone. Let them sleep, somebody should.
leif_primalist
Nice stand of trees over there, Eino. Pretty old, I'd say.
eino_barbarian
Joo, very old. Leave them standing.
leif_primalist
Yep, that's what I was thinking too. Didn't want to say it first.
eino_barbarian
Good, then we agree, and that's enough talking for today.
leif_primalist
{player} keeps looking at us like we're broken. We're fine, I promise, this is a conversation.
eino_barbarian
A long one, for us. My throat is tired.
thiago_paladin
Gente, three healers at one fire, so let's settle it. Who here is worst at looking after themselves?
liam_suncleric
Easy, mate, Nicolas. He's told everybody not to drag him if he goes down, which is the worst rule I've ever heard.
nicolas_bloodmage
Oe, Liam, you haven't slept a full night in fifteen years, pata, and you're judging me?
thiago_paladin
And I've sat up with somebody else every night since I got here, so we're all terrible, uai. Good, at least we're honest.
liam_suncleric
Here's a better question, team. Who's going to make {player} drink some water before bed? They never do.
nicolas_bloodmage
All three of us, causas, at once. They can't say no to three medics.

options.text: Fine, I'll drink the water. Happy?
reply: thiago_paladin
Very happy, meu irmao, that's the best patient I've had all week.
liam_suncleric
Good on ya, now all of us drink some, that's an order, team.

options.text: Only if all three of you go to sleep early.
reply: nicolas_bloodmage
Ya, okay, that's fair, a deal. The patient negotiates, causas.
thiago_paladin
Uai, outplayed by our own patient. Fine, early to bed, all of us.

silent: liam_suncleric
Not answering, eh? That's a no, then. Thiago, get the water, mate.

lines: cristobal_knight
Hermanos, there's a fire in the next valley, I can smell it. We go now, we put it out, simple.
diego_tinker
And I've got a machine that sprays water, my friends, nearly finished, sure, sure! Twenty minutes and she'll be perfect!
henrik_mage
Neither of you has asked what's burning, how big it is, or which way the wind is going. Those are the only questions that matter.
cristobal_knight
Henrik, I fought wildfires for twelve years, I know how to read a fire. You read numbers.
henrik_mage
Then read it aloud, please, and I'll write it down. Diego, your machine stays here until somebody's checked the pressure.
diego_tinker
Ay, the pressure is fine, mostly, probably. {player}, tell him, she only exploded once, and it was a small one.
haruto_runemaster
Jun-seo, a moment. You cut too quickly. The knife is ahead of your mind again.
junseo_reaper
Aigo, I know, I know. My hands want to finish, it's the line, nine years of it.
haruto_runemaster
Then put the knife down for a breath. Look at the wood. Decide the cut. Only then, the knife.
junseo_reaper
Okay, okay, slowly. Look, decide, then cut. It's like learning to walk again.
haruto_runemaster
It is exactly that. {player}, you're watching. Notice how much better that cut was.
iker_guardian
Champions, up, up, morning run, three laps of the camp before breakfast! Who's with me? Everybody's with me!
dan_warrior
It's half five, Iker. I've not had a brew, and I'm not running anywhere till I've had two.
callum_venomancer
I'm in, mate, as long as we go past the creek. There's a nest of something I want to check on.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, nobody runs before my grill is lit. You run, you come back, you eat, that's the order of the universe.
iker_guardian
Okay, okay, Callum and me, and {player} obviously, the three champions! The rest of you, cheer from the fire.
dan_warrior
I'll cheer, love, from under my blanket. Don't expect it to be loud.

reply: iker_guardian
Aupa, that's my champion! Venga, Callum, the creek is lap one.
sebastian_bloodmage
Three laps, then the best breakfast of your life, chicos, I promise.
dan_warrior
Now that's a sensible person, that is. Kettle's on, sit down.
iker_guardian
Traitors, both of you, but I'll win you over by Tuesday.

silent: callum_venomancer
Silence means yes in Iker's rules, mate, sorry, so get your shoes on.

lines: driss_shaman
My friends, water first, always, then tea, poured from high so it sings. That's how a guest is welcomed at my fire.
tarek_templar
Water first, yes, but water I've checked. Then food, habibi, nobody drinks tea on an empty stomach in my house.
yiannis_paladin
Ela, children, water, then food, then wine, a little wine, and then the stories start. This is civilisation.
driss_shaman
Three hosts at one fire, and nobody's allowed to serve anybody. This could be a very long evening.
tarek_templar
Then we split it, like engineers. Driss pours the water, I cook, Yiannis brings the wine, and everybody's a guest.
yiannis_paladin
And {player} is the guest of honour, so {player} eats first. Sit, sit, child, before the three of us start fighting over you.
eino_barbarian
The sauna's ready now. Sondre and Ivan understand what it's for, and Rhodri will learn tonight.
sondre_stormbringer
Ah, finally, at last. In Bergen we'd sit in one and then jump off the pier into the fjord. It's very sensible, I promise.
ivan_warrior
In Novosibirsk we have the banya, with birch branches, and then snow. Here there is no snow, so I'll accept the river.
rhodri_knight
Hang on, boys, you're telling me you sit in a hot box on purpose, then jump in cold water, also on purpose? Duw, you're all mad.
eino_barbarian
Joo, we're mad. Come in, sit, say nothing for twenty minutes. You'll understand after.
sondre_stormbringer
{player}, you're coming too. Nobody's exempt, Eino's very strict about it.

options.text: Twenty minutes of silence? I'm in.
reply: eino_barbarian
That's good, then. The rule is no talking, and you already understand it.
rhodri_knight
Right, I'll come too, but if I faint, somebody carry me out, isn't it.

options.text: I'll mind the river and catch whoever jumps in.
reply: ivan_warrior
Good, a lifeguard. I'll be first in, and I'm very heavy.
eino_barbarian
Fine, next time you come in. That's a promise you're making.

silent: eino_barbarian
No answer means yes, in a sauna, so come and sit.

lines: orlando_witchdoctor
Enzo, mi amor, sit in my chair, please, I can't look at that hair for one more day. Who cut it, a sabre?
enzo_cultist
Nobody touches my hair, Orlando, uaglio. It's part of the look, the opponent sees it and knows he's lost.
cristobal_knight
Hermano, the opponent sees it and thinks a seagull landed on your head. Let the man cut it.
enzo_cultist
Mannaggia, from the man who lost his eyebrows to a barbecue? Fine, Orlando, a trim, only a trim.
orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, a trim, of course, papi, I'm very trustworthy. {player}, hold the mirror, and don't let him see until I'm done.
cristobal_knight
This is going to be the best thing that's happened all week. Somebody fetch the others.
